content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 10 del curso B1** (*Repaso 6–9*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [Repaso 6–9 B1](/blog/curso-b1/unidad-10-repaso-6-9)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 10 — Repaso 6–9](/curso-b1/unit-10)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Repaso 6–9](/blog/curso-b1/unit-10/review-map.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática](#leccion-1--gramatica)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario](#leccion-2--vocabulario)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: Mixed review paragraph](#leccion-3--reading)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: Emma's mixed plans](#leccion-4--listening)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing](#leccion-5--writing)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** futuros, was/were going to, modales, used to

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I ___ visit my parents next weekend. (plan) → *am going to / will / was going to*
2. She ___ be happy — she got promoted. → *must / might / can't*
3. I ___ play football when I was young. → *used to / am used to / get used to*
4. They ___ travel last summer but cancelled. → *were going to / are going to / will*
5. That ___ be him — he's in Paris. → *can't / must / might*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **am going to** · 2. **must** · 3. **used to** · 4. **were going to** · 5. **can't**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige / completa

1. Wait — I ___ help you. → *will / am going to / used to*
2. She ___ living in a big city. → *is used to / used to / was going to*
3. I ___ have left my keys at work. → *might / must / can't*
4. She ___ meeting her boss at 3. → *is / will / used to*
5. It took months to ___ living here. → *get used to / used to / must*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **will** · 2. **is used to** · 3. **might** · 4. **is** · 5. **get used to**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

1. *I am going to call you yesterday.*
2. *That mustn't be him.* (imposible)
3. *I am used to play tennis.*
4. *Look! It will rain.* (nubes negras)
5. *They was going to come.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I **was going to** call you yesterday.
2. That **can't** be him.
3. I am used to **playing** / I **used to play**…
4. It **is going to** rain.
5. They **were going to** come.

</details>

---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** travel, plans, feelings, habits (mix)

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja / elige

1. postpone → *posponer · must · continuous*
2. relieved → *aliviado · despegar · pueblo*
3. commuting → *ir/venir al trabajo · cancelar · anillo*
4. engaged → *prometido/a · horario · campo*
5. arrangement → *arreglo fijo · hábito pasado · imposibilidad*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **posponer** · 2. **aliviado** · 3. **ir/venir al trabajo** · 4. **prometido/a** · 5. **arreglo fijo**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

1. was going to = ___ → *plan fallido / hábito pasado / casi seguro*
2. used to = ___ → *hábito pasado / arreglo fijo / evidencia*
3. must = ___ → *casi seguro / posible / imposible*
4. can't = ___ → *imposible / plan / rutina*
5. get used to = ___ → *acostumbrarse / cancelar / despegar*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **plan fallido** · 2. **hábito pasado** · 3. **casi seguro** · 4. **imposible** · 5. **acostumbrarse**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — En contexto

11. Usa 3 palabras nuevas en frases con el foco gramatical.
12. Di en voz alta el vocabulario de la unidad.
13. Empareja cada palabra con un ejemplo personal.
14. Revisa la tabla de vocabulario de la [guía teórica](/blog/curso-b1/unidad-10-repaso-6-9).
15. Continúa en la [Unidad 10 del curso](/curso-b1/unit-10).

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11–13. Open answers — check meaning in theory. · 14. Theory vocab section. · 15. **/curso-b1/unit-10**

</details>

---

## Lección 3 — Reading: Mixed review paragraph

**Objetivo:** comprender un texto con el foco de la unidad.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-10/reading-workbook.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Mixed review paragraph"></audio>

> I used to live in a small town but now I live in London. I am meeting my sister at the airport next Saturday — she is flying from Spain. I have already booked my flight to Tokyo for next month. I was going to go last year but I cancelled because of work. My neighbour must be happy — he just moved into a new house. I am getting used to the busy city lifestyle.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Used to live in a small ___ → *town / castle / plane*
2. Lives now in ___ → *London / Tokyo / village*
3. Meeting sister at the ___ → *airport / park / office*
4. Sister is flying from ___ → *Spain / Japan / Italy*
5. Booked flight to ___ → *Tokyo / Paris / Rome*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **town** · 2. **London** · 3. **airport** · 4. **Spain** · 5. **Tokyo**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Was going to go last year but ___ → *cancelled because of work*
7. Neighbour must be ___ → *happy / angry / late*
8. Getting used to ___ lifestyle → *busy city / village / quiet*
9. Find a future form in the text
10. Find was going to

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **cancelled / work** · 7. **happy** · 8. **busy city** · 9. **am meeting / is flying / booked…** · 10. **I was going to go last year**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. Find must
12. Find used to / getting used to
13. Main idea? → *mixed / only A1 / empty*
14. Write 4 sentences: going to, was going to, must, used to
15. Course link → */curso-b1/unit-10*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **must be happy** · 12. **used to live / getting used to** · 13. **mixed B1 structures in one story** · 14. **Model OK** · 15. **/curso-b1/unit-10**

</details>

---

## Lección 4 — Listening: Emma's mixed plans

**Objetivo:** escuchar el foco gramatical en contexto.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-10/listening-workbook.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Emma's mixed plans"></audio>

> Hi, I am Emma. I used to work in an office but now I work from home. I am going to travel to Italy next month. I was going to go last year but I had to cancel because of work. My friend must be happy — she just got engaged. I am used to early flights now because I travel a lot.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Who speaks? → *Emma / Tom / Lisa*
2. Used to work in an ___ → *office / shop / farm*
3. Works now ___ → *from home / abroad*
4. Going to travel to ___ → *Italy / Japan / Spain*
5. Was going to go ___ year → *last / next / this*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Emma** · 2. **office** · 3. **from home** · 4. **Italy** · 5. **last**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Cancelled because of ___ → *work / weather / money*
7. Friend must be ___ → *happy / angry / late*
8. Friend just got ___ → *engaged / fired / lost*
9. Used to early ___ → *flights / classes / meals*
10. Find going to

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **work** · 7. **happy** · 8. **engaged** · 9. **flights** · 10. **am going to travel**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. Find was going to
12. Find must
13. Find used to / am used to
14. Shadow audio
15. Open Ver solución → *yes*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **was going to go last year** · 12. **must be happy** · 13. **used to work / am used to early flights** · 14. **done** · 15. **yes**

</details>

---

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

1. Una frase con cada: going to, was going to, must, can't, used to, get used to.
2. Completa: I ___ visit my parents next weekend. (plan)
3. Completa: I ___ call you yesterday but I forgot.
4. Completa: She ___ be happy — she got promoted.
5. Completa: That ___ be him — he's abroad.
6. Completa: I ___ play tennis when I was young.
7. Completa: She ___ living in London now.
8. Corrige: *I am going to call you yesterday.*
9. Corrige: *That mustn't be him.* (imposible)
10. Corrige: *I am used to play…*
11. Mini-historia (5 frases) mezclando U6–U9.
12. Matching mental: plan fallido vs hábito pasado.
13. Traduce: Iba a ir pero cancelé.
14. Traduce: Debe de estar emocionada.
15. Autochequeo con el mapa de la Unidad 10.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. Open — one of each structure.
2. **am going to**
3. **was going to**
4. **must**
5. **can't**
6. **used to**
7. **is used to**
8. I **was going to** call you yesterday.
9. That **can't** be him.
10. I am used to **playing** / I **used to play**.
11. Open mixed paragraph.
12. was going to = unfulfilled plan; used to = past habit.
13. I **was going to** go but I cancelled.
14. She **must** be excited.
15. Self-check vs review map.

</details>

---

## Cómo seguir

1. Repasa fallos en la [guía teórica](/blog/curso-b1/unidad-10-repaso-6-9).

author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 10 del curso B1: repaso integrado de futuros, was/were going to, modales de deducción y used to.

faqs.question: ¿Qué repasa la Unidad 10?
faqs.answer: Futuros (will, going to, present continuous), was/were going to, modales de deducción (must, might, can't) y used to / be used to / get used to, con vocabulario de travel, plans, feelings y habits.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo elijo entre will y going to?
faqs.answer: Going to = plan/evidencia; will = opinión, promesa o decisión espontánea; present continuous = arreglo fijo con hora/lugar.

faqs.question: ¿Was going to o used to?
faqs.answer: Was going to = un plan concreto que no se cumplió. Used to = hábito o estado habitual del pasado.

faqs.question: ¿Must o might?
faqs.answer: Must = casi seguro por evidencia. Might = posible. Can't = imposible.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico el repaso?
faqs.answer: En la [Unidad 10 del curso B1](/curso-b1/unit-10) y revisando las guías U6–U9 del blog.

content:
La **Unidad 10 del curso B1** (*Repaso 6–9*) integra lo aprendido desde los futuros hasta *used to*. Úsala como **chequeo** antes del Módulo 2 (condicionales).

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 10 — Repaso 6–9](/curso-b1/unit-10)  
> **Guías:** [U6](/blog/curso-b1/unidad-6-future-will-going-to) · [U7](/blog/curso-b1/unidad-7-was-were-going-to) · [U8](/blog/curso-b1/unidad-8-modals-deduction) · [U9](/blog/curso-b1/unidad-9-used-to-be-get-used-to)

---

## Qué repasas

![Mapa de repaso](/blog/curso-b1/unit-10/review-map.png)

| Unidad | Gramática | Vocabulario |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **6** | will / going to / present continuous | Travel & transport |
| **7** | was/were going to | Plans & intentions |
| **8** | must / might / can't | Personal feelings |
| **9** | used to / be used to / get used to | Habits & lifestyle |

---

## 1. Futuros (U6) — recordatorio

> I **am going to** visit my parents next weekend. *(plan)*  
> Wait, I **will** help you. *(espontáneo)*  
> She **is meeting** her boss at 3 PM. *(arreglo)*  
> Look at the clouds! It **is going to** rain. *(evidencia)*  
> We **are flying** to Rome on Friday. *(viaje fijo)*

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-10/future-review.mp3" title="🔊 Future forms review"></audio>

---

## 2. Was/were going to (U7)

> I **was going to** call you yesterday but I forgot.  
> They **were going to** travel to Spain last summer but cancelled.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-10/was-going-to-review.mp3" title="🔊 Was/were going to review"></audio>

---

## 3. Deducción (U8)

> She **must** be happy — she just got promoted.  
> That **can't** be him — he is in Paris this week.  
> I **might** have left my keys at the office.  
> They **must** be at home — the lights are on.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-10/modals-review.mp3" title="🔊 Modals of deduction review"></audio>

---

## 4. Used to trio (U9)

> I **used to** play football when I was young.  
> She **is used to** living in a big city.  
> It took me a few months to **get used to** living here.  
> They **got used to** the cold weather after a few months.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-10/used-to-review.mp3" title="🔊 Used to trio review"></audio>

---

## 5. Mini-mapa de decisión

![Ejemplos rápidos](/blog/curso-b1/unit-10/review-examples.png)

1. ¿Plan futuro vigente? → **going to** / continuous  
2. ¿Plan pasado fallido? → **was/were going to**  
3. ¿Hábito pasado habitual? → **used to**  
4. ¿Acostumbrado ahora / adaptándote? → **be / get used to**  
5. ¿Deduciendo? → **must / might / can't**

---

## 6. Listening / practice mix

> I am going to visit my parents next weekend. She must be happy. I used to play football. I was going to call you but I forgot. We are flying to Rome on Friday. That can't be him.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-10/practice-mix.mp3" title="🔊 Mixed practice"></audio>

---

## 7. Ejercicios integrados

### Ejercicio 1 — Elige la forma

1. I \_\_\_\_ visit my parents next weekend. *(plan)*  
2. She \_\_\_\_ be happy — she got promoted.  
3. I \_\_\_\_ play football when I was young.  
4. They \_\_\_\_ travel last summer but cancelled.  
5. That \_\_\_\_ be him — he's in Paris.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **am going to** · 2. **must** · 3. **used to** · 4. **were going to** · 5. **can't**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Más contraste

1. Wait — I \_\_\_\_ help you.  
2. She \_\_\_\_ living in a big city for years. *(is used to)*  
3. I \_\_\_\_ have left my keys at work.  
4. She \_\_\_\_ meeting her boss at 3.  
5. It took months to \_\_\_\_ living here.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **will** · 2. **is used to** · 3. **might** · 4. **is** · 5. **get used to**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Corrección

1. *I am going to call you yesterday* → \_\_\_\_  
2. *That mustn't be him* (imposible) → \_\_\_\_  
3. *I am used to play tennis* → \_\_\_\_  
4. *Look! It will rain* (nubes negras) → \_\_\_\_

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I **was going to** call you yesterday…  
2. That **can't** be him.  
3. I am used to **playing** / I **used to play**…  
4. It **is going to** rain.
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Matching rápido

A. arrangement fijo · B. plan fallido · C. hábito pasado · D. deducción fuerte  

1. We are flying on Friday. → \_\_\_\_  
2. I was going to go but cancelled. → \_\_\_\_  
3. I used to live in a village. → \_\_\_\_  
4. She must be relieved. → \_\_\_\_

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **A** · 2. **B** · 3. **C** · 4. **D**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Produce

Escribe una frase con cada estructura: *going to*, *was going to*, *must*, *can't*, *used to*, *get used to*.

<details>
<summary>Modelo</summary>

I **am going to** study tonight. I **was going to** go out but I was tired. She **must** be pleased. That **can't** be true. I **used to** hate mornings. I am **getting used to** waking up early.
</details>

---

## 8. Checklist antes del Módulo 2

- [ ] Distingo *will / going to / continuous*  
- [ ] Sé narrar un plan cancelado con *was/were going to*  
- [ ] Uso *must / might / can't* con evidencia  
- [ ] No confundo *used to* con *be used to*  
- [ ] Puedo hablar de travel, plans, feelings y habits

---

## Tip del profesor

En el repaso, **no memorices tablas**: inventa mini-historias (viaje cancelado + deducciones + cambio de hábitos). La gramática B1 se fija con contexto.

---

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 11 del curso B1** (*First Conditional & Weather*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [First conditional & Weather B1](/blog/curso-b1/unidad-11-first-conditional-weather)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 11 — First conditional & Weather](/curso-b1/unit-11)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![First conditional & Weather](/blog/curso-b1/unit-11/first-conditional.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática](#leccion-1--gramatica)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario](#leccion-2--vocabulario)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: Weekend weather plans](#leccion-3--reading)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: Anna's weather plans](#leccion-4--listening)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing](#leccion-5--writing)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** first conditional + future time clauses (when, as soon as, until)

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. If it ___ tomorrow, I will stay at home. → *rains / will rain / rained*
2. When I ___, I will call you. → *arrive / will arrive / arrived*
3. As soon as the storm ___, I will call. → *passes / will pass / passed*
4. We will stay indoors until the rain ___. → *stops / will stop / stopped*
5. If it's sunny, we ___ have a barbecue. → *will / would / are*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **rains** · 2. **arrive** · 3. **passes** · 4. **stops** · 5. **will**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige / completa

1. If you ___ early, we will have time for coffee. → *come / will come / came*
2. Before we leave, I ___ check the forecast. → *will / would / am*
3. After the storm, we ___ go for a walk. → *will / would / are*
4. If there ___ a storm, we will stay indoors. → *is / will be / was*
5. I will tell you when I ___ the forecast. → *see / will see / saw*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **come** · 2. **will** · 3. **will** · 4. **is** · 5. **see**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

1. *If it will rain, I stay home.*
2. *When I will arrive, I call you.*
3. *As soon as it will pass…*
4. *Until the rain will stop…*
5. *If it's sunny, we would have a barbecue.* (plan real)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

1. Escribe 3 frases: if / when / as soon as + weather.
2. Completa: If it ___ tomorrow, I will stay at home.
3. Completa: When I ___, I will call you.
4. Completa: As soon as the storm ___, I will call.
5. Completa: We will stay indoors until the rain ___.
6. Escribe 1 frase con *before* + present + will.
7. Usa *forecast* y *storm* en 2 frases first conditional.
8. Corrige: *If it will rain, I stay home.*
9. Corrige: *When I will arrive, I call you.*
10. Párrafo (3–4 frases) sobre planes de fin de semana y el tiempo.
11. Traduce: Si hace sol, haremos una barbacoa.
12. Traduce: En cuanto pase la tormenta, te llamaré.
13. Pregunta *What will you do if it rains?* + respuesta.
14. Escribe 1× *until* correcto (sin will en la cláusula).
15. Autochequeo: no will en if/when/as soon as/until.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. Model: If it's windy, we'll stay in. When I see the forecast, I'll tell you. As soon as it stops, we'll leave.
2. **rains**
3. **arrive**
4. **passes**
5. **stops**
6. Before we leave, I will check the forecast.
7. If the forecast is bad, we'll cancel. If there's a storm, we'll stay indoors.
8. If it **rains**, I **will** stay home.
9. When I **arrive**, I **will** call you.
10. Open — include if + time clause + weather vocab.
11. If it's sunny, we will have a barbecue.
12. As soon as the storm passes, I will call you.
13. What will you do if it rains? — I'll stay at home.
14. We will wait until the rain stops.
15. Self-check vs theory.

</details>

faqs.question: ¿Qué es el first conditional?
faqs.answer: If + present simple, will + verbo. Habla de situaciones reales o posibles en el futuro: If it rains, I will stay at home.

faqs.question: ¿Qué son future time clauses?
faqs.answer: When, as soon as, until, before, after + present (no will): When I arrive, I will call you. As soon as the storm passes…

faqs.question: ¿Puedo poner will en el if?
faqs.answer: No en el first conditional estándar: *If it will rain* ✗ → If it rains ✓.

content:
Tras el [Repaso 6–9](/blog/curso-b1/unidad-10-repaso-6-9), la **Unidad 11 del curso B1** (*First Conditional & Weather*) enseña a hablar del **futuro real/posible** con *if* y cláusulas de tiempo — y vocabulario del **tiempo atmosférico**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 11 — First Conditional](/curso-b1/unit-11)  
> **Antes:** [U10 — Repaso 6–9](/blog/curso-b1/unidad-10-repaso-6-9)

---

## Qué aprenderás

- Formar **If + present, will…**
- Usar **when / as soon as / until / before / after** + present
- Vocabulario: *sunny, rainy, storm, forecast, temperature…*

![First conditional](/blog/curso-b1/unit-11/first-conditional.png)

---

## 1. Mapa rápido

| Estructura | Uso | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **If + present, will** | futuro posible | If it **rains**, I **will** stay at home. |
| **when + present, will** | cuando ocurra | **When** I arrive, I **will** call you. |
| **as soon as** | en cuanto | **As soon as** the storm passes, I **will** call. |
| **until** | hasta que | We **will** stay indoors **until** the rain stops. |

---

## 2. First conditional

> If it **rains** tomorrow, I **will** stay at home.  
> If you **come** early, we **will** have time for coffee.  
> If it's **sunny** on Saturday, we **will** have a barbecue.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-11/if-it-rains.mp3" title="🔊 If it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home."></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-11/if-sunny.mp3" title="🔊 If it's sunny on Saturday, we will have a barbecue."></audio>

Orden flexible: *I will stay at home if it rains.*

---

## 3. Future time clauses

> **When** I arrive, I **will** call you.  
> **As soon as** the storm passes, I **will** call you.  
> We **will** stay indoors **until** the rain stops.  
> **Before** we leave, I **will** check the forecast.  
> **After** the storm, we **will** go for a walk.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-11/when-i-arrive.mp3" title="🔊 When I arrive, I will call you."></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-11/as-soon-as.mp3" title="🔊 As soon as the storm passes, I will call you."></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-11/until-rain.mp3" title="🔊 We will stay indoors until the rain stops."></audio>

Truco: en la cláusula de tiempo **no** uses *will*.

---

## 4. Vocabulario: Weather

![Weather vocab](/blog/curso-b1/unit-11/weather-vocab.png)

| Palabra | Idea |
| :--- | :--- |
| sunny / rainy / cloudy / windy | soleado / lluvioso / nublado / ventoso |
| storm / thunder / lightning | tormenta / trueno / rayo |
| temperature / forecast | temperatura / pronóstico |
| mild / hot / cold / freezing | suave / calor / frío / helado |
| barbecue / picnic | barbacoa / picnic |

---

## 5. Reading

![Weekend weather](/blog/curso-b1/unit-11/weather-weekend.png)

> Tomorrow the weather forecast says it will be sunny in the morning but cloudy in the afternoon. If it rains, we will stay at home and watch a film. When the sun comes out, we will go for a walk in the park. As soon as the storm passes, I will call you to arrange our picnic. The temperature will be mild, around twenty degrees.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-11/reading-weather.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: weather plans"></audio>

---

## 6. Mini-diálogo

> If it's sunny on Saturday, we will have a barbecue in the garden.  
> When I see the forecast, I will tell you.  
> As soon as we know the temperature, we will decide what to wear.  
> If there's a storm, we will stay indoors.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-11/dialogue-weather.mp3" title="🔊 Dialogue: weekend weather"></audio>

---

## 7. Practica en voz alta

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-11/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 Practice"></audio>

---

## 8. Ejercicios

### 1 — Completa
1. If it ___ tomorrow, I will stay at home. (*rains*)  
2. When I ___, I will call you. (*arrive*)  
3. As soon as the storm ___, I will call. (*passes*)  
4. We will stay indoors until the rain ___. (*stops*)  
5. If it's sunny, we ___ have a barbecue. (*will*)

<details><summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **rains** · 2. **arrive** · 3. **passes** · 4. **stops** · 5. **will**
</details>

### 2 — Corrige
1. *If it will rain, I stay home.* → If it **rains**, I **will** stay…  
2. *When I will arrive, I call you.* → When I **arrive**, I **will** call…  
3. *As soon as it will pass…* → As soon as it **passes**…

### 3 — Vocab
1. Day with no clouds = ___ · 2. Strong rain + thunder = ___ · 3. How hot/cold = ___ · 4. Pronóstico = ___

<details><summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **sunny** · 2. **storm** · 3. **temperature** · 4. **forecast**
</details>

## Tip del profesor

Si el plan es **realista** (el tiempo, un plan de fin de semana), usa **first conditional**. Lo imaginario va en la Unidad 12 (*second*).

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** second conditional (if + past, would)

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. If I ___ a million dollars, I would travel. → *had / have / will have*
2. If she ___ here, she would help us. → *were / is / will be*
3. If I were you, I ___ apologize. → *would / will / am*
4. If money ___ a problem, I would buy a house. → *weren't / isn't / won't be*
5. What ___ you do if you won the lottery? → *would / will / do*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **had** · 2. **were** · 3. **would** · 4. **weren't** · 5. **would**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige / completa

1. If we ___ travel back in time, where would we go? → *could / can / will*
2. In an ideal world, everyone ___ speak two languages. → *would / will / can*
3. If I ___ more time, I would learn the guitar. → *had / have / will have*
4. If you ___ me, what would you do? → *were / are / will be*
5. If she ___ the choice, she would live by the sea. → *had / has / will have*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **could** · 2. **would** · 3. **had** · 4. **were** · 5. **had**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

1. *If I will have time, I would go.*
2. *If I would be rich, I travel.*
3. *If she was here, she will help.* (hipotético)
4. *What if we can travel back in time?*
5. *If I have a million dollars, I would travel.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. If I **had** time, I **would** go.
2. If I **were** rich, I **would** travel.
3. If she **were** here, she **would** help.
4. What if we **could** travel back in time?
5. If I **had** a million dollars, I **would** travel.

</details>

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Who speaks? → *Chris / Anna / Maya*
2. Million dollars → ___ → *travel / stay home*
3. If she were here → ___ → *help / leave*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **everyone speak two languages** · 7. **second conditional** · 8. **Yes** · 9. **would travel…** · 10. **would apologize**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. Write What if we could…
12. Hypothetical vocab? → *yes / none*
13. Shadow audio
14. Real lottery win? → *False / True*
15. Open Ver solución → *yes*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **Model OK** · 12. **ideal world, what if** · 13. **done** · 14. **False (hypothetical)** · 15. **yes**

</details>

---

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

1. Escribe 3 frases second conditional (*If I had…, I would…*).
2. Completa: If I ___ a million dollars, I would travel.
3. Completa: If she ___ here, she would help.
4. Completa: If I were you, I ___ apologize.
5. Escribe *What if we could…?*
6. Escribe *In an ideal world…*
7. Usa *wish* / *imagine* en 2 frases.
8. Corrige: *If I will have time, I would go.*
9. Corrige: *If I would be rich, I travel.*
10. Párrafo: ¿dónde vivirías si pudieras elegir?
11. Traduce: Si yo fuera tú, me disculparía.
12. Traduce: Si tuviera más tiempo, aprendería guitarra.
13. Pregunta *What would you do if…?* + respuesta.
14. Escribe 1× *If I were…*
15. Autochequeo: past en if + would en resultado.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. Model: If I had more free time, I would read more.
2. **had**
3. **were**
4. **would**
5. What if we could live on an island?
6. In an ideal world, everyone would be kind.
7. I wish I had more time. Imagine if we could fly.
8. If I **had** time, I **would** go.
9. If I **were** rich, I **would** travel.
10. Open island/city paragraph with would.
11. If I were you, I would apologize.
12. If I had more time, I would learn the guitar.
13. What would you do if you won? — I would travel.
14. If I were free, I would call you.
15. Self-check.

</details>

---

faqs.question: ¿Qué es el second conditional?
faqs.answer: If + past simple, would + verbo. Situaciones imaginarias o poco probables ahora: If I had a million dollars, I would travel.

faqs.question: ¿Por qué were con I/he/she?
faqs.answer: En B1 es muy frecuente If I were you… / If she were here… (forma hipotética). If I was también aparece en informal.

faqs.question: ¿First o second?
faqs.answer: First = posible en el futuro real. Second = irreal / hipotético ahora.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico?
faqs.answer: En la [Unidad 12 del curso B1](/curso-b1/unit-12).

content:
Tras el [First conditional (U11)](/blog/curso-b1/unidad-11-first-conditional-weather), la **Unidad 12** (*Second Conditional*) te lleva a lo **imaginario**: *If I had…, I would…*

> **Practica:** [Unidad 12](/curso-b1/unit-12) · **Antes:** [U11](/blog/curso-b1/unidad-11-first-conditional-weather)

---

## Qué aprenderás

- **If + past, would + verb**
- *If I were you…* / *What if…?* / *In an ideal world…*
- Vocabulario: *imagine, wish, dream, ideal*

![Second conditional](/blog/curso-b1/unit-12/second-conditional.png)

---

## 1. Forma

| | |
| :--- | :--- |
| **If + past simple** | **would + infinitivo** |
| If I **had** a million dollars, | I **would** travel around the world. |
| If she **were** here, | she **would** help us. |
| If I **were** you, | I **would** apologize. |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-12/if-i-had.mp3" title="🔊 If I had a million dollars…"></audio>
<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-12/if-she-were.mp3" title="🔊 If she were here…"></audio>
<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-12/if-i-were-you.mp3" title="🔊 If I were you…"></audio>

---

## 2. Expresiones útiles

> **What if** we could travel back in time?  
> **In an ideal world**, everyone would speak two languages.  
> If I **had** more time, I **would** learn the guitar.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-12/what-if.mp3" title="🔊 What if…"></audio>
<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-12/ideal-world.mp3" title="🔊 Ideal world"></audio>

---

## 3. Vocabulario

![Hypothetical vocab](/blog/curso-b1/unit-12/hypothetical-vocab.png)

| Word | Idea |
| :--- | :--- |
| imagine / suppose | imaginar / suponer |
| wish / dream | desear / sueño |
| ideal / fantasy | ideal / fantasía |

---

## 4. Reading

![Island dream](/blog/curso-b1/unit-12/island-dream.png)

> Imagine if you could live anywhere in the world. Where would you go? If I had the choice, I would choose a small island in the Mediterranean. If money weren't a problem, I would buy a house by the sea. In my ideal world, everyone would speak at least two languages. What would you do?

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-12/reading-island.mp3" title="🔊 Reading"></audio>

---

## 5. Diálogo

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-12/dialogue-dream.mp3" title="🔊 Dialogue"></audio>

> If I had more time, I would learn to play the guitar.  
> What if we could travel back in time? I would visit ancient Rome.  
> If you were me, what would you do?  
> I would probably take a year off and travel the world.

---

## 6. Practica

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-12/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 Practice"></audio>

---

## 7. Ejercicios

1. If I ___ a million dollars, I would travel. (*had*)  
2. If she ___ here, she would help. (*were*)  
3. If I were you, I ___ apologize. (*would*)  
4. *If I will have time, I would go* → If I **had** time, I **would** go.  
5. Vocab: imaginar = ___ · ojalá/desear = ___

<details><summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **had** · 2. **were** · 3. **would** · 4. correction above · 5. **imagine** · **wish**
</details>

---

## Tip

Second = **no es un plan real**. Si puedes comprobarlo mañana con el tiempo, es first (U11).

Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 13 del curso B1** (*First vs Second Conditional & Entertainment*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![First vs Second Conditional](/blog/curso-b1/unit-13/first-vs-second.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática](#leccion-1--gramatica)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario](#leccion-2--vocabulario)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: Cinema or concert](#leccion-3--reading)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: Maya's tickets](#leccion-4--listening)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing](#leccion-5--writing)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** first vs second conditional (real vs hypothetical)

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. If we ___ time tonight, we'll watch a documentary. → *have / had / will have*
2. If I ___ a film director, I'd make a comedy. → *were / am / will be*
3. If the concert ___ at 8, we'll arrive at 7:30. → *starts / started / will start*
4. If we ___ VIP tickets, we'd be so happy. → *won / win / will win*
5. If you ___ to the party, you'll meet lots of people. → *come / came / will come*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **have** · 2. **were** · 3. **starts** · 4. **won** · 5. **come**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige / completa

1. If the episode is boring, we ___ change series. → *will / would / are*
2. If I had a free evening, I ___ go to a gig. → *would / will / am*
3. If tickets are cheap, we ___ book now. → *will / would / are*
4. If I were you, I ___ avoid spoilers. → *would / will / am*
5. If concerts ___ free, everyone would go more. → *were / are / will be*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **will** · 2. **would** · 3. **will** · 4. **would** · 5. **were**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

1. *If it will rain, we stay in.*
2. *If I would have time, I go.*
3. *If concerts are free, everyone would go.* (deseo irreal)
4. *If we leave early, we would get seats.* (plan real)
5. *If I had wings, I will fly.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. If it **rains**, we**'ll** stay in.
2. If I **had** time, I **would** go.
3. If concerts **were** free, everyone **would** go.
4. If we leave early, we **will** get seats.
5. If I had wings, I **would** fly.

</details>

---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** entertainment

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja / elige

1. concert → *concierto · tormenta · rutina*
2. series → *serie · granizo · hábito*
3. celebrity → *celebridad · temperatura · aviso*
4. streaming → *streaming · sequía · ascenso*
5. ticket → *entrada · niebla · pueblo*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **concierto** · 2. **serie** · 3. **celebridad** · 4. **streaming** · 5. **entrada**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

1. binge-watch ≈ ___ → *ver de seguido / cancelar / soñar*
2. gig ≈ ___ → *concierto informal / pronóstico / error*
3. spoilers ≈ ___ → *spoilers / humidity / regret*
4. audience ≈ ___ → *audiencia / climate / drought*
5. premiere ≈ ___ → *estreno / thunder / commute*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **ver de seguido** · 2. **concierto informal** · 3. **spoilers** · 4. **audiencia** · 5. **estreno**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — En contexto

11. Usa 3 palabras nuevas en frases con el foco gramatical.
12. Di en voz alta el vocabulario de la unidad.
13. Empareja cada palabra con un ejemplo personal.
14. Revisa la tabla de vocabulario de la [guía teórica](/blog/curso-b1/unidad-13-first-vs-second-conditional).
15. Continúa en la [Unidad 13 del curso](/curso-b1/unit-13).

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11–13. Open answers — check meaning in theory. · 14. Theory vocab section. · 15. **/curso-b1/unit-13**

</details>

## Lección 3 — Reading: Cinema or concert

**Objetivo:** comprender un texto con el foco de la unidad.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-13/reading-workbook.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Cinema or concert"></audio>

> If the tickets are still available, we will go to the comedy show on Friday. If we won free VIP tickets, we would invite the whole class. If the series is good, we might binge-watch two episodes tonight. If I could meet any celebrity, I would choose a musician. If concerts were free, everyone would go to more shows. Entertainment plans depend on money and luck!

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. If tickets available → ___ → *comedy / exam / storm*
2. VIP tickets → ___ → *invite class / cancel*
3. If series good → ___ → *binge-watch / delete*
4. Celebrity choice? → *musician / politician / chef*
5. If concerts free → ___ → *more shows / none*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **comedy show** · 2. **invite the whole class** · 3. **binge-watch two episodes** · 4. **musician** · 5. **everyone would go more**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. First or second: tickets available? → *first / second*
7. First or second: VIP fantasy? → *second / first*
8. Entertainment focus? → *Yes / No*
9. Find binge-watch
10. Find If I could meet…

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **first** · 7. **second** · 8. **Yes** · 9. **binge-watch two episodes** · 10. **celebrity / musician**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. Underline one first + one second.
12. Write cinema first + concert second.
13. Key vocab? → *yes / none*
14. Depends on ___ → *money/luck / weather only*
15. Course link → */curso-b1/unit-13*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **See text** · 12. **Model OK** · 13. **tickets, series, celebrity, concerts** · 14. **money and luck** · 15. **/curso-b1/unit-13**

</details>

---

## Lección 4 — Listening: Maya's tickets

**Objetivo:** escuchar el foco gramatical en contexto.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-13/listening-workbook.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Maya's tickets"></audio>

> Hi, I am Maya. If we leave early, we will get good seats at the cinema. If we had more money, we would go to the concert instead. If the soundtrack is amazing, I might buy it after the film. If I were you, I would avoid spoilers online. If concerts were free, everyone would go to more shows.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Who speaks? → *Maya / Sam / Leo*
2. Leave early → ___ → *cinema seats / miss train*
3. More money → ___ → *concert / stay home*
4. Amazing soundtrack → ___ → *buy / delete*
5. If I were you → ___ → *avoid spoilers / spoil*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Maya** · 2. **good seats at cinema** · 3. **concert instead** · 4. **might buy it** · 5. **avoid spoilers**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Concerts free → ___ → *more shows / none*
7. Cinema line = first? → *Yes / No*
8. Concert money line = second? → *Yes / No*
9. Find spoilers line
10. Find might line

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **everyone would go more** · 7. **Yes** · 8. **Yes** · 9. **avoid spoilers online** · 10. **might buy it after**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. Write one first + one second
12. Entertainment words? → *yes / none*
13. Shadow audio
14. VIP certain? → *False / True*
15. Open Ver solución → *yes*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **Model OK** · 12. **cinema, concert, soundtrack, spoilers** · 13. **done** · 14. **False** · 15. **yes**

</details>

---

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

1. Escribe 2 first + 2 second sobre cine/conciertos.
2. Completa: If we ___ time tonight, we'll watch a documentary.
3. Completa: If I ___ a director, I'd make a comedy.
4. Completa: If tickets are cheap, we ___ book now.
5. Completa: If I were you, I ___ avoid spoilers.
6. Usa *binge-watch* y *gig* en 2 frases (una first, una second).
7. Clasifica: If we leave early, we'll get seats. → ___
8. Clasifica: If we had more money, we'd go to the concert. → ___
9. Corrige: *If concerts are free, everyone would go.* (irreal)
10. Mini-diálogo (4 líneas) first + second.
11. Traduce: Si la serie es buena, puede que veamos dos episodios.
12. Traduce: Si tuviera entradas VIP, te invitaría.
13. Escribe sobre un plan real de ocio (first).
14. Escribe una fantasía de celebrity (second).
15. Autochequeo: ¿real o hipotético?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. Open — 2+2 entertainment conditionals.
2. **have**
3. **were**
4. **will / 'll**
5. **would / 'd**
6. If the series is good, we'll binge-watch it. If I had a free night, I'd go to a gig.
7. **first**
8. **second**
9. If concerts **were** free, everyone **would** go.
10. Open dialogue.
11. If the series is good, we might watch two episodes.
12. If I had VIP tickets, I would invite you.
13. If we book now, we'll get cheaper tickets.
14. If I could meet a celebrity, I would choose a musician.
15. Self-check probability.

</details>

title: First vs Second Conditional B1 & Entertainment
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 13 del curso B1: first vs second conditional y entertainment.
description: Contrasta first y second conditional en inglés B1 y practica vocabulario de entretenimiento (cine, series, conciertos). Guía Unidad 13 con audios.
alt: First vs second conditional y entertainment B1

faqs.question: ¿Cuándo uso first y cuándo second?
faqs.answer: First = situación real o probable en el futuro (If it rains, we'll stay in). Second = hipotética o poco probable ahora (If I had wings, I'd fly).

faqs.question: ¿Puedo mezclar will y would?
faqs.answer: No en la misma estructura estándar: first lleva will/can/might; second lleva would/could/might. Elige según probabilidad, no mezcles por casualidad.

faqs.question: ¿Qué vocabulario de entertainment practico?
faqs.answer: Series, episode, streaming, cinema, concert, gig, festival, comedy, documentary, binge-watch, spoilers…

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 13?
faqs.answer: En la [Unidad 13 del curso B1](/curso-b1/unit-13) de Linguafly.

content:
Tras el [Second conditional (U12)](/blog/curso-b1/unidad-12-second-conditional), la **Unidad 13 del curso B1** (*First vs Second Conditional & Entertainment*) te enseña a **elegir** el condicional correcto y a hablar de **planes de ocio**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 13 — First vs Second](/curso-b1/unit-13)  
> **Antes:** [U12 — Second conditional](/blog/curso-b1/unidad-12-second-conditional)

---

## Qué aprenderás

- Elegir **first** (real/probable) o **second** (hipotético)
- Evitar mezclas incorrectas de *will* / *would*
- Vocabulario: *series, concert, streaming, spoilers…*

![First vs second](/blog/curso-b1/unit-13/first-vs-second.png)

---

## 1. Contraste rápido

| | First | Second |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Idea | Real / probable | Irreal / hipotético |
| If-clause | Present simple | Past simple |
| Resultado | will / can / might… | would / could / might… |
| Ejemplo | If it **rains**, we**'ll** stay in. | If it **rained**, we**'d** stay in. |

Pregunta clave: *¿Es un plan real o una fantasía?*

---

## 2. Ejemplos lado a lado

> **First:** If you **come** to the party, you **will meet** lots of people.  
> **Second:** If I **had** wings, I **would fly** around the world.  
> **First:** If the film **is** good tonight, I **will recommend** it.  
> **Second:** If I **could** meet any celebrity, I **would choose** a musician.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-13/first-rains.mp3" title="🔊 First: If it rains…"></audio>
<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-13/first-party.mp3" title="🔊 First: party"></audio>
<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-13/second-wings.mp3" title="🔊 Second: wings"></audio>
<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-13/second-celebrity.mp3" title="🔊 Second: celebrity"></audio>

---

## 3. Vocabulario: Entertainment

![Entertainment vocab](/blog/curso-b1/unit-13/entertainment-vocab.png)

| Word | Idea |
| :--- | :--- |
| series / show / episode | serie / programa / episodio |
| streaming / binge-watch | streaming / ver de seguido |
| cinema / movie / soundtrack | cine / película / banda sonora |
| concert / gig / festival | concierto / bolo / festival |
| comedy / documentary | comedia / documental |
| spoilers | spoilers |

---

## 4. Reading

![Cinema or concert](/blog/curso-b1/unit-13/cinema-concert.png)

> If the tickets are still available, we'll go to the comedy show. That's a real plan — first conditional. If we won free VIP tickets, we'd invite the whole class: unlikely fantasy — second conditional. If the series is good, we might binge-watch two episodes tonight. And if concerts were free, everyone would go to more shows!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-13/reading-entertainment.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: entertainment plans"></audio>

---

## 5. Diálogo

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-13/dialogue-tickets.mp3" title="🔊 Dialogue: tickets"></audio>

> If we leave early, we'll get good seats at the cinema.  
> If we had more money, we'd go to the concert instead.  
> If the soundtrack is amazing, I might buy it after.  
> If I were you, I'd avoid spoilers online!

---

## 6. Practica en voz alta

## 7. Ejercicios

### 1 — First o second
1. If we ___ time tonight, we'll watch a documentary. (*have*)  
2. If I ___ a film director, I'd make a comedy. (*were*)  
3. If the concert ___ at 8, we'll arrive at 7:30. (*starts*)  
4. If we ___ VIP tickets, we'd be so happy. (*won*)

<details><summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **have** (first) · 2. **were** (second) · 3. **starts** (first) · 4. **won** (second)
</details>

### 2 — will o would
1. If the episode is boring, we ___ change series.  
2. If I had a free evening, I ___ go to a gig.  
3. If tickets are cheap, we ___ book now.  
4. If I were you, I ___ avoid spoilers.

<details><summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **will / 'll** · 2. **would / 'd** · 3. **will / 'll** · 4. **would / 'd**
</details>

### 3 — Corrige
1. *If it will rain, we stay in.* → If it **rains**, we**'ll** stay…  
2. *If I would have time, I go.* → If I **had** time, I **would** go…  
3. *If concerts are free, everyone would go* (deseo irreal) → If concerts **were** free, everyone **would** go…

### 4 — Vocab
1. Ver muchos episodios seguidos = ___ · 2. Concierto informal = ___ · 3. Revelar el final = ___

<details><summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **binge-watch** · 2. **gig** · 3. **spoilers**
</details>

---

## Tip del profesor

Si puedes **comprobarlo mañana** (entradas, tiempo, plan real) → **first**. Si es *imaginemos que…* → **second**.

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** third conditional (if + past perfect, would have)

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. If she ___ earlier, she would have arrived on time. → *had left / left / leaves*
2. We ___ the train if we had run. → *wouldn't have missed / wouldn't miss / won't miss*
3. If I had seen the warning, I ___. → *would have stopped / would stop / will stop*
4. They might have won if they ___ more. → *had practised / practised / practise*
5. If I ___ about the party, I would have come. → *had known / knew / know*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **had left** · 2. **wouldn't have missed** · 3. **would have stopped** · 4. **had practised** · 5. **had known**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige / completa

1. If we ___ stayed up so late, we might have slept better. → *hadn't / didn't / don't*
2. If the teacher ___ us another day, we could have finished. → *had given / gave / gives*
3. He ___ have told you if he had seen you. → *would / will / can*
4. If I had taken the job, I ___ have moved to London. → *would / will / can*
5. If you had listened, you ___ have made that mistake. → *wouldn't / won't / don't*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **hadn't** · 2. **had given** · 3. **would** · 4. **would** · 5. **wouldn't**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

1. *If I would have known…*
2. *I would passed.*
3. *If I knew about the party yesterday…* (pasado irreal)
4. *If she studied harder, she would have passed.*
5. *We would catch the train if we had left earlier.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. If I **had known**…
2. I **would have passed**.
3. If I **had known**…
4. If she **had studied** harder, she would have passed.
5. We **would have caught** the train if we had left earlier.

</details>

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** regrets & past events

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja / elige

1. regret → *arrepentirse · reservar · soñar*
2. miss (a chance) → *perder (oportunidad) · ganar · empezar*
3. opportunity → *oportunidad · concierto · soleado*
4. mistake → *error · festival · streaming*
5. hindsight → *en retrospectiva · estreno · audience*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **arrepentirse** · 2. **perder (oportunidad)** · 3. **oportunidad** · 4. **error** · 5. **en retrospectiva**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

1. I wish I had ≈ ___ → *ojalá hubiera / voy a / solía*
2. should have ≈ ___ → *debería haber / voy a / podría*
3. could have ≈ ___ → *podría haber / debe / will*
4. missed opportunity ≈ ___ → *oportunidad perdida / entrada VIP / picnic*
5. on time ≈ ___ → *a tiempo / tarde / nunca*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **ojalá hubiera** · 2. **debería haber** · 3. **podría haber** · 4. **oportunidad perdida** · 5. **a tiempo**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — En contexto

## Lección 3 — Reading: The missed train

**Objetivo:** comprender un texto con el foco de la unidad.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-14/reading-workbook.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: The missed train"></audio>

> Sam arrived late at the station yesterday. If he had left home earlier, he would have caught the train. If he hadn't checked his phone so many times, he might have been on time. If the warning had been clearer, he could have avoided the mistake. He regrets missing the opportunity. If he had known about the delay, he would have taken a taxi.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Who arrived late? → *Sam / Anna / Maya*
2. Where? → *station / cinema / office*
3. If left earlier → ___ → *caught train / slept*
4. Phone checks → ___ → *on time / richer*
5. Clearer warning → ___ → *avoided / celebrated*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Sam** · 2. **station** · 3. **caught the train** · 4. **might have been on time** · 5. **could have avoided mistake**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. He regrets ___ → *missing / winning*
7. If known about delay → ___ → *taxi / plane*
8. Main grammar? → *third / first / second*
9. Would have in if-clause? → *No / Yes*
10. Find If he had left…

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **missing the opportunity** · 7. **taken a taxi** · 8. **third conditional** · 9. **No (had + V3)** · 10. **would have caught the train**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. Underline past perfect ×2.
12. Write one If I had known…
13. Regret vocab? → *yes / none*
14. Changes the past? → *No / Yes*
15. Course link → */curso-b1/unit-14*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **See text** · 12. **Model OK** · 13. **regrets, opportunity, mistake** · 14. **No** · 15. **/curso-b1/unit-14**

</details>

## Lección 4 — Listening: Sam's exam regrets

**Objetivo:** escuchar el foco gramatical en contexto.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-14/listening-workbook.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Sam's exam regrets"></audio>

> Hi, I am Sam. If I had revised more, I would have felt more confident in the exam. If we hadn't stayed up so late, we might have slept better. If the teacher had given us another day, we could have finished the project. If I had left home earlier, I would have caught the train. Next time we will plan earlier.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Who speaks? → *Sam / Maya / Anna*
2. Revised more → ___ → *confident / richer*
3. Not stayed up late → ___ → *slept better / failed*
4. Teacher another day → ___ → *finished / cancelled*
5. Left earlier → ___ → *caught train / missed more*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Sam** · 2. **felt more confident** · 3. **slept better** · 4. **could have finished project** · 5. **caught the train**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Next time → ___ → *plan earlier / quit*
7. Grammar? → *third / first / second*
8. Find If I had revised…
9. Find hadn't stayed up…
10. Find could have finished…

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **plan earlier** · 7. **third conditional** · 8. **would have felt…** · 9. **might have slept better** · 10. **another day…**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. Write If I had known…
12. Regret topic? → *yes / weather only*
13. Shadow audio
14. Changes past? → *No / Yes*
15. Open Ver solución → *yes*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **Model OK** · 12. **exam / train / project** · 13. **done** · 14. **No** · 15. **yes**

</details>

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

1. Escribe 3 third conditionals (*If I had…, I would have…*).
2. Completa: If she ___ earlier, she would have arrived on time.
3. Completa: We ___ the train if we had run.
4. Completa: If I had seen the warning, I ___.
5. Escribe *If I had known…*
6. Usa *regret* y *miss* en 2 frases con third.
7. Second o third: If I had more time now, I'd help. → ___
8. Second o third: If I had had more time yesterday, I'd have helped. → ___
9. Corrige: *If I would have known…*
10. Corrige: *I would passed.*
11. Párrafo: un tren/examen/oportunidad perdida.
12. Traduce: Si hubiéramos salido antes, no habríamos perdido el tren.
13. Traduce: Si hubiera repasado más, me habría sentido más seguro.
14. Escribe 1× *might have* + 1× *could have*.
15. Autochequeo: past perfect en if + would have en resultado.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. Model: If I had left earlier, I would have caught the bus.
2. **had left**
3. **wouldn't have missed**
4. **would have stopped**
5. If I had known, I would have called.
6. I regret missing the chance. If I hadn't missed it, I would have…
7. **second**
8. **third**
9. If I **had known**…
10. I **would have passed**.
11. Open regret story.
12. If we had left earlier, we wouldn't have missed the train.
13. If I had revised more, I would have felt more confident.
14. We might have slept better. We could have finished the project.
15. Self-check.

</details>

author: linguafly-team

faqs.question: ¿Qué es el third conditional?
faqs.answer: If + past perfect, would have + past participle. Habla de un pasado diferente: If I had studied, I would have passed.

faqs.question: ¿Second o third?
faqs.answer: Second = ahora/futuro irreal (If I had time, I'd help). Third = pasado irreal (If I had had time yesterday, I'd have helped).

faqs.question: ¿Puedo decir If I would have known…?
faqs.answer: No en el estándar B1: en la if-clause usa past perfect (*If I had known…*), no *would have*.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico?
faqs.answer: En la [Unidad 14 del curso B1](/curso-b1/unit-14).

content:
Tras el [contraste first vs second (U13)](/blog/curso-b1/unidad-13-first-vs-second-conditional), la **Unidad 14** (*Third Conditional & Regrets*) te lleva al **pasado irreal**: *qué habría pasado si…*

> **Practica:** [Unidad 14](/curso-b1/unit-14) · **Antes:** [U13](/blog/curso-b1/unidad-13-first-vs-second-conditional)

---

## Qué aprenderás

- **If + past perfect, would have + V3**
- Variantes *could have / might have*
- Vocabulario de **regrets** y decisiones

![Third conditional](/blog/curso-b1/unit-14/third-conditional.png)

---

## 1. Forma

| If-clause | Resultado |
| :--- | :--- |
| **If + past perfect** | **would have + past participle** |
| If I **had known**, | I **would have come**. |
| If she **had studied** harder, | she **would have passed**. |
| If we **had left** earlier, | we **would have caught** the train. |

También: *could have* (capacidad) · *might have* (posibilidad).

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-14/if-i-had-known.mp3" title="🔊 If I had known…"></audio>
<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-14/if-she-had-studied.mp3" title="🔊 If she had studied…"></audio>
<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-14/if-we-had-left.mp3" title="🔊 If we had left…"></audio>

---

## 2. Second vs Third

| | Second | Third |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Tiempo | Ahora / general | Pasado |
| If | Past simple | Past perfect |
| Result | would + V1 | would have + V3 |
| Ejemplo | If I **had** money, I**'d** travel. | If I **had had** money, I**'d have** travelled. |

---

## 3. Vocabulario: regrets

![Regrets vocab](/blog/curso-b1/unit-14/regrets-vocab.png)

| Word / phrase | Idea |
| :--- | :--- |
| regret / wish I had… | arrepentirse / ojalá hubiera… |
| miss (a chance / train) | perder (oportunidad / tren) |
| on time / late / rush | a tiempo / tarde / con prisas |
| warning / decision | aviso / decisión |
| otherwise | de lo contrario |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-14/wish-i-had.mp3" title="🔊 Wish I had…"></audio>

---

## 4. Reading

![Regrets story](/blog/curso-b1/unit-14/regrets-story.png)

> Sam arrived late at the station. If he had left home earlier, he would have caught the train. If he hadn't checked his phone so many times, he might have been on time. If the warning had been clearer, he could have avoided the mistake. None of this changes the past — but it helps him explain the regret.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-14/reading-regrets.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: regrets"></audio>

---

## 5. Diálogo

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-14/dialogue-regrets.mp3" title="🔊 Dialogue: exam regrets"></audio>

> If I had revised more, I would have felt more confident.  
> If we hadn't stayed up so late, we might have slept better.  
> If the teacher had given us another day, we could have finished the project.  
> Next time we'll plan earlier — no more third-conditional regrets!

---

## 6. Practica

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-14/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 Practice"></audio>

---

## 7. Ejercicios

### 1 — Completa (third)
1. If she ___ earlier, she would have arrived on time. (*had left*)  
2. We ___ the train if we had run. (*wouldn't have missed*)  
3. If I had seen the warning, I ___ . (*would have stopped*)  
4. They might have won if they ___ more. (*had practised*)

<details><summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **had left** · 2. **wouldn't have missed** · 3. **would have stopped** · 4. **had practised**
</details>

### 2 — Second o third
1. If I had more time now, I'd help you. → ___  
2. If I had had more time yesterday, I'd have helped you. → ___  
3. If she studied more, she'd pass. → ___  
4. If she had studied more, she would have passed. → ___

<details><summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **second** · 2. **third** · 3. **second** · 4. **third**
</details>

### 3 — Corrige
1. *If I would have known…* → If I **had known**…  
2. *I would passed* → I **would have passed**  
3. *If I knew about the party yesterday…* (pasado irreal) → If I **had known**…

### 4 — Traduce
1. Si hubiéramos salido antes, no habríamos perdido el tren.  
2. Si hubiera repasado más, me habría sentido más seguro.

<details><summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. If we **had left** earlier, we **wouldn't have missed** the train.  
2. If I **had revised** more, I **would have felt** more confident.
</details>

---

## Tip

Third = **pasado cerrado**. Si aún puedes cambiarlo hoy, no es third.

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** first, second y third conditional + time clauses

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. If it ___ sunny tomorrow, we'll walk. → *is / were / had been*
2. If I ___ you, I'd take an umbrella. → *were / am / had been*
3. If they ___ earlier, they would have got seats. → *had booked / booked / book*
4. We ___ out if it doesn't rain. → *will go / would go / went*
5. She ___ if she had known. → *would have called / would call / will call*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **is** · 2. **were** · 3. **had booked** · 4. **will go** · 5. **would have called**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige / completa

1. If she studies, she ___ pass. (first) → *will / would / would have*
2. If she studied, she ___ pass. (second) → *would / will / would have*
3. If she had studied, she ___ passed. (third) → *would have / will / would*
4. When I ___, I will call you. → *arrive / will arrive / arrived*
5. If we ___ VIP tickets, we'd meet the band. → *had / have / had had*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **will** · 2. **would** · 3. **would have** · 4. **arrive** · 5. **had**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

1. *If it will rain…*
2. *If I would have time…*
3. *I would passed.*
4. *If we leave now, we would catch the bus.* (plan real)
5. *If I had left earlier, I would arrive.* (pasado)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

</details>

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

3. Completa: If I ___ you, I'd take an umbrella.

7. Clasifica: If she studied, she'd pass. → ___
8. Clasifica: If she had studied, she would have passed. → ___
9. Corrige: *If it will rain…*

content:
Antes de seguir el Módulo 2 (pasiva y reported speech), la **Unidad 15** (*Repaso 11–14*) consolida los **tres condicionales** del bloque.

> **Practica:** [Unidad 15](/curso-b1/unit-15) · **Antes:** [U14 — Third](/blog/curso-b1/unidad-14-third-conditional)

---

## Qué aprenderás

- Elegir **first / second / third** según tiempo y realidad
- Revisar weather, entertainment y regrets
- Autoevaluarte con ejercicios mixtos

![Review map](/blog/curso-b1/unit-15/review-conditionals.png)

---

## 1. Mapa de los tres condicionales

| Tipo | If-clause | Result | Uso |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **First** | Present simple | will / can / might… | Real / futuro probable |
| **Second** | Past simple | would / could / might… | Hipotético presente/futuro |
| **Third** | Past perfect | would have + V3 | Pasado irreal / regrets |

![Review examples](/blog/curso-b1/unit-15/review-examples.png)

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-15/review-first.mp3" title="🔊 First review"></audio>
<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-15/review-second.mp3" title="🔊 Second review"></audio>
<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-15/review-third.mp3" title="🔊 Third review"></audio>
<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-15/review-time.mp3" title="🔊 Time clauses"></audio>

---

## 2. Checklist de autoevaluación

- [ ] First: *If it rains, we'll cancel.*  
- [ ] Time clauses: *When / as soon as / until* + present (no *will*)  
- [ ] Second: *If I won, I'd travel.* / *If I were you…*  
- [ ] Third: *If I had left earlier, I would have arrived.*  
- [ ] No pongo *would* en la if-clause (B1 estándar)

---

## 3. Reading: un fin de semana, tres condicionales

> **Friday (first):** If the weather is good, we'll go to the festival.  
> **Saturday dream (second):** If we had VIP tickets, we'd meet the band.  
> **Sunday regret (third):** If we had booked earlier, we would have got better seats.

Same topic — three different time/reality frames.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-15/reading-mix.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: mix"></audio>

---

## 4. Diálogo de repaso

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-15/dialogue-mix.mp3" title="🔊 Dialogue: mix"></audio>

> If it rains tomorrow, we'll watch a series at home.  
> If I were free every evening, I'd learn the guitar.  
> If we had left earlier last week, we wouldn't have missed the concert.  
> Perfect — first, second and third in one chat!

---

## 5. Practica

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-15/practice-mix.mp3" title="🔊 Practice mix"></audio>

---

## 6. Ejercicios

### 1 — ¿First, second o third?
1. If she studies, she'll pass.  
2. If she studied, she'd pass.  
3. If she had studied, she would have passed.  
4. If we had more money, we'd go to the festival.  
5. If we leave now, we'll catch the bus.

<details><summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **first** · 2. **second** · 3. **third** · 4. **second** · 5. **first**
</details>

### 2 — Completa
1. If it ___ sunny tomorrow, we'll walk. (*is*)  
2. If I ___ you, I'd take an umbrella. (*were*)  
3. If they ___ earlier, they would have got seats. (*had booked*)  
4. We ___ out if it doesn't rain. (*will go*)  
5. She ___ if she had known. (*would have called*)

<details><summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **is** · 2. **were** · 3. **had booked** · 4. **will go / 'll go** · 5. **would have called**
</details>

### 3 — Corrige
1. *If it will rain…* → If it **rains**…  
2. *If I would have time…* → If I **had** time… / If I **had had** time…  
3. *I would passed* → I **would have passed**

### 4 — Traduce
1. Si hace buen tiempo, iremos al festival.  
2. Si tuviera entradas VIP, conocería a la banda.  
3. Si hubiéramos reservado antes, habríamos tenido mejores asientos.

<details><summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. If the weather **is** good, we**'ll** go to the festival.  
2. If I **had** VIP tickets, I**'d** meet the band.  
3. If we **had booked** earlier, we **would have had/got** better seats.
</details>

### 5 — Mini writing
Escribe 3 frases (first + second + third) sobre el mismo tema (viaje, examen o fin de semana).

<details><summary>Modelo</summary>

If I finish work early, I'll go to the cinema.  
If I had more free time, I'd binge-watch a new series.  
If I had bought tickets yesterday, I would have gone to the concert.
</details>

---

## Tip del profesor

En el repaso, **clasifica primero** (¿pasado / ahora / futuro real?) y luego conjugas. El error suele ser de *marco temporal*, no de vocabulario.

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** passive voice present & past (is/are/was/were + past participle)

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. Emails ___ sent automatically. → *are / is / was*
2. The laptop ___ repaired last week. → *was / were / is*
3. The files ___ deleted yesterday. → *were / was / are*
4. The device ___ manufactured in China. → *is / are / were*
5. Passwords ___ changed regularly. → *are / is / was*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **are** · 2. **was** · 3. **were** · 4. **is** · 5. **are**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige / completa

1. The website ___ designed by a team. → *was / were / are*
2. Wi-Fi ___ connected to all devices. → *is / are / were*
3. The data ___ stored in the cloud last month. → *were / was / is*
4. Updates ___ downloaded every week. → *are / is / was*
5. The system ___ tested before the launch. → *was / were / are*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **was** · 2. **is** · 3. **were** · 4. **are** · 5. **was**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

1. *Someone installs the app.* → The app ___ ___.
2. *They deleted the files.* → The files ___ ___.
3. *The emails is sent daily.*
4. *The laptop were repaired.*
5. *It designed by a team.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. The app **is installed**.
2. The files **were deleted**.
3. The emails **are** sent daily.
4. The laptop **was** repaired.
5. It **was designed** by a team.

</details>

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

1. Escribe 3 pasivas (present + past) sobre tecnología.
2. Completa: Emails ___ sent automatically.
3. Completa: The laptop ___ repaired last week.
4. Completa: The files ___ deleted yesterday.
5. Transforma: Someone installs the app. → ___
6. Usa *upload* y *cloud* en 2 frases pasivas.
7. Corrige: *The emails is sent daily.*
8. Corrige: *The laptop were repaired.*
9. Escribe 1 frase con *by + agent*.
10. Párrafo (3–4 frases) sobre apps/dispositivos en pasiva.
11. Traduce: La app está instalada en mi móvil.
12. Traduce: Los archivos fueron borrados por error.
13. Pregunta *Was the laptop repaired?* + respuesta.
14. Escribe 1× *are changed* + 1× *was designed*.
15. Autochequeo: is/are/was/were + V3.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. Model: The app is installed. Updates are downloaded. The phone was repaired.
2. **are**
3. **was**
4. **were**
5. The app **is installed**.
6. Photos are uploaded to the cloud. Data is stored in the cloud.
7. The emails **are** sent daily.
8. The laptop **was** repaired.
9. The website was designed by a professional team.
10. Open tech passive paragraph.
11. The app is installed on my phone.
12. The files were deleted by mistake.
13. Was the laptop repaired? — Yes, it was repaired last week.
14. Passwords are changed regularly. The site was designed by a team.
15. Self-check.

</details>

author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 16 del curso B1: passive voice y technology.

faqs.question: ¿Qué es la voz pasiva?
faqs.answer: be + past participle. Presente: is/are + V3. Pasado: was/were + V3. El foco está en la acción o el objeto: The app is installed.

faqs.question: ¿Cuándo uso by?
faqs.answer: Cuando quieres decir quién hace la acción: The website was designed by a professional team. Si no importa, omite by.

faqs.question: ¿Active o passive?
faqs.answer: Active si el sujeto hace la acción. Passive si el sujeto recibe la acción o no sabes/no importa el agente.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico?
faqs.answer: En la [Unidad 16 del curso B1](/curso-b1/unit-16).

content:
Tras el [Repaso 11–14](/blog/curso-b1/unidad-15-repaso-11-14), la **Unidad 16** (*Passive Voice & Technology*) enseña a formar la **voz pasiva** en presente y pasado con vocabulario de **tecnología**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 16](/curso-b1/unit-16)  
> **Antes:** [U15 — Repaso 11–14](/blog/curso-b1/unidad-15-repaso-11-14)

---

## Qué aprenderás

- Formar **is/are + past participle** y **was/were + past participle**
- Decidir cuándo usar pasiva (foco en la acción)
- Vocabulario: *app, device, upload, cloud, password…*

![Passive voice y technology B1](/blog/curso-b1/unit-16/passive-voice.png)

---

## 1. Mapa rápido

| Tiempo | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Present | **is / are + V3** | The app **is installed**. Emails **are sent**. |
| Past | **was / were + V3** | The laptop **was repaired**. Files **were deleted**. |
| Agente | **by + noun** | Designed **by** a team. |

---

## 2. Present passive

> The device **is manufactured** in China.  
> Emails **are sent** automatically.  
> Passwords **are changed** regularly.  
> Wi-Fi **is connected** to all devices.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-16/is-installed.mp3" title="🔊 is installed"></audio>
<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-16/are-sent.mp3" title="🔊 are sent"></audio>

---

## 3. Past passive

> New software **was installed** yesterday.  
> The laptop **was repaired** last week.  
> The files **were deleted** by mistake.  
> The website **was designed** by a professional team.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-16/was-repaired.mp3" title="🔊 was repaired"></audio>
<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-16/were-deleted.mp3" title="🔊 were deleted"></audio>
<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-16/was-designed.mp3" title="🔊 was designed"></audio>

---

## 4. Vocabulario: Technology

![Technology vocab](/blog/curso-b1/unit-16/tech-vocab.png)

| Word | Idea |
| :--- | :--- |
| smartphone / app / device | móvil / app / dispositivo |
| software / update / download / upload | software / actualización / descargar / subir |
| password / screen / connection / network | contraseña / pantalla / conexión / red |
| cloud / data / file / link | nube / datos / archivo / enlace |

---

## 5. Reading

![Tech scene](/blog/curso-b1/unit-16/tech-scene.png)

> Millions of photos are uploaded to the internet every day. New software was installed on my computer yesterday. Passwords are changed regularly for safety. The data were stored in the cloud last month. The device is manufactured in China and the Wi-Fi is connected to all devices in the office.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-16/reading-tech.mp3" title="🔊 Reading"></audio>

---

## 6. Diálogo

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-16/dialogue-tech.mp3" title="🔊 Dialogue"></audio>

> Is the update installed? — Yes, it was installed this morning.  
> Are the messages encrypted? — Yes, they are encrypted for security.  
> Was the laptop repaired? — Yes, it was repaired last week.

---

## 7. Practica

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-16/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 Practice"></audio>

---

## 8. Ejercicios

1. Emails ___ sent automatically. (*are*)  
2. The laptop ___ repaired last week. (*was*)  
3. The files ___ deleted yesterday. (*were*)  
4. *Someone installs the app.* → The app ___ ___.  
5. Vocab: subir = ___ · nube = ___ · contraseña = ___

<details><summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **are** · 2. **was** · 3. **were** · 4. **is installed** · 5. **upload** · **cloud** · **password**
</details>

---

## Tip del profesor

Si no importa *quién* lo hace (o no lo sabes), usa **pasiva**. Si el agente es importante, añade *by…*.

---

## Practica ahora

1. Repasa los ejemplos en voz alta.  
2. Practica en la [Unidad 16 del curso B1](/curso-b1/unit-16).
3. Haz el [cuaderno de ejercicios U16 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-b1/unidad-16-passive-voice-technology-ejercicios-soluciones).

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 17 del curso B1** (*Modal Passive & Work & Jobs*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [Modal Passive & Work B1](/blog/curso-b1/unidad-17-modal-passive-work)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 17 — Modal Passive & Work](/curso-b1/unit-17)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Modal Passive & Work](/blog/curso-b1/unit-17/modal-passive.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática](#leccion-1--gramatica)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario](#leccion-2--vocabulario)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: Office deadlines](#leccion-3--reading)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: Omar at work](#leccion-4--listening)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing](#leccion-5--writing)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** modal passive (must/should/can/might be + past participle)

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. The form ___ be completed. → *must / should / can*
2. The report ___ be sent today. → *should / must / can*
3. The meeting ___ be postponed. → *can / must / should*
4. The interview ___ be cancelled. → *might / must / should*
5. The contract ___ be signed by Friday. → *must / can / might*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **must** · 2. **should** · 3. **can** · 4. **might** · 5. **must**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige / completa

1. Applications must ___ submitted before the deadline. → *be / being / been*
2. Meetings can ___ held online. → *be / being / been*
3. The salary might ___ increased next year. → *be / being / been*
4. Work experience should ___ included in your resume. → *be / being / been*
5. The client must ___ informed about the delay. → *be / being / been*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **be** · 2. **be** · 3. **be** · 4. **be** · 5. **be**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

1. *Must to be finished.*
2. *The form must completed.*
3. *Should be send today.*
4. *Can be postpone.*
5. *Might being cancelled.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. It **must be** finished.
2. The form must **be** completed.
3. Should be **sent** today.
4. Can be **postponed**.
5. Might **be** cancelled.

</details>

---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** work & jobs

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja / elige

1. deadline → *fecha límite · nube · acento*
2. colleague → *compañero · dispositivo · mensaje*
3. interview → *entrevista · upload · grammar*
4. salary → *salario · password · translate*
5. resume → *CV · cloud · spoiler*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **fecha límite** · 2. **compañero** · 3. **entrevista** · 4. **salario** · 5. **CV**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

1. contract ≈ ___ → *contrato / archivo / acento*
2. promotion ≈ ___ → *ascenso / download / phrase*
3. client ≈ ___ → *cliente / Wi-Fi / binge*
4. meeting ≈ ___ → *reunión / storm / gig*
5. application ≈ ___ → *solicitud / thunder / forecast*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **contrato** · 2. **ascenso** · 3. **cliente** · 4. **reunión** · 5. **solicitud**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — En contexto

11. Usa 3 palabras nuevas en frases con el foco gramatical.
12. Di en voz alta el vocabulario de la unidad.
13. Empareja cada palabra con un ejemplo personal.
14. Revisa la tabla de vocabulario de la [guía teórica](/blog/curso-b1/unidad-17-modal-passive-work).
15. Continúa en la [Unidad 17 del curso](/curso-b1/unit-17).

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11–13. Open answers — check meaning in theory. · 14. Theory vocab section. · 15. **/curso-b1/unit-17**

</details>

## Lección 3 — Reading: Office deadlines

**Objetivo:** comprender un texto con el foco de la unidad.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-b1/unit-17/reading-workbook.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Office deadlines"></audio>

> Applications must be submitted before the deadline. The contract should be signed by Friday. Meetings can be held online with colleagues. The salary might be increased next year. Work experience should be included in your resume. The client must be informed about the delay. The interview might be postponed until Monday.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Applications must be ___ → *submitted / deleted / ignored*
2. Before the ___ → *deadline / weekend / party*

4. Meetings can be ___ online → *held / deleted / uploaded*
5. Salary might be ___ → *increased / forgotten / translated*

<details>

1. **submitted** · 2. **deadline** · 3. **signed** · 4. **held** · 5. **increased**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Resume should include ___ → *work experience / passwords*
7. Client must be ___ → *informed / ignored / deleted*
8. Interview might be ___ → *postponed / uploaded / translated*
9. Main grammar? → *modal passive / first / third*
10. Find must be

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

12. Write one can be + V3
13. Work vocab? → *yes / none*

<details>
