## Lección 4 — Listening: Science and habits

**Objetivo:** escuchar el foco gramatical en contexto.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-27/listening-zero.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Science and habits"></audio>

> If you heat water to 100 degrees, it boils. If you put ice in the sun, it melts. If you don't water plants, they die. If you eat too much sugar, you get tired. If you drink water every day, you feel better. If you read every day, your vocabulary improves.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Water at 100 degrees → ____. → a) Boils · b) Melts · c) Dies
2. Ice in the sun → ____. → a) Melts · b) Boils · c) Freezes
3. Don't water plants → ____. → a) They die · b) They boil · c) Vocabulary improves
4. Too much sugar → ____. → a) Get tired · b) Feel better · c) Boil
5. Read every day → ____. → a) Vocabulary improves · b) Plants die · c) Ice melts

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Boils** · 2. **a) Melts** · 3. **a) They die** · 4. **a) Get tired** · 5. **a) Vocabulary improves**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Listening checks ____. → a) Zero facts & habits · b) only spelling · c) only *into*
7. No *will* in Zero results: ____. → a) true · b) false · c) irrelevant
8. *100 degrees* appears with ____. → a) boiling water · b) melting ice · c) dying plants
9. Health habits are ____. → a) general truths · b) future promises · c) past ability
10. Unit 27 practice: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only Unit 60

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Zero facts & habits** · 7. **a) true** · 8. **a) boiling water** · 9. **a) general truths** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. Notice both clauses in ____. → a) Present Simple · b) will · c) Past
12. *If you read every day…* is ____. → a) Zero · b) First · c) wrong
13. Shadow and ____. → a) repeat Present + Present · b) ignore verbs · c) translate titles only
14. Write 3 general facts: ____. → a) good practice · b) useless · c) teachers only
15. U27 is not mainly about ____. → a) future will promises · b) science facts · c) routines

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) Present Simple** · 12. **a) Zero** · 13. **a) repeat Present + Present** · 14. **a) good practice** · 15. **a) future will promises**

</details>


---

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. If you heat water, it ____. → *boils / will boil / boiled*
2. If you put ice in the sun, it ____. → *melts / will melt / melted*
3. If you don't water plants, they ____. → *die / will die / died*
4. If you exercise regularly, you ____ healthy. → *stay / will stay / stayed*
5. If you read every day, your vocabulary ____. → *improves / will improve / improved*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **boils** · 2. **melts** · 3. **die** · 4. **stay** · 5. **improves**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. If / you / heat / water, / it / boils.
7. If / you / don't / eat / enough, / you / feel / hungry.
8. Water / boils / if / you / heat / it.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. If you heat water, it boils.
7. If you don't eat enough, you feel hungry.
8. Water boils if you heat it.

</details>


### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Un hecho científico con Zero Conditional.
10. Un hábito de salud (*If you exercise…*).
11. Una negativa (*If you don't…*).
12. Reordenar: resultado primero (*Water boils if…*).
13. Un hecho sobre estudio o lectura.
14. Contrasta una frase Zero y una First.
15. Párrafo (6–8 frases) con verdades generales.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

9. If you heat water, it boils.
10. If you exercise regularly, you stay healthy.
11. If you don't sleep well, you feel tired the next day.
12. Water boils if you heat it.
13. If you read every day, your vocabulary improves.
14. Zero: If you heat water, it boils. First: If it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home.
15. If you heat water, it boils. If you freeze water, it turns into ice. If you don't eat enough, you feel hungry. If you exercise regularly, you stay healthy. If you read every day, your vocabulary improves!

</details>


---

## Resumen rápido

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Condición** | *If* + Present Simple |
| **Resultado** | Present Simple (sin *will*) |
| **Uso** | hechos generales / ciencia / rutinas |
| **vs First** | ¿siempre verdadero? → Zero |

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 28 del curso A2** (*Have to / Don't have to*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [Have to A2](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-28-have-to-dont-have-to)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 28 — Have to / Don't have to](/curso-a2/unit-28)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Have to / Don't have to](/blog/curso-a2/unit-28/a2-unit28-have-to.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática](#leccion-1--gramatica)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario](#leccion-2--vocabulario)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: A day with obligations](#leccion-3--reading)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: School rules](#leccion-4--listening)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing](#leccion-5--writing)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** have to / has to y don't / doesn't have to (obligación y lo opcional).

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I ____ to get up early. → *have / has / having*
2. She ____ to wear a uniform. → *has / have / having*
3. They ____ have to work on Saturdays. → *don't / doesn't / isn't*
4. He ____ to study tonight. → *has / have / having*
5. ____ you have to wear a uniform? → *Do / Does / Are*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **have** · 2. **has** · 3. **don't** · 4. **has** · 5. **Do**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. *I/you/we/they* use ____. → a) have to · b) has to · c) having to
7. *He/she/it* uses ____. → a) has to · b) have to · c) haves to
8. *Don't have to* means ____. → a) not necessary · b) forbidden · c) past ability
9. Questions: ____. → a) Do/Does + have to · b) Have to + do · c) Are + have to
10. Unit 28 trains ____. → a) obligation vs optional · b) only Zero · c) only could

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) have to** · 7. **a) has to** · 8. **a) not necessary** · 9. **a) Do/Does + have to** · 10. **a) obligation vs optional**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *She have to wear a uniform.*
12. *He don't have to pay today.*
13. *Do she have to study tonight?*
14. *I have to to get up early.*
15. *They has to arrive on time.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. She **has to** wear a uniform.
12. He **doesn't have to** pay today.
13. **Does** she have to study tonight?
14. I have to get up early.
15. They **have to** arrive on time.

</details>


---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** obligation, uniform, bills, canteen, homework, arrive on time.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja / elige

1. *obligation* ≈ ____ → *something necessary · optional · a colour*
2. *uniform* ≈ ____ → *same clothes for work/school · a ticket · rain*
3. *pay bills* ≈ ____ → *pay for electricity/rent etc. · cook dinner · swim*
4. *canteen* ≈ ____ → *school cafeteria · a bus stop · a park*
5. *arrive on time* ≈ ____ → *not be late · forget · melt*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **something necessary** · 2. **same clothes for work/school** · 3. **pay for electricity/rent etc.** · 4. **school cafeteria** · 5. **not be late**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. I have to ____ up early. → *get / getting / got*
7. She has to ____ a uniform. → *wear / wearing / wore*
8. Students have to do ____ every day. → *homework / homeworks / homeworke*
9. They don't have to ____ lunch. → *bring / bringing / brought*
10. Teachers have to ____ exams. → *correct / correcting / corrected*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **get** · 7. **wear** · 8. **homework** · 9. **bring** · 10. **correct**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. Work at 8 → often ____. → a) have to get up early · b) don't have to work · c) could swim
12. *Don't have to cook* means cooking is ____. → a) optional today · b) forbidden · c) always required
13. *Does she have to…?* is a ____. → a) question · b) past tense · c) Zero Conditional
14. After *have to* use ____. → a) infinitive · b) *to* + infinitive again · c) *-ing* only
15. Unit 28 is about ____. → a) rules & obligations · b) only conditionals · c) only past ability

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) have to get up early** · 12. **a) optional today** · 13. **a) question** · 14. **a) infinitive** · 15. **a) rules & obligations**

</details>


---

## Lección 3 — Reading: A day with obligations

**Objetivo:** comprender un texto con el foco de la unidad.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-28/reading-have-to.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: A day with obligations"></audio>

> I have to get up early every day because I work at 8 o'clock. I have to wear a uniform at work. I don't have to work on Saturdays, so I can rest. I have to pay my bills every month. I don't have to cook today because my mother is making dinner. I have to study tonight for my exam tomorrow.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Why get up early? → a) Work at 8 o'clock · b) School canteen · c) Exam yesterday
2. What at work? → a) Wear a uniform · b) Cook dinner · c) Pay for books
3. Saturdays? → a) Don't have to work · b) Have to study · c) Have to pay bills
4. Why not cook today? → a) Mother is making dinner · b) No uniform · c) No exam
5. Tonight? → a) Study for exam tomorrow · b) Rest on Saturday · c) Pay bills

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Work at 8 o'clock** · 2. **a) Wear a uniform** · 3. **a) Don't have to work** · 4. **a) Mother is making dinner** · 5. **a) Study for exam tomorrow**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. The text practices ____. → a) have to / don't have to · b) only Zero · c) only could
7. *Pay bills every month* is ____. → a) an obligation · b) optional · c) a polite request
8. *Don't have to work on Saturdays* means ____. → a) optional · b) forbidden · c) always required
9. *Have to study tonight* is for ____. → a) exam tomorrow · b) canteen · c) uniform only
10. Matches unit 28: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only Module 6

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) have to / don't have to** · 7. **a) an obligation** · 8. **a) optional** · 9. **a) exam tomorrow** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *I have to* + ____. → a) infinitive · b) *to* twice · c) *-ing* only
12. *She has to wear* is ____. → a) correct · b) wrong · c) Past Perfect
13. *Don't have to* ≠ *mustn't* at A2: ____. → a) true · b) false · c) irrelevant
14. Obligation vs optional: ask ____. → a) Is it necessary? · b) Is it past? · c) Is it Zero?
15. Reading helps you ____. → a) notice rules in context · b) skip form · c) avoid English

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) infinitive** · 12. **a) correct** · 13. **a) true** · 14. **a) Is it necessary?** · 15. **a) notice rules in context**

</details>


---

## Lección 4 — Listening: School rules

**Objetivo:** escuchar el foco gramatical en contexto.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-28/listening-have-to.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: School rules"></audio>

> At school, students have to wear uniform. They have to arrive on time. They don't have to bring lunch because the school has a canteen. Students have to do homework every day. They don't have to pay for books — the school gives them free. Teachers have to correct exams and help students.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Students have to ____. → a) Wear uniform · b) Pay for books · c) Skip homework
2. They have to ____. → a) Arrive on time · b) Bring lunch always · c) Correct exams
3. Lunch? → a) Don't have to bring (canteen) · b) Must bring · c) Never eat
4. Homework? → a) Every day · b) Never · c) Only teachers
5. Books? → a) Free from school · b) Must pay · c) Not mentioned

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Wear uniform** · 2. **a) Arrive on time** · 3. **a) Don't have to bring (canteen)** · 4. **a) Every day** · 5. **a) Free from school**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Listening is about ____. → a) school rules · b) dentist · c) London travel
7. Teachers have to ____. → a) correct exams and help · b) wear student uniform · c) bring lunch
8. *Don't have to pay for books* means ____. → a) books are free · b) forbidden to read · c) no school
9. *Have to* appears for students and ____. → a) teachers · b) only rain · c) only could
10. Unit 28 practice: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only Unit 60

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) school rules** · 7. **a) correct exams and help** · 8. **a) books are free** · 9. **a) teachers** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. Students *have to* + ____. → a) infinitive · b) *-ing* · c) PP
12. *They don't have to bring lunch* is ____. → a) optional · b) obligation · c) past ability
13. Shadow and ____. → a) mark obligation vs optional · b) ignore verbs · c) translate titles only
14. Write 3 school rules: ____. → a) good practice · b) useless · c) teachers only
15. U28 is not mainly about ____. → a) conditionals only · b) have to · c) don't have to

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) infinitive** · 12. **a) optional** · 13. **a) mark obligation vs optional** · 14. **a) good practice** · 15. **a) conditionals only**

</details>


---

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I ____ to get up early every day. → *have / has / having*
2. She ____ to wear a uniform. → *has / have / having*
3. We ____ have to work on Saturdays. → *don't / doesn't / isn't*
4. ____ they have to do homework? → *Do / Does / Are*
5. He ____ to study tonight. → *has / have / having*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **have** · 2. **has** · 3. **don't** · 4. **Do** · 5. **has**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. I / have / to / get / up / early / every / day.
7. She / doesn't / have / to / work / on / Saturdays.
8. Do / you / have / to / wear / a / uniform?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. I have to get up early every day.
7. She doesn't have to work on Saturdays.
8. Do you have to wear a uniform?

</details>


### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Tres obligaciones con *I have to…*.
10. Dos cosas opcionales con *I don't have to…*.
11. Una regla escolar con *Students have to…*.
12. Una pregunta *Do you have to…?*
13. Una frase con *has to* (he/she).
14. Contrasta obligación y opción en el trabajo.
15. Párrafo (6–8 frases) sobre tus reglas diarias.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

9. I have to get up early. I have to wear a uniform. I have to pay my bills.
10. I don't have to work on Saturdays. I don't have to cook today.
11. Students have to arrive on time.
12. Do you have to wear a uniform?
13. She has to study tonight for her exam.
14. I have to get up early, but I don't have to work on Saturdays.
15. I have to get up early because I work at eight. I have to wear a uniform. I don't have to work on Saturdays. I have to study tonight for my exam tomorrow!

</details>


---

## Resumen rápido

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Obligación** | *have to / has to* + infinitivo |
| **No necesario** | *don't / doesn't have to* |
| **Pregunta** | *Do/Does … have to…?* |
| **Cuidado** | *don't have to* ≠ prohibido |

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 29 del curso A2** (*Could: Past Ability & Polite Requests*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [Could A2](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-29-could-habilidad-peticiones)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 29 — Could: Past Ability & Polite Requests](/curso-a2/unit-29)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Could: Past Ability & Polite Requests](/blog/curso-a2/unit-29/a2-unit29-could.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática](#leccion-1--gramatica)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario](#leccion-2--vocabulario)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: Childhood and requests](#leccion-3--reading)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: Young and please](#leccion-4--listening)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing](#leccion-5--writing)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** could / couldn't (habilidad pasada) y Could you…? (peticiones educadas).

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. When I was young, I ____ swim very well. → *could / can / will*
2. Now I ____ speak English. → *can / could / will*
3. She ____ speak French when she was a child. → *could / can / cans*
4. I ____ cook when I lived with my parents. → *couldn't / can't / won't*
5. ____ you pass the salt, please? → *Could / Can / Do*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **could** · 2. **can** · 3. **could** · 4. **couldn't** · 5. **Could**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. Past ability uses ____. → a) could · b) can only · c) will
7. Polite requests often use ____. → a) Could you…? · b) You open! · c) Opened you
8. *Could* changes with he/she? → a) No, same for all · b) Yes, coulds · c) Yes, cans
9. After *could* use ____. → a) infinitive without to · b) to + infinitive · c) *-ing* only
10. Unit 29 trains ____. → a) could past + polite requests · b) only have to · c) only Zero

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) could** · 7. **a) Could you…?** · 8. **a) No, same for all** · 9. **a) infinitive without to** · 10. **a) could past + polite requests**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *I could to swim very well.*
12. *She coulds speak French.*
13. *When I was young, I can run fast.*
14. *Could you to help me?*
15. *I no could cook.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. I could swim very well.
12. She **could** speak French.
13. When I was young, I **could** run fast.
14. Could you help me?
15. I **couldn't** cook.

</details>


---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** swim, ride a bike, piano, pass the salt, turn down, repeat, polite.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja / elige

1. *ride a bike* ≈ ____ → *use a bicycle · swim · cook*
2. *pass the salt* ≈ ____ → *give someone the salt · open a window · run fast*
3. *turn down the volume* ≈ ____ → *make sound quieter · repeat · tell time*
4. *polite* ≈ ____ → *kind / respectful · angry · fast*
5. *at the age of five* ≈ ____ → *when you were five · tomorrow · never*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **use a bicycle** · 2. **give someone the salt** · 3. **make sound quieter** · 4. **kind / respectful** · 5. **when you were five**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. When I was a child, I could ____ very well. → *swim / swimming / swam*
7. I could play the ____ at seven. → *piano / pianos / pianing*
8. Could you ____ me the salt? → *pass / passing / passed*
9. Could you ____ down the volume? → *turn / turning / turned*
10. I couldn't ____ when I lived with my parents. → *cook / cooking / cooked*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **swim** · 7. **piano** · 8. **pass** · 9. **turn** · 10. **cook**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. *When I was young* signals ____. → a) past · b) future · c) Zero only
12. *Could you…, please?* is ____. → a) a polite request · b) past ability · c) obligation
13. *Now I can* contrasts with ____. → a) couldn't before · b) will tomorrow · c) have to
14. *Could you repeat that?* asks someone to ____. → a) say again · b) swim · c) pay bills
15. Unit 29 is about ____. → a) could (past + requests) · b) only conditionals · c) only have to

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) past** · 12. **a) a polite request** · 13. **a) couldn't before** · 14. **a) say again** · 15. **a) could (past + requests)**

</details>

## Lección 3 — Reading: Childhood and requests

**Objetivo:** comprender un texto con el foco de la unidad.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-29/reading-could.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Childhood and requests"></audio>

> When I was a child, I could swim very well. I could ride a bike at the age of five. I couldn't speak English when I was young, but now I can. Could you pass me the salt, please? Could you help me with this bag? Could you open the window? It is hot in here.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. As a child, what could they do well? → a) Swim · b) Cook · c) Speak English
2. At what age ride a bike? → a) Five · b) Seven · c) Never
3. English when young? → a) Couldn't, but now can · b) Always could · c) Not mentioned
4. What polite requests? → a) Salt, help, open window · b) Pay bills · c) Study exam
5. Why open the window? → a) Hot in here · b) Cold · c) Exam tomorrow

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Swim** · 2. **a) Five** · 3. **a) Couldn't, but now can** · 4. **a) Salt, help, open window** · 5. **a) Hot in here**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. The text mixes ____. → a) past could + Could you…? · b) only have to · c) only Zero
7. *When I was a child* introduces ____. → a) past ability · b) school rules · c) scientific facts
8. *Could you pass me the salt* is ____. → a) a request · b) past ability · c) obligation
9. *Now I can* shows ____. → a) present ability · b) only past · c) don't have to
10. Matches unit 29: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only Module 6

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) past could + Could you…?** · 7. **a) past ability** · 8. **a) a request** · 9. **a) present ability** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. Past ability: *could* + ____. → a) infinitive · b) to + inf · c) *-ing*
12. *Could you help me?* is ____. → a) polite · b) rude · c) Past Perfect
13. *Couldn't* = ____. → a) could not · b) can not now · c) will not
14. Same word *could*, different ____. → a) context (past vs request) · b) spelling · c) tense always
15. Reading helps you ____. → a) separate past and requests · b) skip form · c) avoid English

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) infinitive** · 12. **a) polite** · 13. **a) could not** · 14. **a) context (past vs request)** · 15. **a) separate past and requests**

</details>


---

## Lección 4 — Listening: Young and please

**Objetivo:** escuchar el foco gramatical en contexto.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-29/listening-could.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Young and please"></audio>

> When I was young, I could run very fast. I could play the piano at the age of seven. I couldn't cook when I lived with my parents. Could you turn down the volume, please? Could you repeat that, please? Could you tell me the time? I forgot my watch at home.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. When young, could run ____. → a) Very fast · b) Very slowly · c) Not at all
2. Piano at age ____. → a) Seven · b) Five · c) Ten
3. Cooking with parents? → a) Couldn't · b) Could very well · c) Not mentioned
4. Requests include ____. → a) Volume, repeat, time · b) Salt only · c) Uniform
5. Why ask the time? → a) Forgot watch at home · b) Hot in here · c) Exam tomorrow

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Very fast** · 2. **a) Seven** · 3. **a) Couldn't** · 4. **a) Volume, repeat, time** · 5. **a) Forgot watch at home**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Listening separates ____. → a) past could vs Could you…? · b) only Zero · c) only have to
7. *Turn down the volume* is ____. → a) a request · b) past ability · c) obligation
8. *At the age of seven* refers to ____. → a) piano · b) swimming at five · c) cooking
9. *Please* appears with requests: ____. → a) yes · b) never · c) only past
10. Unit 29 practice: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only Unit 60

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) past could vs Could you…?** · 7. **a) a request** · 8. **a) piano** · 9. **a) yes** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *When I was young, I could…* = ____. → a) past ability · b) request · c) Zero
12. *Could you tell me the time?* = ____. → a) request · b) past ability · c) have to
13. Shadow and ____. → a) label past vs request · b) ignore verbs · c) translate titles only
14. Write 2 past + 2 requests: ____. → a) good practice · b) useless · c) teachers only
15. U29 is mainly about ____. → a) could · b) only First · c) only don't have to

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) past ability** · 12. **a) request** · 13. **a) label past vs request** · 14. **a) good practice** · 15. **a) could**

</details>


---

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. When I was a child, I ____ swim well. → *could / can / will*
2. Now I ____ speak English. → *can / could / will*
3. I ____ cook when I lived with my parents. → *couldn't / can't / won't*
4. ____ you help me with this bag, please? → *Could / Do / Are*
5. Could you ____ the window? → *open / opening / opened*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **could** · 2. **can** · 3. **couldn't** · 4. **Could** · 5. **open**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. When / I / was / young, / I / could / run / very / fast.
7. Could / you / pass / me / the / salt, / please?
8. I / couldn't / speak / English / when / I / was / young.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. When I was young, I could run very fast.
7. Could you pass me the salt, please?
8. I couldn't speak English when I was young.

</details>


### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Dos habilidades pasadas (*When I was…, I could…*).
10. Una negativa pasada (*I couldn't…*).
11. Contraste *Then I could… / Now I can…*.
12. Tres peticiones con *Could you…, please?*
13. Una petición sobre volumen o repetir.
14. Una petición educada en un restaurante.
15. Párrafo (6–8 frases) mezclando pasado y peticiones.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

9. When I was a child, I could swim very well. I could ride a bike at five.
10. I couldn't cook when I lived with my parents.
11. I couldn't speak English when I was young, but now I can.
12. Could you pass the salt? Could you help me? Could you open the window?
13. Could you turn down the volume, please?
14. Could you bring me the menu, please?
15. When I was young, I could run very fast. I could play the piano at seven. I couldn't cook then, but now I can. Could you repeat that, please? Could you tell me the time?

</details>


---

## Resumen rápido

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Pasado** | *could / couldn't* + infinitivo |
| **Petición** | *Could you…, please?* |
| **Ahora** | *can* (habilidad presente) |
| **Truco** | pasado → *could* · pedir → *Could you…?* |

---

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 3 del curso A2** (*Past Simple: Irregular Verbs*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [Past Simple irregulares A2](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-3-past-simple-verbos-irregulares)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 3 — Past Simple: verbos irregulares](/curso-a2/unit-3)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Irregular verbs](/blog/curso-a2/unit-3/a2-unit3-irregular-verbs.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática: irregulares](#leccion-1--gramatica-irregulares)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario: went, saw, had…](#leccion-2--vocabulario-went-saw-had)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: Last weekend](#leccion-3--reading-last-weekend)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: A trip to London](#leccion-4--listening-a-trip-to-london)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing: My last trip](#leccion-5--writing-my-last-trip)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática: irregulares

**Objetivo:** *went, saw, had, made, wrote, bought*; *didn't / Did* + base.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I ____ to the cinema yesterday. → *went / go / goed*  
2. She ____ a film last night. → *saw / see / seen*  
3. We ____ a great time at the party. → *had / have / haved*  
4. He ____ a cake for his birthday. → *made / make / maked*  
5. They ____ some souvenirs. → *bought / buy / buyed*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **went**  
2. **saw** — no *seen* en Past Simple.  
3. **had**  
4. **made**  
5. **bought**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. Past of *write* = ____. → a) wrote · b) writed · c) written (here)  
7. *I goed to London* is ____. → a) wrong · b) correct · c) future  
8. After *didn't* we use ____. → a) base (*go*) · b) *went* · c) *going*  
9. *Did you ____ a film?* → a) see · b) saw · c) seen  
10. *Seen* in *I seen a film* is ____. → a) wrong for Past Simple · b) correct · c) better

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) wrote**  
7. **a) wrong**  
8. **a) base (*go*)**  
9. **a) see**  
10. **a) wrong for Past Simple**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *I goed to the shop.*  
12. *She buyed a dress.*  
13. *He didn't went home.*  
14. *Did you saw Tom?*  
15. *I seen a film yesterday.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. I **went** to the shop.  
12. She **bought** a dress.  
13. He didn't **go** home.  
14. Did you **see** Tom?  
15. I **saw** a film yesterday.

</details>

---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario: went, saw, had…

**Objetivo:** memorizar pares base → past.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja

1. go  
2. see  
3. have  
4. make  
5. buy  

a) saw · b) went · c) bought · d) had · e) made

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **b** · 2 → **a** · 3 → **d** · 4 → **e** · 5 → **c**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. write → ____  
7. go → ____  
8. see → ____  
9. make → ____  
10. buy → ____  

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **wrote** · 7. **went** · 8. **saw** · 9. **made** · 10. **bought**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. *Souvenirs* = ____. → a) things you buy on a trip · b) medicine · c) homework  
12. *Market* = ____. → a) place to buy food · b) cinema · c) hospital  
13. *Postcard* = ____. → a) short card you write to someone · b) a cake · c) a film  
14. *Had coffee* = ____. → a) drank coffee · b) bought a car · c) wrote a letter  
15. *Made dinner* = ____. → a) cooked dinner · b) saw a film · c) went shopping

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) things you buy on a trip**  
12. **a) place to buy food**  
13. **a) short card you write to someone**  
14. **a) drank coffee**  
15. **a) cooked dinner**

</details>

---

## Lección 3 — Reading: Last weekend

**Objetivo:** leer un relato con irregulares (+ algún regular).

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-3/reading-irregular.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Last weekend"></audio>

> Last weekend I had a wonderful time. On Saturday morning I went to the market and bought some fresh fruit and vegetables. Then I saw my old friend Tom at the cafe. We had coffee together and talked for hours. In the afternoon I went home and made a delicious cake for my family. My sister wrote a letter to our grandmother and I helped her with it. In the evening we saw a film on TV. It was very good!

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Where did they go on Saturday morning? → a) The market · b) London · c) School  
2. Who did they see at the cafe? → a) Tom · b) Sarah · c) Maria  
3. What did they make in the afternoon? → a) A cake · b) Pasta only · c) Nothing  
4. What did the sister write? → a) A letter · b) A book · c) An email only  
5. What did they see in the evening? → a) A film · b) A match · c) A museum

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) The market**  
2. **a) Tom**  
3. **a) A cake**  
4. **a) A letter**  
5. **a) A film**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Irregular past verbs include ____. → a) had, went, bought, saw, made, wrote · b) only walked · c) only am  
7. *Talked* and *helped* are ____. → a) regular · b) irregular · c) future  
8. They bought ____. → a) fruit and vegetables · b) a car · c) tickets only  
9. The cake was for ____. → a) the family · b) Tom only · c) school  
10. The main topic is ____. → a) a wonderful weekend · b) introductions · c) weather

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) had, went, bought, saw, made, wrote**  
7. **a) regular**  
8. **a) fruit and vegetables**  
9. **a) the family**  
10. **a) a wonderful weekend**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Went* is past of ____. → a) go · b) see · c) buy  
12. *Saw* is past of ____. → a) see · b) go · c) write  
13. *Wrote* is past of ____. → a) write · b) make · c) have  
14. *Bought* is past of ____. → a) buy · b) bring · c) bringed  
15. Mix regular + irregular is ____. → a) natural in stories · b) wrong · c) only for A1

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) go**  
12. **a) see**  
13. **a) write**  
14. **a) buy**  
15. **a) natural in stories**

</details>

---

## Lección 4 — Listening: A trip to London

**Objetivo:** escuchar un relato de viaje con irregulares.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-3/listening-irregular.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: A trip to London"></audio>

> Hi! I want to tell you about my trip last month. I went to London with my family. We had a wonderful time! On the first day we went to the British Museum. I saw many interesting things there. Then we bought some souvenirs from a shop near the museum. My sister wrote postcards to her friends. In the evening we made dinner at our hotel. It was delicious! I really enjoyed the trip.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Where did they go? → a) London · b) Madrid · c) Barcelona  
2. Who did they travel with? → a) Family · b) Alone · c) Only Tom  
3. Where did they go on the first day? → a) The British Museum · b) The beach · c) School  
4. What did they buy? → a) Souvenirs · b) A car · c) Medicine  
5. What did they make in the evening? → a) Dinner · b) A cake only · c) Postcards

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) London**  
2. **a) Family**  
3. **a) The British Museum**  
4. **a) Souvenirs**  
5. **a) Dinner**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. The sister wrote ____. → a) postcards · b) a novel · c) homework  
7. Dinner was at ____. → a) the hotel · b) the museum · c) school  
8. They had a ____ time. → a) wonderful · b) terrible · c) boring  
9. *Enjoyed* is ____. → a) regular past · b) irregular · c) present  
10. The listening practices ____. → a) irregular past verbs · b) only *to be* · c) conditionals

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) postcards**  
7. **a) the hotel**  
8. **a) wonderful**  
9. **a) regular past**  
10. **a) irregular past verbs**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Went / saw / bought / wrote / made / had* are ____. → a) irregular past · b) present · c) future  
12. *Last month* marks ____. → a) past · b) future · c) never  
13. After *Did* use ____. → a) base · b) past form · c) *-ing*  
14. *Made dinner* = ____. → a) cooked dinner · b) bought dinner only · c) saw dinner  
15. Trip story order starts with ____. → a) went to London · b) made dinner · c) wrote postcards

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) irregular past**  
12. **a) past**  
13. **a) base**  
14. **a) cooked dinner**  
15. **a) went to London**

</details>

---

## Lección 5 — Writing: My last trip

**Objetivo:** escribir un relato con irregulares.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. Yesterday I ____ to the park. → *went / go / goed*  
2. I ____ many people there. → *saw / see / seen*  
3. We ____ a great time. → *had / have / haved*  
4. She ____ a letter. → *wrote / write / writed*  
5. They ____ souvenirs. → *bought / buy / buyed*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **went** · 2. **saw** · 3. **had** · 4. **wrote** · 5. **bought**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. I / went / to London / last month.  
7. She / bought / a new dress / yesterday.  
8. We / made / dinner / at the hotel.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. I went to London last month.  
7. She bought a new dress yesterday.  
8. We made dinner at the hotel.

</details>

### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Fui al mercado ayer.  
10. Vi a un amigo en el café.  
11. Compré fruta fresca.  
12. Hice un pastel para mi familia.  
13. Negativa: no fui a Londres.  
14. Pregunta: ¿Compraste souvenirs?  
15. Párrafo (6–8 frases) de un viaje/fin de semana con 5 irregulares.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución (ejemplos)</summary>

9. I went to the market yesterday.  
10. I saw a friend at the cafe.  
11. I bought fresh fruit.  
12. I made a cake for my family.  
13. I didn't go to London.  
14. Did you buy souvenirs?  
15. Last weekend I went to the market. I bought fruit. Then I saw my friend. We had coffee. In the evening I made dinner and we saw a film. I had a wonderful time!

</details>

---

## Resumen rápido

| Base | Past |
| :--- | :--- |
| go | **went** |
| see | **saw** |
| have | **had** |
| make | **made** |
| write | **wrote** |
| buy | **bought** |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

Continúa con la [**Unidad 4 — Wh-questions en Past Simple**](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-4-wh-questions-past-simple): *What/Where/When/Who/Why/How did…?*

Antes de pasar de unidad, memoriza los 6 pares y cuenta un mini-viaje.

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 30 del curso A2** (*Module 3 Review*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [Repaso Módulo 3 A2](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-30-repaso-modulo-3)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 30 — Module 3 Review](/curso-a2/unit-30)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Module 3 Review](/blog/curso-a2/unit-30/a2-unit30-module3-review.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática](#leccion-1--gramatica)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario](#leccion-2--vocabulario)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: Next week](#leccion-3--reading)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: Dentist tomorrow](#leccion-4--listening)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing](#leccion-5--writing)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** repaso integrado: futuro, condicionales, have to y could.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. Next week I ____ travel to London. → *will / am / have*
2. If it ____, I will take an umbrella. → *rains / will rain / rained*
3. If you heat water, it ____. → *boils / will boil / boiled*
4. I ____ to get up early tomorrow. → *have / has / having*
5. When I was young, I ____ speak two languages. → *could / can / will*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **will** · 2. **rains** · 3. **boils** · 4. **have** · 5. **could**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. *If it rains, I will…* is ____. → a) First Conditional · b) Zero · c) have to
7. *If you heat water, it boils* is ____. → a) Zero · b) First · c) could past
8. *Don't have to work on Friday* means ____. → a) optional · b) forbidden · c) past ability
9. *Could you pass me the water?* is ____. → a) polite request · b) Zero · c) will promise
10. Unit 30 reviews ____. → a) Module 3 mix · b) only Unit 1 · c) only phrasal verbs

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) First Conditional** · 7. **a) Zero** · 8. **a) optional** · 9. **a) polite request** · 10. **a) Module 3 mix**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *If it will rains, I will take an umbrella.*
12. *If you heat water, it will boils.* *(general fact)*
13. *She have to get up early.*
14. *When I was young, I can speak two languages.*
15. *Could you to pass me the water?*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. If it **rains**, I will take an umbrella.
12. If you heat water, it **boils**.
13. She **has to** get up early.
14. When I was young, I **could** speak two languages.
15. Could you pass me the water?

</details>


---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** umbrella, meeting, dentist, glasses, slowly, general fact.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja / elige

1. *umbrella* ≈ ____ → *use when it rains · a bike · homework*
2. *general fact* ≈ ____ → *always true · tomorrow's plan · polite ask*
3. *dentist* ≈ ____ → *tooth doctor · train station · uniform*
4. *glasses* ≈ ____ → *wear to see/read better · cook · boil*
5. *slowly* ≈ ____ → *not fast · always · yesterday*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **use when it rains** · 2. **always true** · 3. **tooth doctor** · 4. **wear to see/read better** · 5. **not fast**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. If it rains, I will take an ____. → *umbrella / umbrellas / umbrelling*
7. I have to get up early because I have a ____. → *meeting / meet / met*
8. I don't have to ____ on Friday. → *work / working / worked*
9. Tomorrow I will go to the ____. → *dentist / dentists / dentisting*
10. Could you speak more ____, please? → *slowly / slow / slowness*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **umbrella** · 7. **meeting** · 8. **work** · 9. **dentist** · 10. **slowly**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. London trip uses ____. → a) will · b) Zero only · c) couldn't
12. Teeth yellow without brushing is ____. → a) Zero fact · b) First future · c) have to
13. *I could draw well* is ____. → a) past ability · b) request · c) obligation
14. Module 3 asks you to ____. → a) choose the right form · b) use one form only · c) avoid English
15. Unit 30 is ____. → a) integrated review · b) only greetings · c) only Unit 31

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) will** · 12. **a) Zero fact** · 13. **a) past ability** · 14. **a) choose the right form** · 15. **a) integrated review**

</details>

## Lección 3 — Reading: Next week

**Objetivo:** comprender un texto con el foco de la unidad.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-30/reading-review.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Next week"></audio>

> Next week I will travel to London. If it rains, I will take an umbrella. If you heat water, it boils — that is a general fact. I have to get up early tomorrow because I have a meeting. I don't have to work on Friday. When I was young, I could speak two languages. Could you pass me the water, please?

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Next week? → a) Travel to London · b) Go to dentist · c) Draw well
2. If it rains? → a) Take an umbrella · b) Boil water · c) Work on Friday
3. Heat water? → a) Boils (general fact) · b) Will travel · c) Get up early
4. Friday? → a) Don't have to work · b) Have to wear uniform · c) Forgot watch
5. When young? → a) Could speak two languages · b) Could draw well · c) Will go to dentist

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Travel to London** · 2. **a) Take an umbrella** · 3. **a) Boils (general fact)** · 4. **a) Don't have to work** · 5. **a) Could speak two languages**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. The text mixes ____. → a) will / First / Zero / have to / could · b) only Past · c) only Unit 1
7. *Have a meeting* explains ____. → a) get up early · b) boil water · c) draw well
8. *Could you pass me the water* is ____. → a) a request · b) Zero · c) will travel
9. Zero fact is marked as ____. → a) general fact · b) tomorrow only · c) past ability
10. Matches unit 30 review: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only Module 6

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) will / First / Zero / have to / could** · 7. **a) get up early** · 8. **a) a request** · 9. **a) general fact** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. Label *If it rains, I will…*: ____. → a) First · b) Zero · c) could
12. Label *If you heat water, it boils*: ____. → a) Zero · b) First · c) have to
13. Integrated texts are ____. → a) natural at review · b) wrong · c) only C2
14. Ask what you mean first, then ____. → a) choose form · b) random pick · c) always will
15. Reading helps you ____. → a) tag each structure · b) skip meaning · c) avoid English

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) First** · 12. **a) Zero** · 13. **a) natural at review** · 14. **a) choose form** · 15. **a) tag each structure**

</details>

## Lección 4 — Listening: Dentist tomorrow

**Objetivo:** escuchar el foco gramatical en contexto.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-30/listening-review.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Dentist tomorrow"></audio>

> Tomorrow I will go to the dentist. If I finish early, I will have lunch with a friend. If you don't brush your teeth, they get yellow — that is a general fact. I have to wear glasses when I read. I don't have to work tomorrow. When I was a child, I could draw well. Could you speak more slowly, please?

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Tomorrow? → a) Go to the dentist · b) Travel to London · c) Work on Friday
2. Finish early? → a) Lunch with a friend · b) Take umbrella · c) Boil water
3. Don't brush teeth? → a) They get yellow · b) Will travel · c) Wear glasses
4. When read? → a) Have to wear glasses · b) Don't have to work · c) Could speak languages
5. Polite request? → a) Speak more slowly · b) Pass water only · c) Get up early

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Go to the dentist** · 2. **a) Lunch with a friend** · 3. **a) They get yellow** · 4. **a) Have to wear glasses** · 5. **a) Speak more slowly**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Listening mixes ____. → a) Module 3 forms · b) only spelling · c) only *into*
7. *General fact* refers to ____. → a) yellow teeth without brushing · b) dentist trip · c) draw well
8. *Don't have to work tomorrow* is ____. → a) optional · b) obligation · c) Zero condition
9. *When I was a child, I could draw well* is ____. → a) past ability · b) request · c) will
10. Unit 30 practice: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only Unit 60

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Module 3 forms** · 7. **a) yellow teeth without brushing** · 8. **a) optional** · 9. **a) past ability** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. Tag *Tomorrow I will go…*: ____. → a) will/future · b) Zero · c) couldn't only
12. Tag *If I finish early, I will…*: ____. → a) First · b) Zero · c) have to only
13. Shadow and ____. → a) label each grammar point · b) ignore verbs · c) translate titles only
14. Write a mini Module 3 story: ____. → a) good review · b) useless · c) teachers only
15. U30 closes ____. → a) Module 3 · b) Module 1 · c) the whole A2 course

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) will/future** · 12. **a) First** · 13. **a) label each grammar point** · 14. **a) good review** · 15. **a) Module 3**

</details>


---

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. Next week I ____ travel to London. → *will / am / have*
2. If it rains, I will take an ____. → *umbrella / umbrellas / umbrellas*
3. If you heat water, it ____. → *boils / will boil / boiled*
4. I ____ to get up early tomorrow. → *have / has / having*
5. Could you pass me the ____, please? → *water / waters / watering*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **will** · 2. **umbrella** · 3. **boils** · 4. **have** · 5. **water**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. If / it / rains, / I / will / take / an / umbrella.
7. I / don't / have / to / work / on / Friday.
8. Could / you / speak / more / slowly, / please?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. If it rains, I will take an umbrella.
7. I don't have to work on Friday.
8. Could you speak more slowly, please?

</details>


### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Una frase con *will* o *going to*.
10. Una First Conditional.
11. Una Zero Conditional.
12. Una obligación y una opción (*have to / don't have to*).
13. Una habilidad pasada con *could*.
14. Una petición con *Could you…?*
15. Párrafo (8–10 frases) repaso Módulo 3.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

9. Next week I will travel to London.
10. If it rains, I will take an umbrella.
11. If you heat water, it boils.
12. I have to get up early tomorrow. I don't have to work on Friday.
13. When I was young, I could speak two languages.
14. Could you pass me the water, please?
15. Next week I will travel to London. If it rains, I will take an umbrella. If you heat water, it boils. I have to get up early tomorrow. I don't have to work on Friday. When I was young, I could speak two languages. Could you help me, please?

</details>


---

## Resumen rápido

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Futuro** | *going to / will / am meeting* |
| **Condicionales** | First (*will*) · Zero (Present) |
| **Obligación** | *have to / don't have to* |
| **Could** | pasado · *Could you…?* |

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 31 del curso A2** (*Phrasal Verbs: Introduction*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [Phrasal verbs A2](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-31-phrasal-verbs-introduccion)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 31 — Phrasal Verbs: Introduction](/curso-a2/unit-31)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Phrasal Verbs: Introduction](/blog/curso-a2/unit-31/a2-unit31-phrasal-verbs.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática](#leccion-1--gramatica)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario](#leccion-2--vocabulario)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: Morning routine](#leccion-3--reading)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: In class and at home](#leccion-4--listening)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing](#leccion-5--writing)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** phrasal verbs básicos: get up, wake up, look for, turn on/off, sit down, stand up.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I ____ at 7 every day. *(dejar de dormir)* → *wake up / get up / look for*
2. Then I ____ and have a shower. *(salir de la cama)* → *get up / wake up / turn on*
3. I ____ my keys every morning. → *look for / look / look at*
4. ____ the light, please. *(encender)* → *Turn on / Turn off / Sit down*
5. ____ the TV before you go to bed. *(apagar)* → *Turn off / Turn on / Stand up*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **wake up** · 2. **get up** · 3. **look for** · 4. **Turn on** · 5. **Turn off**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. A phrasal verb is ____. → a) verb + particle · b) only one word · c) noun + adjective
7. *Wake up* vs *get up*: wake up = ____. → a) stop sleeping · b) leave the house · c) eat breakfast
8. *Look for* needs ____. → a) for · b) at · c) no particle
9. *Turn on* and *turn off* are ____. → a) opposites · b) the same · c) only past tense
10. Unit 31 introduces ____. → a) basic phrasal verbs · b) separable rules only · c) articles

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) verb + particle** · 7. **a) stop sleeping** · 8. **a) for** · 9. **a) opposites** · 10. **a) basic phrasal verbs**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *I look my keys every morning.*
12. *Turn the light.* *(encender)*
13. *I get up of bed at 7.*
14. *Please sit.* *(en clase)*
15. *I wake up the bed.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. I **look for** my keys every morning.
12. **Turn on** the light.
13. I **get up** at 7.
14. Please **sit down**.
15. I **wake up** at 7. / I **get up** at 7.

</details>


---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** wake up, get up, look for, turn on/off, sit down, stand up, light, keys, phone.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja / elige

1. *wake up* ≈ ____ → *stop sleeping · leave home · turn off*
2. *get up* ≈ ____ → *leave the bed · look for keys · sit down*
3. *look for* ≈ ____ → *search · encender · apagar*
4. *turn on* ≈ ____ → *switch on · stand up · wake up*
5. *sit down* ≈ ____ → *take a seat · get up · look for*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **stop sleeping** · 2. **leave the bed** · 3. **search** · 4. **switch on** · 5. **take a seat**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. Every morning I ____ up at seven. → *wake / get / look*
7. Then I ____ up and turn on the light. → *get / wake / sit*
8. I look ____ my keys and my phone. → *for / at / on*
9. Please ____ down — the lesson is starting. → *sit / stand / turn*
10. After breakfast I stand ____ and turn off the lights. → *up / down / on*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **wake** · 7. **get** · 8. **for** · 9. **sit** · 10. **up**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. *Look for* is ____. → a) inseparable in U31 · b) always separable · c) only past
12. *Turn off the lights* means ____. → a) apagar · b) encender · c) buscar
13. *Stand up* is the opposite of ____. → a) sit down · b) wake up · c) look for
14. Phrasal verbs in U31 are about ____. → a) routines & instructions · b) only shopping · c) only past tense
15. Unit 31 prepares you for ____. → a) separable phrasals (U32) · b) articles only · c) Zero Conditional

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) inseparable in U31** · 12. **a) apagar** · 13. **a) sit down** · 14. **a) routines & instructions** · 15. **a) separable phrasals (U32)**

</details>


---

## Lección 3 — Reading: Morning routine

**Objetivo:** comprender un texto con el foco de la unidad.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-31/reading-phrasal.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Morning routine"></audio>

> Every morning I wake up at seven. Then I get up and turn on the light. I look for my keys and my phone. I sit down to have breakfast. After that I stand up, turn off the lights and leave home.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Wake up time? → a) Seven · b) Eight · c) Before school only
2. After getting up? → a) Turn on the light · b) Turn off the TV · c) Look for the file
3. What does she look for? → a) Keys and phone · b) Bag only · c) Computers
4. Before leaving? → a) Turn off the lights · b) Turn on computers · c) Sit in class
5. Breakfast? → a) Sit down to eat · b) Stand up only · c) Wake up in bed

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Seven** · 2. **a) Turn on the light** · 3. **a) Keys and phone** · 4. **a) Turn off the lights** · 5. **a) Sit down to eat**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. The text describes ____. → a) a morning routine · b) a shop dialogue · c) subject questions
7. *Get up* comes after ____. → a) wake up · b) turn off · c) look for file
8. *Turn on* is used with ____. → a) the light · b) the radio in class · c) worksheets
9. Order: stand up, then ____. → a) turn off lights & leave · b) wake up · c) sit for breakfast first
10. Matches unit 31 phrasals: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only U35

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) a morning routine** · 7. **a) wake up** · 8. **a) the light** · 9. **a) turn off lights & leave** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Wake up* = ____. → a) stop sleeping · b) leave home · c) search
12. *Look for* always includes ____. → a) for · b) at · c) off
13. Instructions often use ____. → a) Turn on / Sit down · b) Who called you? · c) some / any
14. Learn each phrasal as ____. → a) one block · b) separate words only · c) only in past
15. Reading helps you ____. → a) spot phrasals in context · b) skip particles · c) avoid English

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) stop sleeping** · 12. **a) for** · 13. **a) Turn on / Sit down** · 14. **a) one block** · 15. **a) spot phrasals in context**

</details>


---

## Lección 4 — Listening: In class and at home

**Objetivo:** escuchar el foco gramatical en contexto.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-31/listening-phrasal.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: In class and at home"></audio>

> Good morning! Please sit down. Don't stand up yet. First, turn on your computers. If you look for the file on your desk, you will find it. When you finish, turn off the computers. At home I wake up early, get up, turn on the radio and look for my bag before school.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. First instruction in class? → a) Sit down · b) Stand up · c) Leave home
2. Computers? → a) Turn on first · b) Never use · c) Turn on radio
3. File? → a) Look for it on the desk · b) Buy at shop · c) Give back
4. When finish in class? → a) Turn off computers · b) Wake up · c) Eat breakfast
5. At home before school? → a) Wake up, get up, radio, look for bag · b) Only sit down · c) Visit cousin

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Sit down** · 2. **a) Turn on first** · 3. **a) Look for it on the desk** · 4. **a) Turn off computers** · 5. **a) Wake up, get up, radio, look for bag**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Listening mixes ____. → a) class instructions + home routine · b) only shopping · c) only questions
7. *Don't stand up yet* means ____. → a) stay seated for now · b) leave immediately · c) turn off lights
8. *Look for the file* is ____. → a) search on desk · b) put on jacket · c) subject question
9. Home routine includes ____. → a) turn on the radio · b) give worksheets back · c) How many tomatoes
10. Unit 31 practice: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only Module 6

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) class instructions + home routine** · 7. **a) stay seated for now** · 8. **a) search on desk** · 9. **a) turn on the radio** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Please sit down* is ____. → a) an instruction · b) a subject question · c) a quantity
12. *Turn on your computers* uses ____. → a) turn on · b) look for · c) give back
13. Shadow the audio and ____. → a) mark each phrasal · b) skip particles · c) translate titles only
14. Class + home texts show phrasals are ____. → a) everyday · b) rare · c) only C1
15. U31 opens ____. → a) Module 4 phrasals · b) Module 1 only · c) articles review

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) an instruction** · 12. **a) turn on** · 13. **a) mark each phrasal** · 14. **a) everyday** · 15. **a) Module 4 phrasals**

</details>


---

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I ____ up at 7 every day. → *wake / get / look*
2. Then I get up and turn ____ the light. → *on / off / for*
3. I look ____ my keys every morning. → *for / at / on*
4. Please ____ down. → *sit / stand / turn*
5. ____ off the lights before you leave. → *Turn / Look / Wake*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **wake** · 2. **on** · 3. **for** · 4. **sit** · 5. **Turn**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. Please / sit / down.
7. Turn / on / the / light, / please.
8. I / look / for / my / keys / every / morning.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. Please sit down.
7. Turn on the light, please.
8. I look for my keys every morning.

</details>


### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Una frase con *wake up*.
10. Una frase con *get up* y *turn on*.
11. Una frase con *look for*.
12. Una instrucción con *sit down* o *stand up*.
13. Una instrucción con *turn off*.
14. Explica *wake up* vs *get up* con tu horario.
15. Párrafo (8–10 frases) sobre tu mañana con phrasals.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

9. I wake up at seven every morning.
10. I get up and turn on the light.
11. I look for my keys every morning.
12. Please sit down.
13. Turn off the lights before you leave.
14. I wake up at 7, but I get up at 7:15.
15. Every morning I wake up at seven. Then I get up and turn on the light. I look for my keys and my phone. I sit down to have breakfast. After that I stand up, turn off the lights and leave home.

</details>


---

## Resumen rápido

| Phrasal | Idea |
| :--- | :--- |
| **wake up / get up** | despertarse / levantarse |
| **look for** | buscar |
| **turn on / off** | encender / apagar |
| **sit down / stand up** | sentarse / ponerse de pie |

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 32 del curso A2** (*Phrasal Verbs: Separable*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [Phrasal verbs separables A2](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-32-phrasal-verbs-separables)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 32 — Phrasal Verbs: Separable](/curso-a2/unit-32)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Phrasal Verbs: Separable](/blog/curso-a2/unit-32/a2-unit32-phrasal-separable.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática](#leccion-1--gramatica)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario](#leccion-2--vocabulario)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: Morning at home](#leccion-3--reading)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: In class](#leccion-4--listening)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing](#leccion-5--writing)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** phrasal verbs separables; pronombre en el medio (turn it off).

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. The TV is on. Please turn ____ off. → *it / on it / off it*
2. Your bag is on the floor. Pick ____ up. → *it / up it / on it*
3. It's cold. Put your coat ____. → *on / on it / it on*
4. We're home. Take your shoes ____. → *off / off them / them off*
5. This is Ana's pen. Give ____ back. → *it / back it / it back*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **it** · 2. **it** · 3. **on** *(Put your coat on / Put on your coat)* · 4. **off** *(Take your shoes off / Take them off)* · 5. **it** *(Give it back)*

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. With a pronoun object, place it ____. → a) in the middle · b) after the particle · c) before the verb only
7. ~~Turn off it~~ is wrong because ____. → a) pronoun must be middle · b) turn is irregular · c) off is inseparable always
8. *Pick up the book* = ____. → a) Pick the book up · b) Pick up book the · c) Pick book for
9. *Put on* vs *take off* are ____. → a) opposites (clothes) · b) the same · c) only inseparable
10. Unit 32 focuses on ____. → a) separable phrasals · b) only look for · c) articles

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) in the middle** · 7. **a) pronoun must be middle** · 8. **a) Pick the book up** · 9. **a) opposites (clothes)** · 10. **a) separable phrasals**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *Turn off it, please.*
12. *Pick up them from the floor.*
13. *Put on it your jacket.*
14. *Give back it tomorrow.*
15. *Take off them before you sit.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. Turn **it** off, please.
12. Pick **them** up from the floor.
13. Put **it** on. / Put your jacket on.
14. Give **it** back tomorrow.
15. Take **them** off before you sit.

</details>


---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** pick up, put down, take off, put on, give back, separable vs inseparable.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja / elige

1. *pick up* ≈ ____ → *collect / lift · put down · turn on*
2. *put down* ≈ ____ → *place down · take off · give back*
3. *put on* ≈ ____ → *wear / start · take off · pick up*
4. *take off* ≈ ____ → *remove (clothes) · put on · look for*
5. *give back* ≈ ____ → *return · pick up · sit down*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **collect / lift** · 2. **place down** · 3. **wear / start** · 4. **remove (clothes)** · 5. **return**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. Turn the TV off. = Turn ____ the TV ____. → *off / on · the / it*
7. Pick up the keys. = Pick ____ keys ____. → *the / up · up / the*
8. Put your coat on. = Put ____ coat ____. → *on / your · your / on*
9. Please put ____ your bags ____. → *down / your · your / down*
10. Can you give ____ back? → *it / back it / it back*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **off** the TV *(or: Turn the TV off)* · 7. **the** keys **up** · 8. **your** coat **on** · 9. **down** your bags **here** *(put down your bags)* · 10. **it** back

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. *Look for* is ____. → a) inseparable · b) separable with pronoun middle · c) only past
12. *Turn off the TV* and *turn the TV off* are ____. → a) both correct · b) only first · c) only second
13. *Give it back* means ____. → a) devolver · b) encender · c) buscar
14. Separable phrasals with names: object can be ____. → a) two positions · b) only after particle · c) never used
15. Unit 32 builds on U31 ____. → a) phrasal basics · b) only could · c) only some/any

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) inseparable** · 12. **a) both correct** · 13. **a) devolver** · 14. **a) two positions** · 15. **a) phrasal basics**

</details>


---

## Lección 3 — Reading: Morning at home

**Objetivo:** comprender un texto con el foco de la unidad.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-32/reading-separable.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Morning at home"></audio>

> Every morning I wake up and get up. I look for my phone. Then I put on my clothes and pick up my bag. Before I leave, I turn the lights off. If I borrow my sister's scarf, I give it back in the evening.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. After looking for the phone? → a) Put on clothes & pick up bag · b) Give back scarf · c) Turn on computers
2. Before leaving? → a) Turn the lights off · b) Sit down in class · c) Order cappuccino
3. Sister's scarf? → a) Give it back in evening · b) Keep it · c) Pick up from floor
4. *Look for* here is ____. → a) inseparable (U31) · b) separable with it · c) only past
5. Separable examples in text? → a) put on, pick up, turn off, give back · b) only wake up · c) only Who called

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Put on clothes & pick up bag** · 2. **a) Turn the lights off** · 3. **a) Give it back in evening** · 4. **a) inseparable (U31)** · 5. **a) put on, pick up, turn off, give back**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. *Turn the lights off* shows ____. → a) separated form · b) inseparable only · c) subject question
7. *Give it back* uses ____. → a) pronoun in middle · b) ~~give back it~~ · c) no object
8. Morning sequence: wake/get up → look for phone → ____. → a) put on & pick up · b) hate waiting · c) any milk
9. Borrowed item returned ____. → a) in the evening · b) before breakfast · c) at the shop
10. Matches unit 32: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only U35

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) separated form** · 7. **a) pronoun in middle** · 8. **a) put on & pick up** · 9. **a) in the evening** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Pick up my bag* = Pick ____ bag ____. → a) my / up · b) up / my · c) for / my
12. Pronoun rule: Pick ____ up. → a) it/them · b) up it · c) up them
13. *Put on* + clothes = opposite ____. → a) take off · b) look for · c) wake up
14. Reading mixes U31 + U32 phrasals: ____. → a) natural · b) wrong · c) only C2
15. Mark separable forms when ____. → a) reading aloud · b) skipping meaning · c) only translating titles

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) my / up** · 12. **a) it/them** · 13. **a) take off** · 14. **a) natural** · 15. **a) reading aloud**

</details>


---

## Lección 4 — Listening: In class

**Objetivo:** escuchar el foco gramatical en contexto.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-32/listening-separable.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: In class"></audio>

> Please sit down. Take off your headphones and put them down on the desk. Can I put on my jacket? It's cold. Yes. And pick up your pencil — it's on the floor. When you finish, give the worksheets back.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Headphones? → a) Take off & put down on desk · b) Turn on · c) Look for file
2. Student asks to ____. → a) put on jacket · b) take off jacket · c) give back scarf
3. Pencil? → a) Pick it up from floor · b) On the sofa · c) In a bag of six
4. When finish? → a) Give worksheets back · b) Wake up early · c) Pay now
5. Cold reason for ____. → a) put on jacket · b) sit down only · c) hate waiting

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Take off & put down on desk** · 2. **a) put on jacket** · 3. **a) Pick it up from floor** · 4. **a) Give worksheets back** · 5. **a) put on jacket**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. *Put them down* uses ____. → a) pronoun middle · b) ~~put down them~~ · c) inseparable look for
7. *Give the worksheets back* = ____. → a) Give back the worksheets · b) Who called you · c) some bread
8. Listening is ____. → a) classroom context · b) shopping list · c) café order
9. *Take off your headphones* opposite of ____. → a) put on · b) wake up · c) live here
10. Unit 32 practice: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only Module 6

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) pronoun middle** · 7. **a) Give back the worksheets** · 8. **a) classroom context** · 9. **a) put on** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. ~~Pick up them~~ → ____. → a) Pick them up · b) Pick them · c) Them pick up
12. Separable with noun: two positions ____. → a) often OK · b) never OK · c) only in past
13. Practice pairs: put on ↔ ____. → a) take off · b) look for · c) could
14. Shadow and label ____. → a) each separable phrasal · b) only spelling · c) only articles
15. U32 next is ____. → a) gerunds & infinitives · b) Module 6 only · c) articles U36 first skip

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) Pick them up** · 12. **a) often OK** · 13. **a) take off** · 14. **a) each separable phrasal** · 15. **a) gerunds & infinitives**

</details>


---

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. The music is loud. Turn ____ off. → *it / off it / on*
2. Pick ____ up — it's on the floor. → *it / up it / them*
3. It's raining. Put your coat ____. → *on / on it / off*
4. Take your shoes ____. → *off / off them / on*
5. Please give ____ back. → *it / back it / it back*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **it** · 2. **it** · 3. **on** · 4. **off** · 5. **it**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. Turn / it / off, / please.
7. Pick / up / your / pencil.
8. Give / the / keys / back.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. Turn it off, please.
7. Pick up your pencil. / Pick your pencil up.
8. Give the keys back. / Give back the keys.

</details>


### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Una frase con *pick up* (nombre).
10. Una frase con *put it on*.
11. Una frase con *take them off*.
12. Dos formas de *turn off the TV*.
13. Una frase con *give it back*.
14. Contrasta *look for* (inseparable) y *pick up* (separable).
15. Párrafo (8–10 frases) mañana o llegada a casa con separables.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

9. Pick up the book. / Pick the book up.
10. Here's your jacket. Put it on.
11. Take your shoes off. / Take them off.
12. Turn off the TV. / Turn the TV off.
13. Can you give it back, please?
14. I look for my keys (inseparable). I pick my keys up (separable).
15. Every morning I wake up and get up. I look for my phone. Then I put on my clothes and pick up my bag. Before I leave, I turn the lights off. If I borrow my sister's scarf, I give it back in the evening.

</details>


---

## Resumen rápido

| Regla | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Nombre: 2 posiciones** | turn off the TV / turn the TV off |
| **Pronombre: solo medio** | turn **it** off |
| **pick up / put down** | recoger / dejar |
| **put on / take off** | ponerse / quitarse |
| **give back** | devolver |

---

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 33 del curso A2** (*Gerunds & Infinitives*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [Gerundios e infinitivos A2](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-33-gerunds-infinitives)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 33 — Gerunds & Infinitives](/curso-a2/unit-33)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Gerunds & Infinitives](/blog/curso-a2/unit-33/a2-unit33-gerunds-infinitives.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática](#leccion-1--gramatica)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario](#leccion-2--vocabulario)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: Likes and plans](#leccion-3--reading)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: At the café](#leccion-4--listening)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing](#leccion-5--writing)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** like/love/hate + -ing; want/need/would like + to.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I like ____ (swim). → *swimming / to swim / swim*
2. She wants ____ (learn) French. → *to learn / learning / learn*
3. They hate ____ (wait). → *waiting / to wait / wait*
4. We need ____ (leave) early. → *to leave / leaving / leave*
5. I'd like ____ (visit) the museum. → *to visit / visiting / visit*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **swimming** · 2. **to learn** · 3. **waiting** · 4. **to leave** · 5. **to visit**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. *Like* for general taste uses ____. → a) -ing · b) to only · c) past tense
7. *Want* always needs ____. → a) to + infinitive · b) -ing · c) no verb after
8. *Would like* is ____. → a) polite wish · b) only past · c) same as hate + -ing
9. ~~I want going~~ is wrong: use ____. → a) want to go · b) want go · c) want went
10. Unit 33 trains ____. → a) -ing vs to patterns · b) only phrasals · c) only articles

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) -ing** · 7. **a) to + infinitive** · 8. **a) polite wish** · 9. **a) want to go** · 10. **a) -ing vs to patterns**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *I want going home.*
12. *She like dancing.*
13. *I'd like eating pizza now.*
14. *He need to study more.*
15. *They hates waiting.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. I want **to go** home.
12. She **likes** dancing.
13. I'd like **to eat** pizza now.
14. He **needs** to study more.
15. They **hate** waiting.

</details>


---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** like, love, hate, want, need, would like; cooking, travel, rest, order.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja / elige

1. *love* + -ing ≈ ____ → *really enjoy · need to · polite order*
2. *hate* + -ing ≈ ____ → *don't like at all · want now · live here*
3. *want to* ≈ ____ → *wish/plan · general taste · subject question*
4. *need to* ≈ ____ → *must/necessary · optional · past ability*
5. *would like to* ≈ ____ → *polite desire · hate waiting · pick up*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **really enjoy** · 2. **don't like at all** · 3. **wish/plan** · 4. **must/necessary** · 5. **polite desire**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. I love ____ Italian food. → *cooking / cook / to cooking*
7. He wants ____ a new phone. → *to buy / buying / buy*
8. We hate ____ up early. → *getting / get / to get*
9. You need ____ a coat — it's cold. → *to wear / wearing / wear*
10. Would you like ____ sit here? → *to / for / -ing*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **cooking** · 7. **to buy** · 8. **getting** · 9. **to wear** · 10. **to**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. General habit: I ____ coffee in the morning. → a) like drinking · b) would like to drink now
12. At the café now: I ____ a cappuccino. → a) like drinking · b) would like to order
13. *Like* vs *would like*: different ____. → a) meaning/time · b) spelling only · c) always -ing
14. *Need to rest* = ____. → a) necessary · b) optional · c) past ability
15. Unit 33 follows ____. → a) U32 phrasals · b) only Module 1 · c) only some/any

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) like drinking** · 12. **b) would like to order** · 13. **a) meaning/time** · 14. **a) necessary** · 15. **a) U32 phrasals**

</details>


---

## Lección 3 — Reading: Likes and plans

**Objetivo:** comprender un texto con el foco de la unidad.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-33/reading-gerunds.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Likes and plans"></audio>

> I love reading in the evening. I also like cooking, but I hate washing the dishes. Next year I want to travel to Ireland. First I need to save money. Tonight I'd like to watch a film at home.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Evening activity loved? → a) Reading · b) Washing dishes · c) Travel now
2. Dislikes? → a) Washing dishes · b) Cooking · c) Reading
3. Next year plan? → a) Travel to Ireland · b) Watch film tonight · c) Save dishes
4. Before travel must ____. → a) Save money · b) Hate waiting · c) Order tea
5. Tonight? → a) Would like to watch a film · b) Need to leave early · c) Love cooking only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Reading** · 2. **a) Washing dishes** · 3. **a) Travel to Ireland** · 4. **a) Save money** · 5. **a) Would like to watch a film**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Text uses ____. → a) -ing likes + to plans · b) only phrasals · c) only Who called
7. *Love reading* pattern: love + ____. → a) -ing · b) to only · c) did
8. *Need to save* before ____. → a) travel · b) wash dishes · c) sit down
9. *I'd like to watch* is ____. → a) tonight wish · b) general hate · c) subject Q
10. Matches unit 33: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only U35

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) -ing likes + to plans** · 7. **a) -ing** · 8. **a) travel** · 9. **a) tonight wish** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Hate washing* = hate + ____. → a) -ing · b) to + base · c) past
12. *Want to travel* ≠ *like travelling* in ____. → a) time/meaning · b) spelling · c) always same
13. After *need* use ____. → a) to + infinitive · b) -ing only · c) did
14. Reading labels: mark ____. → a) -ing vs to · b) only nouns · c) only articles
15. Pair aloud: like cooking / ____. → a) I'd like to cook tonight · b) hate to cook always · c) need cooking

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) -ing** · 12. **a) time/meaning** · 13. **a) to + infinitive** · 14. **a) -ing vs to** · 15. **a) I'd like to cook tonight**

</details>
