content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 47 del curso A2** (*Health & Body*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [Health & Body A2](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-47-health-body)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 47 — Health & Body](/curso-a2/unit-47)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Health & Body](/blog/curso-a2/unit-47/a2-unit47-health-body.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática](#leccion-1--gramatica)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario](#leccion-2--vocabulario)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: Medicine label](#leccion-3--reading)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: At the pharmacy](#leccion-4--listening)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing](#leccion-5--writing)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** have a + symptom; feel sick/tired; should / shouldn't; hurts / pain

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I have ___ headache. → *a / the / —*

2. I feel ___. *(mareado)* → *sick / sickness / sickly*

3. You ___ rest. → *should / should to / shoulds*

4. My throat ___. → *hurts / hurt / hurting*

5. You ___ go to work with a fever. *(no)* → *shouldn't / should / don't should*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a** · 2. **sick** · 3. **should** · 4. **hurts** · 5. **shouldn't**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. *I have a headache* (no *I have headache*): ____. → a) correcto · b) I have headache · c) I have the headache only

7. *You should rest* (no *should to*): ____. → a) correcto · b) You should to rest · c) You should resting

8. *Feel sick* = ____. → a) mareado/náuseas · b) solo cansado formal · c) weather

9. *What's the matter?* = ____. → a) ¿Qué te pasa? · b) ¿Cómo es? · c) precio

10. Unit 47 follows ____. → a) Shopping U46 · b) Module 6 only · c) skip U48

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) correcto** · 7. **a) correcto** · 8. **a) mareado/náuseas** · 9. **a) ¿Qué te pasa?** · 10. **a) Shopping U46**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *I have headache.*

12. *You should to rest.*

13. *I feel me tired.*

14. *My throat pain.*

15. *What's the matter with you health?*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. I have **a** headache.
12. You should rest.
13. I feel tired.
14. My throat **hurts**. / I've got a sore throat.
15. What's the matter? / What's wrong?

</details>



---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** headache, fever, cold, sore throat, medicine, pharmacy, doctor

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja / elige

1. *headache* ≈ ____ → *dolor de cabeza · fiebre · farmacia*

2. *fever* ≈ ____ → *fiebre · resfriado · medicina*

3. *pharmacy* ≈ ____ → *farmacia · médico · garganta*

4. *sore throat* ≈ ____ → *dolor de garganta · estómago · pierna*

5. *medicine* ≈ ____ → *medicamento · temperatura · vecino*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **dolor de cabeza** · 2. **fiebre** · 3. **farmacia** · 4. **dolor de garganta** · 5. **medicamento**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. I have a ___. *(resfriado)* → *cold / cool / cloudy*

7. Go to the ___. → *pharmacy / checkout / platform*

8. See a ___ if it's worse. → *doctor / drama / degree*

9. Take this ___ every 8 hours. → *medicine / museum / movie*

10. I've got a pain in my ___. → *back / bag / bakery*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **cold** · 7. **pharmacy** · 8. **doctor** · 9. **medicine** · 10. **back**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. *Have a + symptom* needs ____. → a) a (often) · b) never article · c) only the

12. *Shouldn't* with fever: ____. → a) You shouldn't go running · b) You should to run · c) listen music

13. Label: max ___ tablets a day. → a) three · b) eight · c) thirty

14. Patient also feels ____. → a) tired · b) sunny · c) cheaper

15. Unit 47 next is ____. → a) Clothes U48 · b) Module 6 only · c) skip U48

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) a (often)** · 12. **a) You shouldn't go running** · 13. **a) three** · 14. **a) tired** · 15. **a) Clothes U48**

</details>



---

## Lección 3 — Reading: Medicine label

**Objetivo:** comprender un texto con el foco de la unidad.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-47/reading-health.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Medicine label"></audio>

> This **medicine** is for a **cold** or a **sore throat**. Take one tablet every 8 hours with water. **Don't** take more than three tablets a day. If you have a high **fever**, see a **doctor**. Keep out of reach of children. If you feel worse, stop and ask at the **pharmacy**.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Medicine for cold or ____. → a) sore throat · b) checkout · c) platform

2. Take one tablet every ___ hours. → a) 8 · b) 14 · c) 80

3. Don't take more than ___ a day. → a) three · b) ten · c) zero

4. High fever → see a ____. → a) doctor · b) colleague · c) concert

5. Feel worse → ask at the ____. → a) pharmacy · b) museum · c) gate

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) sore throat** · 2. **a) 8** · 3. **a) three** · 4. **a) doctor** · 5. **a) pharmacy**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Take with ____. → a) water · b) cash · c) train

7. Keep out of reach of ____. → a) children · b) jackets · c) dramas

8. *Sore throat* = ____. → a) dolor al tragar · b) precio · c) viaje

9. *Every 8 hours* = ____. → a) dosis / frecuencia · b) only Past · c) only will

10. Matches unit 47: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only U31

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) water** · 7. **a) children** · 8. **a) dolor al tragar** · 9. **a) dosis / frecuencia** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Take one tablet* = ____. → a) instrucción de dosis · b) weather · c) check in

12. *See a doctor* = ____. → a) ir al médico · b) solo farmacia siempre · c) only Who

13. *Feel worse* = ____. → a) empeorar · b) mejorar · c) cheaper

14. Label uses ____. → a) health structures · b) only did · c) only phrasals

15. Health writing uses ____. → a) have a / should / pharmacy · b) only articles · c) only prefer

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) instrucción de dosis** · 12. **a) ir al médico** · 13. **a) empeorar** · 14. **a) health structures** · 15. **a) have a / should / pharmacy**

</details>



---

## Lección 4 — Listening: At the pharmacy

**Objetivo:** escuchar el foco gramatical en contexto.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-47/listening-health.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: At the pharmacy"></audio>

> **Pharmacist:** Hello. How can I help you?
> **Patient:** I **have a headache** and a **sore throat**.
> **Pharmacist:** Do you have a **fever**?
> **Patient:** A little. I also **feel tired**.
> **Pharmacist:** You **should** rest and drink water. Take this **medicine** every 8 hours.
> **Patient:** Thanks. **Should** I see a **doctor**?
> **Pharmacist:** If you feel **worse** tomorrow, yes.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Patient has headache and ____. → a) sore throat · b) checkout · c) platform

2. Has a little ____. → a) fever · b) comedy · c) gate

3. Also feels ____. → a) tired · b) sunny · c) cheaper

4. Should rest and drink ____. → a) water · b) tickets · c) dramas

5. Medicine every ___ hours. → a) 8 · b) 80 · c) 1 only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) sore throat** · 2. **a) fever** · 3. **a) tired** · 4. **a) water** · 5. **a) 8**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. See doctor if feel ___ tomorrow. → a) worse · b) better always · c) sunny

7. Pharmacist says you ___ rest. → a) should · b) should to · c) listens

8. *Have a headache* = ____. → a) síntoma con artículo · b) weather · c) How much

9. *Should I see a doctor?* = ____. → a) pedir consejo · b) precio · c) arrive at

10. Unit 47 practice: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only U31

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) worse** · 7. **a) should** · 8. **a) síntoma con artículo** · 9. **a) pedir consejo** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *You should rest* → a) should + infinitive · b) should to · c) prefer than

12. *Feel tired* → a) feel + adj · b) feel me · c) have tired

13. *Take this medicine* → a) instrucción · b) listen to · c) arrive in

14. Shadow and note ____. → a) have a / should / pharmacy · b) only some · c) only Who

15. U47 next unit is ____. → a) Clothes U48 · b) Module 6 only · c) U46 skip

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) should + infinitive** · 12. **a) feel + adj** · 13. **a) instrucción** · 14. **a) have a / should / pharmacy** · 15. **a) Clothes U48**

</details>



---

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I have ___ cold. → *a / the / —*

2. I feel ___. → *sick / sickness / sickly*

3. You ___ drink water. → *should / should to / shoulds*

4. My back ___. → *hurts / hurt / hurting*

5. Go to the ___. → *pharmacy / checkout / platform*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a** · 2. **sick** · 3. **should** · 4. **hurts** · 5. **pharmacy**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. a / have / I / headache

7. should / You / rest

8. the / Go / to / pharmacy

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. I have a headache.
7. You should rest.
8. Go to the pharmacy.

</details>


### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Una frase con *have a…* (síntoma).

10. Una frase con *feel…*.

11. Una frase con *should* o *shouldn't*.

12. Una frase con *pharmacy* o *doctor*.

13. Una frase con *hurts* o *pain*.

14. Corrige: *You should to rest.*

15. Describe un problema de salud y da consejos (8–10 líneas).

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

9. I have a headache. / I have a cold.
10. I feel sick. / I feel tired.
11. You should rest. / You shouldn't go to work.
12. Go to the pharmacy. / You should see a doctor.
13. My throat hurts. / I've got a pain in my back.
14. You should rest.
15. I have a headache and a sore throat. I feel tired. My throat hurts. You should rest and drink water. Take medicine every 8 hours. You shouldn't go to work. If you feel worse, go to the pharmacy or see a doctor.

</details>



---

## Resumen rápido

| | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Síntoma | have a… | I have a headache. |
| Sensación | feel… | I feel sick. |
| Dolor | hurts | My back hurts. |
| Consejo | should | You should rest. |
| Lugar | pharmacy / doctor | Go to the pharmacy. |

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** wear / put on / take off; too + adj; adj + enough; casual / formal

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I'm ___ a blue dress today. → *wearing / putting / taking*

2. ___ on your coat. → *Put / Wear / Take*

3. ___ off your shoes, please. → *Take / Put / Wear*

4. This shirt is ___ small. → *too / enough / very much*

5. This coat is warm ___. → *enough / too / very*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **wearing** · 2. **Put** · 3. **Take** · 4. **too** · 5. **enough**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. *Put on* = acción de ponerse: ____. → a) correcto · b) I put a jacket (solo) · c) I wear on

7. *Too small* (no *too much small*): ____. → a) correcto · b) too much small · c) enough small

8. *Wear* = llevar puesto: ____. → a) estado · b) solo acción · c) weather

9. *Warm enough* = ____. → a) suficientemente abrigado · b) demasiado calor · c) precio

10. Unit 48 follows ____. → a) Health U47 · b) Module 6 only · c) skip U49

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) correcto** · 7. **a) correcto** · 8. **a) estado** · 9. **a) suficientemente abrigado** · 10. **a) Health U47**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *I put a jacket.*

12. *This is enough big.*

13. *Too much small.*

14. *I wear on a hat.*

15. *It fits to me.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. I **put on** a jacket. / I'm **wearing** a jacket.
12. This is **big enough**.
13. **Too small**.
14. I **put on** a hat. / I **wear** a hat.
15. It **fits** me. / It fits.

</details>

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** outfit, casual, formal, pattern, size, fit, scarf, trainers

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja / elige

1. *outfit* ≈ ____ → *conjunto/look · talla · estampado*

2. *casual* ≈ ____ → *informal · formal · demasiado*

3. *formal* ≈ ____ → *elegante/de trabajo · playa · fiebre*

4. *pattern* ≈ ____ → *estampado · material · probador*

5. *scarf* ≈ ____ → *bufanda · cinturón · zapato*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **conjunto/look** · 2. **informal** · 3. **elegante/de trabajo** · 4. **estampado** · 5. **bufanda**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. Jeans are ___. → *casual / formal / fever*

7. A suit is ___. → *formal / casual / sick*

8. What ___ are you? → *size / sick / sunny*

9. Does it ___ well? → *fit / fits to / fitting*

10. Put on your ___ . *(abrigo)* → *coat / cold / cough*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **casual** · 7. **formal** · 8. **size** · 9. **fit** · 10. **coat**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. *Clothes* is ____. → a) plural · b) singular always · c) uncountable only

12. Office dress code: ___ outfit. → a) formal/smart · b) only trainers · c) only beach

13. Shirt is ___ bright. → a) too · b) enough · c) many

14. Jacket is warm ___. → a) enough · b) too much · c) many

15. Unit 48 next is ____. → a) People U49 · b) Module 6 only · c) skip U49

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) plural** · 12. **a) formal/smart** · 13. **a) too** · 14. **a) enough** · 15. **a) People U49**

</details>

## Lección 3 — Reading: Dress code tip

**Objetivo:** comprender un texto con el foco de la unidad.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-48/reading-clothes.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Dress code tip"></audio>

> For the office, wear a **smart** or **formal outfit**: a shirt, dark trousers and clean shoes. Avoid **casual** clothes like old jeans or trainers. If it's cold, **put on** a jacket. Check that everything **fits** well — not **too tight** and not **too loose**. A simple bag and a belt are enough accessories.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Office: wear ___ or formal outfit. → a) smart · b) sunny · c) cheaper

2. Avoid ___ clothes like old jeans. → a) casual · b) formal only · c) pharmacy

3. If cold, ___ on a jacket. → a) put · b) wear on · c) take

4. Not too tight and not too ___. → a) loose · b) sunny · c) sick

5. Bag and belt are enough ___. → a) accessories · b) symptoms · c) forecasts

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) smart** · 2. **a) casual** · 3. **a) put** · 4. **a) loose** · 5. **a) accessories**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Wear dark ___ and clean shoes. → a) trousers · b) trains · c) dramas

7. Everything should ___ well. → a) fit · b) fits to · c) fitting room

8. *Trainers* in casual context = ____. → a) zapatillas · b) tren · c) ticket

9. *Too tight* = ____. → a) demasiado ajustado · b) suficiente · c) precio

10. Matches unit 48: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only U31

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) trousers** · 7. **a) fit** · 8. **a) zapatillas** · 9. **a) demasiado ajustado** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Put on a jacket* = ____. → a) ponerse · b) weather · c) check in

12. *Formal outfit* = ____. → a) ropa de trabajo · b) playa · c) only Who

13. *Not too loose* = ____. → a) no demasiado holgado · b) demasiado · c) cheaper

14. Dress code uses ____. → a) wear/put on/too/enough · b) only did · c) only phrasals

15. Clothes writing uses ____. → a) outfit structures · b) only articles · c) only should

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) ponerse** · 12. **a) ropa de trabajo** · 13. **a) no demasiado holgado** · 14. **a) wear/put on/too/enough** · 15. **a) outfit structures**

</details>

## Lección 4 — Listening: Choosing an outfit

**Objetivo:** escuchar el foco gramatical en contexto.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-48/listening-clothes.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Choosing an outfit"></audio>

> **Sam:** What should I **wear** to the party?
> **Alex:** Something **smart casual**. Not too formal.
> **Sam:** Are these jeans OK?
> **Alex:** Yes — but that shirt is **too bright**. Try the blue one.
> **Sam:** Is this jacket **warm enough**?
> **Alex:** Perfect. **Put on** those black shoes and you're ready.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Sam asks what to ___ to the party. → a) wear · b) listen · c) refund

2. Style: smart ___. → a) casual · b) pharmacy · c) platform

3. Jeans are ___. → a) OK · b) too formal only · c) never OK

4. Shirt is too ___. → a) bright · b) sunny · c) cheaper

5. Put on black ___. → a) shoes · b) receipts · c) dramas

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) wear** · 2. **a) casual** · 3. **a) OK** · 4. **a) bright** · 5. **a) shoes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Jacket is warm ___. → a) enough · b) too much small · c) included

7. Try the ___ one (shirt). → a) blue · b) checkout · c) gate

8. *Put on* those shoes = ____. → a) ponerse · b) weather · c) How much

9. *Too bright* = ____. → a) demasiado llamativo · b) suficiente · c) arrive at

10. Unit 48 practice: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only U31

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) enough** · 7. **a) blue** · 8. **a) ponerse** · 9. **a) demasiado llamativo** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *What should I wear?* → a) wear / outfit · b) listen to · c) prefer than

12. *Too bright* → a) too + adj · b) enough + adj · c) will

13. *Warm enough* → a) adj + enough · b) too + adj · c) arrive in

14. Shadow and note ____. → a) wear/put on/too/enough · b) only some · c) only Who

15. U48 next unit is ____. → a) People U49 · b) Module 6 only · c) U47 skip

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) wear / outfit** · 12. **a) too + adj** · 13. **a) adj + enough** · 14. **a) wear/put on/too/enough** · 15. **a) People U49**

</details>

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I'm ___ jeans today. → *wearing / putting / taking*

2. ___ on your jumper. → *Put / Wear / Take*

3. This T-shirt is ___ big. → *too / enough / very much*

4. These shoes aren't comfortable ___. → *enough / too / very*

5. I love your ___. → *outfit / outfitting / outfits to*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **wearing** · 2. **Put** · 3. **too** · 4. **enough** · 5. **outfit**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. wearing / I'm / a / red / jumper

7. on / Put / your / coat

8. small / is / This / too / shirt

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. I'm wearing a red jumper.
7. Put on your coat.
8. This shirt is too small.

</details>


### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Una frase con *wear* o *I'm wearing…*.

10. Una frase con *put on* o *take off*.

11. Una frase con *too + adjetivo*.

12. Una frase con *adj + enough*.

13. Una frase con *casual* o *formal*.

14. Corrige: *I put a jacket.*

15. Describe tu outfit de hoy (8–10 líneas) con estructuras de ropa.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

9. I'm wearing jeans. / I wear a coat in winter.
10. Put on your coat. / Take off your shoes.
11. This shirt is too small. / That shirt is too bright.
12. This jacket is warm enough. / Is this smart enough for work?
13. Jeans are casual. / A suit is formal.
14. I **put on** a jacket. / I'm **wearing** a jacket.
15. Today I'm wearing a casual outfit: a white T-shirt, blue jeans and black trainers. I put on a jacket because it's cold. The jacket is warm enough. My shoes are comfortable, not too tight. I love this simple outfit.

</details>



---

## Resumen rápido

| | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Llevar | wear | I'm wearing jeans. |
| Ponerse | put on | Put on your coat. |
| Quitarse | take off | Take off your shoes. |
| Demasiado | too + adj | Too small. |
| Suficiente | adj + enough | Warm enough. |

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 49 del curso A2** (*People & Relationships*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [People & Relationships A2](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-49-people-relationships)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 49 — People & Relationships](/curso-a2/unit-49)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![People & Relationships](/blog/curso-a2/unit-49/a2-unit49-people-relationships.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática](#leccion-1--gramatica)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario](#leccion-2--vocabulario)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: My neighbour Maya](#leccion-3--reading)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: Talking about a colleague](#leccion-4--listening)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing](#leccion-5--writing)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** look like (apariencia); What's … like? (carácter); have known + for/since

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. She ___ like her mother. → *looks / is look / looking*

2. What's he ___ ? *(carácter)* → *like / look / likes*

3. I've ___ him for two years. → *known / knew / know*

4. He's ___ than his brother. *(friendly)* → *friendlier / more friendly / friendlyer*

5. We ___ on well. → *get / gets / getting*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **looks** · 2. **like** · 3. **known** · 4. **friendlier** · 5. **get**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. *Look like* = apariencia: ____. → a) correcto · b) What does she like? (gustos) · c) How is she like?

7. *What's she like?* = carácter: ____. → a) correcto · b) apariencia física · c) precio

8. *I've known her for 3 years* = ____. → a) Present Perfect + for · b) Past only · c) will

9. *Get on well* = ____. → a) llevarse bien · b) weather · c) checkout

10. Unit 49 follows ____. → a) Clothes U48 · b) Module 6 only · c) skip U50

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) correcto** · 7. **a) correcto** · 8. **a) Present Perfect + for** · 9. **a) llevarse bien** · 10. **a) Clothes U48**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *How is she like?*

12. *She is look like her mum.*

13. *I know her for 10 years.*

14. *He is more tall than me.*

15. *We have a good relation.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **What's she like?**
12. She **looks like** her mum.
13. I've **known** her for 10 years.
14. He's **taller than** me.
15. We have a good **relationship**.

</details>



---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** friend, colleague, neighbour, friendly, funny, kind, get on well

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja / elige

1. *neighbour* ≈ ____ → *vecino/a · colega · amigo*

2. *colleague* ≈ ____ → *compañero de trabajo · vecino · turista*

3. *friendly* ≈ ____ → *simpático/a · tímido · alto*

4. *honest* ≈ ____ → *honesto · divertido · callado*

5. *shy* ≈ ____ → *tímido · trabajador · amable*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **vecino/a** · 2. **compañero de trabajo** · 3. **simpático/a** · 4. **honesto** · 5. **tímido**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. She's my best ___. → *friend / fever / forecast*

7. He's a ___ from work. → *colleague / checkout / concert*

8. Maya is my ___. → *neighbour / pharmacy / platform*

9. She's very ___ . *(kind)* → *kind / kinder only wrong · kind of*

10. He's ___-working. → *hard / hardly / harder*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **friend** · 7. **colleague** · 8. **neighbour** · 9. **kind** · 10. **hard**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. *Look like* for appearance: ____. → a) yes · b) What's she like? for looks · c) listen music

12. Maya is ___ than me. → a) quieter · b) more quiet always wrong · c) sunny

13. Known her for ___ years. → a) three · b) since only here · c) tomorrow

14. Colleague is ___. → a) hard-working · b) checkout · c) foggy

15. Unit 49 next is ____. → a) Module 5 Review U50 · b) Module 6 only · c) skip U50

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) yes** · 12. **a) quieter** · 13. **a) three** · 14. **a) hard-working** · 15. **a) Module 5 Review U50**

</details>



---

## Lección 3 — Reading: My neighbour Maya

**Objetivo:** comprender un texto con el foco de la unidad.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-49/reading-people.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: My neighbour Maya"></audio>

> Maya is my **neighbour**. I've **known** her **for** three years. She **looks like** her mother — same smile and dark hair. What's she **like**? She's **friendly**, **funny** and very **kind**. We **get on well**. She's a bit **quieter** than me, but we talk every weekend over coffee.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Maya is Leo's ___. → a) neighbour · b) checkout · c) platform

2. Known her for ___ years. → a) three · b) thirty · c) zero

3. Looks like her ___. → a) mother · b) museum · c) movie

4. She's friendly, funny and ___. → a) kind · b) cloudy · c) cheaper

5. They get on ___. → a) well · b) sick · c) sunny

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) neighbour** · 2. **a) three** · 3. **a) mother** · 4. **a) kind** · 5. **a) well**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Quieter ___ me. → a) than · b) to · c) over

7. Talk every weekend over ___. → a) coffee · b) train · c) receipt

8. *Looks like* = ____. → a) parecerse físicamente · b) carácter · c) precio

9. *Get on well* = ____. → a) buena relación · b) only Past · c) only will

10. Matches unit 49: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only U31

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) than** · 7. **a) coffee** · 8. **a) parecerse físicamente** · 9. **a) buena relación** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *I've known her for three years* = ____. → a) tiempo con for · b) weather · c) check in

12. *What's she like?* = ____. → a) carácter · b) solo apariencia · c) only Who

13. *Quieter than me* = ____. → a) comparativo · b) superlativo · c) cheaper

14. Maya text uses ____. → a) look like / be like / known · b) only did · c) only phrasals

15. People writing uses ____. → a) relationships structures · b) only articles · c) only should

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) tiempo con for** · 12. **a) carácter** · 13. **a) comparativo** · 14. **a) look like / be like / known** · 15. **a) relationships structures**

</details>



---

## Lección 4 — Listening: Talking about a colleague

**Objetivo:** escuchar el foco gramatical en contexto.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-49/listening-people.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Talking about a colleague"></audio>

> **Leo:** Have you met the new **colleague**?
> **Nora:** Yes. What's he **like**?
> **Leo:** He's **hard-working** and **honest**. A bit **shy** at first.
> **Nora:** What does he **look like**?
> **Leo:** Tall, short hair. He **looks like** my cousin, actually.
> **Nora:** How long have you **known** him?
> **Leo:** Only **for** two weeks — but we already **get on** well.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Talking about a new ___. → a) colleague · b) checkout · c) forecast

2. He's hard-working and ___. → a) honest · b) sunny · c) cheaper

3. A bit ___ at first. → a) shy · b) sick · c) windy

4. Looks like Leo's ___. → a) cousin · b) concert · c) gate

5. Known him for two ___. → a) weeks · b) years only · c) degrees

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) colleague** · 2. **a) honest** · 3. **a) shy** · 4. **a) cousin** · 5. **a) weeks**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Hair: short ___. → a) hair · b) rains · c) receipts

7. They already get on ___. → a) well · b) worse · c) foggy

8. *What does he look like?* = ____. → a) apariencia · b) carácter · c) precio

9. *How long have you known him?* = ____. → a) Present Perfect · b) only Past · c) will

10. Unit 49 practice: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only U31

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) hair** · 7. **a) well** · 8. **a) apariencia** · 9. **a) Present Perfect** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *What's he like?* → a) carácter · b) look like · c) prefer than

12. *He looks like my cousin* → a) apariencia · b) carácter · c) arrive in

13. *Only for two weeks* → a) for + period · b) since only wrong here · c) listen music

14. Shadow and note ____. → a) look like / be like / known · b) only some · c) only Who

15. U49 next unit is ____. → a) Module 5 Review U50 · b) Module 6 only · c) U48 skip

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) carácter** · 12. **a) apariencia** · 13. **a) for + period** · 14. **a) look like / be like / known** · 15. **a) Module 5 Review U50**

</details>



---

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. She ___ like her sister. → *looks / is look / looking*

2. What's she ___ ? → *like / look / likes*

3. I've ___ him since 2020. → *known / knew / know*

4. He's my ___ from work. → *colleague / neighbour only wrong · friend*

5. We get on ___. → *well / good / better*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **looks** · 2. **like** · 3. **known** · 4. **colleague** · 5. **well**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. like / looks / she / her / mother

7. known / I've / her / for / years / three

8. on / we / get / well

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. She looks like her mother.
7. I've known her for three years.
8. We get on well.

</details>


### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Una frase con *look like*.

10. Una frase con *What's … like?* (carácter).

11. Una frase con *I've known … for/since*.

12. Una frase con *friend*, *colleague* o *neighbour*.

13. Una frase con un adjetivo de personalidad.

14. Corrige: *I know her for 10 years.*

15. Describe a alguien que conoces (8–10 líneas) con estructuras de personas.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

9. She looks like her mother. / He looks like my cousin.
10. What's she like? She's friendly and funny.
11. I've known her for three years. / I've known him since 2019.
12. Maya is my neighbour. / He's a colleague from work.
13. She's kind and hard-working. / He's shy but honest.
14. I've **known** her for 10 years.
15. Maya is my neighbour. I've known her for three years. She looks like her mother. What's she like? She's friendly, funny and very kind. We get on well. She's quieter than me, but we talk every weekend over coffee.

</details>



---

## Resumen rápido

| | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Apariencia | look like | She looks like her mum. |
| Carácter | What's … like? | What's he like? |
| Relación | friend / colleague… | My neighbour |
| Tiempo | have known + for/since | I've known her for years. |
| Comparar | -er / more … than | More friendly than… |

---

faqs.answer: Cinco lecciones con 15 actividades cada una: gramática (-er / more / better / as… as), vocabulario, reading, listening y writing.

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 5 del curso A2** (*Comparatives*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [Comparativos A2](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-5-comparativos-er-more-than)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 5 — Comparativos](/curso-a2/unit-5)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Comparatives](/blog/curso-a2/unit-5/a2-unit5-comparatives.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática: -er / more / better](#leccion-1--gramatica--er--more--better)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario: comparar](#leccion-2--vocabulario-comparar)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: Laura and her sisters](#leccion-3--reading-laura-and-her-sisters)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: Two phones](#leccion-4--listening-two-phones)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing: Compare two things](#leccion-5--writing-compare-two-things)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática: -er / more / better

**Objetivo:** *-er than*, *more… than*, *better/worse*, *as… as*.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. My brother is ____ than me. → *taller / more tall / tallest*  
2. This book is ____ interesting than that one. → *more / most / -er*  
3. Summer is ____ than winter. → *hotter / more hot / hottest*  
4. This film is ____ than the other. → *better / more good / gooder*  
5. She is ____ tall ____ her sister. → *as / as · more / than · -er / than*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **taller**  
2. **more**  
3. **hotter**  
4. **better**  
5. **as** · **as**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. Short adjectives often take ____. → a) *-er* · b) *more* only · c) *the most*  
7. Long adjectives often take ____. → a) *more* · b) *-er* · c) *-est* only  
8. *Good* → ____. → a) better · b) gooder · c) more good  
9. *Bad* → ____. → a) worse · b) badder · c) more bad  
10. Equality uses ____. → a) as… as · b) *-er* · c) *more* only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) *-er***  
7. **a) *more***  
8. **a) better**  
9. **a) worse**  
10. **a) as… as**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *She is more tall than me.*  
12. *This phone is expensiver than that one.*  
13. *Today is more better than yesterday.*  
14. *He is as taller as his brother.*  
15. *Winter is more cold than summer.* (prefer short form)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. She is **taller** than me.  
12. This phone is **more expensive** than that one.  
13. Today is **better** than yesterday.  
14. He is as **tall** as his brother.  
15. Winter is **colder** than summer.

</details>

---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario: comparar

**Objetivo:** adjetivos frecuentes en comparativos.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja

1. tall →  
2. big →  
3. hot →  
4. interesting →  
5. expensive →  

a) more interesting · b) hotter · c) taller · d) more expensive · e) bigger

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **c** · 2 → **e** · 3 → **b** · 4 → **a** · 5 → **d**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. fast → ____  
7. quiet → ____  
8. beautiful → ____  
9. useful → ____  
10. light → ____  

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **faster** · 7. **quieter** · 8. **more beautiful** · 9. **more useful** · 10. **lighter**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. *Bigger* spelling doubles ____. → a) g · b) nothing · c) b only  
12. *Hotter* doubles ____. → a) t · b) h · c) nothing  
13. *Lighter* means ____. → a) less heavy · b) more expensive · c) taller  
14. *More powerful* describes ____. → a) stronger battery/energy · b) quieter · c) shorter  
15. *Prefer* means ____. → a) like more · b) hate · c) buy only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) g**  
12. **a) t**  
13. **a) less heavy**  
14. **a) stronger battery/energy**  
15. **a) like more**

</details>

---

## Lección 3 — Reading: Laura and her sisters

**Objetivo:** leer un texto lleno de comparativos.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-5/reading-comparatives.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Laura and her sisters"></audio>

> My name is Laura and I have two sisters. My older sister Maria is taller than me and she has longer hair than I do. My younger sister Sofia is shorter than both of us but she is faster than us when we run. Our house is bigger than our grandmother's house but grandmother's garden is more beautiful than ours. I think our city is more interesting than the village where grandmother lives but the village is quieter than the city.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Who is taller than Laura? → a) Maria · b) Sofia · c) Grandmother  
2. Who is shorter but faster? → a) Sofia · b) Maria · c) Laura  
3. Whose house is bigger? → a) Their house · b) Grandmother's · c) Same  
4. Whose garden is more beautiful? → a) Grandmother's · b) Theirs · c) The city's  
5. What is quieter? → a) The village · b) The city · c) The house

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Maria**  
2. **a) Sofia**  
3. **a) Their house**  
4. **a) Grandmother's**  
5. **a) The village**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Comparatives with *-er* include ____. → a) taller, longer, shorter, faster, bigger, quieter · b) only more · c) only better  
7. *More beautiful / more interesting* are ____. → a) long-adjective forms · b) short *-er* · c) superlatives  
8. Maria has ____ hair than Laura. → a) longer · b) shorter · c) no hair  
9. The city is ____ than the village. → a) more interesting · b) quieter · c) shorter  
10. The main topic is ____. → a) comparing people and places · b) past questions · c) irregular verbs only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) taller, longer, shorter, faster, bigger, quieter**  
7. **a) long-adjective forms**  
8. **a) longer**  
9. **a) more interesting**  
10. **a) comparing people and places**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Taller than* needs ____. → a) *than* · b) *that* · c) *as* only  
12. *More beautiful than* = ____. → a) correct · b) *beautifuler* · c) *most beautiful than*  
13. *Quieter* is comparative of ____. → a) quiet · b) quite · c) quick  
14. *Faster than us when we run* compares ____. → a) speed · b) price · c) age only  
15. Mixing *-er* and *more* in one text is ____. → a) natural · b) wrong · c) only for B1

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) *than***  
12. **a) correct**  
13. **a) quiet**  
14. **a) speed**  
15. **a) natural**

</details>

---

## Lección 4 — Listening: Two phones

**Objetivo:** escuchar una comparación de dos objetos.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-5/listening-comparatives.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Two phones"></audio>

> Hi! I want to tell you about my two phones. I have an old phone and a new one. The new phone is bigger than the old one but the old one is lighter than the new one. The new phone has a better camera than the old one. The battery is more powerful than before. I think the new phone is more expensive than the old one but it is much more useful than that one. Overall I prefer the new one because it is faster than my old phone.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Which phone is bigger? → a) The new one · b) The old one · c) Same  
2. Which phone is lighter? → a) The old one · b) The new one · c) Neither  
3. Which camera is better? → a) The new phone's · b) The old phone's · c) Same  
4. Is the new phone more expensive? → a) Yes · b) No · c) The audio doesn't say  
5. Why prefer the new one? → a) Faster · b) Lighter · c) Older

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) The new one**  
2. **a) The old one**  
3. **a) The new phone's**  
4. **a) Yes**  
5. **a) Faster**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. The battery is ____ than before. → a) more powerful · b) quieter · c) shorter  
7. The new phone is ____ useful. → a) much more · b) less · c) not  
8. *Better camera* uses irregular ____. → a) better · b) gooder · c) more good  
9. Patterns include ____. → a) bigger / lighter / better / more… / faster · b) only *went* · c) only *did*  
10. The listening practices ____. → a) comparatives · b) Wh-questions only · c) Present Perfect

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) more powerful**  
7. **a) much more**  
8. **a) better**  
9. **a) bigger / lighter / better / more… / faster**  
10. **a) comparatives**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Bigger than* = short adj + ____. → a) *-er than* · b) *more than* · c) *as as*  
12. *More expensive than* = ____. → a) long adj pattern · b) short *-er* · c) superlative  
13. *Lighter* means ____. → a) less heavy · b) more heavy · c) taller  
14. *Prefer the new one* = ____. → a) like it more · b) hate it · c) sell it  
15. *Faster than my old phone* compares ____. → a) speed · b) colour · c) age only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) *-er than***  
12. **a) long adj pattern**  
13. **a) less heavy**  
14. **a) like it more**  
15. **a) speed**

</details>

---

## Lección 5 — Writing: Compare two things

**Objetivo:** escribir comparaciones claras.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. My city is ____ than Valencia. → *bigger / more big / biggest*  
2. This book is ____ interesting than that film. → *more / most / -er*  
3. Today the weather is ____ than yesterday. → *worse / badder / more bad*  
4. She is ____ tall ____ her sister. → *as / as*  
5. The new phone is ____ than the old one. → *faster / more fast / fastly*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **bigger** · 2. **more** · 3. **worse** · 4. **as** · **as** · 5. **faster**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. My / brother / is / taller / than / me.  
7. This / phone / is / more / expensive / than / that one.  
8. She / is / as / tall / as / her sister.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. My brother is taller than me.  
7. This phone is more expensive than that one.  
8. She is as tall as her sister.

</details>

### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Compara altura de dos personas (*taller*).  
10. Compara dos libros (*more interesting*).  
11. Compara verano e invierno (*hotter / colder*).  
12. Usa *better* con una película o móvil.  
13. Usa *as… as* para igualdad.  
14. Compara tu ciudad con otra (2 frases).  
15. Párrafo (6–8 frases) comparando dos cosas (hermanas, móviles o ciudades).

<details>
<summary>Ver solución (ejemplos)</summary>

9. My brother is taller than me.  
10. This book is more interesting than that one.  
11. Summer is hotter than winter. Winter is colder than summer.  
12. This film is better than the other. / The new phone has a better camera.  
13. She is as tall as her sister.  
14. My city is bigger than Valencia. Valencia is more beautiful than my city.  
15. I have two phones. The new one is bigger and faster. The old one is lighter. The new camera is better. It is more expensive but more useful. I prefer the new one.

</details>

---

## Resumen rápido

| Caso | Forma |
| :--- | :--- |
| Corto | **-er** than |
| Largo | **more** + adj + than |
| good/bad | **better** / **worse** |
| Igualdad | **as** + adj + **as** |

---

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 50 del curso A2** (*Module 5 Review*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [Module 5 Review A2](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-50-module-5-review)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 50 — Module 5 Review](/curso-a2/unit-50)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Module 5 Review](/blog/curso-a2/unit-50/a2-unit50-module-5-review.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática](#leccion-1--gramatica)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario](#leccion-2--vocabulario)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: A weekend in Lisbon](#leccion-3--reading)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: Planning the day](#leccion-4--listening)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing](#leccion-5--writing)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** by/take/get to; It's…/going to/will; watch/listen/prefer; shopping; should; wear/too/enough; look like/be like

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. We go ___ train. → *by / with / in*

2. It's ___ to rain. → *going / will going / goes*

3. I'm ___ for sunscreen. → *looking / look / looked*

4. I have ___ headache. → *a / the / —*

5. She ___ like her mother. → *looks / is look / looking*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **by** · 2. **going** · 3. **looking** · 4. **a** · 5. **looks**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. *By bus* (no *with bus*): ____. → a) correcto · b) with bus · c) in bus only

7. *Prefer comedies to dramas*: ____. → a) correcto · b) prefer than · c) like watch

8. *You should rest*: ____. → a) consejo salud · b) precio · c) only Past

9. *I've known her for years*: ____. → a) Present Perfect · b) Past only · c) will

10. Unit 50 reviews ____. → a) Module 5 U41–U49 · b) Module 6 only · c) skip U51

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) correcto** · 7. **a) correcto** · 8. **a) consejo salud** · 9. **a) Present Perfect** · 10. **a) Module 5 U41–U49**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *I go with train.*

12. *listen music*

13. *How many is it?*

14. *I have headache.*

15. *I know her for years.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. I go **by** train.
12. **listen to** music.
13. How **much** is it?
14. I have **a** headache.
15. I've **known** her for years.

</details>



---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** repaso integrado U41–U49: viaje, tiempo, ocio, compras, salud, ropa, personas

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja / elige

1. Travel → go ___ bus → *by / with / in*

2. Weather → It's ___ → *sunny / sun / a sun*

3. Shopping → How ___ is it? → *much / many / more*

4. Health → You ___ rest → *should / should to / shoulds*

5. Clothes → ___ on a hat → *Put / Wear / Take*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **by** · 2. **sunny** · 3. **much** · 4. **should** · 5. **Put**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. We ___ sightseeing in Lisbon. → *went / go / will going*

7. I ___ comedies to dramas. → *prefer / prefer than / likes*

8. Scarf cost ___. → *€12 / sunny / platform*

9. Hotel ___ was friendly. → *neighbour / checkout / forecast*

10. Known partner for ten ___. → *years / year / sunny*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **went** · 7. **prefer** · 8. **€12** · 9. **neighbour** · 10. **years**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. *Checked in* at hotel = ____. → a) registrarse · b) devolución · c) weather only

12. *Sightseeing* = ____. → a) ver lugares turísticos · b) comprar · c) headache

13. *Put on a hat* = ____. → a) ropa · b) precio · c) look like

14. *Get on well* = ____. → a) personas · b) solo tiempo · c) only will

15. Unit 50 next is ____. → a) Making Suggestions U51 · b) Module 6 only · c) skip U51

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) registrarse** · 12. **a) ver lugares turísticos** · 13. **a) ropa** · 14. **a) personas** · 15. **a) Making Suggestions U51**

</details>

## Lección 3 — Reading: A weekend in Lisbon

**Objetivo:** comprender un texto con el foco de la unidad.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-50/reading-review.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: A weekend in Lisbon"></audio>

> Last Friday we **took the train** to Lisbon and **checked in** at a small hotel. On Saturday it was **sunny**, so we went **sightseeing**. In the evening we **watched** a film — I **prefer comedies** to dramas. On Sunday I bought a scarf: "**How much is it?**" — €12. Later I had a **headache**, so my friend said: "You **should** rest." Our **neighbour** in the hotel was **friendly**. I've **known** my travel partner **for** ten years — we always **get on** well.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Took the ___ to Lisbon. → a) train · b) receipt · c) pharmacy

2. Saturday was ___. → a) sunny · b) refund · c) shy

3. Watched a ___ in the evening. → a) film · b) fever · c) gate

4. Scarf cost ___. → a) €12 · b) €59 · c) free only

5. Had a ___ later. → a) headache · b) checkout · c) platform

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) train** · 2. **a) sunny** · 3. **a) film** · 4. **a) €12** · 5. **a) headache**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Prefer ___ to dramas. → a) comedies · b) storms · c) receipts

7. Neighbour was ___. → a) friendly · b) foggy · c) cheaper

8. Known partner for ten ___. → a) years · b) weeks only · c) degrees

9. *Checked in* = ____. → a) hotel · b) only shop · c) only Who

10. Matches Module 5 review: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only U31

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) comedies** · 7. **a) friendly** · 8. **a) years** · 9. **a) hotel** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Took the train* = ____. → a) viaje · b) weather · c) check in only

12. *How much is it?* in text = ____. → a) compras · b) solo salud · c) only Who

13. *You should rest* = ____. → a) salud · b) ocio · c) cheaper

14. Lisbon text mixes ____. → a) M5 topics · b) only did · c) only phrasals

15. Review writing uses ____. → a) integrated M5 structures · b) only articles · c) only should

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) viaje** · 12. **a) compras** · 13. **a) salud** · 14. **a) M5 topics** · 15. **a) integrated M5 structures**

</details>



---

## Lección 4 — Listening: Planning the day

**Objetivo:** escuchar el foco gramatical en contexto.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-50/listening-review.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Planning the day"></audio>

> **Mia:** What's the weather **like** today?
> **Omar:** It's **going to be** hot. **Put on** a hat.
> **Mia:** Shall we go **by bus** to the museum?
> **Omar:** Yes. Then I'd like to **watch** a documentary.
> **Mia:** OK — but first **I'm looking for** sunscreen at the pharmacy.
> **Omar:** Good idea. If you feel sick, you **should** drink water.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Weather today: going to be ___. → a) hot · b) refund · c) shy

2. Go to museum ___ bus. → a) by · b) with · c) in

3. Omar wants to ___ a documentary. → a) watch · b) listen · c) exchange

4. Mia is looking for ___ at pharmacy. → a) sunscreen · b) receipt · c) drama

5. If feel sick → ___ water. → a) drink · b) take off · c) look like

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) hot** · 2. **a) by** · 3. **a) watch** · 4. **a) sunscreen** · 5. **a) drink**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Omar says ___ on a hat. → a) Put · b) Wear on · c) Take

7. *What's the weather like?* = ____. → a) tiempo · b) carácter · c) precio

8. *I'm looking for sunscreen* = ____. → a) compras/salud · b) only films · c) arrive at

9. *You should drink water* = ____. → a) consejo · b) predicción · c) only Past

10. Unit 50 practice: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only U31

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Put** · 7. **a) tiempo** · 8. **a) compras/salud** · 9. **a) consejo** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Going to be hot* → a) predicción tiempo · b) look like · c) prefer than

12. *By bus to the museum* → a) transporte · b) solo hotel · c) arrive in

13. *Watch a documentary* → a) ocio · b) solo compras · c) listen music

14. Shadow and note ____. → a) M5 mixed structures · b) only some · c) only Who

15. U50 next unit is ____. → a) Making Suggestions U51 · b) Module 6 only · c) U49 skip

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) predicción tiempo** · 12. **a) transporte** · 13. **a) ocio** · 14. **a) M5 mixed structures** · 15. **a) Making Suggestions U51**

</details>



---

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. We went ___ bus. → *by / with / in*

2. It's ___ to be hot. → *going / will going / goes*

3. How ___ is this scarf? → *much / many / more*

4. You ___ rest if you have a headache. → *should / should to / shoulds*

5. She ___ like her mother. → *looks / is look / looking*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **by** · 2. **going** · 3. **much** · 4. **should** · 5. **looks**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. train / took / the / we / to / Lisbon

7. comedies / prefer / I / to / dramas

8. on / Put / a / hat / your

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. We took the train to Lisbon.
7. I prefer comedies to dramas.
8. Put on your hat.

</details>


### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Una frase de viaje (*by*, *take*, *get to* o *checked in*).

10. Una frase del tiempo (*It's…* o *going to*).

11. Una frase de compras o salud.

12. Una frase de ropa (*wear*, *put on*, *too/enough*).

13. Una frase de personas (*look like*, *What's … like?*, *known*).

14. Corrige: *I go with train.*

15. Escribe un mini-relato de fin de semana (8–10 líneas) mezclando temas del Módulo 5.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

9. We took the train to Lisbon. / We checked in at a small hotel.
10. On Saturday it was sunny. / It's going to be hot.
11. How much is it? — €12. / You should rest.
12. Put on a hat. / This jacket is warm enough.
13. She looks like her mother. / I've known my friend for ten years.
14. I go **by** train.
15. Last Friday we took the train to Lisbon and checked in at a small hotel. On Saturday it was sunny, so we went sightseeing. In the evening we watched a film — I prefer comedies to dramas. On Sunday I bought a scarf: "How much is it?" — €12. Later I had a headache, so my friend said: "You should rest." Our neighbour in the hotel was friendly. I've known my travel partner for ten years — we always get on well.

</details>



---

## Resumen rápido

| | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Viaje | by / take / get to | I go by train. |
| Tiempo | It's… / going to | It's going to rain. |
| Ocio | watch / prefer | I prefer comedies. |
| Compras | How much…? | How much is it? |
| Personas | look like / known | I've known her for years. |

---

Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 51 del curso A2** (*Making Suggestions*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [Making Suggestions A2](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-51-making-suggestions)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Making Suggestions](/blog/curso-a2/unit-51/a2-unit51-making-suggestions.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática](#leccion-1--gramatica)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario](#leccion-2--vocabulario)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: Weekend plans](#leccion-3--reading)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: Making plans](#leccion-4--listening)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** Shall we…? / Let's… / Why don't we…? / How about + -ing/noun; Would you like to…?

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. ___ we go to the park? → *Shall / Do / Am*

2. ___ have lunch. → *Let's / Let / Lets to*

3. Why ___ we watch a film? → *don't / doesn't / not*

4. How about ___ (meet) at 6? → *meeting / meet / to meet*

5. Would you like ___ (come)? → *to come / come / coming*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Shall** · 2. **Let's** · 3. **don't** · 4. **meeting** · 5. **to come**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. *Let's go* (no *Let's to go*): ____. → a) correcto · b) Let's to go · c) Let we go

7. *How about + -ing*: ____. → a) correcto · b) How about to go · c) How about go

8. *Would you like to* = ____. → a) invitación · b) precio · c) only Past

9. *Why don't we* = ____. → a) sugerencia suave · b) petición · c) opinión

10. Unit 51 follows ____. → a) Module 5 Review U50 · b) Module 4 only · c) skip U52

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) correcto** · 7. **a) correcto** · 8. **a) invitación** · 9. **a) sugerencia suave** · 10. **a) Module 5 Review U50**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *Let's to watch a film.*

12. *Shall we to leave?*

13. *How about to meet at 5?*

14. *Why we don't go?*

15. *Would you like come?*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. Let's watch a film.
12. Shall we leave?
13. How about meeting at 5?
14. Why don't we go?
15. Would you like to come?

</details>



---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** go for a walk, have a coffee, see a film, hang out, stay in, meet up

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja / elige

1. *go for a walk* ≈ ____ → *dar un paseo · quedarse en casa · ver una serie*

2. *have a coffee* ≈ ____ → *tomar un café · ir al cine · llevar bocadillos*

3. *see a film* ≈ ____ → *ver una película · ir a la playa · tren*

4. *stay in* ≈ ____ → *quedarse en casa · salir · invitar*

5. *meet up* ≈ ____ → *quedar / encontrarse · llover · rechazar*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **dar un paseo** · 2. **tomar un café** · 3. **ver una película** · 4. **quedarse en casa** · 5. **quedar / encontrarse**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. Shall we ___ at 5? → *meet up / meeting up / meet to*

7. Why don't we ___ the train? → *take / takes / taking*

8. How about ___ Lara? → *inviting / invite / to invite*

9. Let's ___ in tonight. → *stay / staying / to stay*

10. Would you like to ___ some sandwiches? → *bring / brings / bringing*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **meet up** · 7. **take** · 8. **inviting** · 9. **stay** · 10. **bring**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. *Shall we* for plans: ____. → a) yes · b) only offers · c) only opinions

12. Beach plan if weather good: ____. → a) Saturday · b) receipt · c) platform

13. Train at ____. → a) 9 · b) 19 · c) midnight only

14. If rains → ___ in. → a) stay · b) checkout · c) refund

15. Unit 51 next is ____. → a) Offers U52 · b) Module 6 only · c) skip U52

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) yes** · 12. **a) Saturday** · 13. **a) 9** · 14. **a) stay** · 15. **a) Offers U52**

</details>

## Lección 3 — Reading: Weekend plans

**Objetivo:** comprender un texto con el foco de la unidad.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-51/reading-suggestions.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Weekend plans"></audio>

> Shall we do something this weekend? Let's go to the beach on Saturday if the weather is good. Why don't we take the train at 9? How about inviting Lara too? Would you like to bring some sandwiches? If it rains, let's stay in and watch a series instead.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Shall we do something this ___. → a) weekend · b) receipt · c) platform

2. Let's go to the ___ on Saturday. → a) beach · b) pharmacy · c) checkout

3. Why don't we take the ___ at 9? → a) train · b) drama · c) gate

4. How about inviting ___ too? → a) Lara · b) refund · c) forecast

5. If it rains → ___ in. → a) stay · b) go out · c) exchange

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) weekend** · 2. **a) beach** · 3. **a) train** · 4. **a) Lara** · 5. **a) stay**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Would you like to bring some ___. → a) sandwiches · b) receipts · c) dramas

7. Watch a ___ if it rains. → a) series · b) platform · c) degree

8. *Shall we* in text = ____. → a) sugerencia · b) opinión · c) precio

9. *How about inviting* = ____. → a) How about + -ing · b) How about to · c) prefer than

10. Matches unit 51: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only U31

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) sandwiches** · 7. **a) series** · 8. **a) sugerencia** · 9. **a) How about + -ing** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Let's go to the beach* = ____. → a) plan · b) weather only · c) shopping

12. *Why don't we take the train* = ____. → a) transporte · b) only health · c) only Who

13. *Would you like to bring* = ____. → a) invitación · b) I agree · c) recycle

14. Text uses ____. → a) suggestion structures · b) only did · c) only phrasals

15. Suggestion writing uses ____. → a) Shall we / Let's / How about · b) only articles · c) only should

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) plan** · 12. **a) transporte** · 13. **a) invitación** · 14. **a) suggestion structures** · 15. **a) Shall we / Let's / How about**

</details>

## Lección 4 — Listening: Making plans

**Objetivo:** escuchar el foco gramatical en contexto.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-51/listening-suggestions.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Making plans"></audio>

> Eva: Shall we go to the cinema tonight?
> Nico: I'd love to, but I finish work late.
> Eva: How about tomorrow?
> Nico: Good idea. Would you like to meet at 7?
> Eva: Sure. Let's have a coffee first.
> Nico: Perfect.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Eva suggests the ___. → a) cinema · b) beach · c) train station only

2. Nico finishes work ___. → a) late · b) early always · c) never

3. They meet at ___. → a) 7 · b) 9 · c) midnight

4. Eva suggests ___. → a) tomorrow · b) last week · c) never

5. First they ___ have a coffee. → a) Let's · b) Should · c) Must

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) cinema** · 2. **a) late** · 3. **a) 7** · 4. **a) tomorrow** · 5. **a) Let's**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Nico says *I'd love to, but* = ____. → a) rechazo educado · b) I agree · c) precio

7. *How about tomorrow?* = ____. → a) alternativa · b) opinión · c) weather

8. *Would you like to meet at 7?* = ____. → a) invitación · b) recycle · c) There is

9. Dialogue uses ____. → a) suggestions · b) only opinions · c) only linking

10. Unit 51 practice: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only U31

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) rechazo educado** · 7. **a) alternativa** · 8. **a) invitación** · 9. **a) suggestions** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Shall we go to the cinema* → a) Shall we…? · b) Let's to · c) How about to

12. *Let's have a coffee first* → a) Let's + base · b) Let's to · c) I am agree

13. *Good idea* → a) aceptar · b) I disagree · c) checkout

14. Shadow and note ____. → a) suggestion forms · b) only some · c) only Who

15. U51 next unit is ____. → a) Offers U52 · b) Module 6 only · c) U50 skip

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) Shall we…?** · 12. **a) Let's + base** · 13. **a) aceptar** · 14. **a) suggestion forms** · 15. **a) Offers U52**

</details>

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. ___ we go out? → *Shall / Do / Am*

2. ___ have pizza. → *Let's / Let / Lets to*

3. How about ___ (go) for a walk? → *going / go / to go*

4. Why ___ we call her? → *don't / doesn't / not*

5. Would you like ___ (join) us? → *to join / join / joining*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Shall** · 2. **Let's** · 3. **going** · 4. **don't** · 5. **to join**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. we / Shall / go / ?

7. about / How / a / coffee / ?

8. like / Would / you / to / come / ?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. Shall we go?
7. How about a coffee?
8. Would you like to come?

</details>


### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Una sugerencia con *Shall we…?*.

10. Una sugerencia con *Let's…*.

11. Una sugerencia con *How about…?*.

12. Una invitación con *Would you like to…?*.

13. Una respuesta de aceptación.

14. Corrige: *Let's to go.*

15. Escribe un diálogo de planes (8–10 líneas) con sugerencias y respuestas.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

9. Shall we go to the cinema?
10. Let's have lunch.
11. How about meeting at 6?
12. Would you like to come with us?
13. Good idea! / Sure. / I'd love to.
14. Let's go.
15. A: Shall we go to the cinema tonight? B: I'd love to, but I finish work late. A: How about tomorrow? B: Good idea. Would you like to meet at 7? A: Sure. Let's have a coffee first. B: Perfect.

</details>



---

## Resumen rápido

| | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Directo | Let's… | Let's go. |
| Pregunta | Shall we…? | Shall we eat? |
| Suave | How about…? | How about pizza? |
| Invitar | Would you like to…? | Would you like to come? |
| Responder | Great / Sorry, I can't | I'd love to, but… |

**Contenido de la unidad:**

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** Can I…? / Would you like me to…? (offers); Could you…? / Can you…? (requests)

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. ___ I help you? → *Can / Do / Am*

2. Would you like me ___ help? → *to / for / at*

3. ___ you open the window? → *Could / Can to / Do*

4. ___ I make some tea? → *Shall / Should to / Must*

5. Yes, ___. *(aceptar oferta)* → *please / of / course only*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Can** · 2. **to** · 3. **Could** · 4. **Shall** · 5. **please**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. *Can I help you?* = ____. → a) offer · b) request · c) opinion

7. *Could you please send…* = ____. → a) request educada · b) offer · c) only Past

8. *Would you like me to* + ____. → a) verbo base · b) to + verbo · c) -ing only

9. *Yes, please* acepta ____. → a) offer · b) only request · c) I disagree

10. Unit 52 follows ____. → a) Suggestions U51 · b) Module 5 only · c) skip U53

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) offer** · 7. **a) request educada** · 8. **a) verbo base** · 9. **a) offer** · 10. **a) Suggestions U51**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *Can I to help you?*

12. *Could you to wait?*

13. *Would you like me help?*

14. *Please you send the email.*

15. *No.* *(rechazo oferta — educado)*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. Can I help you?
12. Could you wait?
13. Would you like me to help?
14. Could you please send the email?
15. No, thanks. / It's OK, thanks.

</details>



---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** Can I help you?, Could you please…?, Yes please, Of course, No thanks

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja / elige

1. *Can I help you?* ≈ ____ → *¿Puedo ayudarte? · abre la ventana · estoy de acuerdo*

2. *Could you please…* ≈ ____ → *¿Podrías… por favor? · sí por favor · no gracias*

3. *Would you like me to…* ≈ ____ → *¿Te gustaría que yo…? · ayúdame · opino que*

4. *Yes, please* ≈ ____ → *sí, por favor · por supuesto · no gracias*

5. *Of course* ≈ ____ → *por supuesto/claro · no puedo · me aburro*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **¿Puedo ayudarte?** · 2. **¿Podrías… por favor?** · 3. **¿Te gustaría que yo…?** · 4. **sí, por favor** · 5. **por supuesto/claro**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. Those bags look ___. → *heavy / heavies / heaviness*

7. Take them ___. → *upstairs / upstair / up stair*

8. Open the ___. → *door / drama / degree*

9. Send the report by ___. → *email / train / sunny*

10. Book a meeting ___ for 3. → *room / rain / receipt*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **heavy** · 7. **upstairs** · 8. **door** · 9. **email** · 10. **room**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. *Can I* for offers: ____. → a) yes · b) only opinions · c) only linking

12. Reception call is an ____. → a) offer · b) request · c) opinion

13. *That would be great* = ____. → a) aceptar · b) rechazar · c) I disagree

14. Office text uses ____. → a) offers & requests · b) only did · c) only phrasals

15. Unit 52 next is ____. → a) Opinions U53 · b) Module 5 only · c) skip U53

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) yes** · 12. **a) offer** · 13. **a) aceptar** · 14. **a) offers & requests** · 15. **a) Opinions U53**

</details>

## Lección 3 — Reading: At the office

**Objetivo:** comprender un texto con el foco de la unidad.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-52/reading-offers.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: At the office"></audio>

> Good morning. Can I help you with those boxes? If you want, Would you like me to call reception? Later, Could you please send me the report by email? And Shall I book a meeting room for 3? Thanks — that would be great.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Can I help with those ___. → a) boxes · b) dramas · c) platforms

2. Would you like me to call ___. → a) reception · b) weather · c) museum

3. Send report by ___. → a) email · b) train · c) gate

4. Shall I book meeting room for ___. → a) 3 · b) 30 · c) midnight

5. Thanks — that would be ___. → a) great · b) refund · c) foggy

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) boxes** · 2. **a) reception** · 3. **a) email** · 4. **a) 3** · 5. **a) great**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. *Could you please* = ____. → a) request cortés · b) offer · c) only Past

7. *Shall I book* = ____. → a) offer · b) opinion · c) recycle

8. Office reading mixes ____. → a) offers & requests · b) only feelings · c) only places

9. *Good morning* starts ____. → a) office context · b) beach · c) exam only

10. Matches unit 52: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only U31

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) request cortés** · 7. **a) offer** · 8. **a) offers & requests** · 9. **a) office context** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Can I help you with those boxes* = ____. → a) offer · b) I think · c) There is

12. *Would you like me to call reception* = ____. → a) offer · b) request · c) linking only

13. *Could you please send* = ____. → a) request · b) suggestion · c) feel

14. Text uses ____. → a) Can I / Could you / Would you like me to · b) only articles · c) only should recycle

15. Offer writing uses ____. → a) Can I / Would you like me to · b) only I think · c) only although

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) offer** · 12. **a) offer** · 13. **a) request** · 14. **a) Can I / Could you / Would you like me to** · 15. **a) Can I / Would you like me to**

</details>

## Lección 4 — Listening: Helping a neighbour

**Objetivo:** escuchar el foco gramatical en contexto.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-52/listening-offers.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Helping a neighbour"></audio>

> Alex: Hi! Those bags look heavy. Can I help you?
> Sam: Yes, please. Thanks!
> Alex: Would you like me to take them upstairs?
> Sam: That would be great.
> Alex: Could you open the door?
> Sam: Of course. Here you are.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Alex offers to help with ___. → a) bags · b) emails · c) exams

2. Sam accepts with ___. → a) Yes, please · b) I disagree · c) In my opinion

3. Alex offers to take bags ___. → a) upstairs · b) to cinema · c) to beach

4. Alex asks Sam to open the ___. → a) door · b) window only · c) app

5. Sam says ___. → a) Of course · b) I don't think so · c) Let's to go

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) bags** · 2. **a) Yes, please** · 3. **a) upstairs** · 4. **a) door** · 5. **a) Of course**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. *Those bags look heavy* = ____. → a) observación antes de offer · b) weather · c) opinion forum

7. *That would be great* = ____. → a) aceptar offer · b) rechazar · c) linking only

8. *Could you open the door?* = ____. → a) request · b) offer · c) suggestion Shall we

9. Dialogue uses ____. → a) offers & requests · b) only opinions · c) only environment

10. Unit 52 practice: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only U31

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) observación antes de offer** · 7. **a) aceptar offer** · 8. **a) request** · 9. **a) offers & requests** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Can I help you?* → a) offer · b) I think · c) There are

12. *Would you like me to take them upstairs?* → a) offer · b) request · c) opinion

13. *Of course* → a) aceptar request · b) No thanks · c) I am agree

14. Shadow and note ____. → a) offer/request forms · b) only some · c) only Who

15. U52 next unit is ____. → a) Opinions U53 · b) Module 5 only · c) U51 skip

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) offer** · 12. **a) offer** · 13. **a) aceptar request** · 14. **a) offer/request forms** · 15. **a) Opinions U53**

</details>

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. ___ I carry your bag? → *Can / Do / Am*

2. Could you ___ close the door? *(please)* → *please / to / for*

3. Would you like me ___ help? → *to / for / at*

4. ___ you send the file? → *Could / Can to / Do*

5. Yes, ___. → *please / of / course only*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Can** · 2. **please** · 3. **to** · 4. **Could** · 5. **please**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. help / I / Can / you / ?

7. open / Could / you / the / window / ?

8. me / like / Would / you / to / help / ?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. Can I help you?
7. Could you open the window?
8. Would you like me to help?

</details>


### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Una offer con *Can I…?*.

10. Una offer con *Would you like me to…?*.

11. Una request con *Could you…?*.

12. Una respuesta *Yes, please.*

13. Una respuesta *Of course.*

14. Corrige: *Can I to help you?*

15. Escribe un diálogo de cortesía (8–10 líneas) con offers y requests.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

9. Can I help you?
10. Would you like me to call a taxi?
11. Could you open the window, please?
12. Yes, please.
13. Of course.
14. Can I help you?
15. A: Those bags look heavy. Can I help you? B: Yes, please. A: Would you like me to take them upstairs? B: That would be great. A: Could you open the door? B: Of course. Here you are.

</details>



---

## Resumen rápido

| | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Offer | Can I…? | Can I help you? |
| Offer | Would you like me to…? | Would you like me to carry that? |
| Request | Could you…? | Could you open the window? |
| Aceptar | Yes, please. | Yes, please. |
| Aceptar | Of course. | Of course. |

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** I think… / I don't think…; In my opinion…; I agree (with you); I don't think so

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I ___ the film is great. → *think / am think / thinking*

2. I don't ___ it's funny. → *think / thinking / thought*

3. In my ___, it's too long. → *opinion / agree / think*

4. I agree ___ you. → *with / to / for*

5. I don't think ___. → *so / yes / that so*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **think** · 2. **think** · 3. **opinion** · 4. **with** · 5. **so**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. *I am agree* is ____. → a) wrong → I agree · b) correct · c) I agree you

7. *I agree with you* = ____. → a) acordar · b) discrepar · c) offer

8. *In my opinion,* needs ____. → a) coma often · b) always that after · c) only Past

9. *I don't think so* = ____. → a) discrepar · b) acordar · c) Can I help

10. Unit 53 follows ____. → a) Offers U52 · b) Module 5 only · c) skip U54

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) wrong → I agree** · 7. **a) acordar** · 8. **a) coma often** · 9. **a) discrepar** · 10. **a) Offers U52**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *I am agree with you.*

12. *I agree you.*

13. *I think so not.*

14. *In my opinion that it's boring.*

15. *According to me, it's great.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. I agree with you.
12. I agree with you.
13. I don't think so.
14. In my opinion, it's boring.
15. In my opinion, / For me, it's great.

</details>

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** I think, In my opinion, I agree, I disagree, What do you think?, boring, brilliant, catchy

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja / elige

1. *brilliant* ≈ ____ → *genial/brillante · aburrido · demasiado largo*

2. *boring* ≈ ____ → *aburrido · emocionante · genial*

3. *catchy* ≈ ____ → *pegadizo (música) · lento · caro*

4. *exciting* ≈ ____ → *emocionante · aburrido · lento*

5. *worth watching* ≈ ____ → *merece la pena verlo · demasiado largo · no lo creo*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **genial/brillante** · 2. **aburrido** · 3. **pegadizo (música)** · 4. **emocionante** · 5. **merece la pena verlo**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. What do you ___ of this restaurant? → *think / agree / opinion*

8. Episode one is ___. → *slow / slowly / slowness*

9. The ending was ___. → *amazing / amazingly / amaze*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **think** · 7. **brilliant** · 8. **slow** · 9. **amazing** · 10. **boring**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. *What do you think?* = ____. → a) pedir opinión · b) offer · c) recycle

15. Unit 53 next is ____. → a) Feelings U54 · b) Module 5 only · c) skip U54

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) pedir opinión** · 12. **a) brilliant** · 13. **a) duda** · 14. **a) I think / In my opinion / I agree** · 15. **a) Feelings U54**

</details>

## Lección 3 — Reading: Forum review

**Objetivo:** comprender un texto con el foco de la unidad.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-53/reading-opinions.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Forum review"></audio>

> What do you think of the new series? In my opinion, episode one is slow, but the story is interesting. I think the actors are brilliant. Some people say it's boring — I don't think so. I agree that it's a bit long, but it's worth watching.

## Lección 4 — Listening: After a film

**Objetivo:** escuchar el foco gramatical en contexto.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-53/listening-opinions.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: After a film"></audio>

> Lara: What do you think of the film?
> Ben: I think it was exciting.
> Lara: I agree. The ending was amazing.
> Ben: Do you agree that it was too long?

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Ben thinks film was ___. → a) exciting · b) boring · c) foggy

2. Lara ___. → a) agrees · b) I don't think so always · c) Can I help

3. Ending was ___. → a) amazing · b) receipt · c) platform

4. Ben asks if it was too ___. → a) long · b) cheap · c) sunny

5. Lara says in her opinion it was ___. → a) fine · b) terrible always · c) never

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. *I'm not sure* = ____. → a) duda · b) I agree · c) Yes please

8. *Do you agree that…?* = ____. → a) preguntar acuerdo · b) offer · c) recycle

9. Dialogue about ____. → a) film opinion · b) shopping · c) transport only

10. Unit 53 practice: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only U31

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) duda** · 7. **a) aceptar diferencia** · 8. **a) preguntar acuerdo** · 9. **a) film opinion** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *I think it was exciting* → a) I think… · b) I am think · c) I agree you

12. *I agree* → a) acordar · b) I don't think so · c) Can I

13. *In my opinion, it was fine* → a) In my opinion… · b) In my opinion that · c) According to me only

14. Shadow and note ____. → a) opinion phrases · b) only some · c) only Who

15. U53 next unit is ____. → a) Feelings U54 · b) Module 5 only · c) U52 skip

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) I think…** · 12. **a) acordar** · 13. **a) In my opinion…** · 14. **a) opinion phrases** · 15. **a) Feelings U54**

</details>

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I ___ it's a good idea. → *think / am think / thinking*

2. In my ___, we should stay. → *opinion / agree / think*

### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

10. Una opinión con *In my opinion…*.

## Resumen rápido
