content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 54 del curso A2** (*Feelings & Emotions*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [Feelings & Emotions A2](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-54-feelings-emotions)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 54 — Feelings & Emotions](/curso-a2/unit-54)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Feelings & Emotions](/blog/curso-a2/unit-54/a2-unit54-feelings-emotions.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática](#leccion-1--gramatica)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario](#leccion-2--vocabulario)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: Before the interview](#leccion-3--reading)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: After an exam](#leccion-4--listening)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing](#leccion-5--writing)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** I feel… / I'm… + adj; excited/worried/bored/disappointed/proud/nervous; How do you feel?

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I ___ nervous before interviews. → *feel / feels / feeling*

2. I'm ___ about the exam. → *worried / worry / worrying*

3. How do you ___ ? → *feel / feels / feeling*

4. You should be ___ of your work. → *proud / pride / proudly*

5. The film is ___, so I feel ___. → *boring / bored · bored / boring*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **feel** · 2. **worried** · 3. **feel** · 4. **proud** · 5. **boring / bored**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. *I'm bored* (yo) vs *The film is boring*: ____. → a) correcto · b) I'm boring · c) film is bored

7. *Proud of* (no *proud for*): ____. → a) correcto · b) proud for you · c) pride you

8. *Worried about* = ____. → a) preocupado por · b) orgulloso · c) aburrido

9. *How do you feel?* = ____. → a) preguntar emoción · b) opinion only · c) price

10. Unit 54 follows ____. → a) Opinions U53 · b) Module 5 only · c) skip U55

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) correcto** · 7. **a) correcto** · 8. **a) preocupado por** · 9. **a) preguntar emoción** · 10. **a) Opinions U53**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *I feel me happy.*

12. *I'm excite.*

13. *proud for you*

14. *worried of the exam*

15. *How you feel?*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. I feel happy.
12. I'm excited.
13. proud of you
14. worried about the exam
15. How do you feel?

</details>



---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** excited, worried, bored, disappointed, proud, nervous, relieved, tired, hopeful

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja / elige

1. *excited* ≈ ____ → *emocionado/ilusión · aburrido · decepcionado*

2. *worried* ≈ ____ → *preocupado · orgulloso · aliviado*

3. *disappointed* ≈ ____ → *decepcionado · emocionado · nervioso*

4. *relieved* ≈ ____ → *aliviado · cansado · orgulloso*

5. *hopeful* ≈ ____ → *con esperanza · aburrido · enfadado*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **emocionado/ilusión** · 2. **preocupado** · 3. **decepcionado** · 4. **aliviado** · 5. **con esperanza**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. I feel ___ about the trip. → *excited / exciting / excite*

7. She was ___ about the result. → *disappointed / disappointing / disappoint*

8. I'm a bit ___ after the exam. → *tired / tire / tiring*

9. Be ___ of your CV. → *proud / proudly / pride*

10. Don't feel ___ waiting — take a book. → *bored / boring / bore*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **excited** · 7. **disappointed** · 8. **tired** · 9. **proud** · 10. **bored**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. Interview tomorrow → feel ____. → a) nervous · b) checkout · c) platform

12. Mum says be ____. → a) proud · b) refund · c) drama

13. Last week was ____. → a) disappointed · b) sunny · c) cheaper

14. Feelings text uses ____. → a) feel / excited / worried · b) only Can I · c) only There is

15. Unit 54 next is ____. → a) Environment U55 · b) Module 5 only · c) skip U55

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) nervous** · 12. **a) proud** · 13. **a) disappointed** · 14. **a) feel / excited / worried** · 15. **a) Environment U55**

</details>



---

## Lección 3 — Reading: Before the interview

**Objetivo:** comprender un texto con el foco de la unidad.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-54/reading-feelings.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Before the interview"></audio>

> Tomorrow I have a job interview. I feel nervous, but also excited. My mum says I should be proud of my CV. Last week I was disappointed about another interview, so I'm a bit worried. I don't want to feel bored waiting all morning — I'll take a book. How do I feel right now? Hopeful!

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Tomorrow: job ___. → a) interview · b) receipt · c) platform

2. Feels ___ and excited. → a) nervous · b) sunny · c) cheaper

3. Should be ___ of CV. → a) proud · b) foggy · c) shy

4. Last week was ___. → a) disappointed · b) brilliant always · c) free

5. Feels ___ now. → a) hopeful · b) checkout · c) gate

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) interview** · 2. **a) nervous** · 3. **a) proud** · 4. **a) disappointed** · 5. **a) hopeful**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Worried about another ___. → a) interview · b) sandwich · c) drama

7. Take a ___ while waiting. → a) book · b) receipt · c) refund

8. *I feel nervous* = ____. → a) emoción · b) opinión · c) precio

9. *Don't want to feel bored* = ____. → a) aburrirse · b) aburrido cosa · c) recycle

10. Matches unit 54: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only U31

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) interview** · 7. **a) book** · 8. **a) emoción** · 9. **a) aburrirse** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *I feel nervous, but also excited* = ____. → a) dos emociones · b) only opinion · c) only offer

12. *Proud of my CV* = ____. → a) proud of · b) proud for · c) pride my

13. *Hopeful* = ____. → a) con esperanza · b) cansado · c) aburrido cosa

14. Text uses ____. → a) feelings vocabulary · b) only linking · c) only shopping

15. Feelings writing uses ____. → a) I feel / I'm / How do you feel · b) only articles · c) only Shall we

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) dos emociones** · 12. **a) proud of** · 13. **a) con esperanza** · 14. **a) feelings vocabulary** · 15. **a) I feel / I'm / How do you feel**

</details>



---

## Lección 4 — Listening: After an exam

**Objetivo:** escuchar el foco gramatical en contexto.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-54/listening-feelings.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: After an exam"></audio>

> Mia: How do you feel?
> Omar: I'm relieved — and a bit tired.
> Mia: Were you nervous?
> Omar: Yes. I was also worried about the listening part.
> Mia: You should be proud. You studied a lot.
> Omar: Thanks. I was disappointed last time, so this feels better.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Omar feels ___ and tired. → a) relieved · b) sunny · c) cheaper

2. Was he ___? → a) nervous · b) never · c) checkout

3. Worried about ___ part. → a) listening · b) shopping · c) weather only

4. Mia says be ___. → a) proud · b) bored thing · c) refund

5. Last time felt ___. → a) disappointed · b) amazing always · c) free

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) relieved** · 2. **a) nervous** · 3. **a) listening** · 4. **a) proud** · 5. **a) disappointed**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. *How do you feel?* opens ____. → a) feelings dialogue · b) shopping · c) places only

7. *You studied a lot* supports ____. → a) proud · b) I disagree · c) recycle

8. *This feels better* after ____. → a) disappointment before · b) never exam · c) only weather

9. Dialogue uses ____. → a) feelings · b) only opinions forum · c) only tech

10. Unit 54 practice: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only U31

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) feelings dialogue** · 7. **a) proud** · 8. **a) disappointment before** · 9. **a) feelings** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *I'm relieved* → a) I'm + adj · b) I feel me · c) I am boring

12. *Worried about the listening part* → a) worried about · b) worried of · c) worry about

13. *You should be proud* → a) consejo/emoción · b) Can I help · c) There are

14. Shadow and note ____. → a) feelings forms · b) only some · c) only Who

15. U54 next unit is ____. → a) Environment U55 · b) Module 5 only · c) U53 skip

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) I'm + adj** · 12. **a) worried about** · 13. **a) consejo/emoción** · 14. **a) feelings forms** · 15. **a) Environment U55**

</details>



---

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I ___ excited about the trip. → *feel / am feel / feeling*

2. I'm ___ about the exam. → *worried / worry / worrying*

3. How do you ___ ? → *feel / feels / feeling*

4. I'm ___ of you. → *proud / pride / proudly*

5. I was ___ about the result. → *disappointed / disappointing / disappoint*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **feel** · 2. **worried** · 3. **feel** · 4. **proud** · 5. **disappointed**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. feel / I / nervous

7. proud / You / should / be

8. do / How / you / feel / ?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. I feel nervous.
7. You should be proud.
8. How do you feel?

</details>


### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Una frase con *I feel…*.

10. Una frase con *I'm worried about…*.

11. Una frase con *proud of*.

12. Una pregunta *How do you feel?*

13. Una frase con *disappointed*.

14. Corrige: *I feel me happy.*

15. Describe cómo te sientes antes de un examen (8–10 líneas).

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

9. I feel nervous.
10. I'm worried about the exam.
11. You should be proud of your CV.
12. How do you feel?
13. I was disappointed about the result.
14. I feel happy.
15. Tomorrow I have a job interview. I feel nervous, but also excited. My mum says I should be proud of my CV. Last week I was disappointed about another interview, so I'm a bit worried. I don't want to feel bored waiting all morning — I'll take a book. How do I feel right now? Hopeful!

</details>



---

## Resumen rápido

| | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Preguntar | How do you feel? | How do you feel? |
| Sentir | I feel… | I feel nervous. |
| Estado | I'm… | I'm excited. |
| Emoción | proud / worried | I'm proud of you. |
| Contraste | -ed vs -ing | I'm bored. / The film is boring. |

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 55 del curso A2** (*The Environment*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [The Environment A2](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-55-the-environment)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 55 — The Environment](/curso-a2/unit-55)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![The Environment](/blog/curso-a2/unit-55/a2-unit55-the-environment.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática](#leccion-1--gramatica)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario](#leccion-2--vocabulario)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: Green tips at home](#leccion-3--reading)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: At the supermarket](#leccion-4--listening)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing](#leccion-5--writing)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** recycle / save / pollute / waste; should / shouldn't for environmental advice

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. You ___ recycle paper. → *should / should to / shoulds*

2. Don't ___ food. → *waste / wastes / wasting*

3. We ___ glass and paper. → *recycle / recycles / recycling*

4. Cars ___ the air. → *pollute / pollutes / pollution*

5. ___ water when you can. → *Save / Saves / Saving*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **should** · 2. **waste** · 3. **recycle** · 4. **pollute** · 5. **Save**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. *You should recycle* (no *should to*): ____. → a) correcto · b) You should to recycle · c) You shoulds recycle

7. *Pollution* is ____. → a) sustantivo · b) verbo · c) adjetivo only

8. *Don't waste food* = ____. → a) no desperdiciar · b) reciclar · c) only Past

9. *Save energy* = ____. → a) ahorrar energía · b) contaminar · c) plastic only

10. Unit 55 follows ____. → a) Feelings U54 · b) Module 5 only · c) skip U56

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) correcto** · 7. **a) sustantivo** · 8. **a) no desperdiciar** · 9. **a) ahorrar energía** · 10. **a) Feelings U54**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *You should to recycle.*

12. *Cars pollution the air.*

13. *Don't wastes food.*

14. *Save the water always the.*

15. *We should recycle plastics only one.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. You should recycle.
12. Cars pollute the air.
13. Don't waste food.
14. Save water.
15. We should recycle paper, glass and plastic.

</details>



---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** environment, recycle, pollution, plastic, save water, save energy, reuse

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja / elige

1. *environment* ≈ ____ → *medio ambiente · contaminación · plástico*

2. *recycle* ≈ ____ → *reciclar · desperdiciar · contaminar*

3. *pollution* ≈ ____ → *contaminación · reciclar · ahorrar*

4. *reuse* ≈ ____ → *reutilizar · tirar · contaminar*

5. *plastic* ≈ ____ → *plástico · papel · energía*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **medio ambiente** · 2. **reciclar** · 3. **contaminación** · 4. **reutilizar** · 5. **plástico**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. Turn off lights to save ___. → *energy / energetic / energies*

7. Air ___ is a problem. → *pollution / pollute / polluting*

8. We shouldn't buy many ___ bags. → *plastic / plastics / plasticity*

9. Walk or take the ___. → *bus / busy / busily*

10. Small ___ help every day. → *actions / actioning / acted*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **energy** · 7. **pollution** · 8. **plastic** · 9. **bus** · 10. **actions**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. *Should recycle* paper, glass and ____. → a) plastic · b) platform · c) drama

12. *Save water* when you brush ____. → a) teeth · b) train · c) receipt

13. *Pollution getting worse* in ____. → a) city · b) museum · c) gate

14. Environment text uses ____. → a) should / recycle / save · b) only I think · c) only There is

15. Unit 55 next is ____. → a) Technology U56 · b) Module 5 only · c) skip U56

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) plastic** · 12. **a) teeth** · 13. **a) city** · 14. **a) should / recycle / save** · 15. **a) Technology U56**

</details>



---

## Lección 3 — Reading: Green tips at home

**Objetivo:** comprender un texto con el foco de la unidad.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-55/reading-environment.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Green tips at home"></audio>

> Protecting the environment starts at home. You should recycle paper, glass and plastic. Save water when you brush your teeth, and turn off lights to save energy. Don't waste food. If you can, walk or take the bus — cars pollute the air. Small actions help every day.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Protecting the ___ starts at home. → a) environment · b) checkout · c) platform

2. Recycle paper, glass and ___. → a) plastic · b) drama · c) gate

3. Save water when you brush ___. → a) teeth · b) train · c) receipt

4. Turn off lights to save ___. → a) energy · b) pollution · c) plastic only

5. Cars pollute the ___. → a) air · b) library · c) degree

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) environment** · 2. **a) plastic** · 3. **a) teeth** · 4. **a) energy** · 5. **a) air**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Don't ___ food. → a) waste · b) recycle · c) save only

7. Walk or take the ___. → a) bus · b) museum · c) exam

8. *Small actions help* = ____. → a) acciones diarias · b) only tech · c) only opinions

9. *Protecting the environment* = ____. → a) tema unidad · b) shopping · c) only Who

10. Matches unit 55: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only U31

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) waste** · 7. **a) bus** · 8. **a) acciones diarias** · 9. **a) tema unidad** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *You should recycle* = ____. → a) consejo ecológico · b) I think · c) Could you

12. *Save water* = ____. → a) ahorrar agua · b) contaminar · c) download

13. *Cars pollute the air* = ____. → a) pollute · b) pollution verb wrong · c) recycle

14. Text uses ____. → a) environment structures · b) only did · c) only phrasals

15. Environment writing uses ____. → a) should / recycle / save · b) only articles · c) only Shall we

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) consejo ecológico** · 12. **a) ahorrar agua** · 13. **a) pollute** · 14. **a) environment structures** · 15. **a) should / recycle / save**

</details>



---

## Lección 4 — Listening: At the supermarket

**Objetivo:** escuchar el foco gramatical en contexto.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-55/listening-environment.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: At the supermarket"></audio>

> Ana: We shouldn't buy so many plastic bags.
> Leo: You're right. We should reuse this one.
> Ana: Do you recycle at home?
> Leo: Yes — paper and bottles. I also try to save water.
> Ana: Good. Pollution is getting worse in the city.
> Leo: Let's walk more and use the bus.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Ana says shouldn't buy many ___ bags. → a) plastic · b) paper only · c) glass

2. Leo says ___ this bag. → a) reuse · b) waste · c) pollute

3. Leo recycles paper and ___. → a) bottles · b) dramas · c) receipts

4. Leo tries to save ___. → a) water · b) energy only always · c) plastic bags more

5. Pollution worse in the ___. → a) city · b) library · c) stadium only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) plastic** · 2. **a) reuse** · 3. **a) bottles** · 4. **a) water** · 5. **a) city**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Leo suggests walk and use ____. → a) bus · b) car more · c) plastic

7. *We shouldn't buy* = ____. → a) shouldn't · b) should to · c) don't should

8. *Do you recycle at home?* = ____. → a) pregunta hábito · b) offer · c) opinion forum

9. Dialogue uses ____. → a) environment advice · b) only tech · c) only work

10. Unit 55 practice: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only U31

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) bus** · 7. **a) shouldn't** · 8. **a) pregunta hábito** · 9. **a) environment advice** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *We should reuse this one* → a) reuse · b) waste · c) pollute

12. *Pollution is getting worse* → a) pollution · b) pollute noun · c) plastic verb

13. *Let's walk more* → a) suggestion + environment · b) only I agree · c) only log in

14. Shadow and note ____. → a) should / recycle / save · b) only some · c) only Who

15. U55 next unit is ____. → a) Technology U56 · b) Module 5 only · c) U54 skip

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) reuse** · 12. **a) pollution** · 13. **a) suggestion + environment** · 14. **a) should / recycle / save** · 15. **a) Technology U56**

</details>



---

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. You ___ recycle at home. → *should / should to / shoulds*

2. Don't ___ food. → *waste / wastes / wasting*

3. We should ___ water. → *save / saves / saving*

4. Cars ___ the air. → *pollute / pollutes / pollution*

5. Protect the ___. → *environment / environmental / environ*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **should** · 2. **waste** · 3. **save** · 4. **pollute** · 5. **environment**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. recycle / We / should / glass

7. water / Save / when / you / can

8. pollute / Cars / the / air

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. We should recycle glass.
7. Save water when you can.
8. Cars pollute the air.

</details>


### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Un consejo con *You should…*.

10. Un consejo con *You shouldn't…*.

11. Una frase con *recycle*.

12. Una frase con *pollution* o *pollute*.

13. Una frase con *save water* o *save energy*.

14. Corrige: *You should to recycle.*

15. Escribe 8–10 líneas sobre qué haces por el medio ambiente.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

9. You should recycle paper and plastic.
10. You shouldn't waste food.
11. We recycle glass at home.
12. Air pollution is a problem in the city.
13. Save water when you brush your teeth.
14. You should recycle.
15. Protecting the environment starts at home. You should recycle paper, glass and plastic. Save water when you brush your teeth, and turn off lights to save energy. Don't waste food. If you can, walk or take the bus — cars pollute the air. Small actions help every day.

</details>



---

## Resumen rápido

| | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Acción | recycle / save | Recycle plastic. |
| Problema | pollution / waste | Air pollution… |
| Consejo | should / shouldn't | You should recycle. |
| Verbo | pollute | Cars pollute the air. |
| Tema | environment | Protect the environment. |

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** send / download / upload; log in; turn on WiFi; password / link / app

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. ___ in with your email. → *Log / Logs / Logging*

2. ___ the app. → *Download / Downloads / Downloading*

3. Turn ___ the WiFi. → *on / in / at*

4. ___ me an email. → *Send / Sends / Sending*

5. ___ your homework before Friday. → *Upload / Uploads / Uploading*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Log** · 2. **Download** · 3. **on** · 4. **Send** · 5. **Upload**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. *Log in* (no *log in to with password only wrong)*): ____. → a) correcto · b) log on to always wrong · c) login to only

7. *Turn on WiFi* = ____. → a) encender WiFi · b) descargar · c) subir archivo

8. *Download the app* = ____. → a) bajar app · b) enviar email · c) recycle

9. *Check spam folder* = ____. → a) carpeta spam · b) password · c) museum

10. Unit 56 follows ____. → a) Environment U55 · b) Module 5 only · c) skip U57

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) correcto** · 7. **a) encender WiFi** · 8. **a) bajar app** · 9. **a) carpeta spam** · 10. **a) Environment U55**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *I can't to log in.*

12. *Send me an screenshot.*

13. *Download the homework.* *(wrong context)*

14. *Turn the WiFi.*

15. *Upload an email.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. I can't log in.
12. Send me a screenshot.
13. Upload your homework. / Download the app.
14. Turn on the WiFi.
15. Send an email. / Upload your homework.

</details>

**Objetivo:** email, download, upload, log in, WiFi, password, link, app, website, screenshot

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja / elige

1. *log in* ≈ ____ → *iniciar sesión · descargar · subir*

2. *download* ≈ ____ → *descargar · enviar · encender*

3. *upload* ≈ ____ → *subir (archivo) · bajar · borrar*

4. *password* ≈ ____ → *contraseña · enlace · correo*

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. Open the ___. → *website / web / webs*

7. Click the ___ in your email. → *link / links / linking*

8. Check your spam ___. → *folder / fold / folding*

9. Try another ___. → *password / pass / passwords*

10. Send me a ___. → *screenshot / screen / screens*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **website** · 7. **link** · 8. **folder** · 9. **password** · 10. **screenshot**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

12. *Upload homework* before ____. → a) Friday · b) sunny · c) gate

13. *Turn on WiFi* before ____. → a) log in · b) recycle · c) proud

14. Tech text uses ____. → a) log in / download / upload · b) only I think · c) only There is

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** work as / work in; study at; have to + infinitivo; deadline / meeting / exam

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I work ___ a designer. → *as / like / in*

2. I work ___ an office. → *in / as / at*

3. I study ___ university. → *at / in / on*

4. I ___ to answer emails today. → *have / has / having*

5. Finish before the ___. → *deadline / dead line / deadlined*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **as** · 2. **in** · 3. **at** · 4. **have** · 5. **deadline**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. *Work as* = profesión: ____. → a) correcto · b) work like · c) work at a designer

7. *Study at university* = ____. → a) correcto · b) study in university always · c) study to university

8. *Have to* = ____. → a) obligación · b) opinión · c) only Past

9. *Deadline* = ____. → a) fecha límite · b) reunión · c) examen only

10. Unit 57 follows ____. → a) Technology U56 · b) Module 5 only · c) skip U58

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) correcto** · 7. **a) correcto** · 8. **a) obligación** · 9. **a) fecha límite** · 10. **a) Technology U56**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *I work like a nurse.*

12. *I study in university.*

13. *I have to finishing today.*

14. *She works as an office.*

15. *He has to takes three exams.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. I work as a nurse.
12. I study at university.
13. I have to finish today.
14. She works in an office.
15. He has to take three exams.

</details>

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** work as, work in, study at, have to, deadline, meeting, exam, office, graduation

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja / elige

## Lección 3 — Reading: Two routines

1. Mia works as a ___. → a) receptionist · b) designer · c) biologist only

2. She works in a small ___. → a) office · b) stadium · c) pharmacy

3. Has to answer emails before ___. → a) deadline · b) sunny · c) gate

4. Leo studies at ___. → a) university · b) checkout · c) library only tourist

5. Favourite subject is ___. → a) biology · b) drama · c) refund

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) receptionist** · 2. **a) office** · 3. **a) deadline** · 4. **a) university** · 5. **a) biology**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

10. Matches unit 57: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only U31

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) exams** · 7. **a) lab** · 8. **a) profesión** · 9. **a) trabajo** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

14. Text uses ____. → a) work & education · b) only linking · c) only health

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) work as + job** · 12. **a) estudiar en** · 13. **a) have to** · 14. **a) work & education** · 15. **a) work as / study at / have to**

</details>

## Lección 4 — Listening: At lunch

**Objetivo:** escuchar el foco gramatical en contexto.

> Nora: What do you do?
> Pablo: I work as a designer. I work in an advertising company.

<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) designer** · 2. **a) advertising** · 3. **a) meetings** · 4. **a) university** · 5. **a) Monday**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. *What do you do?* = ____. → a) preguntar trabajo · b) How do you feel · c) recycle

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) preguntar trabajo** · 7. **a) frecuencia trabajo** · 8. **a) exam** · 9. **a) work & education** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

14. Shadow and note ____. → a) work/education forms · b) only some · c) only Who

15. U57 next unit is ____. → a) Places U58 · b) Module 5 only · c) U56 skip

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) work as** · 12. **a) have to** · 13. **a) study at** · 14. **a) work/education forms** · 15. **a) Places U58**

</details>

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

<details>

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. ___ is a museum in the centre. → *There / It / They*

2. ___ there any good cafés? → *Are / Is / Do*

3. The library is ___ in Green Street. → *located / locate / locating*

4. There are two cafés ___ the museum. → *opposite / opposite to / oppositing*

5. The hospital is ___ the station. → *near / nearly / nears*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **There** · 2. **Are** · 3. **located** · 4. **opposite** · 5. **near**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. is / There / a / library / .

7. the / located / museum / is / next / to / square / the / .

8. there / Are / any / parks / ?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. There is a library.
7. The museum is located next to the square.
8. Are there any parks?

</details>


### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Una frase con *There is…*.

10. Una frase con *There are…*.

11. Una pregunta *Is there…?* o *Are there…?*

12. Una frase con *located in* o *opposite*.

13. Menciona un edificio del vocabulario.

14. Corrige: *There are a museum.*

15. Escribe una mini guía de tu ciudad (8–10 líneas).

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

9. There is a museum in the centre.
10. There are two cafés opposite the square.
11. Is there a library near here?
12. The library is located in Green Street, opposite the museum.
13. The football stadium is in the south.
14. There is a museum.
15. Welcome to Riverton. There is a beautiful main square in the centre. The art museum is located next to the square, and there are two cafés opposite it. The library is the oldest building in town. The football stadium is in the south. The hospital is near the station — easy to find.

</details>



---

## Resumen rápido

| | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Hay (sg) | There is | There is a museum. |
| Hay (pl) | There are | There are two cafés. |
| Preguntar | Is there…? | Is there a library? |
| Ubicación | located in | located in Green Street |
| Lugar | opposite / near | opposite the museum |

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 59 del curso A2** (*Linking Words*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [Linking Words A2](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-59-linking-words)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 59 — Linking Words](/curso-a2/unit-59)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Linking Words](/blog/curso-a2/unit-59/a2-unit59-linking-words.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática](#leccion-1--gramatica)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario](#leccion-2--vocabulario)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: A short paragraph](#leccion-3--reading)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: Weekend plans](#leccion-4--listening)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing](#leccion-5--writing)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** and (suma); but / although / however (contraste); because (causa); so (resultado)

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I like tea ___ coffee. → *and / but / because*

2. It's cheap, ___ small. → *but / and / so*

3. I'm tired ___ I worked late. → *because / so / but*

4. It rained, ___ we stayed in. → *so / because / but*

5. ___ the centre is expensive, I enjoy living there. → *Although / Because / So*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **and** · 2. **but** · 3. **because** · 4. **so** · 5. **Although**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. *Because* shows ____. → a) causa · b) resultado · c) suma

7. *So* shows ____. → a) resultado · b) causa · c) contraste only

8. *Although* = ____. → a) aunque · b) por eso · c) y

9. *However* often contrasts with ____. → a) previous idea · b) only and · c) only because

10. Unit 59 follows ____. → a) Places U58 · b) Module 5 only · c) skip U60

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) causa** · 7. **a) resultado** · 8. **a) aunque** · 9. **a) previous idea** · 10. **a) Places U58**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *I like tea because coffee.*

12. *It rained, because we stayed in.*

13. *Although it's cheap, but it's small.*

14. *So I was tired, I worked late.*

15. *I enjoy living there, however I love my city because.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. I like tea and coffee. / I like tea, but not coffee.
12. It rained, so we stayed in.
13. Although it's expensive, it's nice. / It's cheap, but it's small.
14. I was tired because I worked late.
15. I love my city because there are parks and museums.

</details>



---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** and, but, because, so, although, however, therefore

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja / elige

1. *because* ≈ ____ → *porque · por eso · pero*

2. *so* ≈ ____ → *así que/por eso · aunque · y*

3. *although* ≈ ____ → *aunque · porque · y*

4. *however* ≈ ____ → *sin embargo · y · porque*

5. *therefore* ≈ ____ → *por lo tanto · pero · y*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **porque** · 2. **así que/por eso** · 3. **aunque** · 4. **sin embargo** · 5. **por lo tanto**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. Parks ___ museums in the city. → *and / but / so*

7. Busy ___ friendly. → *but / because / so*

8. Rained, ___ stayed home. → *so / because / although*

9. Film was long; ___, excellent. → *however / because / and*

10. Tired ___ worked late. → *because / so / and*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **and** · 7. **but** · 8. **so** · 9. **however** · 10. **because**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. *Because there are parks* explains ____. → a) love city · b) stayed home · c) film long only

12. *Although expensive* = ____. → a) contraste · b) suma · c) resultado

13. Paragraph links ideas with ____. → a) connectors · b) only There is · c) only Can I

14. *We watched a film and cooked* = ____. → a) and · b) but · c) so cause

15. Unit 59 next is ____. → a) Module 6 Review U60 · b) Module 5 only · c) skip U60

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) love city** · 12. **a) contraste** · 13. **a) connectors** · 14. **a) and** · 15. **a) Module 6 Review U60**

</details>



---

## Lección 3 — Reading: A short paragraph

**Objetivo:** comprender un texto con el foco de la unidad.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-59/reading-linking.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: A short paragraph"></audio>

> I love my city because there are parks and museums. It's busy, but friendly. Although the centre is expensive, I enjoy living there. Last Saturday it rained, so we stayed at home. We watched a film and cooked dinner. The film was long; however, it was excellent.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Loves city ___ parks and museums. → a) because · b) so · c) but only

2. City is busy ___ friendly. → a) but · b) and cause · c) because result

3. ___ centre expensive, enjoys living there. → a) Although · b) So · c) And

4. It rained, ___ stayed at home. → a) so · b) because · c) although wrong order

5. Watched film ___ cooked dinner. → a) and · b) but · c) so

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) because** · 2. **a) but** · 3. **a) Although** · 4. **a) so** · 5. **a) and**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Film was long; ___, excellent. → a) however · b) because · c) and only

7. Last Saturday it ___. → a) rained · b) sunny always · c) free

8. *Because* introduces ____. → a) reason · b) result · c) addition only

9. *So* introduces ____. → a) result · b) reason · c) contrast only

10. Matches unit 59: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only U31

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) however** · 7. **a) rained** · 8. **a) reason** · 9. **a) result** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *I love my city because* = ____. → a) causa · b) resultado · c) offer

12. *Although the centre is expensive* = ____. → a) contraste · b) suma · c) Can I help

13. *However, it was excellent* = ____. → a) however · b) because · c) and

14. Text uses ____. → a) linking words · b) only places · c) only tech

15. Linking writing uses ____. → a) and/but/because/so/although · b) only articles · c) only Shall we

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) causa** · 12. **a) contraste** · 13. **a) however** · 14. **a) linking words** · 15. **a) and/but/because/so/although**

</details>



---

## Lección 4 — Listening: Weekend plans

**Objetivo:** escuchar el foco gramatical en contexto.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-59/listening-linking.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Weekend plans"></audio>

> Eva: Shall we go out?
> Nico: I'd like to, but I'm tired because I worked late.
> Eva: OK — so let's stay in and watch a series.
> Nico: Good idea. Although I'm tired, I don't want to sleep yet.
> Eva: Perfect.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Eva asks go ___. → a) out · b) shopping only · c) museum

2. Nico is tired ___ worked late. → a) because · b) so · c) and only

3. They decide ___ stay in. → a) to · b) for · c) at

4. Watch a ___ . → a) series · b) receipt · c) gate

5. Although tired, doesn't want ___ yet. → a) sleep · b) recycle · c) checkout

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) out** · 2. **a) because** · 3. **a) to** · 4. **a) series** · 5. **a) sleep**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. *I'd like to, but* = ____. → a) but · b) because · c) so

7. *So let's stay in* = ____. → a) so result · b) because · c) although

8. *Although I'm tired* = ____. → a) although · b) so · c) and

9. Dialogue mixes ___ + linking. → a) suggestions · b) only places · c) only tech

10. Unit 59 practice: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only U31

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) but** · 7. **a) so result** · 8. **a) although** · 9. **a) suggestions** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Shall we go out?* + *but I'm tired* → a) suggestion + contrast · b) only opinion · c) only There is

12. *Because I worked late* → a) because · b) so · c) however

13. *Good idea* → a) accept · b) I don't think so · c) No thanks

14. Shadow and note ____. → a) linking words · b) only some · c) only Who

15. U59 next unit is ____. → a) Module 6 Review U60 · b) Module 5 only · c) U58 skip

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) suggestion + contrast** · 12. **a) because** · 13. **a) accept** · 14. **a) linking words** · 15. **a) Module 6 Review U60**

</details>



---

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I was tired ___ I worked late. → *because / so / but*

2. It rained, ___ we stayed in. → *so / because / although*

3. It's busy ___ friendly. → *but / and / because*

4. ___ it's expensive, I like it. → *Although / So / And*

5. We watched a film ___ cooked dinner. → *and / but / so*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **because** · 2. **so** · 3. **but** · 4. **Although** · 5. **and**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. tired / I'm / because / worked / I / late / .

7. home / stayed / we / so / in / , / rained / it / .

8. friendly / but / busy / it's / , / .

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. I'm tired because I worked late.
7. It rained, so we stayed in.
8. It's busy, but friendly.

</details>


### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Una frase con *because*.

10. Una frase con *so*.

11. Una frase con *but*.

12. Una frase con *although*.

13. Una frase con *and*.

14. Corrige: *It rained, because we stayed in.*

15. Escribe un párrafo corto (8–10 líneas) usando conectores.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

9. I stayed home because it rained.
10. It rained, so we stayed at home.
11. It's busy, but friendly.
12. Although the centre is expensive, I enjoy living there.
13. We watched a film and cooked dinner.
14. It rained, so we stayed in.
15. I love my city because there are parks and museums. It's busy, but friendly. Although the centre is expensive, I enjoy living there. Last Saturday it rained, so we stayed at home. We watched a film and cooked dinner. The film was long; however, it was excellent.

</details>



---

## Resumen rápido

| | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Suma | and | tea and coffee |
| Contraste | but / although | cheap, but small |
| Causa | because | tired because… |
| Resultado | so | late, so we left |
| Matiz | however | long; however, excellent |

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 6 del curso A2** (*Superlatives*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [Superlativos A2](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-6-superlativos-est-the-most)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 6 — Superlativos](/curso-a2/unit-6)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Superlatives](/blog/curso-a2/unit-6/a2-unit6-superlatives.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática: the … -est / the most](#leccion-1--gramatica-the--est--the-most)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario: extremos e in/of](#leccion-2--vocabulario-extremos-e-inof)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: My hometown](#leccion-3--reading-my-hometown)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: The biggest park](#leccion-4--listening-the-biggest-park)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing: The best place](#leccion-5--writing-the-best-place)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática: the … -est / the most

**Objetivo:** *the tallest*, *the most beautiful*, *the best/worst*.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. He is ____ tallest boy in the school. → *the / a / more*
2. This is ____ most interesting book. → *the / a / -est*
3. July is the ____ month of the year. → *hottest / hotter / hot*
4. This is the ____ film I have ever seen. → *best / better / good*
5. She is the ____ intelligent student in the class. → *most / more / -est*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **the** · 2. **the** · 3. **hottest** · 4. **best** · 5. **most**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. Superlative of short adj = ____. → a) *the* + *-est* · b) *-er than* · c) *more* only
7. Superlative of long adj = ____. → a) *the most* + adj · b) *-est* · c) *as… as*
8. *good* → ____. → a) the best · b) the goodest · c) the better
9. *bad* → ____. → a) the worst · b) the baddest · c) the worse
10. Comparatives compare ____; superlatives choose ____. → a) two / the extreme · b) many / two · c) none / none

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) *the* + *-est*** · 7. **a) *the most* + adj** · 8. **a) the best** · 9. **a) the worst** · 10. **a) two / the extreme**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *She is most tallest in the class.*
12. *This is the more beautiful place.*
13. *He is the goodest student.*
14. *It is the most hot day.*
15. *This is best restaurant in town.* (falta artículo)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. She is **the tallest** in the class.
12. This is **the most beautiful** place.
13. He is **the best** student.
14. It is **the hottest** day.
15. This is **the** best restaurant in town.

</details>

---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario: extremos e in/of

**Objetivo:** *in the world / in town*; *of the year / of all*.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja

1. tall → the ____
2. big → the ____
3. beautiful → the ____
4. good → the ____
5. quiet → the ____

a) biggest · b) most beautiful · c) tallest · d) quietest · e) best

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **c** · 2 → **a** · 3 → **b** · 4 → **e** · 5 → **d**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. the highest mountain ____ the world → *in / of / at*
7. the hottest month ____ the year → *of / in / on*
8. the biggest ____ all the towns → *of / in / at*
9. the most peaceful place ____ the world → *in / of / on*
10. delicious → the most ____ → *delicious / deliciouser / best*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **in** · 7. **of** · 8. **of** · 9. **in** · 10. **delicious**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. *in* + ____. → a) place · b) only dates · c) only people names
12. *of* + ____. → a) group / period · b) only hours · c) only *did*
13. *Oldest* means ____. → a) most old in age · b) tallest · c) quietest
14. *Peaceful* → superlative ____. → a) the most peaceful · b) the peacefulest · c) more peaceful than only
15. *Ever seen* often appears with ____. → a) superlatives · b) *at noon* · c) *on Monday* only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) place** · 12. **a) group / period** · 13. **a) most old in age** · 14. **a) the most peaceful** · 15. **a) superlatives**

</details>

---

## Lección 3 — Reading: My hometown

**Objetivo:** leer un texto con muchos superlativos.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-6/reading-superlatives.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: My hometown"></audio>

> My hometown is small but beautiful. It has the oldest church in the region. The main square is the biggest of all the towns near. In summer, July is the hottest month of the year. My grandmother lives in the tallest building in town. She says it is the most beautiful view she has ever seen. The best restaurant in town serves the most delicious food. I think my hometown is the best place in the world!

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. What is the oldest in the region? → a) The church · b) The park · c) The lake
2. What is the biggest of the towns near? → a) The main square · b) The church · c) August
3. Which month is the hottest? → a) July · b) January · c) December
4. Who lives in the tallest building? → a) Grandmother · b) Maria · c) Tom
5. What serves the most delicious food? → a) The best restaurant · b) The park · c) The church

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) The church** · 2. **a) The main square** · 3. **a) July** · 4. **a) Grandmother** · 5. **a) The best restaurant**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. The view is ____ she has ever seen. → a) the most beautiful · b) worse · c) quieter only
7. The hometown is called ____ place in the world. → a) the best · b) the worst · c) the coldest
8. *Of the year* appears with ____. → a) hottest month · b) tallest boy · c) best film only
9. *In the region / in town / in the world* use ____. → a) *in* · b) *of* · c) *at*
10. The main topic is ____. → a) describing a hometown with superlatives · b) Wh-questions · c) adverbs

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) the most beautiful** · 7. **a) the best** · 8. **a) hottest month** · 9. **a) *in*** · 10. **a) describing a hometown with superlatives**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Oldest / biggest / hottest / tallest* are ____. → a) short *-est* · b) *more* · c) *as… as*
12. *Most beautiful / most delicious* are ____. → a) *the most* + long adj · b) *-er* · c) base only
13. *Best* is irregular from ____. → a) good · b) well · c) bad
14. *Ever seen* supports a ____ meaning. → a) superlative experience · b) future plan · c) *at* time
15. Mixing *-est* and *the most* in one text is ____. → a) natural · b) wrong · c) only B1

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) short *-est*** · 12. **a) *the most* + long adj** · 13. **a) good** · 14. **a) superlative experience** · 15. **a) natural**

</details>

## Lección 4 — Listening: The biggest park

**Objetivo:** escuchar una descripción con superlativos.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-6/listening-superlatives.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: The biggest park"></audio>

> Hi! Today I want to tell you about my favourite place in the city. It is the biggest park in town. It has the tallest trees I have ever seen. In the centre there is a lake with the most beautiful swans. The best time to visit is early in the morning when it is the quietest. My sister says it is the most peaceful place in the world. I agree!

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. What is the favourite place? → a) The biggest park · b) A restaurant · c) A church
2. What are the tallest? → a) Trees · b) Buildings · c) Swans
3. What is on the lake? → a) The most beautiful swans · b) Boats only · c) Nothing
4. When is the best time to visit? → a) Early morning · b) Midnight · c) August only
5. The sister says it is ____. → a) the most peaceful place · b) the worst place · c) the hottest month

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) The biggest park** · 2. **a) Trees** · 3. **a) The most beautiful swans** · 4. **a) Early morning** · 5. **a) the most peaceful place**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. In the morning the park is ____. → a) the quietest · b) the hottest · c) the oldest
7. *I agree* means ____. → a) I think the same · b) I disagree · c) I leave
8. *In town / in the world* use ____. → a) *in* · b) *of* · c) *on*
9. Superlatives in the audio include ____. → a) biggest, tallest, most beautiful, best, quietest, most peaceful · b) only *went* · c) only *did*
10. The listening practices ____. → a) superlatives · b) *at/on/in* only · c) *-ly* adverbs

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) the quietest** · 7. **a) I think the same** · 8. **a) *in*** · 9. **a) biggest, tallest, most beautiful, best, quietest, most peaceful** · 10. **a) superlatives**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Biggest park in town* = ____ + place. → a) *in* · b) *of* · c) *at*
12. *Quietest* is superlative of ____. → a) quiet · b) quite · c) quick
13. *Most beautiful* needs ____. → a) *the* · b) *a* · c) nothing
14. *Best time* uses irregular ____. → a) best · b) goodest · c) better than only
15. *Ever seen* with *tallest trees* emphasises ____. → a) extreme experience · b) past Wh · c) *on Monday*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) *in*** · 12. **a) quiet** · 13. **a) *the*** · 14. **a) best** · 15. **a) extreme experience**

</details>

---

## Lección 5 — Writing: The best place

**Objetivo:** escribir descripciones con superlativos.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. This is ____ biggest park in town. → *the / a / more*
2. It is the ____ month of the year. → *hottest / hotter / hot*
3. She is the ____ beautiful singer. → *most / more / -est*
4. This is the ____ restaurant in town. → *best / better / good*
5. It is the most peaceful place ____ the world. → *in / of / on*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **the** · 2. **hottest** · 3. **most** · 4. **best** · 5. **in**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. He / is / the / tallest / boy / in / the school.
7. This / is / the / most / interesting / book.
8. July / is / the / hottest / month / of / the year.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. He is the tallest boy in the school.
7. This is the most interesting book.
8. July is the hottest month of the year.

</details>

### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. El edificio más alto de tu ciudad.
10. El mes más frío / más caluroso.
11. El restaurante mejor de tu pueblo (*the best*).
12. El lugar más pacífico (*the most peaceful*).
13. Usa *in the world* y *of the year*.
14. Compara: una frase comparativa + una superlativa.
15. Párrafo (6–8 frases) sobre tu ciudad o parque favorito.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución (ejemplos)</summary>

9. It has the tallest building in town.
10. January is the coldest month. July is the hottest month of the year.
11. The best restaurant in town is La Luna.
12. It is the most peaceful place in the park.
13. It is the best place in the world. August is the hottest month of the year.
14. My city is bigger than Valencia. It has the biggest park in the region.
15. My favourite place is the biggest park in town. It has the tallest trees. The best time is early morning when it is the quietest. It is the most peaceful place in the world!

</details>

---

## Resumen rápido

| Caso | Forma |
| :--- | :--- |
| Corto | **the** + adj**-est** |
| Largo | **the most** + adj |
| good/bad | **the best** / **the worst** |
| Lugar / grupo | **in** + place · **of** + group |

---

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 60 del curso A2** (*Module 6 Review*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [Module 6 Review A2](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-60-module-6-review)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 60 — Module 6 Review](/curso-a2/unit-60)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Module 6 Review](/blog/curso-a2/unit-60/a2-unit60-module-6-review.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática](#leccion-1--gramatica)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario](#leccion-2--vocabulario)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: My A2 week](#leccion-3--reading)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: After the course](#leccion-4--listening)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing](#leccion-5--writing)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** Shall we/Let's; Can I/Could you; I think/I agree; feelings; should/recycle; log in; work as; There is/are; because/so/although

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. ___ we celebrate? → *Shall / Do / Am*

2. I ___ the course was useful. → *think / am think / thinking*

3. ___ you help me print this? → *Could / Can to / Do*

4. I felt ___ because I finished. → *excited / exciting / excite*

5. ___ it's late, I'm hungry. → *Although / Because / So*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Shall** · 2. **think** · 3. **Could** · 4. **excited** · 5. **Although**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. *Shall we* (U51) in review: ____. → a) yes · b) only U41 · c) skip

7. *Could you help* (U52) = ____. → a) request · b) only opinion · c) only There is

8. *In my opinion* (U53) = ____. → a) opinión · b) offer · c) recycle only

9. *I felt excited* (U54) = ____. → a) feelings · b) shopping · c) weather only

10. Module 6 review covers ____. → a) U51–U59 · b) U41–U49 · c) U1–U10 only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) yes** · 7. **a) request** · 8. **a) opinión** · 9. **a) feelings** · 10. **a) U51–U59**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *Let's to meet in the square.*

12. *I am agree.*

13. *Could you to help me?*

14. *There are a café.*

15. *I felt exciting because I finished.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. Let's meet in the square.
12. I agree.
13. Could you help me?
14. There is a café.
15. I felt excited because I finished.

</details>



---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** repaso integrado Módulo 6: suggestions, offers, opinions, feelings, environment, tech, work, places, linking

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja / elige

1. *celebrate* ≈ ____ → *celebrar · reciclar · estudiar*

2. *certificate* ≈ ____ → *certificado · contraseña · plaza*

3. *location* ≈ ____ → *ubicación · emoción · conector*

4. *useful* ≈ ____ → *útil · aburrido · caro*

5. *assistant* ≈ ____ → *asistente · turista · recepcionista only*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **celebrar** · 2. **certificado** · 3. **ubicación** · 4. **útil** · 5. **asistente**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. Meet in the main ___. → *square / squared / squaring*

7. Café located ___ the library. → *opposite / opposite to / oppositing*

8. Work ___ a student assistant. → *as / in / at*

9. Have to ___ in and send emails. → *log / logs / logging*

10. Try to ___ at home. → *recycle / recycles / recycling*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **square** · 7. **opposite** · 8. **as** · 9. **log** · 10. **recycle**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. Review mixes Module ____. → a) 6 · b) 5 only · c) 1 only

12. *That would be great* (U52) = ____. → a) aceptar · b) I don't think so · c) There are

13. *Send you the location* (U56) = ____. → a) tech · b) only feelings · c) only weather

14. Integrated text uses ____. → a) M6 structures · b) only did · c) only phrasals

15. After U60 continue with ____. → a) ingles-a2 / curso-a2 · b) U51 again · c) skip A2

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) 6** · 12. **a) aceptar** · 13. **a) tech** · 14. **a) M6 structures** · 15. **a) ingles-a2 / curso-a2**

</details>

## Lección 3 — Reading: My A2 week

**Objetivo:** comprender un texto con el foco de la unidad.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-60/reading-review.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: My A2 week"></audio>

> This week I felt excited because I finished Module 6. Shall we celebrate? Let's meet in the main square — there is a nice café located opposite the library. In my opinion, the course was useful, although some units were hard. I work as a student assistant, so I often have to log in and send emails. I also try to recycle at home. Could you help me print my certificate? That would be great!

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Felt ___ because finished Module 6. → a) excited · b) refund · c) foggy

2. Shall we ___? → a) celebrate · b) recycle only · c) checkout

3. Meet in main ___. → a) square · b) pharmacy · c) platform

4. There is a café ___ the library. → a) opposite · b) because · c) although

5. Course was ___ (opinion). → a) useful · b) sunny · c) cheaper

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) excited** · 2. **a) celebrate** · 3. **a) square** · 4. **a) opposite** · 5. **a) useful**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Work ___ student assistant. → a) as · b) in job wrong · c) at university

7. Have to log in and ___ emails. → a) send · b) recycle · c) celebrate

8. Try to ___ at home. → a) recycle · b) pollute · c) waste more

9. *Although some units were hard* = ____. → a) although · b) so · c) and only

10. Matches Module 6 review: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only U31

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) as** · 7. **a) send** · 8. **a) recycle** · 9. **a) although** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Could you help me print my certificate?* = ____. → a) request U52 · b) only opinion · c) only There is

12. *In my opinion, the course was useful* = ____. → a) U53 · b) U41 travel · c) only health

13. *There is a nice café* = ____. → a) U58 · b) U31 phrasal · c) only will

14. Review text mixes ____. → a) M6 topics · b) only Past · c) only comparatives

15. Review writing uses ____. → a) integrated M6 structures · b) only articles · c) only one unit

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) request U52** · 12. **a) U53** · 13. **a) U58** · 14. **a) M6 topics** · 15. **a) integrated M6 structures**

</details>



---

## Lección 4 — Listening: After the course

**Objetivo:** escuchar el foco gramatical en contexto.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-60/listening-review.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: After the course"></audio>

> Lara: How do you feel now?
> Ben: Proud — and a bit tired.
> Lara: I agree. Shall we go for a coffee?
> Ben: Yes. Would you like me to book a table?
> Lara: Please. Although it's late, I'm hungry, so let's eat too.
> Ben: Perfect. I'll send you the location.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Ben feels ___ and tired. → a) proud · b) disappointed always · c) bored thing

2. Lara ___. → a) agrees · b) I don't think so · c) Can I help only

3. Shall we go for ___. → a) coffee · b) recycling · c) exam

4. Ben offers to ___ a table. → a) book · b) download · c) pollute

5. ___ it's late, hungry — eat too. → a) Although · b) And only · c) Because result wrong

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) proud** · 2. **a) agrees** · 3. **a) coffee** · 4. **a) book** · 5. **a) Although**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Ben will ___ the location. → a) send · b) recycle · c) checkout

7. *Would you like me to book* = ____. → a) offer U52 · b) opinion U53 · c) There is U58

8. *How do you feel* = ____. → a) U54 · b) U41 · c) U31

9. Dialogue integrates ____. → a) M6 structures · b) only Module 5 · c) only A1

10. Unit 60 practice: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only U31

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) send** · 7. **a) offer U52** · 8. **a) U54** · 9. **a) M6 structures** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Shall we go for a coffee* → a) U51 · b) U55 recycle · c) U57 only

12. *Although it's late, I'm hungry, so let's eat* → a) linking U59 · b) only and · c) only because wrong pair

13. *I'll send you the location* → a) U56 · b) U54 · c) U41

14. Shadow and note ____. → a) M6 mixed structures · b) only some · c) only Who

15. After U60 go to ____. → a) ingles-a2 or /curso-a2 · b) U51 only · c) skip course

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) U51** · 12. **a) linking U59** · 13. **a) U56** · 14. **a) M6 mixed structures** · 15. **a) ingles-a2 or /curso-a2**

</details>



---

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. ___ we celebrate? → *Shall / Do / Am*

2. I ___ with you. → *agree / am agree / agreeing*

3. ___ you help me? → *Could / Can to / Do*

4. There ___ a café in the square. → *is / are / has*

5. I felt ___ because I finished. → *excited / exciting / excite*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Shall** · 2. **agree** · 3. **Could** · 4. **is** · 5. **excited**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. celebrate / Shall / we / ?

7. opinion / In / my / , / it / was / useful / .

8. recycle / I / at / home / try / to / .

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. Shall we celebrate?
7. In my opinion, it was useful.
8. I try to recycle at home.

</details>


### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Una frase de sugerencias (U51).

10. Una offer o request (U52).

11. Una opinión (U53).

12. Una emoción (U54).

13. Un consejo ecológico (U55).

14. Corrige: *I am agree.*

15. Escribe un mini-repaso del Módulo 6 (8–10 líneas) mezclando temas U51–U59.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

9. Shall we celebrate? / Let's meet in the square.
10. Could you help me print my certificate?
11. In my opinion, the course was useful.
12. I felt excited because I finished Module 6.
13. I try to recycle at home.
14. I agree.
15. This week I felt excited because I finished Module 6. Shall we celebrate? Let's meet in the main square — there is a nice café located opposite the library. In my opinion, the course was useful, although some units were hard. I work as a student assistant, so I often have to log in and send emails. I also try to recycle at home. Could you help me print my certificate? That would be great!

</details>



---

## Resumen rápido

| | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| U51 | Shall we / Let's | Shall we celebrate? |
| U52 | Can I / Could you | Could you help me? |
| U53 | I think / I agree | In my opinion… |
| U54–55 | feel / should recycle | I felt excited. |
| U56–59 | log in / work as / There is / because | There is a café… |

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 7 del curso A2** (*Adverbs of Manner*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [Adverbios de modo A2](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-7-adverbios-modo-ly)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 7 — Adverbios de modo](/curso-a2/unit-7)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Adverbs of manner](/blog/curso-a2/unit-7/a2-unit7-adverbs-manner.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática: -ly / well / badly](#leccion-1--gramatica--ly--well--badly)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario: cómo haces las cosas](#leccion-2--vocabulario-como-haces-las-cosas)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: Maria](#leccion-3--reading-maria)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: Dance class](#leccion-4--listening-dance-class)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing: How I do things](#leccion-5--writing-how-i-do-things)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática: -ly / well / badly

**Objetivo:** formar y colocar adverbios de modo.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. She runs ____. → *quickly / quick / quicker*
2. He speaks ____ because he is tired. → *slowly / slow / slowest*
3. They work ____. → *carefully / careful / care*
4. She sings ____. → *well / good / goods*
5. He played ____ in the match. → *badly / bad / worse*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **quickly** · 2. **slowly** · 3. **carefully** · 4. **well** · 5. **badly**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. Most manner adverbs = ____. → a) adj + *-ly* · b) *-est* · c) *the most*
7. *good* → adverb ____. → a) well · b) goodly · c) goods
8. *bad* → adverb ____. → a) badly · b) bad · c) worse as only form
9. *He runs fast* is ____. → a) correct · b) needs *fastly* · c) wrong
10. *He works hard* is ____. → a) correct · b) needs *hardly* (same meaning) · c) wrong

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) adj + *-ly*** · 7. **a) well** · 8. **a) badly** · 9. **a) correct** · 10. **a) correct**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *She sings good.*
12. *He runs fastly.*
13. *Please speak quiet in the library.*
14. *She learned quick.*
15. *He hardly works every day.* (querías *con esfuerzo*)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. She sings **well**.
12. He runs **fast**.
13. Please speak **quietly** in the library.
14. She learned **quickly**.
15. He works **hard** every day. (*hardly* = casi no)

</details>

---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario: cómo haces las cosas

**Objetivo:** pares adjetivo → adverbio.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja

1. quick →
2. careful →
3. beautiful →
4. fluent →
5. loud →

a) carefully · b) beautifully · c) quickly · d) loudly · e) fluently

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **c** · 2 → **a** · 3 → **b** · 4 → **e** · 5 → **d**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. slow → ____
7. patient → ____
8. good → ____
9. bad → ____
10. quiet → ____

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **slowly** · 7. **patiently** · 8. **well** · 9. **badly** · 10. **quietly**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. Adverbs usually go ____. → a) after the verb / object · b) always before *the* · c) only at the start
12. *Fluently* describes ____. → a) speaking a language smoothly · b) height · c) price
13. *Clapped loudly* means ____. → a) clapped with a lot of noise · b) quietly · c) slowly only
14. *Patiently* means ____. → a) without getting angry / waiting calmly · b) fast · c) badly
15. *Practises every day* helps you learn ____. → a) quickly · b) never · c) worst

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) after the verb / object** · 12. **a) speaking a language smoothly** · 13. **a) clapped with a lot of noise** · 14. **a) without getting angry / waiting calmly** · 15. **a) quickly**

</details>

---

## Lección 3 — Reading: Maria

**Objetivo:** leer un texto rico en adverbios de modo.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-7/reading-adverbs.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Maria"></audio>

> My friend Maria speaks English very fluently. She learned quickly because she practises every day. She reads books slowly to understand everything well. Last week she sang beautifully at the concert. The audience clapped loudly. Maria also writes carefully and she never makes mistakes. She drives very carefully too. I think she does everything well!

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. How does Maria speak English? → a) Fluently · b) Badly · c) Never
2. Why did she learn quickly? → a) She practises every day · b) She never studies · c) She is lazy
3. How does she read? → a) Slowly · b) Loudly · c) Badly
4. How did she sing? → a) Beautifully · b) Badly · c) Quietly only
5. How does she drive? → a) Carefully · b) Fast only · c) Badly

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Fluently** · 2. **a) She practises every day** · 3. **a) Slowly** · 4. **a) Beautifully** · 5. **a) Carefully**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. The audience ____. → a) clapped loudly · b) left early · c) sang badly
7. She understands everything ____. → a) well · b) bad · c) fastly
8. Adverbs in the text include ____. → a) fluently, quickly, slowly, well, beautifully, loudly, carefully · b) only *the best* · c) only *did*
9. *Writes carefully* means ____. → a) with attention · b) without thinking · c) never
10. The main topic is ____. → a) how Maria does things · b) superlatives of places · c) *at/on/in*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) clapped loudly** · 7. **a) well** · 8. **a) fluently, quickly, slowly, well, beautifully, loudly, carefully** · 9. **a) with attention** · 10. **a) how Maria does things**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Fluently* = ____ + *-ly*. → a) fluent · b) fluency · c) fluencer
12. *Well* is the adverb of ____. → a) good · b) bad · c) fast
13. *Beautifully* comes from ____. → a) beautiful · b) beauty only · c) best
14. *Very carefully* intensifies ____. → a) the adverb · b) a noun only · c) *the*
15. Position: *speaks English fluently* puts the adverb ____. → a) after the object · b) before *speaks* only · c) never

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) fluent** · 12. **a) good** · 13. **a) beautiful** · 14. **a) the adverb** · 15. **a) after the object**

</details>

---

## Lección 4 — Listening: Dance class

**Objetivo:** escuchar un relato con adverbios de modo.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-7/listening-adverbs.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Dance class"></audio>

> Hi! Yesterday I went to a dance class. The teacher moved very quickly and we had to follow him. At first I danced badly because I couldn't remember the steps. But the teacher explained everything slowly and patiently. Then I practised carefully and by the end I danced well! My friend sang beautifully at the karaoke after. We had a great time!

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. How did the teacher move? → a) Very quickly · b) Slowly only · c) Badly
2. How did the speaker dance at first? → a) Badly · b) Well · c) Fluently
3. How did the teacher explain? → a) Slowly and patiently · b) Loudly only · c) Never
4. How did they dance by the end? → a) Well · b) Badly · c) Quietly only
5. How did the friend sing? → a) Beautifully · b) Badly · c) Fast

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Very quickly** · 2. **a) Badly** · 3. **a) Slowly and patiently** · 4. **a) Well** · 5. **a) Beautifully**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. They practised ____. → a) carefully · b) never · c) worst
7. After class they went to ____. → a) karaoke · b) the office · c) the beach only
8. Change: badly → ____ by the end. → a) well · b) worse · c) good (adj as adverb)
9. *Couldn't remember* explains dancing ____. → a) badly · b) fluently · c) carefully first
10. The listening practices ____. → a) adverbs of manner · b) only superlatives · c) *on Monday*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) carefully** · 7. **a) karaoke** · 8. **a) well** · 9. **a) badly** · 10. **a) adverbs of manner**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Badly / well* are ____. → a) irregular-style manner adverbs · b) *-est* · c) *the most*
12. *Patiently* = ____ + *-ly*. → a) patient · b) patience · c) path
13. *Quickly* describes ____. → a) speed of moving · b) height · c) age
14. *Danced well* uses ____ after the verb. → a) well · b) good · c) goods
15. Story arc: badly → carefully → ____. → a) well · b) worst · c) the tallest

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) irregular-style manner adverbs** · 12. **a) patient** · 13. **a) speed of moving** · 14. **a) well** · 15. **a) well**

</details>

---

## Lección 5 — Writing: How I do things

**Objetivo:** escribir con adverbios de modo.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I speak English ____. → *slowly / slow / slower*
2. I work ____ every day. → *hard / hardly / hardiest*
3. Please drive ____. → *carefully / careful / care*
4. She sings ____. → *well / good / goods*
5. He danced ____ at first. → *badly / bad / worse*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **slowly** · 2. **hard** · 3. **carefully** · 4. **well** · 5. **badly**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. She / runs / quickly.
7. He / works / hard / every day.
8. They / speak / English / fluently.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. She runs quickly.
7. He works hard every day.
8. They speak English fluently.

</details>

### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Corre rápido (*fast* / *quickly*).
10. Habla inglés con fluidez.
11. Canta bien / mal.
12. Explica despacio y con paciencia.
13. Conduce con cuidado.
14. Trabaja duro (no *hardly*).
15. Párrafo (6–8 frases) sobre cómo estudias o practicas algo.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución (ejemplos)</summary>

9. She runs fast. / She runs quickly.
10. She speaks English fluently.
11. She sings well. / He played badly.
12. The teacher explained slowly and patiently.
13. She drives carefully.
14. He works hard every day.
15. I study carefully every day. I read slowly. I practise quickly. I want to speak fluently. I work hard. I do everything well!

</details>

---

## Resumen rápido

| Adjetivo | Adverbio |
| :--- | :--- |
| quick | **quickly** |
| careful | **carefully** |
| good | **well** |
| bad | **badly** |
| fast / hard | **fast** / **hard** |

---
