content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 8 del curso A2** (*Prepositions of Time*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [Preposiciones de tiempo A2](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-8-preposiciones-tiempo-at-on-in)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 8 — Preposiciones de tiempo](/curso-a2/unit-8)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![at / on / in](/blog/curso-a2/unit-8/a2-unit8-prepositions-time.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática: at / on / in](#leccion-1--gramatica-at--on--in)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario: horarios y calendarios](#leccion-2--vocabulario-horarios-y-calendarios)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: Tom's week](#leccion-3--reading-toms-week)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: My typical day](#leccion-4--listening-my-typical-day)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing: My schedule](#leccion-5--writing-my-schedule)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática: at / on / in

**Objetivo:** elegir la preposición correcta de tiempo.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I get up ____ 7 o'clock. → *at / on / in*
2. I have a meeting ____ Monday. → *on / at / in*
3. We go on holiday ____ August. → *in / on / at*
4. I sleep ____ night. → *at / in / on*
5. We meet ____ the morning. → *in / at / on*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **at** · 2. **on** · 3. **in** · 4. **at** · 5. **in**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. Hours use ____. → a) *at* · b) *on* · c) *in*
7. Days/dates use ____. → a) *on* · b) *at* · c) *in*
8. Months/years/seasons use ____. → a) *in* · b) *at* · c) *on*
9. *At the weekend* is ____. → a) common in BrE · b) wrong · c) only AmE *in*
10. *In the morning* is ____. → a) correct · b) *at the morning* · c) *on the morning*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) *at*** · 7. **a) *on*** · 8. **a) *in*** · 9. **a) common in BrE** · 10. **a) correct**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *I wake up on 6 o'clock.*
12. *I work in Monday.*
13. *I was born at 1990.*
14. *We meet at the morning.*
15. *My birthday is in the 15th of March.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. I wake up **at** 6 o'clock.
12. I work **on** Monday.
13. I was born **in** 1990.
14. We meet **in** the morning.
15. My birthday is **on** the 15th of March.

</details>

---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario: horarios y calendarios

**Objetivo:** combinar expresiones de tiempo con *at/on/in*.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja

1. at
2. on
3. in
4. at noon
5. in summer

a) meses/estaciones/años · b) mediodía · c) horas · d) días/fechas · e) verano

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **c** · 2 → **d** · 3 → **a** · 4 → **b** · 5 → **e**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. ____ midnight → *at / on / in*
7. ____ weekdays → *on / at / in*
8. ____ December → *in / on / at*
9. ____ Saturday morning → *on / at / in*
10. ____ the evening → *in / at / on*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **at** · 7. **on** · 8. **in** · 9. **on** · 10. **in**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. *Noon* = ____. → a) 12:00 · b) midnight · c) morning only
12. *Weekdays* = ____. → a) Monday–Friday · b) only Sunday · c) only August
13. *Until 10 o'clock* means ____. → a) up to that time · b) after forever · c) never
14. *Finish early at 3 pm* uses ____. → a) *at* + clock time · b) *on* + hour · c) *in* + hour
15. Combine: *on Friday at 3 pm* is ____. → a) correct · b) wrong · c) needs *in Friday*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) 12:00** · 12. **a) Monday–Friday** · 13. **a) up to that time** · 14. **a) *at* + clock time** · 15. **a) correct**

</details>

---

## Lección 3 — Reading: Tom's week

**Objetivo:** leer un horario con *at/on/in*.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-8/reading-time.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Tom's week"></audio>

> My name is Tom and I have a busy week. On Monday and Wednesday I go to work at 8 o'clock in the morning. On Tuesday I have a meeting at noon. On Friday I finish early at 3 pm and I go to the gym. At the weekend I relax. On Saturday morning I sleep until 10 o'clock. In the afternoon I meet my friends. In summer I go on holiday in August.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. When does Tom go to work on Monday? → a) At 8 in the morning · b) At midnight · c) In August
2. When is the Tuesday meeting? → a) At noon · b) At night · c) On Sunday
3. When does he finish on Friday? → a) At 3 pm · b) At 8 am · c) At noon only
4. What does he do at the weekend? → a) Relax · b) Work all day · c) Nothing said
5. When is his holiday? → a) In August · b) On Monday · c) At 7 o'clock

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) At 8 in the morning** · 2. **a) At noon** · 3. **a) At 3 pm** · 4. **a) Relax** · 5. **a) In August**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. On Saturday morning he sleeps until ____. → a) 10 o'clock · b) noon · c) midnight
7. He meets friends ____. → a) in the afternoon · b) at night only · c) on Tuesday noon
8. *On Monday and Wednesday* uses ____. → a) *on* · b) *at* · c) *in*
9. *In summer* and *in August* use ____. → a) *in* · b) *on* · c) *at*
10. The main topic is ____. → a) a weekly schedule with time prepositions · b) adverbs · c) superlatives

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) 10 o'clock** · 7. **a) in the afternoon** · 8. **a) *on*** · 9. **a) *in*** · 10. **a) a weekly schedule with time prepositions**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *At 8 o'clock in the morning* combines ____. → a) *at* + *in* · b) *on* + *on* · c) only *of*
12. *At the weekend* is ____. → a) BrE common · b) wrong · c) only *in*
13. *On Saturday morning* uses ____. → a) *on* · b) *in* · c) *at*
14. *Go on holiday in August* uses ____. → a) *in* + month · b) *on* + month · c) *at* + month
15. Mixing several prepositions in one week story is ____. → a) natural · b) wrong · c) only B2

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) *at* + *in*** · 12. **a) BrE common** · 13. **a) *on*** · 14. **a) *in* + month** · 15. **a) natural**

</details>

---

## Lección 4 — Listening: My typical day

**Objetivo:** escuchar un día típico con *at/on/in*.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-8/listening-time.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: My typical day"></audio>

> Hi! I want to tell you about my typical day. I wake up at 6 o'clock in the morning. I have breakfast at 7 am. On weekdays I start work at 9 o'clock. I have lunch at noon. In the afternoon I have meetings. On Saturday I sleep until 10 o'clock and I meet my friends in the evening. In December I go on holiday for two weeks.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. When do they wake up? → a) At 6 in the morning · b) At noon · c) In December
2. When is breakfast? → a) At 7 am · b) At midnight · c) On Monday only
3. When do they start work on weekdays? → a) At 9 · b) At 6 · c) At 3 pm
4. When do they meet friends? → a) In the evening (Saturday) · b) At noon only · c) Never
5. When is the holiday? → a) In December · b) On weekdays · c) At 7 am

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) At 6 in the morning** · 2. **a) At 7 am** · 3. **a) At 9** · 4. **a) In the evening (Saturday)** · 5. **a) In December**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Lunch is ____. → a) at noon · b) on Friday only · c) in summer only
7. Meetings are ____. → a) in the afternoon · b) at night · c) on Sunday morning
8. *On weekdays / on Saturday* use ____. → a) *on* · b) *at* · c) *in*
9. *In the morning / afternoon / evening* and *in December* use ____. → a) *in* · b) *on* · c) *at*
10. The listening practices ____. → a) *at / on / in* · b) only *-ly* · c) only *-est*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) at noon** · 7. **a) in the afternoon** · 8. **a) *on*** · 9. **a) *in*** · 10. **a) *at / on / in***

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *At 6 o'clock* = ____. → a) clock time · b) month · c) day name
12. *On weekdays* = ____. → a) working days · b) only August · c) midnight
13. *In the evening* is ____. → a) correct · b) *at the evening* · c) *on the evening*
14. *In December* = ____. → a) month · b) day · c) hour
15. Typical pattern morning→noon→afternoon→evening uses ____. → a) mixed *at/on/in* · b) only *of* · c) only *did*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) clock time** · 12. **a) working days** · 13. **a) correct** · 14. **a) month** · 15. **a) mixed *at/on/in***

</details>

---

## Lección 5 — Writing: My schedule

**Objetivo:** escribir horarios con *at/on/in*.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I wake up ____ 7 o'clock. → *at / on / in*
2. I work ____ Monday. → *on / at / in*
3. I was born ____ 1995. → *in / on / at*
4. We meet ____ the evening. → *in / at / on*
5. The film starts ____ midnight. → *at / on / in*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **at** · 2. **on** · 3. **in** · 4. **in** · 5. **at**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. I / get up / at / 7 o'clock.
7. I / have / a meeting / on / Friday.
8. We / go / on holiday / in / August.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. I get up at 7 o'clock.
7. I have a meeting on Friday.
8. We go on holiday in August.

</details>

### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Hora de levantarte (*at*).
10. Día de trabajo o clase (*on*).
11. Parte del día (*in the…*).
12. Mes de vacaciones (*in*).
13. Fin de semana (*at the weekend* / *on Saturday*).
14. Combina día + hora: *on Friday at 3 pm*.
15. Párrafo (6–8 frases) de tu día o semana típica.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución (ejemplos)</summary>

9. I wake up at 7 o'clock.
10. I work on Monday.
11. I have meetings in the afternoon.
12. I go on holiday in August.
13. At the weekend I relax. / On Saturday I sleep until 10.
14. The meeting is on Friday at 3 pm.
15. I wake up at 6 o'clock in the morning. On weekdays I start work at 9. I have lunch at noon. In the evening I meet friends. At the weekend I relax. In December I go on holiday.

</details>

---

## Resumen rápido

| Prep. | Uso | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **at** | horas / momentos | at 7 · at noon · at night |
| **on** | días / fechas | on Monday · on 15 March |
| **in** | meses / años / partes del día | in August · in 1990 · in the morning |

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática: into / out of / through / across

**Objetivo:** movimiento hacia dentro, hacia fuera y cruzando.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. She went ____ the room. → *into / out of / across*
2. He ran ____ the building. → *out of / into / across*
3. We walked ____ the park. → *through / across / out of*
4. They ran ____ the bridge. → *across / into / out of*
5. I put the books ____ my bag. → *into / across / through*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **into** · 2. **out of** · 3. **through** · 4. **across** · 5. **into**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. *into* = ____. → a) movement to the inside · b) only time · c) only height
7. *out of* = ____. → a) movement to the outside · b) month · c) comparative
8. *through* = ____. → a) across the inside · b) only surface · c) *at night*
9. *across* = ____. → a) from one side to the other on a surface · b) only rooms · c) *the most*
10. *go into the room* is ____. → a) clear movement in · b) wrong · c) only *go in the room* allowed

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) movement to the inside** · 7. **a) movement to the outside** · 8. **a) across the inside** · 9. **a) from one side to the other on a surface** · 10. **a) clear movement in**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *She went in the room.* (prioriza *into*)
12. *He walked across the tunnel.* (interior)
13. *They ran through the street.* (superficie)
14. *I came out the museum.*
15. *We went into of the cafe.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. She went **into** the room.
12. He walked **through** the tunnel.
13. They ran **across** the street.
14. I came **out of** the museum.
15. We went **into** the cafe.

</details>

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario: entrar, salir y cruzar

**Objetivo:** combinar verbos + preposiciones típicas.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja

1. into
2. out of
3. through
4. across
5. courtyard

a) patio · b) entrar · c) salir · d) por el interior · e) de lado a lado

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **b** · 2 → **c** · 3 → **d** · 4 → **e** · 5 → **a**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. go ____ a bookshop → *into / across / through*
7. come ____ a park → *out of / into / across*
8. walk ____ several rooms → *through / across / out of*
9. run ____ a bridge → *across / into / out of*
10. cross ____ street (también *across the street*) → *the / into / of*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **into** · 7. **out of** · 8. **through** · 9. **across** · 10. **the**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. Typical with *park/forest/tunnel/rooms*: ____. → a) through · b) across only · c) at
12. Typical with *street/bridge/river/road*: ____. → a) across · b) through only · c) in August
13. *Main entrance* pairs with ____. → a) go into · b) the tallest · c) fluently
14. *Sculpture section* is reached by walking ____ a courtyard. → a) across · b) out of · c) at noon
15. *Cafe* after leaving often uses ____. → a) went into · b) the best of · c) *-est*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) through** · 12. **a) across** · 13. **a) go into** · 14. **a) across** · 15. **a) went into**

</details>

## Lección 3 — Reading: City adventure

**Objetivo:** leer un recorrido urbano.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-9/reading-movement.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: City adventure"></audio>

> Yesterday I had an adventure in the city. First I went into an old bookshop to buy a book. Then I walked through the park to get to the other side. I saw many people running across the bridge. When I came out of the park I crossed the street and went into a cafe. I had coffee and read my new book. It was a great day!

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Where did they go first? → a) Into a bookshop · b) Into a museum · c) Across a river only
2. How did they cross the park? → a) Walked through · b) Flew · c) Drove only
3. Where were people running? → a) Across the bridge · b) Into the bag · c) At noon only
4. What happened after the park? → a) Came out, crossed the street, went into a cafe · b) Went home only · c) Nothing
5. What did they do in the cafe? → a) Had coffee and read · b) Worked · c) Slept

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Into a bookshop** · 2. **a) Walked through** · 3. **a) Across the bridge** · 4. **a) Came out, crossed the street, went into a cafe** · 5. **a) Had coffee and read**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Movement verbs include ____. → a) went into, walked through, running across, came out of · b) only *am* · c) only *the most*
7. *To get to the other side* explains ____. → a) why they walked through · b) time only · c) height
8. They bought ____. → a) a book · b) a phone · c) tickets only
9. Sequence: First… Then… When… = ____. → a) order of the route · b) only grammar of *will* · c) superlatives
10. The main topic is ____. → a) a city route with movement prepositions · b) introductions · c) *at/on/in* only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) went into, walked through, running across, came out of** · 7. **a) why they walked through** · 8. **a) a book** · 9. **a) order of the route** · 10. **a) a city route with movement prepositions**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Went into* = past of ____. → a) go into · b) go out of · c) run across
12. *Came out of* = past of ____. → a) come out of · b) go into · c) walk through
13. *Through the park* = ____. → a) interior path · b) month · c) adverb *-ly*
14. *Across the bridge* = ____. → a) surface/side-to-side · b) inside a tunnel · c) *the best*
15. Mixing *into/through/across/out of* in one story is ____. → a) natural · b) wrong · c) only B2

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) go into** · 12. **a) come out of** · 13. **a) interior path** · 14. **a) surface/side-to-side** · 15. **a) natural**

</details>

## Lección 4 — Listening: The museum

**Objetivo:** escuchar un recorrido por un museo.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-9/listening-movement.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: The museum"></audio>

> Hi! Last weekend I went to the museum. I went into the main entrance and walked through several rooms. First I saw the paintings and then I walked across the courtyard to get to the sculpture section. When I came out of the museum I crossed the street and went into a cafe for coffee. I really enjoyed the day!

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Where did they go? → a) The museum · b) The beach · c) School
2. How did they enter? → a) Into the main entrance · b) Across a river · c) Out of a car only
3. How did they move inside? → a) Through several rooms · b) Only across a bridge · c) Never
4. How did they reach sculptures? → a) Across the courtyard · b) Into a bag · c) At 7 only
5. What did they do after? → a) Came out, crossed the street, cafe · b) Stayed forever · c) Worked

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) The museum** · 2. **a) Into the main entrance** · 3. **a) Through several rooms** · 4. **a) Across the courtyard** · 5. **a) Came out, crossed the street, cafe**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. First they saw ____. → a) paintings · b) only coffee · c) nothing
7. *Enjoyed the day* means ____. → a) had a good time · b) hated it · c) left early forever
8. *Crossed the street* is similar in idea to ____. → a) went across the street · b) went into the street bag · c) *the tallest*
9. Prepositions practised: ____. → a) into, through, across, out of · b) only *at* · c) only *-ly*
10. The listening practices ____. → a) movement prepositions · b) only Present Perfect · c) only *will*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) paintings** · 7. **a) had a good time** · 8. **a) went across the street** · 9. **a) into, through, across, out of** · 10. **a) movement prepositions**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. Enter museum → ____. → a) go into · b) go out of · c) run across only
12. Move inside rooms → ____. → a) walk through · b) walk across only · c) come out of only
13. Leave museum → ____. → a) come out of · b) go into · c) the most
14. Courtyard side-to-side → ____. → a) across · b) into · c) fluently
15. Cafe after leaving → ____. → a) went into a cafe · b) the hottest · c) *on Monday* only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) go into** · 12. **a) walk through** · 13. **a) come out of** · 14. **a) across** · 15. **a) went into a cafe**

</details>

## Lección 5 — Writing: My route

**Objetivo:** escribir un recorrido con las cuatro preposiciones.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I went ____ the museum. → *into / across / through*
2. I walked ____ several rooms. → *through / out of / across*
3. I walked ____ the courtyard. → *across / into / out of*
4. I came ____ the museum. → *out of / into / across*
5. I went ____ a cafe. → *into / through / across*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **into** · 2. **through** · 3. **across** · 4. **out of** · 5. **into**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. She / went / into / the room.
7. We / walked / through / the park.
8. They / ran / across / the bridge.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. She went into the room.
7. We walked through the park.
8. They ran across the bridge.

</details>

### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Entra en una tienda.
10. Camina por el interior de un parque.
11. Cruza un puente o una calle.
12. Sal de un edificio.
13. Entra en un café.
14. Mini ruta con First / Then / Finally.
15. Párrafo (6–8 frases) de un día en la ciudad.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución (ejemplos)</summary>

9. I went into a shop.
10. I walked through the park.
11. I ran across the bridge. / I crossed the street.
12. I came out of the building.
13. I went into a cafe.
14. First I went into the museum. Then I walked through the rooms. Finally I came out of the museum.
15. Yesterday I went into a bookshop. Then I walked through the park. People ran across the bridge. I came out of the park and went into a cafe. It was a great day!

</details>

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** Present Perfect, modales, used to, who/which, feelings

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. She ___ visited many countries. → *has / have / had*
2. I ___ to miss my family. → *used / use / using*
3. The woman ___ helped me is kind. → *who / which / where*
4. At first I felt ___. → *anxious / anxiety / anxiously*
5. You ___ wear a seatbelt. → *must / must to / musted*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **has** · 2. **used** · 3. **who** · 4. **anxious** · 5. **must**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. Foco U1 = ____. → a) Present Perfect, modales, used to, who/which, feelings · b) only A1 · c) skip
7. Forma clave U1 es ____. → a) correcta según teoría · b) always Past Simple · c) only will
8. Reading U1 usa ____. → a) foco de la unidad · b) only numbers · c) unrelated
9. Listening U1 practica ____. → a) el mismo foco · b) only spelling · c) only articles
10. Cuaderno U1 tiene ____. → a) 5×15 ejercicios · b) 3 lecciones · c) sin soluciones

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a)** · 7. **a) correcta según teoría** · 8. **a) foco de la unidad** · 9. **a) el mismo foco** · 10. **a) 5×15 ejercicios**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *She have visited Spain.*
12. *I use to miss my family.*
13. *The book who I bought is interesting.*
14. *I felt exciting about the job.*
15. *You must to wear a helmet.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. She **has** visited Spain.
12. I **used to** miss my family.
13. The book **which** I bought is interesting.
14. I felt **excited** about the job.
15. You **must** wear a helmet.

</details>

## Lección 3 — Reading: Maria in London

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** have/has been + -ing

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. She ___ been studying for five years. → *has / have / had*
2. I ___ been attending classes since September. → *have / has / had*
3. ___ long have you been studying? → *How / What / When*
4. They have been working ___ all day. → *for / since / ago*
5. He has been teaching here ___ ten years. → *for / since / yesterday*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **has** · 2. **have** · 3. **How** · 4. **for** (all day = duration context) · 5. **for**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. Foco U2 = ____. → a) have/has been + -ing · b) only A1 · c) skip
7. Forma clave U2 es ____. → a) correcta según teoría · b) always Past Simple · c) only will
8. Reading U2 usa ____. → a) foco de la unidad · b) only numbers · c) unrelated
9. Listening U2 practica ____. → a) el mismo foco · b) only spelling · c) only articles
10. Cuaderno U2 tiene ____. → a) 5×15 ejercicios · b) 3 lecciones · c) sin soluciones

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a)** · 7. **a) correcta según teoría** · 8. **a) foco de la unidad** · 9. **a) el mismo foco** · 10. **a) 5×15 ejercicios**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *She have been studying.*
12. *How long you been working?*
13. *I have been knowing her for years.*
14. *He has been study since Monday.*
15. *They has been waiting.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. She **has** been studying.
12. **How long have** you been working?
13. I **have known** her for years.
14. He has been **studying** since Monday.
15. They **have** been waiting.

</details>

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

Answers vary — compare with theory article and reading text.

### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

7. Order these ideas: plan → detail → result (your unit topic).
8. Put a question before its short answer (your creation).

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6–8. Personal answers; check word order and tense.

</details>

### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Una frase con el foco gramatical principal U2.
10. Una segunda frase con vocabulario de la unidad.
11. Una pregunta + respuesta corta.
12. Corrige un error típico (see theory «Errores frecuentes»).
13. Resume el reading en 2 frases.
14. Resume el listening en 2 frases.
15. Escribe un párrafo B1 (6–8 líneas) mezclando gramática y vocabulario U2.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

9–15. Model: use reading/listening texts as base; adapt with your own details. Check theory for error corrections.

</details>

3. I ___ going to visit some temples. → *am / will / have*
4. The plane ___ off at 8 o'clock. → *takes / is taking / will take*
5. I ___ meeting my colleagues at 6 AM. → *am / will / going to

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **am** · 2. **will** · 3. **am** · 4. **takes** · 5. **am**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

12. *She meeting her boss tomorrow.* (falta *is*)
13. *The flight is depart at 8.*
14. *I think it is going to rain* (solo opinión, sin evidencia)
15. *I am go to visit temples.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. I **will enjoy** the trip.
12. She **is meeting** her boss tomorrow.
13. The flight **departs** / **takes off** at 8.
14. I think it **will** rain.
15. I **am going to** visit temples.

</details>

title: Ejercicios Unidad 41 A1: At the Airport — must / should (con soluciones)

description: Practica todos los ejercicios de la Unidad 41 del curso A1: must y should en el aeropuerto, passport, check-in, boarding pass, gate, reading, listening y writing. Con soluciones comentadas.

faqs.question: ¿Qué ejercicios incluye la Unidad 41 del curso A1?
faqs.answer: Cinco lecciones con 15 actividades cada una: gramática (must/should), vocabulario de aeropuerto, reading, listening y writing.

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 41 del curso A1** (*At the Airport*) con **soluciones comentadas**. Corresponde a las lecciones del curso: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening y writing.

> **Guía teórica:** [At the Airport A1](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-41-aeropuerto-must-should)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 41 — At the Airport](/curso-a1/unit-41)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Must / should at the airport](/blog/curso-a1/unit-41/a1-unit41-must-should.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática: must / should](#leccion-1--gramatica-must--should)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario: aeropuerto](#leccion-2--vocabulario-aeropuerto)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: At the airport](#leccion-3--reading-at-the-airport)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: Check-in](#leccion-4--listening-check-in)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing: Airport tips](#leccion-5--writing-airport-tips)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática: must / should

**Objetivo:** *must* (obligación) y *should* (consejo) en el aeropuerto.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. You ____ show your passport at check-in. → *must / should / canning*  
2. You ____ go to the gate early. → *should / musts / going*  
3. You ____ have your ticket. → *must / shoulding / are*  
4. You ____ arrive early for your flight. → *should / musts / do*  
5. You ____ show your boarding pass. → *must / shoulds / am*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **must** — obligación.  
2. **should** — consejo.  
3. **must**  
4. **should**  
5. **must**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. *Must* shows ____. → a) obligation · b) only a wish · c) past tense  
7. *Should* shows ____. → a) advice or recommendation · b) only past · c) a sport  
8. After *must* / *should* we use ____. → a) base verb · b) -ing only · c) past participle only  
9. You ____ your passport. → a) must show · b) must showing · c) musts show  
10. Check-in is ____. → a) where you get your boarding pass · b) the plane seat · c) the hotel

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) obligation**  
7. **a) advice or recommendation**  
8. **a) base verb**  
9. **a) must show**  
10. **a) where you get your boarding pass**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–13 — Ordena

11. You / must / show / your / passport / at check-in.  
12. Go / to / gate / number / ten.  
13. You / should / arrive / early / for / your / flight.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. You must show your passport at check-in.  
12. Go to gate number ten.  
13. You should arrive early for your flight.

</details>

### Ejercicios 14–15 — Verdadero o falso

14. *Must* + base verb: *You must show your passport.* → True / False  
15. *Should* gives advice: *You should go early.* → True / False

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

14. **True**  
15. **True**

</details>

---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario: aeropuerto

**Objetivo:** *passport, ticket, check-in, boarding pass, gate, boarding, luggage, suitcase, flight*.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige el significado

1. *Passport* = ____. → a) document for travel · b) a gate number · c) a suitcase only  
2. *Ticket* = ____. → a) document for the flight · b) only luggage · c) a gate  
3. *Check-in* = ____. → a) where you get your boarding pass · b) the plane seat · c) customs only  
4. *Gate* = ____. → a) where you board the plane · b) the hotel desk · c) a restaurant  
5. *Boarding* = ____. → a) getting on the plane · b) buying food · c) sleeping

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) document for travel**  
2. **a) document for the flight**  
3. **a) where you get your boarding pass**  
4. **a) where you board the plane**  
5. **a) getting on the plane**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–7 — Empareja

6. Empareja: passport / boarding pass / gate / luggage / flight → travel document · get at check-in · board the plane · bags · plane trip  
7. Empareja: ticket / check-in / boarding / suitcase / passport → for the flight · desk · get on the plane · luggage · show at the airport

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **passport → travel document** · **boarding pass → get at check-in** · **gate → board the plane** · **luggage → bags** · **flight → plane trip**  
7. **ticket → for the flight** · **check-in → desk** · **boarding → get on the plane** · **suitcase → luggage** · **passport → show at the airport**

</details>

### Ejercicios 8–10 — Completa

8. You must show your ____. → *passport / passportsing / gate*  
9. Gate ____ ten. → *number / numbers / numbering*  
10. Have a good ____! → *flight / flightsing / gate*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

8. **passport**  
9. **number**  
10. **flight**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–13 — Definiciones

11. *Luggage* means ____. → a) bags you take when you travel · b) only a ticket · c) a gate  
12. A *boarding pass* is ____. → a) a document to get on the plane · b) a hotel key · c) a menu  
13. Where do you get your boarding pass? → a) At check-in. · b) On the plane seat only · c) At home never

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) bags you take when you travel**  
12. **a) a document to get on the plane**  
13. **a) At check-in.**

</details>

### Ejercicios 14–15 — Verdadero o falso

14. You show your passport and ticket at check-in. → True / False  
15. The gate is where you board the plane. → True / False

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

14. **True**  
15. **True**

</details>

---

## Lección 3 — Reading: At the airport

**Objetivo:** leer un texto sobre el aeropuerto con *must* y *should*.

### Texto

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-41/reading-airport.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: At the airport"></audio>

> I am at the airport today. My flight is at ten o'clock. I must show my passport and my ticket at check-in. After that, I get my boarding pass. I should go to the gate early. Boarding starts at half past nine. I have one suitcase. My luggage is not heavy.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige la respuesta correcta

1. Where is the writer? → a) At the airport. · b) At home. · c) At school.  
2. What time is the flight? → a) At ten o'clock. · b) At nine o'clock. · c) At midnight.  
3. What must the writer show? → a) Passport and ticket. · b) Only a book. · c) Only food.  
4. Where does the writer show them? → a) At check-in. · b) At the hotel. · c) At school.  
5. When does boarding start? → a) At half past nine. · b) At ten. · c) At noon.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) At the airport.**  
2. **a) At ten o'clock.**  
3. **a) Passport and ticket.**  
4. **a) At check-in.**  
5. **a) At half past nine.**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Comprensión

6. How many suitcases does the writer have? → a) One. · b) Five. · c) Zero.  
7. Is the luggage heavy? → a) No. · b) Yes. · c) The text doesn't say.  
8. The writer should go to the gate ____. → a) Early. · b) Late. · c) Never.  
9. Where do you get the boarding pass? → a) Check-in. · b) The plane seat. · c) The park.  
10. A boarding pass is ____. → a) A document to board the plane. · b) A suitcase. · c) A gate number only.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) One.**  
7. **a) No.**  
8. **a) Early.**  
9. **a) Check-in.**  
10. **a) A document to board the plane.**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Detalles

11. The text is about ____. → a) The airport and a flight. · b) Only food. · c) Only sports.  
12. *Must show* means ____. → a) An obligation to show something. · b) A wish only. · c) Past tense.  
13. The *gate* is ____. → a) The place where you board. · b) The hotel room. · c) The ticket price.  
14. *Luggage* means ____. → a) Bags and suitcases. · b) Only tickets. · c) Only gates.  
15. The main topic is ____. → a) What to do at the airport. · b) Cooking. · c) School subjects.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) The airport and a flight.**  
12. **a) An obligation to show something.**  
13. **a) The place where you board.**  
14. **a) Bags and suitcases.**  
15. **a) What to do at the airport.**

</details>

---

## Lección 4 — Listening: Check-in

**Objetivo:** escuchar indicaciones en el aeropuerto.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-41/listening-check-in.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Check-in"></audio>

> **A:** Where is the check-in?  
> **B:** Over there. You must show your passport and ticket.  
> **A:** Thank you. What gate is the flight to London?  
> **B:** Gate twenty-two. You should go now; boarding starts in ten minutes.  
> **A:** I have my boarding pass.  
> **B:** Perfect. Have a good flight!

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. A's first question is ____. → a) “Where is the check-in?” · b) “Where is the hotel?” · c) “What time is lunch?”  
2. What must A show? → a) Passport and ticket. · b) Only food. · c) Only a book.  
3. What gate is the London flight? → a) Gate twenty-two. · b) Gate two. · c) Gate ten.  
4. When does boarding start? → a) In ten minutes. · b) In one hour. · c) Tomorrow.  
5. Does A have a boarding pass? → a) Yes. · b) No. · c) The audio doesn't say.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) “Where is the check-in?”**  
2. **a) Passport and ticket.**  
3. **a) Gate twenty-two.**  
4. **a) In ten minutes.**  
5. **a) Yes.**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. B says A should ____. → a) Go now. · b) Wait three hours. · c) Go home.  
7. Where is check-in? → a) Over there. · b) Outside the city. · c) At school.  
8. “Have a good flight!” is ____. → a) A wish for a good trip. · b) A refusal. · c) A ticket.  
9. The dialogue is ____. → a) At the airport. · b) At home. · c) In a park.  
10. The flight is ____. → a) A plane to London. · b) A bus to London. · c) A train only.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Go now.**  
7. **a) Over there.**  
8. **a) A wish for a good trip.**  
9. **a) At the airport.**  
10. **a) A plane to London.**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Must* here shows ____. → a) An obligation. · b) Only a hobby. · c) Past simple.  
12. *Boarding* means ____. → a) Getting on the plane. · b) Buying lunch. · c) Sleeping.  
13. After the gate information, A says ____. → a) “Thank you.” · b) “Goodbye forever.” · c) “I refuse.”  
14. The *gate* is ____. → a) The place where you board. · b) The suitcase. · c) The passport.  
15. The dialogue gives ____. → a) Airport instructions. · b) Cooking recipes. · c) Sports scores.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) An obligation.**  
12. **a) Getting on the plane.**  
13. **a) “Thank you.”**  
14. **a) The place where you board.**  
15. **a) Airport instructions.**

</details>

---

## Lección 5 — Writing: Airport tips

**Objetivo:** escribir instrucciones y tips con *must* / *should*.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. You ____ show your passport. → *must / shoulds / am*  
2. You ____ go to the gate early. → *should / musts / are*  
3. You ____ your ticket at check-in. → *must show / must showing / musts*  
4. Go ____ the gate now. → *to / for / at*  
5. You ____ have your boarding pass. → *must / shoulding / do*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **must**  
2. **should**  
3. **must show**  
4. **to**  
5. **must**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. You / must / show / your / passport / at check-in.  
7. My / flight / is / at / ten o'clock.  
8. You / should / go / to / the / gate / early.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. You must show your passport at check-in.  
7. My flight is at ten o'clock.  
8. You should go to the gate early.

</details>

### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Escribe una obligación con *must* en el aeropuerto.  
10. Escribe un consejo con *should*.  
11. Dos frases: gate + hora del vuelo.  
12. Pregunta y respuesta: *Where is check-in?*  
13. Párrafo corto (3–4 frases) sobre check-in y gate.  
14. Dos tips: *must* + *should*.  
15. Lista: qué *must* / *should* llevar o hacer.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución (ejemplos)</summary>

9. You must show your passport at check-in.  
10. You should arrive early for your flight.  
11. My gate is number fifteen. My flight is at nine o'clock.  
12. Where is check-in? Over there.  
13. I must show my passport and ticket at check-in. Then I get my boarding pass. I should go to the gate early.  
14. You must show your passport. You should go to the gate now.  
15. I must have my passport and ticket. I should arrive early.

</details>

---

## Resumen rápido

| Forma | Uso | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **must** | obligación | You **must** show your passport. |
| **should** | consejo | You **should** go to the gate early. |
| **check-in** | mostrador | Get your boarding pass at check-in. |
| **gate** | embarque | Gate twenty-two. |
| **boarding** | subir al avión | Boarding starts in ten minutes. |

---

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 42 del curso A1** (*Transport*) con **soluciones comentadas**. Corresponde a las lecciones del curso: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening y writing.

> **Guía teórica:** [Transport A1](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-42-transporte-by-take-the)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 42 — Transport](/curso-a1/unit-42)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![By + transport](/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/a1-unit42-by-transport.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática: by / take the](#leccion-1--gramatica-by--take-the)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario: transporte](#leccion-2--vocabulario-transporte)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: How we travel](#leccion-3--reading-how-we-travel)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: Commute](#leccion-4--listening-commute)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing: My transport](#leccion-5--writing-my-transport)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática: by / take the

**Objetivo:** *by + transporte* (sin artículo) y *take the + transporte*.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I go to work ____ bus. → *by / the / a*  
2. We travel ____ plane. → *by / the / an*  
3. I ____ the bus every day. → *take / takes / taking*  
4. She goes ____ car. → *by / the / a*  
5. He ____ the train to London. → *takes / take / taking*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **by** — *by bus* (sin *the*).  
2. **by**  
3. **take**  
4. **by**  
5. **takes**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. *Go by bus* means ____. → a) using the bus to travel · b) buying a bus · c) walking only  
7. *Take the bus* means ____. → a) using the bus as a passenger · b) driving a plane · c) never travel  
8. After *by* we use ____. → a) transport without an article (by car, by train) · b) the always · c) a always  
9. Correct: ____. → a) I go by train. · b) I go by the train. · c) I go train by.  
10. With *take* we usually ____. → a) use “the” before bus or train · b) never use the · c) use -ing only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) using the bus to travel**  
7. **a) using the bus as a passenger**  
8. **a) transport without an article (by car, by train)**  
9. **a) I go by train.**  
10. **a) use “the” before bus or train**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–13 — Ordena

11. I / go / to work / by / bus.  
12. She / takes / the / train / every Monday.  
13. We / travel / by / plane / to Spain.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. I go to work by bus.  
12. She takes the train every Monday.  
13. We travel by plane to Spain.

</details>

### Ejercicios 14–15 — Verdadero o falso

14. We say *by bus* (not *by the bus*). → True / False  
15. We say *take the train* (with *the*). → True / False

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

14. **True**  
15. **True**

</details>

---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario: transporte

**Objetivo:** *bus, train, plane, taxi, bicycle*.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige el significado

1. *Bus* = ____. → a) a large road vehicle that carries many people · b) a plane · c) a bike  
2. *Train* = ____. → a) a long vehicle that travels on rails · b) a taxi · c) a bicycle  
3. *Plane* = ____. → a) a vehicle that flies in the air · b) a bus · c) a train  
4. *Taxi* = ____. → a) a car you pay to take you somewhere · b) a free bike · c) a train  
5. *Bicycle* = ____. → a) a two-wheeled vehicle that you pedal · b) a plane · c) a bus

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) a large road vehicle that carries many people**  
2. **a) a long vehicle that travels on rails**  
3. **a) a vehicle that flies in the air**  
4. **a) a car you pay to take you somewhere**  
5. **a) a two-wheeled vehicle that you pedal**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–7 — Empareja

6. Empareja: bus / train / plane / taxi / bicycle → many passengers on the road · on rails · flies · you pay the driver · two wheels and pedals  
7. Empareja: by bus / by train / by plane / by taxi / by bicycle → take the bus · take the train · fly · pay for a car ride · cycle

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **bus → many passengers on the road** · **train → on rails** · **plane → flies** · **taxi → you pay the driver** · **bicycle → two wheels and pedals**  
7. **by bus → take the bus** · **by train → take the train** · **by plane → fly** · **by taxi → pay for a car ride** · **by bicycle → cycle**

</details>

### Ejercicios 8–10 — Completa

8. I go ____ bicycle. → *by / the / a*  
9. She takes ____ train. → *the / a / —*  
10. We travel by ____. → *plane / planesing / the*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

8. **by**  
9. **the**  
10. **plane**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–13 — Definiciones

11. Which vehicle flies? → a) Plane. · b) Bus. · c) Bicycle.  
12. Which has two wheels and pedals? → a) Bicycle. · b) Train. · c) Plane.  
13. Which do you pay a driver for? → a) A taxi. · b) A bicycle. · c) Walking.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) Plane.**  
12. **a) Bicycle.**  
13. **a) A taxi.**

</details>

### Ejercicios 14–15 — Verdadero o falso

14. *By car* and *by taxi* do not need *the*. → True / False  
15. *Take the bus* uses *the*. → True / False

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

14. **True**  
15. **True**

</details>

---

## Lección 3 — Reading: How we travel

**Objetivo:** leer cómo viaja una familia.

### Texto

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/reading-transport.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: How we travel"></audio>

> I go to work by bus every day. My sister takes the train to London. We sometimes travel by plane for holidays. Last week I went to the airport by taxi. My brother goes to school by bicycle. He likes it because it is fast and cheap.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige la respuesta correcta

1. How does the writer go to work? → a) By bus. · b) By plane. · c) By train.  
2. What does the sister take? → a) The train. · b) The bus. · c) The taxi.  
3. When do they travel by plane? → a) For holidays. · b) Every day. · c) Never.  
4. How did the writer go to the airport last week? → a) By taxi. · b) By bicycle. · c) By bus.  
5. How does the brother go to school? → a) By bicycle. · b) By plane. · c) By train.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) By bus.**  
2. **a) The train.**  
3. **a) For holidays.**  
4. **a) By taxi.**  
5. **a) By bicycle.**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Comprensión

6. Why does the brother like the bicycle? → a) Because it is fast and cheap. · b) Because it is slow. · c) The text doesn't say.  
7. *Go by bus* means ____. → a) Using the bus. · b) Buying a bus. · c) Flying.  
8. *Take the train* means ____. → a) Using the train. · b) Driving a plane. · c) Walking.  
9. A plane ____. → a) flies in the air · b) travels only on rails · c) has pedals  
10. A taxi is ____. → a) a car you pay for · b) a free bike · c) a train

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Because it is fast and cheap.**  
7. **a) Using the bus.**  
8. **a) Using the train.**  
9. **a) flies in the air**  
10. **a) a car you pay for**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Detalles

11. The text is about ____. → a) Different types of transport. · b) Only food. · c) Only sports.  
12. A bicycle is ____. → a) A vehicle with two wheels that you pedal. · b) A plane. · c) A train.  
13. A bus is ____. → a) A road vehicle that carries many people. · b) A plane. · c) A bike.  
14. A train is ____. → a) A vehicle that travels on rails. · b) A taxi. · c) A bicycle.  
15. The main topic is ____. → a) How people travel. · b) Cooking. · c) Music.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) Different types of transport.**  
12. **a) A vehicle with two wheels that you pedal.**  
13. **a) A road vehicle that carries many people.**  
14. **a) A vehicle that travels on rails.**  
15. **a) How people travel.**

</details>

---

## Lección 4 — Listening: Commute

**Objetivo:** escuchar un diálogo sobre transporte diario.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/listening-commute.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Commute"></audio>

> **A:** How do you go to work?  
> **B:** I take the bus.  
> **A:** I go by car. What about your sister?  
> **B:** She travels by train to London.  
> **A:** Do you ever go by plane?  
> **B:** Yes, for holidays. Last time I went to the airport by taxi.  
> **A:** My son goes to school by bicycle.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. How does B go to work? → a) By bus; B takes the bus. · b) By plane. · c) By bicycle.  
2. How does A go to work? → a) By car. · b) By train. · c) By bus.  
3. How does B's sister travel? → a) By train. · b) By bus. · c) By taxi.  
4. When does B go by plane? → a) For holidays. · b) Every day. · c) Never.  
5. How did B go to the airport last time? → a) By taxi. · b) By bicycle. · c) By train.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) By bus; B takes the bus.**  
2. **a) By car.**  
3. **a) By train.**  
4. **a) For holidays.**  
5. **a) By taxi.**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. How does A's son go to school? → a) By bicycle. · b) By plane. · c) By taxi.  
7. *Take the bus* means ____. → a) Use the bus. · b) Buy a bus. · c) Fly.  
8. *Travel by train* means ____. → a) Use the train. · b) Drive a plane. · c) Walk.  
9. The dialogue is about ____. → a) How people travel. · b) Food. · c) Sports.  
10. A plane ____. → a) flies · b) only pedals · c) only rails

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) By bicycle.**  
7. **a) Use the bus.**  
8. **a) Use the train.**  
9. **a) How people travel.**  
10. **a) flies**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. A taxi is ____. → a) A car you pay for. · b) A free bike. · c) A train.  
12. A bicycle is ____. → a) A two-wheeled vehicle that you pedal. · b) A plane. · c) A bus.  
13. Who travels by train to London? → a) B’s sister. · b) A’s son. · c) Nobody.  
14. A bus is ____. → a) A road vehicle that carries many people. · b) A plane. · c) A bike.  
15. The topic is ____. → a) Transport. · b) Cooking. · c) Music.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) A car you pay for.**  
12. **a) A two-wheeled vehicle that you pedal.**  
13. **a) B’s sister.**  
14. **a) A road vehicle that carries many people.**  
15. **a) Transport.**

</details>

---

## Lección 5 — Writing: My transport

**Objetivo:** escribir sobre cómo viajas.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I go to work ____ bus. → *by / the / a*  
2. She ____ the train every Monday. → *takes / take / taking*  
3. We travel by ____. → *plane / the / a*  
4. He goes ____ bicycle. → *by / the / an*  
5. I take ____ bus every day. → *the / a / —*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **by**  
2. **takes**  
3. **plane**  
4. **by**  
5. **the**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. I / go / to work / by / bus.  
7. She / takes / the / train / every Monday.  
8. We / travel / by / plane / for holidays.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. I go to work by bus.  
7. She takes the train every Monday.  
8. We travel by plane for holidays.

</details>

### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Escribe cómo vas al trabajo/colegio con *by*.  
10. Escribe sobre un familiar con *takes the…*.  
11. Dos frases: diario + vacaciones.  
12. Pregunta y respuesta: *How do you go to work?*  
13. Párrafo corto (4 frases) sobre transporte en tu familia.  
14. Dos frases sobre *take the bus*.  
15. Una frase en pasado + una en presente.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución (ejemplos)</summary>

9. I go to work by bus.  
10. My sister takes the train to London.  
11. I go to school by bus. We travel by plane for holidays.  
12. How do you go to work? I take the bus.  
13. I go to work by bus. My sister takes the train. We travel by plane for holidays. My brother goes by bicycle.  
14. I take the bus every day. It is cheap and fast.  
15. I went to the airport by taxi. I go to work by bus.

</details>

---

## Resumen rápido

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **by + transporte** | I go **by bus** / **by car** / **by plane**. |
| **take the + transporte** | I **take the bus** / She **takes the train**. |
| Sin *the* | by bus, by train, by taxi, by bicycle |
| Con *the* | take **the** bus, take **the** train |

---

Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 43 del curso A1** (*Travel Verbs*) con **soluciones comentadas**. Corresponde a las lecciones del curso: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening y writing.

> **Guía teórica:** [Travel Verbs A1](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-43-verbos-viaje-horarios)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 43 — Travel Verbs](/curso-a1/unit-43)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

**Contenido de la unidad:**

## Lección 1 — Gramática: horarios

**Objetivo:** Present Simple para horarios fijos (*leaves, arrives, departs*).

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. The train ____ at nine o'clock. → *leaves / leave / leaving*  
2. The bus ____ at 8. → *departs / depart / departing*  
3. My flight ____ at ten. → *leaves / leave / leaving*  
4. The plane ____ at five o'clock. → *arrives / arrive / arriving*  
5. It ____ London at half past ten. → *arrives in / arrives at / arrive*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **leaves** — horarios = Present Simple.  
2. **departs**  
3. **leaves**  
4. **arrives**  
5. **arrives in** — *arrive in* + ciudad.

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. For fixed times we use ____. → a) Present Simple (leaves, arrives) · b) only Past Simple · c) only -ing  
7. *Leaves at nine* talks about ____. → a) schedule, fixed time · b) a wish only · c) past habit only  
8. The train ____ at nine. → a) leaves · b) leave · c) leaving  
9. Correct: ____. → a) The bus departs at 8. · b) The bus departing at 8. · c) The bus depart at 8.  
10. *Arrives* means ____. → a) reaches a place (time) · b) leaves forever · c) stays home

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Present Simple (leaves, arrives)**  
7. **a) schedule, fixed time**  
8. **a) leaves**  
9. **a) The bus departs at 8.**  
10. **a) reaches a place (time)**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–13 — Ordena

11. The / train / leaves / at / nine o'clock.  
12. The / plane / arrives / at / five o'clock.  
13. My / flight / departs / at / ten / in the morning.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. The train leaves at nine o'clock.  
12. The plane arrives at five o'clock.  
13. My flight departs at ten in the morning.

</details>

### Ejercicios 14–15 — Verdadero o falso

14. Timetables often use Present Simple: *The train leaves at 9.* → True / False  
15. We say *arrive in London* (city) / *arrive at the station*. → True / False

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

14. **True**  
15. **True**

</details>

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario: verbos de viaje

**Objetivo:** *arrive, depart, visit, stay, explore*.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige el significado

1. *Arrive* = ____. → a) reach a place · b) leave forever · c) only sleep  
2. *Depart* = ____. → a) leave, go away · b) stay · c) visit only  
3. *Visit* = ____. → a) go to see a place or person · b) leave · c) depart  
4. *Stay* = ____. → a) remain in a place · b) fly only · c) depart  
5. *Explore* = ____. → a) discover, look around · b) sleep only · c) depart

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) reach a place**  
2. **a) leave, go away**  
3. **a) go to see a place or person**  
4. **a) remain in a place**  
5. **a) discover, look around**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–7 — Empareja

6. Empareja: arrive / depart / visit / stay / explore → reach a place · leave · go to see · remain · discover  
7. Empareja: the train arrives / the plane departs / visit Paris / stay at a hotel / explore the city → reaches the station · leaves the airport · go to see Paris · sleep there · look around

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **arrive → reach a place** · **depart → leave** · **visit → go to see** · **stay → remain** · **explore → discover**  
7. **the train arrives → reaches the station** · **the plane departs → leaves the airport** · **visit Paris → go to see Paris** · **stay at a hotel → sleep there** · **explore the city → look around**

</details>

### Ejercicios 8–10 — Completa

8. The train ____ at ten. → *arrives / arrive / arriving*  
9. I want to ____ the museums. → *visit / visits / visiting*  
10. I ____ at a hotel for three nights. → *stay / stays / staying*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

8. **arrives**  
9. **visit**  
10. **stay**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–13 — Definiciones

11. *Depart* means ____. → a) leave · b) arrive · c) stay  
12. *Explore* means ____. → a) look around, discover · b) only sleep · c) only depart  
13. *Stay at a hotel* means ____. → a) sleep there for some days · b) leave forever · c) fly only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) leave**  
12. **a) look around, discover**  
13. **a) sleep there for some days**

</details>

### Ejercicios 14–15 — Verdadero o falso

14. *Arrive* = reach a place; *depart* = leave. → True / False  
15. *Visit* and *explore* are useful for city trips. → True / False

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

14. **True**  
15. **True**

</details>

## Lección 3 — Reading: London trip

**Objetivo:** leer un plan de viaje con horarios y verbos de viaje.

### Texto

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/reading-london.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: London trip"></audio>

> I am going to London next week. My train leaves at eight o'clock in the morning. It arrives in London at half past ten. I stay at a hotel for three nights. I want to visit the museums and explore the city. My flight departs on Sunday at five o'clock.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige la respuesta correcta

1. Where is the writer going? → a) To London · b) To Paris · c) To Madrid  
2. When does the train leave? → a) At eight o'clock · b) At ten · c) At noon  
3. When does it arrive in London? → a) At half past ten · b) At eight · c) At five  
4. Where does the writer stay? → a) At a hotel · b) At school · c) At the airport only  
5. How many nights? → a) Three · b) One · c) Ten

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) To London**  
2. **a) At eight o'clock**  
3. **a) At half past ten**  
4. **a) At a hotel**  
5. **a) Three**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Comprensión

6. What does the writer want to do? → a) Visit museums and explore the city · b) Only sleep · c) Only work  
7. When does the flight depart? → a) On Sunday at five · b) On Monday at eight · c) Never  
8. *Departs* means ____. → a) leaves · b) arrives · c) stays  
9. *Explore* means ____. → a) discover, look around · b) only sleep · c) only depart  
10. *Stay at a hotel* means ____. → a) sleep there for some days · b) leave forever · c) fly only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Visit museums and explore the city**  
7. **a) On Sunday at five**  
8. **a) leaves**  
9. **a) discover, look around**  
10. **a) sleep there for some days**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Detalles

11. The text is about ____. → a) a trip to London · b) only food · c) only sports  
12. *Arrives* means ____. → a) reaches a place · b) leaves forever · c) stays home  
13. *Visit* means ____. → a) go to see · b) depart · c) never go  
14. The train ____ at eight. → a) leaves · b) leave · c) leaving  
15. The main topic is ____. → a) Travel plans: leave, arrive, stay, visit, explore · b) Cooking · c) Music

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) a trip to London**  
12. **a) reaches a place**  
13. **a) go to see**  
14. **a) leaves**  
15. **a) Travel plans: leave, arrive, stay, visit, explore**

</details>

---

## Lección 4 — Listening: Schedules

**Objetivo:** escuchar un diálogo sobre tren, hotel y vuelo.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/listening-schedules.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Schedules"></audio>

> **A:** When does your train leave?  
> **B:** It leaves at nine o'clock.  
> **A:** What time does it arrive in London?  
> **B:** At half past eleven. I stay at a hotel for two nights.  
> **A:** Do you visit museums?  
> **B:** Yes, I want to explore the city. My flight departs on Monday at six in the evening.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. When does the train leave? → a) At nine o'clock · b) At eight · c) At noon  
2. When does it arrive in London? → a) At half past eleven · b) At nine · c) At five  
3. Where does B stay? → a) At a hotel · b) At school · c) At the airport only  
4. How many nights? → a) Two · b) Five · c) Ten  
5. Does B visit museums? → a) Yes, and explore the city · b) No · c) Never

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) At nine o'clock**  
2. **a) At half past eleven**  
3. **a) At a hotel**  
4. **a) Two**  
5. **a) Yes, and explore the city**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. When does the flight depart? → a) On Monday at six · b) On Sunday at five · c) Never  
7. *Departs* here means ____. → a) schedule, leaves · b) arrives · c) stays  
8. *Explore* means ____. → a) discover, look around · b) only sleep · c) only depart  
9. The dialogue is about ____. → a) travel plans · b) food · c) sports  
10. *Arrive* means ____. → a) reach a place · b) leave forever · c) stay home

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) On Monday at six**  
7. **a) schedule, leaves**  
8. **a) discover, look around**  
9. **a) travel plans**  
10. **a) reach a place**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Leave* means ____. → a) go away / depart · b) arrive · c) stay  
12. *Stay at a hotel* means ____. → a) sleep there · b) fly only · c) depart  
13. A asks about ____. → a) when the train leaves and when it arrives · b) only food · c) only sports  
14. *Visit* means ____. → a) go to see · b) depart · c) never go  
15. The topic is ____. → a) travel: train, hotel, flight, explore · b) cooking · c) music

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) go away / depart**  
12. **a) sleep there**  
13. **a) when the train leaves and when it arrives**  
14. **a) go to see**  
15. **a) travel: train, hotel, flight, explore**

</details>

---

## Lección 5 — Writing: My trip

**Objetivo:** escribir horarios y planes de viaje.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. The train ____ at nine o'clock. → *leaves / leave / leaving*  
2. The plane ____ at five. → *arrives / arrive / arriving*  
3. I ____ at a hotel for three nights. → *stay / stays / staying*  
4. I want to ____ the museums. → *visit / visits / visiting*  
5. My flight ____ at ten. → *departs / depart / departing*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **leaves**  
2. **arrives**  
3. **stay**  
4. **visit**  
5. **departs**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. The / train / leaves / at / nine o'clock.  
7. The / plane / arrives / at / five o'clock.  
8. I / want / to / explore / the / city.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. The train leaves at nine o'clock.  
7. The plane arrives at five o'clock.  
8. I want to explore the city.

</details>

### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Escribe la hora de salida de tu tren/bus/vuelo.  
10. Escribe dónde te alojas y cuántas noches.  
11. Dos frases: *departs* + *arrives*.  
12. Pregunta y respuesta: *What time does the train leave?*  
13. Párrafo corto (4–5 frases) sobre un viaje.  
14. Dos frases: *visit* + *explore*.  
15. Horario de bus: *departs* + *arrive*.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución (ejemplos)</summary>

9. My train leaves at eight o'clock.  
10. I stay at a hotel for three nights.  
11. My flight departs at ten. It arrives at two o'clock.  
12. What time does the train leave? It leaves at nine.  
13. My train leaves at eight. It arrives in London at noon. I stay at a hotel. I want to visit museums and explore the city.  
14. I want to visit the museums. I want to explore the city.  
15. The bus departs at seven. I arrive at half past eight.

</details>

---

## Resumen rápido

| Verbo | Uso | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **leave / depart** | salir | The train **leaves** at 9. |
| **arrive** | llegar | It **arrives in** London at 10:30. |
| **stay** | alojarse | I **stay** at a hotel. |
| **visit** | visitar | I want to **visit** museums. |
| **explore** | explorar | I want to **explore** the city. |

## Lección 1 — Gramática: It is + clima

**Objetivo:** *It is* + adjetivo de tiempo (*sunny, cold…*) y *It is raining / snowing*.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. It ____ sunny today. → *is / are / am*  
2. It ____ raining now. → *is / are / am*  
3. It ____ cold in winter. → *is / are / am*  
4. It ____ hot in summer. → *is / are / am*  
5. It ____ cloudy this morning. → *is / are / am*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **is** — *It is* + adjetivo.  
2. **is** — *It is raining.*  
3. **is**  
4. **is**  
5. **is**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. The pattern is ____. → a) It is + adjective · b) I is + adjective · c) They is + adjective  
7. *It is raining* means ____. → a) Rain is falling now · b) The sun shines · c) It is never wet  
8. Correct for low temperature: ____. → a) It is cold. · b) It are cold. · c) It am cold.  
9. *It is sunny* means ____. → a) The sun is shining · b) It snows · c) It rains  
10. *It is snowing* means ____. → a) Snow falls · b) It is hot · c) It is sunny only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) It is + adjective**  
7. **a) Rain is falling now**  
8. **a) It is cold.**  
9. **a) The sun is shining**  
10. **a) Snow falls**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–13 — Ordena

11. It / is / sunny / today.  
12. It / is / raining / now.  
13. It / is / cold / in / winter.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. It is sunny today.  
12. It is raining now.  
13. It is cold in winter.

</details>

### Ejercicios 14–15 — Verdadero o falso

14. For weather we use *It is*, not *I is* or *They is*. → True / False  
15. *It is hot* means the temperature is high. → True / False

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

14. **True**  
15. **True**

</details>

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario: el tiempo

**Objetivo:** *sunny, rainy, cloudy, snowy, hot, cold*.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige el significado

1. *Sunny* = ____. → a) The sun is shining · b) It rains · c) It snows  
2. *Rainy* = ____. → a) It rains; the weather is wet · b) The sun shines · c) It is never wet  
3. *Cloudy* = ____. → a) There are clouds in the sky · b) It is always hot · c) Snow falls  
4. *Snowy* / *It is snowing* = ____. → a) Snow falls · b) It is hot · c) It is sunny only  
5. *Hot* = ____. → a) The temperature is high or warm · b) The temperature is low · c) It snows

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) The sun is shining**  
2. **a) It rains; the weather is wet**  
3. **a) There are clouds in the sky**  
4. **a) Snow falls**  
5. **a) The temperature is high or warm**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–8 — Empareja y completa

6. *Cold* means ____. → a) The temperature is low · b) The temperature is high · c) The sun shines  
7. Empareja: sunny / rainy / cloudy / snowy / hot / cold → the sun shines · it rains · clouds · snow · high temperature · low temperature  
8. Empareja: It is sunny / It is rainy / It is cold / It is hot / It is snowy → take sunglasses · take an umbrella · wear a coat · wear shorts · snow on the ground

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) The temperature is low**  
7. **sunny → the sun shines** · **rainy → it rains** · **cloudy → clouds** · **snowy → snow** · **hot → high temperature** · **cold → low temperature**  
8. **It is sunny → take sunglasses** · **It is rainy → take an umbrella** · **It is cold → wear a coat** · **It is hot → wear shorts** · **It is snowy → snow on the ground**

</details>

### Ejercicios 9–13 — Completa / elige

9. It is ____ today — the sun is shining. → *sunny / rainy / snowy*  
10. Take an umbrella — it is ____. → *rainy / sunny / hot*  
11. Wear a coat — it is ____. → *cold / hot / sunny*  
12. Low temperature = ____. → a) cold · b) hot · c) sunny  
13. *It is snowing* means ____. → a) Snow falls · b) It is hot · c) It is sunny only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

9. **sunny**  
10. **rainy**  
11. **cold**  
12. **a) cold**  
13. **a) Snow falls**

</details>

### Ejercicios 14–15 — Verdadero o falso

14. *Cloudy* means there are clouds in the sky. → True / False  
15. Sunny, rainy, cloudy, hot and cold are weather words. → True / False

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

14. **True**  
15. **True**

</details>

## Lección 3 — Reading: Today and seasons

**Objetivo:** leer sobre el tiempo hoy, ayer y en las estaciones.

### Texto

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/reading-weather.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Weather"></audio>

> Today it is sunny and hot. I like this weather. Yesterday it was cloudy and rainy. It was raining in the afternoon. In winter it is cold and sometimes it is snowing. In summer it is hot and sunny. I prefer sunny weather because I can go outside.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige la respuesta correcta

1. What is the weather like today? → a) Sunny and hot · b) Cold and snowy · c) Only rainy  
2. What was it like yesterday? → a) Cloudy and rainy · b) Sunny and hot · c) Snowy  
3. When was it raining yesterday? → a) In the afternoon · b) At night only · c) Never  
4. What is winter like? → a) Cold and sometimes snowy · b) Always hot · c) Always sunny  
5. What is summer like? → a) Hot and sunny · b) Always snowy · c) Always cold

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Sunny and hot**  
2. **a) Cloudy and rainy**  
3. **a) In the afternoon**  
4. **a) Cold and sometimes snowy**  
5. **a) Hot and sunny**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Comprensión

6. What weather does the writer prefer? → a) Sunny weather · b) Rainy weather · c) Snowy weather  
7. Why? → a) Because the writer can go outside · b) Because it is cold · c) The text doesn't say  
8. *It was raining* means ____. → a) Rain falls / fell · b) The sun shines · c) It is hot  
9. *Sunny* means ____. → a) The sun shines · b) It snows · c) It rains  
10. *Cloudy* means ____. → a) There are clouds in the sky · b) It is always hot · c) Snow falls

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Sunny weather**  
7. **a) Because the writer can go outside**  
8. **a) Rain falls / fell**  
9. **a) The sun shines**  
10. **a) There are clouds in the sky**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Detalles

11. The text is about ____. → a) Weather at different times · b) Only food · c) Only sports  
12. *Hot* means ____. → a) High temperature · b) Low temperature · c) Snow  
13. *Cold* means ____. → a) Low temperature · b) High temperature · c) Sunny only  
14. *It is snowing* means ____. → a) Snow falls · b) It is hot · c) It is sunny only  
15. The main topic is ____. → a) Weather: sunny, rainy, cloudy, hot, and cold · b) Cooking · c) Music

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) Weather at different times**  
12. **a) High temperature**  
13. **a) Low temperature**  
14. **a) Snow falls**  
15. **a) Weather: sunny, rainy, cloudy, hot, and cold**

</details>

## Lección 4 — Listening: Weather talk

**Objetivo:** escuchar un diálogo sobre el tiempo.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/listening-weather.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Weather talk"></audio>

> **A:** What is the weather like today?  
> **B:** It is sunny and hot.  
> **A:** Great. Yesterday it was cloudy and it was raining.  
> **B:** Yes, I had an umbrella. In winter it is cold and sometimes it is snowing.  
> **A:** I prefer sunny weather.  
> **B:** Me too.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. What is the weather like today? → a) Sunny and hot · b) Cold and snowy · c) Only rainy  
2. What was it like yesterday? → a) Cloudy and raining · b) Sunny and hot · c) Snowy  
3. What did B have yesterday? → a) An umbrella · b) Sunglasses · c) Shorts  
4. What is winter like? → a) Cold and sometimes snowy · b) Always hot · c) Always sunny  
5. What weather does A prefer? → a) Sunny weather · b) Rainy weather · c) Snowy weather

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Sunny and hot**  
2. **a) Cloudy and raining**  
3. **a) An umbrella**  
4. **a) Cold and sometimes snowy**  
5. **a) Sunny weather**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Does B agree? → a) Yes. B says “Me too.” · b) No · c) The audio doesn't say  
7. *Sunny* means ____. → a) The sun shines · b) It rains · c) It snows  
8. *It was raining* means ____. → a) Rain falls / fell · b) The sun shines · c) It is hot  
9. The dialogue is about ____. → a) The weather · b) Food · c) Sports  
10. *Hot* means ____. → a) High temperature · b) Low temperature · c) Snow

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Yes. B says “Me too.”**  
7. **a) The sun shines**  
8. **a) Rain falls / fell**  
9. **a) The weather**  
10. **a) High temperature**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Cold* means ____. → a) Low temperature · b) High temperature · c) Sunny only  
12. *Cloudy* means ____. → a) There are clouds in the sky · b) It is always hot · c) Snow falls  
13. A's first question is ____. → a) What the weather is like today · b) What time it is · c) Where the hotel is  
14. *It is snowing* means ____. → a) Snow falls · b) It is hot · c) It is sunny only  
15. The topic is ____. → a) Weather: sunny, rainy, cold, and snowy · b) Cooking · c) Music

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) Low temperature**  
12. **a) There are clouds in the sky**  
13. **a) What the weather is like today**  
14. **a) Snow falls**  
15. **a) Weather: sunny, rainy, cold, and snowy**

</details>

---

## Lección 5 — Writing: My weather

**Objetivo:** escribir frases sobre el tiempo.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. It ____ sunny today. → *is / are / am*  
2. It ____ raining now. → *is / are / am*  
3. It is ____ in winter. → *cold / hot / sunny*  
4. It is ____ in summer. → *hot / cold / snowy*  
5. It is ____ this morning — there are clouds. → *cloudy / sunny / hot*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **is**  
2. **is**  
3. **cold**  
4. **hot**  
5. **cloudy**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. It / is / sunny / today.  
7. It / is / raining / now.  
8. It / is / cold / in / winter.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. It is sunny today.  
7. It is raining now.  
8. It is cold in winter.

</details>

### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Escribe el tiempo de hoy con *It is…*.  
10. Escribe el invierno con *cold* / *snowy*.  
11. Dos frases: ayer + hoy.  
12. Pregunta y respuesta: *What is the weather like?*  
13. Párrafo corto (4 frases) sobre el tiempo.  
14. Escribe qué tiempo prefieres y por qué.  
15. Dos tips: qué llevar si hace frío / si llueve.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución (ejemplos)</summary>

9. It is sunny and hot today.  
10. It is cold and snowy in winter.  
11. Yesterday it was rainy. Today it is sunny.  
12. What is the weather like? It is sunny.  
13. Today it is sunny and hot. In winter it is cold. Sometimes it is rainy and cloudy. I like sunny weather.  
14. I prefer sunny weather because I can go outside.  
15. When it is cold, wear a coat. When it is rainy, take an umbrella.

</details>

---

## Resumen rápido

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **It is + adj.** | It is **sunny** / **hot** / **cold** / **cloudy**. |
| **It is + -ing** | It is **raining** / **snowing**. |
| Pregunta | **What is the weather like?** |
| Ayer | Yesterday it **was** rainy. |

---
