content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 45 del curso A1** (*Seasons*) con **soluciones comentadas**. Corresponde a las lecciones del curso: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening y writing.

> **Guía teórica:** [Seasons A1](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-45-estaciones-in-spring)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 45 — Seasons](/curso-a1/unit-45)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![In + seasons](/blog/curso-a1/unit-45/a1-unit45-in-seasons.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática: in + estación](#leccion-1--gramatica-in--estacion)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario: estaciones](#leccion-2--vocabulario-estaciones)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: Four seasons](#leccion-3--reading-four-seasons)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: Favourite season](#leccion-4--listening-favourite-season)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing: My seasons](#leccion-5--writing-my-seasons)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática: in + estación

**Objetivo:** preposición *in* con *spring, summer, autumn, winter*.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. It is hot ____ summer. → *in / on / at*  
2. The flowers bloom ____ spring. → *in / on / at*  
3. It is cold ____ winter. → *in / on / at*  
4. The leaves fall ____ autumn. → *in / on / at*  
5. I go to the beach ____ summer. → *in / on / at*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **in** — *in* + estación.  
2. **in**  
3. **in**  
4. **in**  
5. **in**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. Before seasons we use ____. → a) in · b) on · c) at  
7. Correct: ____. → a) in spring · b) on spring · c) at spring  
8. *In autumn* means ____. → a) during autumn · b) never autumn · c) only winter  
9. The four seasons are ____. → a) spring, summer, autumn, winter · b) only summer · c) Monday–Friday  
10. It is snowy ____ winter. → a) in · b) on · c) at

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) in**  
7. **a) in spring**  
8. **a) during autumn**  
9. **a) spring, summer, autumn, winter**  
10. **a) in**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–13 — Ordena

11. It / is / hot / in / summer.  
12. The / flowers / bloom / in / spring.  
13. It / is / cold / in / winter.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. It is hot in summer.  
12. The flowers bloom in spring.  
13. It is cold in winter.

</details>

### Ejercicios 14–15 — Verdadero o falso

14. We say *in summer* (not *on summer*). → True / False  
15. The four seasons are spring, summer, autumn and winter. → True / False

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

14. **True**  
15. **True**

</details>

---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario: estaciones

**Objetivo:** *spring, summer, autumn, winter, nature, flowers, leaves*.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige el significado

1. *Spring* = ____. → a) the season after winter, when flowers bloom · b) the cold season · c) only snow  
2. *Summer* = ____. → a) the hot, sunny season · b) the cold season · c) only autumn  
3. *Autumn* = ____. → a) the season when leaves fall · b) the hot beach season · c) only spring  
4. *Winter* = ____. → a) the cold season, associated with snow · b) the hot season · c) only flowers  
5. *Nature* = ____. → a) plants, animals, weather, and things not made by people · b) only cars · c) only schools

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) the season after winter, when flowers bloom**  
2. **a) the hot, sunny season**  
3. **a) the season when leaves fall**  
4. **a) the cold season, associated with snow**  
5. **a) plants, animals, weather, and things not made by people**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–7 — Empareja

6. Empareja: spring / summer / autumn / winter / nature → flowers bloom · hot and sunny · leaves fall · cold and snow · trees, animals, and plants  
7. Empareja: in spring / in summer / in autumn / in winter / nature → warm weather and new leaves · holidays and the beach · orange leaves · snow and a coat · parks and forests

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **spring → flowers bloom** · **summer → hot and sunny** · **autumn → leaves fall** · **winter → cold and snow** · **nature → trees, animals, and plants**  
7. **in spring → warm weather and new leaves** · **in summer → holidays and the beach** · **in autumn → orange leaves** · **in winter → snow and a coat** · **nature → parks and forests**

</details>

### Ejercicios 8–13 — Completa / elige

8. It is hot ____ summer. → *in / on / at*  
9. Flowers bloom ____. → a) in spring · b) on spring · c) at spring  
10. I like ____ in every season. → *nature / natures / naturings*  
11. Which season is cold and snowy? → a) Winter · b) Summer · c) Spring  
12. Which season do leaves fall? → a) Autumn · b) Summer · c) Spring  
13. Parks and forests are part of ____. → a) nature · b) only hotels · c) only tickets

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

8. **in**  
9. **a) in spring**  
10. **nature**  
11. **a) Winter**  
12. **a) Autumn**  
13. **a) nature**

</details>

### Ejercicios 14–15 — Verdadero o falso

14. *Autumn* is when leaves fall. → True / False  
15. *In spring* uses the preposition *in*. → True / False

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

14. **True**  
15. **True**

</details>

---

## Lección 3 — Reading: Four seasons

**Objetivo:** leer sobre las cuatro estaciones y la naturaleza.

### Texto

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-45/reading-seasons.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Four seasons"></audio>

> I love all four seasons. In spring, the flowers bloom and the weather is warm. In summer, it is hot and sunny; I go to the beach. In autumn, the leaves fall and the trees are orange and yellow. In winter, it is cold and sometimes it snows. I like nature in every season.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige la respuesta correcta

1. What does the writer love? → a) All four seasons · b) Only winter · c) Only summer  
2. What happens in spring? → a) The flowers bloom and the weather is warm · b) It always snows · c) Leaves fall  
3. Where does the writer go in summer? → a) To the beach · b) To school only · c) Nowhere  
4. What happens in autumn? → a) The leaves fall, and the trees are orange and yellow · b) Flowers bloom · c) It is always hot  
5. What is winter like? → a) It is cold and sometimes snowy · b) Always hot · c) Always sunny

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) All four seasons**  
2. **a) The flowers bloom and the weather is warm**  
3. **a) To the beach**  
4. **a) The leaves fall, and the trees are orange and yellow**  
5. **a) It is cold and sometimes snowy**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Comprensión

6. What does the writer like in every season? → a) Nature · b) Only hotels · c) Only cars  
7. Summer is ____. → a) hot and sunny · b) always snowy · c) always cold  
8. In spring, ____. → a) flowers bloom · b) leaves fall · c) it always snows  
9. In autumn, ____. → a) leaves fall · b) flowers bloom · c) it is always hot  
10. Winter is ____. → a) cold and snow · b) always hot · c) always sunny

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Nature**  
7. **a) hot and sunny**  
8. **a) flowers bloom**  
9. **a) leaves fall**  
10. **a) cold and snow**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Detalles

11. The text is about ____. → a) the four seasons and nature · b) only food · c) only sports  
12. *Nature* means ____. → a) trees, flowers, animals, and other things not made by people · b) only cars · c) only tickets  
13. Before seasons we use ____. → a) in · b) on · c) at  
14. Summer is ____. → a) the hot season · b) the cold season · c) only autumn  
15. The main topic is ____. → a) seasons and nature · b) cooking · c) music

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) the four seasons and nature**  
12. **a) trees, flowers, animals, and other things not made by people**  
13. **a) in**  
14. **a) the hot season**  
15. **a) seasons and nature**

</details>

---

## Lección 4 — Listening: Favourite season

**Objetivo:** escuchar un diálogo sobre estaciones favoritas.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-45/listening-seasons.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Favourite season"></audio>

> **A:** What is your favourite season?  
> **B:** I like summer. It is hot and sunny in summer.  
> **A:** I prefer spring. The flowers bloom in spring.  
> **B:** In autumn, the leaves fall. In winter, it is cold and snowy.  
> **A:** I love nature in all seasons.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. What is B's favourite season? → a) Summer · b) Winter · c) Autumn  
2. What is summer like for B? → a) Hot and sunny · b) Cold and snowy · c) Always rainy  
3. What does A prefer? → a) Spring · b) Winter · c) Autumn  
4. What happens in spring? → a) The flowers bloom · b) Leaves fall · c) It always snows  
5. What happens in autumn? → a) The leaves fall · b) Flowers bloom · c) It is always hot

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Summer**  
2. **a) Hot and sunny**  
3. **a) Spring**  
4. **a) The flowers bloom**  
5. **a) The leaves fall**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. What is winter like? → a) Cold and snowy · b) Always hot · c) Always sunny  
7. What does A love? → a) Nature in all seasons · b) Only winter · c) Only cars  
8. Before summer we use ____. → a) in · b) on · c) at  
9. The dialogue is about ____. → a) seasons and nature · b) food · c) sports  
10. In spring, ____. → a) flowers bloom · b) leaves fall · c) it always snows

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Cold and snowy**  
7. **a) Nature in all seasons**  
8. **a) in**  
9. **a) seasons and nature**  
10. **a) flowers bloom**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. Winter is ____. → a) cold and snow · b) always hot · c) always sunny  
12. *Nature* includes ____. → a) trees, flowers, and animals · b) only hotels · c) only tickets  
13. A's first question is ____. → a) “What is your favourite season?” · b) “What time is it?” · c) “Where is the hotel?”  
14. In autumn, ____. → a) leaves fall · b) flowers bloom · c) it is always hot  
15. The topic is ____. → a) the four seasons and nature · b) cooking · c) music

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) cold and snow**  
12. **a) trees, flowers, and animals**  
13. **a) “What is your favourite season?”**  
14. **a) leaves fall**  
15. **a) the four seasons and nature**

</details>

---

## Lección 5 — Writing: My seasons

**Objetivo:** escribir sobre estaciones y naturaleza.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. It is hot ____ summer. → *in / on / at*  
2. Flowers bloom ____ spring. → *in / on / at*  
3. It is cold ____. → a) in winter · b) on winter · c) at winter  
4. Leaves fall ____ autumn. → *in / on / at*  
5. My favourite season is ____. → *spring / springs / springing*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **in**  
2. **in**  
3. **a) in winter**  
4. **in**  
5. **spring** (u otra estación válida)

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. It / is / hot / in / summer.  
7. The / flowers / bloom / in / spring.  
8. It / is / cold / in / winter.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. It is hot in summer.  
7. The flowers bloom in spring.  
8. It is cold in winter.

</details>

### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Escribe el verano con *It is… in summer*.  
10. Escribe tu estación favorita y por qué.  
11. Dos frases: spring + autumn.  
12. Pregunta y respuesta: *What is your favourite season?*  
13. Párrafo corto (4–5 frases) sobre las cuatro estaciones.  
14. Dos actividades: summer + winter.  
15. Cuatro frases: una por estación.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución (ejemplos)</summary>

9. It is hot and sunny in summer.  
10. My favourite season is summer because it is hot.  
11. In spring, the flowers bloom. In autumn, the leaves fall.  
12. What is your favourite season? My favourite season is summer.  
13. In spring, the flowers bloom. In summer, it is hot. In autumn, the leaves fall. In winter, it is cold. I like nature in every season.  
14. In summer, I go to the beach. In winter, I stay at home when it is snowing.  
15. In spring, it is warm. In summer, it is hot. In autumn, the leaves fall. In winter, it is cold.

</details>

---

## Resumen rápido

| Estación | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **spring** | In spring, the flowers bloom. |
| **summer** | It is hot **in summer**. |
| **autumn** | In autumn, the leaves fall. |
| **winter** | It is cold **in winter**. |
| Preposición | **in** + estación |

---

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 46 del curso A1** (*At the Hotel*) con **soluciones comentadas**. Corresponde a las lecciones del curso: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening y writing.

> **Guía teórica:** [At the Hotel A1](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-46-hotel-can-i-have)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 46 — At the Hotel](/curso-a1/unit-46)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Hotel requests](/blog/curso-a1/unit-46/a1-unit46-hotel-requests.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática: peticiones](#leccion-1--gramatica-peticiones)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario: hotel](#leccion-2--vocabulario-hotel)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: Check-in](#leccion-3--reading-check-in)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: Reception](#leccion-4--listening-reception)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing: At the hotel](#leccion-5--writing-at-the-hotel)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática: peticiones

**Objetivo:** *Can I have/get…?*, *Is there…?*, *I would like…*.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. Can I ____ a key? → *have / has / having*  
2. ____ there a restaurant? → *Is / Are / Am*  
3. Can I ____ room service? → *get / gets / getting*  
4. Is there ____ Wi-Fi? → *any / an / a*  
5. I would ____ a double room. → *like / likes / liking*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **have** — *Can I have…?*  
2. **Is** — *Is there…?*  
3. **get**  
4. **any**  
5. **like**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. *Can I have…?* is a ____. → a) polite request · b) past story · c) refusal  
7. *Is there…?* asks about ____. → a) the existence of something · b) only the past · c) a sport  
8. At reception you ____. → a) ask for a key and check in · b) only cook · c) only fly  
9. Correct: ____. → a) Can I have a key? · b) Can I has a key? · c) Can I having a key?  
10. *Room service* means ____. → a) food or help brought to your room · b) only the lobby · c) only the key

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) polite request**  
7. **a) the existence of something**  
8. **a) ask for a key and check in**  
9. **a) Can I have a key?**  
10. **a) food or help brought to your room**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–13 — Ordena

11. Can / I / have / a / key / for / room / five?  
12. Is / there / a / double / room / available?  
13. I / would / like / room / service, / please.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. Can I have a key for room five?  
12. Is there a double room available?  
13. I would like room service, please.

</details>

### Ejercicios 14–15 — Verdadero o falso

14. *Can I have…?* is a polite way to ask for something. → True / False

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

14. **True**  
15. **True**

</details>

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario: hotel

**Objetivo:** *reception, room service, single/double room, key, booking, check in*.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige el significado

1. *Reception* = ____. → a) a desk where you check in · b) only the beach · c) only the plane  
2. *Room service* = ____. → a) food or help brought to your room · b) only the lobby · c) only the key  
3. *Single room* = ____. → a) a room for one person · b) a room for ten people · c) only the restaurant  
4. *Double room* = ____. → a) a room for two people, often with one bed · b) a room for one person · c) only Wi-Fi  
5. *Key* = ____. → a) something used to open your room · b) only a password · c) only a booking

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) a desk where you check in**  
2. **a) food or help brought to your room**  
3. **a) a room for one person**  
4. **a) a room for two people, often with one bed**  
5. **a) something used to open your room**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–7 — Empareja

6. Empareja: reception / room service / single room / double room / key → check in/get a key · order food to your room · one person · two people · open the room  
7. Empareja: hotel / available / check in / booking / lobby → place to stay · free to use · register when you arrive · reservation · entrance area

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **reception → check in/get a key** · **room service → order food to your room** · **single room → one person** · **double room → two people** · **key → open the room**  
7. **hotel → place to stay** · **available → free to use** · **check in → register when you arrive** · **booking → reservation** · **lobby → entrance area**

</details>

### Ejercicios 8–13 — Completa / elige

8. Can I have a ____ for room five? → *key / keysing / lobby*  
9. I go to ____ to check in. → *reception / restauranting / beach*  
10. Is there a ____ room available? → *double / doubles / doubling*  
11. *Available* means ____. → a) free; available for use · b) closed forever · c) only past  
12. *Check in* means ____. → a) register when you arrive at the hotel · b) leave forever · c) only cook  
13. Where do you get your key? → a) at reception · b) at the beach · c) on the plane

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

8. **key**  
9. **reception**  
10. **double**  
11. **a) free; available for use**  
12. **a) register when you arrive at the hotel**  
13. **a) at reception**

</details>

### Ejercicios 14–15 — Verdadero o falso

14. A single room is for one person. → True / False  
15. A booking is a reservation. → True / False

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

14. **True**  
15. **True**

</details>

## Lección 3 — Reading: Check-in

**Objetivo:** leer un check-in en el hotel.

### Texto

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-46/reading-hotel.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Check-in"></audio>

> I am at the hotel today. I go to reception to check in. Can I have a key for room twelve? The receptionist says yes. Is there a restaurant? Yes, there is. I would like room service tonight. I have a single room. It is clean and quiet.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige la respuesta correcta

1. Where is the writer? → a) At the hotel · b) At school · c) At the beach  
2. What does the writer ask for? → a) A key for room twelve · b) A plane ticket · c) A bike  
3. Is there a restaurant? → a) Yes, there is · b) No · c) The text doesn't say  
4. What does the writer want tonight? → a) Room service · b) A taxi only · c) Nothing  
5. What type of room? → a) A single room · b) A double room · c) A suite only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) At the hotel**  
2. **a) A key for room twelve**  
3. **a) Yes, there is**  
4. **a) Room service**  
5. **a) A single room**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Comprensión

6. How is the room? → a) It is clean and quiet · b) It is dirty · c) It is noisy  
7. Where does the writer go first? → a) To reception · b) To the beach · c) To school  
8. A *receptionist* is ____. → a) a person at reception · b) a plane · c) a key  
9. *Can I have…?* is ____. → a) a polite request · b) a refusal · c) a past tense  
10. Room twelve is ____. → a) room number twelve · b) a restaurant · c) Wi-Fi only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) It is clean and quiet**  
7. **a) To reception**  
8. **a) a person at reception**  
9. **a) a polite request**  
10. **a) room number twelve**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Detalles

11. The text is about ____. → a) hotel check-in and a hotel stay · b) only food · c) only sports  
12. *Is there…?* is ____. → a) asking whether something exists · b) only past · c) a sport  
13. *Quiet* means ____. → a) not noisy · b) always loud · c) always dirty  
14. A *key* is ____. → a) something used to open your room · b) only a password forever · c) only a booking  
15. The main topic is ____. → a) staying at a hotel, checking in and getting a room · b) cooking · c) music

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) hotel check-in and a hotel stay**

## Lección 4 — Listening: Reception

**Objetivo:** escuchar un check-in en recepción.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-46/listening-check-in.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Reception"></audio>

> **Guest:** Hello. I have a booking.  
> **Receptionist:** Welcome. Can I have your name?

> **Receptionist:** Here is your key for room eight.  
> **Guest:** Is there Wi-Fi in the hotel?

> **Guest:** Can I have room service?  
> **Receptionist:** Yes. Call reception.  
> **Guest:** Thank you.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. What does the guest say first? → a) I have a booking · b) I need a taxi · c) Goodbye  
2. What room is the key for? → a) Room eight · b) Room twelve · c) Room one  
3. Is there Wi-Fi? → a) Yes, there is · b) No · c) The audio doesn't say  
4. Where is the password? → a) On the key card · b) On the plane · c) At school  
5. What else does the guest ask for? → a) Room service · b) A bike · c) A ticket

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) I have a booking**  
2. **a) Room eight**  
3. **a) Yes, there is**  
4. **a) On the key card**  
5. **a) Room service**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. How do you get room service? → a) Call reception · b) Go to the beach · c) Fly  
7. A *booking* is a ____. → a) reservation · b) key only · c) password only  
8. The dialogue is at ____. → a) hotel reception · b) school · c) the beach  
9. *Can I have…?* is ____. → a) a polite request · b) a refusal · c) past simple  
10. A *key card* is ____. → a) a key card, sometimes with the password · b) only a plane · c) only food

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Call reception**  
7. **a) reservation**  
8. **a) hotel reception**  
9. **a) a polite request**  
10. **a) a key card, sometimes with the password**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. The guest ends with ____. → a) Thank you · b) Goodbye forever · c) Never  
12. *Welcome* is ____. → a) a greeting used when someone arrives · b) a refusal · c) a password  
13. For room service, ____. → a) phone reception · b) leave the hotel · c) buy a plane  
14. A *password* is ____. → a) a secret code used for Wi-Fi or another service · b) a room number only · c) a key forever  
15. The topic is ____. → a) hotel check-in and hotel requests · b) cooking · c) music

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) Thank you**  
12. **a) a greeting used when someone arrives**  
13. **a) phone reception**  
14. **a) a secret code used for Wi-Fi or another service**  
15. **a) hotel check-in and hotel requests**

</details>

## Lección 5 — Writing: At the hotel

**Objetivo:** escribir peticiones y un mini diálogo de check-in.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. Can I ____ a key? → *have / has / having*  
2. ____ there Wi-Fi? → *Is / Are / Am*  
3. I would ____ room service. → *like / likes / liking*  
4. I go ____ reception to check in. → *to / for / at*  
5. Here is your ____. → *key / keysing / lobby*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **have**  
2. **Is**  
3. **like**  
4. **to**  
5. **key**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. Can / I / have / a / key / for / room / five?  
7. Is / there / a / double / room / available?  
8. I / go / to / reception / to / check / in.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. Can I have a key for room five?  
7. Is there a double room available?  
8. I go to reception to check in.

</details>

### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Pide una llave para una habitación.  
10. Pregunta si hay Wi-Fi.  
11. Dos frases: booking + tipo de habitación.  
12. Mini diálogo: room service.  
13. Párrafo corto (3–4 frases) de check-in.  
14. Tres peticiones/preguntas de hotel.  
15. Escribe lo que quieres: habitación + baño.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución (ejemplos)</summary>

9. Can I have a key for room ten?  
10. Is there Wi-Fi in the hotel?  
11. I have a booking. I would like a double room.  
12. Can I have room service? Yes, call reception.  
13. I go to reception to check in. Can I have a key for room eight? Is there a restaurant? Yes, there is.  
14. Can I have a key? Is there Wi-Fi? I would like room service.  
15. I would like a single room. Is there a bathroom in the room?

</details>

## Resumen rápido

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Can I have…?** | Can I have a key? |
| **Is there…?** | Is there Wi-Fi? |
| **I would like…** | I would like room service. |
| **Check in** | I go to reception to check in. |
| **Booking** | I have a booking. |

> **Guía teórica:** [Holidays A1](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-47-vacaciones-was-were)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática: was/were](#leccion-1--gramatica-waswere)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario: vacaciones](#leccion-2--vocabulario-vacaciones)

## Lección 1 — Gramática: was/were

**Objetivo:** *was/were* y pasado regular (*visited, played*).

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I ____ on the beach last week. → *was / were / am*  
2. We ____ in the mountains. → *were / was / are*  
3. She ____ the museum yesterday. → *visited / visit / visiting*  
4. They ____ volleyball on the beach. → *played / play / playing*  
5. It ____ sunny. → *was / were / are*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **was** — *I/he/she/it was*.  
2. **were** — *you/we/they were*.  
3. **visited** — pasado regular *-ed*.  
4. **played**  
5. **was**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. *I ____ happy.* → a) was · b) were · c) are  
7. *You ____ on holiday.* → a) were · b) was · c) is  
8. Past of *visit*: ____. → a) visited · b) visit · c) visiting  
9. *She ____ at the hotel.* → a) was · b) were · c) are  
10. *Did* is used for ____. → a) past questions · b) only present · c) only future

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) was**  
7. **a) were**  
8. **a) visited**  
9. **a) was**  
10. **a) past questions**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–13 — Ordena

11. I / was / on / the / beach / last week.  
12. She / visited / the / museum / yesterday.  
13. We / were / in / the / mountains.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. I was on the beach last week.  
12. She visited the museum yesterday.  
13. We were in the mountains.

</details>

### Ejercicios 14–15 — Verdadero o falso

14. *Was* goes with I/he/she/it; *were* goes with you/we/they. → True / False  
15. Regular past verbs often end in *-ed*: *visited, played*. → True / False

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

14. **True**  
15. **True**

</details>

---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario: vacaciones

**Objetivo:** *beach, mountains, sightseeing, souvenir, holiday*.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige el significado

1. *Beach* = ____. → a) a sandy place by the sea · b) high land · c) only a museum  
2. *Mountains* = ____. → a) high land or hills · b) the sea · c) only a hotel  
3. *Sightseeing* = ____. → a) visiting places as a tourist · b) only sleeping · c) only cooking  
4. *Souvenir* = ____. → a) something you buy to remember a place · b) only a ticket · c) only weather  
5. *Holiday* = ____. → a) time off or a trip · b) only work · c) only school

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) a sandy place by the sea**  
2. **a) high land or hills**  
3. **a) visiting places as a tourist**  
4. **a) something you buy to remember a place**  
5. **a) time off or a trip**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–7 — Empareja

6. Empareja: beach / mountains / sightseeing / souvenir / last year → sea and sand · hiking and snow · visiting monuments · something bought as a reminder · past time  
7. Empareja: visited / played / was / were / yesterday → past of visit · past of play · past of is/am · past of are · a past day

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **beach → sea and sand** · **mountains → hiking and snow** · **sightseeing → visiting monuments** · **souvenir → something bought as a reminder** · **last year → past time**  
7. **visited → past of visit** · **played → past of play** · **was → past of is/am** · **were → past of are** · **yesterday → a past day**

</details>

### Ejercicios 8–13 — Completa / elige

8. I was on the ____ every day. → *beach / beachesing / mountain*  
9. I bought a ____. → *souvenir / souvenirsing / weather*  
10. We did ____ in Barcelona. → *sightseeing / sightsee / sights*  
11. *Yesterday* is ____. → a) past time · b) future time · c) never  
12. Past of *visit*: ____. → a) visited · b) visit · c) visiting  
13. Sightseeing often includes ____. → a) museums and monuments · b) only sleeping · c) only cooking

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

8. **beach**  
9. **souvenir**  
10. **sightseeing**  
11. **a) past time**  
12. **a) visited**  
13. **a) museums and monuments**

</details>

### Ejercicios 14–15 — Verdadero o falso

14. A souvenir helps you remember a place. → True / False  
15. *Last summer* talks about the past. → True / False

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

14. **True**  
15. **True**

</details>

## Lección 3 — Reading: Last summer

**Objetivo:** leer sobre unas vacaciones en España.

### Texto

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-47/reading-holiday.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Last summer"></audio>

> Last summer I was on holiday in Spain. I was on the beach every day. My friends visited the mountains too. We did sightseeing in Barcelona. I bought a souvenir—a small statue. The weather was sunny. We played volleyball on the beach. It was great.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige la respuesta correcta

1. Where was the writer? → a) In Spain, on holiday · b) At school · c) At work only  
2. Where was the writer every day? → a) On the beach · b) In the mountains · c) At home  
3. Where did friends visit? → a) The mountains · b) Only the hotel · c) Nowhere  
4. Where did they do sightseeing? → a) In Barcelona · b) In Paris · c) In London  
5. What souvenir? → a) A small statue · b) A car · c) A plane

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) In Spain, on holiday**  
2. **a) On the beach**  
3. **a) The mountains**  
4. **a) In Barcelona**  
5. **a) A small statue**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Comprensión

6. What was the weather like? → a) Sunny · b) Snowy · c) Cold  
7. What sport did they play? → a) Volleyball · b) Football only · c) Tennis only  
8. *Sightseeing* means ____. → a) visiting places as a tourist · b) only sleeping · c) only cooking  
9. A *souvenir* is ____. → a) something you buy to remember a place · b) only a ticket · c) only weather  
10. *It was great* means ____. → a) It was very good · b) It was terrible · c) It was never fun

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Sunny**  
7. **a) Volleyball**  
8. **a) visiting places as a tourist**  
9. **a) something you buy to remember a place**  
10. **a) It was very good**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Detalles

11. The text is about ____. → a) a holiday in Spain · b) only food · c) only work  
12. *Was* is the past of ____. → a) is/am · b) are · c) will  
13. *Visited* is ____. → a) the past of visit · b) the present · c) the future  
14. *Mountains* means ____. → a) high land · b) the sea · c) only a hotel  
15. The main topic is ____. → a) a summer holiday with beach, mountains and sightseeing · b) cooking · c) music

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) a holiday in Spain**  
12. **a) is/am**  
13. **a) the past of visit**  
14. **a) high land**  
15. **a) a summer holiday with beach, mountains and sightseeing**

</details>

## Lección 4 — Listening: Last week

**Objetivo:** escuchar un diálogo sobre unas vacaciones recientes.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-47/listening-holiday.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Last week"></audio>

> **A:** Where were you last week?  
> **B:** I was on the beach. I played volleyball and swam.  
> **A:** Nice. Did you do sightseeing?  
> **B:** Yes. I visited the old town. I bought a souvenir.  
> **A:** Were you in the mountains too?

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Where was B last week? → a) On the beach · b) In the mountains · c) At school  
2. What did B do? → a) Played volleyball and swam · b) Only worked · c) Only slept  
3. Did B do sightseeing? → a) Yes · b) No · c) The audio doesn't say  
4. What did B visit? → a) The old town · b) Only a hotel · c) Nowhere  
5. Did B buy a souvenir? → a) Yes · b) No · c) Never

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) On the beach**  
2. **a) Played volleyball and swam**  
3. **a) Yes**  
4. **a) The old town**  
5. **a) Yes**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Was B in the mountains? → a) No · b) Yes · c) Always  
7. Where will B go next year? → a) To the mountains · b) To school · c) Nowhere  
8. *Old town* means ____. → a) the historic centre of a city · b) only a beach · c) only a hotel  
9. *Was* is ____. → a) the past of I am · b) the present · c) the future  
10. *Swam* is ____. → a) the past of swim · b) the present · c) the future

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) No**  
7. **a) To the mountains**  
8. **a) the historic centre of a city**  
9. **a) the past of I am**  
10. **a) the past of swim**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. The dialogue is about ____. → a) a holiday, the beach, and sightseeing · b) only food · c) only work  
12. *Bought* is ____. → a) the past of buy · b) the present · c) the future  
13. *Nice* here is ____. → a) an expression of approval · b) a refusal · c) a ticket  
14. *Were you…?* is ____. → a) a past-tense question with you · b) a present question · c) a future question  
15. The dialogue uses ____. → a) the past tense · b) only present · c) only future

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) a holiday, the beach, and sightseeing**  
12. **a) the past of buy**  
13. **a) an expression of approval**  
14. **a) a past-tense question with you**  
15. **a) the past tense**

</details>

## Lección 5 — Writing: My holiday

**Objetivo:** escribir sobre vacaciones en pasado.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I ____ on the beach last week. → *was / were / am*  
2. She ____ the museum yesterday. → *visited / visit / visiting*  
3. We ____ in the mountains. → *were / was / are*  
4. I ____ a souvenir. → *bought / buy / buying*  
5. They ____ volleyball. → *played / play / playing*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **was**  
2. **visited**  
3. **were**  
4. **bought**  
5. **played**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. I / was / on / the / beach / last week.  
7. We / did / sightseeing / in / Barcelona.  
8. She / visited / the / museum / yesterday.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. I was on the beach last week.  
7. We did sightseeing in Barcelona.  
8. She visited the museum yesterday.

</details>

### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Escribe dónde estuviste la semana pasada.  
10. Dos actividades: visit + play.  
11. Dos frases: tiempo + souvenir.  
12. Pregunta y respuesta con *Were you…?*  
13. Párrafo corto (4 frases) sobre unas vacaciones.  
14. Dos frases: *I was…* + *My friends were…*  
15. Dos frases sobre ayer.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución (ejemplos)</summary>

9. I was on the beach last week.  
10. I visited the old town and played volleyball.  
11. The weather was sunny. I bought a souvenir—a small statue.  
12. Were you on the beach? Yes, I was.  
13. Last summer I was on the beach. I played volleyball and did sightseeing. The weather was sunny. I bought a souvenir.  
14. I was on the beach last week. My friends were in the mountains.  
15. Yesterday I was in town. I visited the museum.

</details>

---

## Resumen rápido

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **was** | I **was** on the beach. |
| **were** | We **were** in the mountains. |
| **visited / played** | She **visited** the museum. |
| **sightseeing** | We did sightseeing. |
| **souvenir** | I bought a souvenir. |

Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 48 del curso A1** (*Sightseeing*) con **soluciones comentadas**. Corresponde a las lecciones del curso: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening y writing.

> **Guía teórica:** [Sightseeing A1](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-48-sightseeing-superlativos)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 48 — Sightseeing](/curso-a1/unit-48)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Superlativos sightseeing](/blog/curso-a1/unit-48/a1-unit48-superlatives.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática: superlativos](#leccion-1--gramatica-superlativos)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario: turismo y monumentos](#leccion-2--vocabulario-turismo-y-monumentos)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: Yesterday in the city](#leccion-3--reading-yesterday-in-the-city)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: Sightseeing today](#leccion-4--listening-sightseeing-today)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing: My sightseeing day](#leccion-5--writing-my-sightseeing-day)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática: superlativos

**Objetivo:** *the most famous*, *the oldest*, *the biggest*, *the tallest*.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. This is ____ famous monument in the city. → *the most / the more / most*  
2. It is ____ old church in town. → *the oldest / the older / oldest*  
3. That is ____ big museum here. → *the biggest / the bigger / biggest*  
4. We saw ____ tall statue in the square. → *the tallest / the taller / tallest*  
5. This is ____ beautiful building in the city. → *the most beautiful / the more beautiful / most beautiful*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **the most** — adjetivo largo: *the most + adj.*  
2. **the oldest** — adjetivo corto: *the + -est*.  
3. **the biggest** — *big → bigger → the biggest* (doble g).  
4. **the tallest**  
5. **the most beautiful**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. Superlative = ____. → a) the most / the -est · b) more / -er · c) present only  
7. *Famous* → superlative = ____. → a) the most famous · b) the famousest · c) the more famous  
8. *Old* → superlative = ____. → a) the oldest · b) the most old · c) the older  
9. We use ____ before superlative adjectives. → a) the · b) a · c) no article  
10. *The most famous monument* means ____. → a) the monument that is most famous · b) a monument · c) the only monument always

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) the most / the -est**  
7. **a) the most famous**  
8. **a) the oldest**  
9. **a) the**  
10. **a) the monument that is most famous**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–13 — Ordena

11. This is / the / most / famous / monument / in / the city.  
12. It is / the / oldest / church / in / town.  
13. We / did / a / guided tour / of / the museum.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. This is the most famous monument in the city.  
12. It is the oldest church in town.  
13. We did a guided tour of the museum.

</details>

### Ejercicios 14–15 — Verdadero o falso

14. Superlatives compare one thing with all others (*the most famous*, *the oldest*). → True / False  
15. Long adjectives use *the most*; short adjectives use *the -est*. → True / False

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

14. **True**  
15. **True**

</details>

---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario: turismo y monumentos

**Objetivo:** *museum, monument, statue, guided tour, sightseeing, square, guide*.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige el significado

1. *Museum* = ____. → a) a place with art, history or objects · b) a monument · c) a statue  
2. *Monument* = ____. → a) a building or structure to remember someone/something · b) a museum · c) a guided tour  
3. *Statue* = ____. → a) a figure of a person or animal in stone/metal · b) a monument only · c) a museum  
4. *Guided tour* = ____. → a) a visit with a guide who explains · b) a museum only · c) a statue  
5. *Sightseeing* = ____. → a) visiting famous places · b) staying at a hotel · c) shopping only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) a place with art, history or objects**  
2. **a) a building or structure to remember someone/something**  
3. **a) a figure of a person or animal in stone/metal**  
4. **a) a visit with a guide who explains**  
5. **a) visiting famous places**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–7 — Empareja

6. Empareja: museum / monument / statue / guided tour / square → art and history · remember someone/something · figure in stone · guide explains · open place in town  
7. Empareja: the most famous / the oldest / church / building / city → superlative · superlative of old · religious building · structure · town/city

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **museum → art and history** · **monument → remember someone/something** · **statue → figure in stone** · **guided tour → guide explains** · **square → open place in town**  
7. **the most famous → superlative** · **the oldest → superlative of old** · **church → religious building** · **building → structure** · **city → town/city**

</details>

### Ejercicios 8–13 — Completa / elige

8. We visited ____ museum yesterday. → *the / a / this*  
9. There is a ____ in the square. → *statue / museum / guided tour*  
10. We did a ____ of the old town. → *guided tour / monument / statue*  
11. *Square* = ____. → a) an open place in a town · b) a museum · c) a statue  
12. *Guide* = ____. → a) a person who shows and explains · b) a monument · c) a museum  
13. Where do you often see statues? → a) In squares, parks, near monuments · b) Only in museums · c) At home only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

8. **the**  
9. **statue**  
10. **guided tour**  
11. **a) an open place in a town**  
12. **a) a person who shows and explains**  
13. **a) In squares, parks, near monuments**

</details>

### Ejercicios 14–15 — Verdadero o falso

14. A guided tour has a guide who explains the place. → True / False  
15. A museum has collections; a monument is a structure. → True / False

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

14. **True**  
15. **True**

</details>

---

## Lección 3 — Reading: Yesterday in the city

**Objetivo:** leer sobre un día de sightseeing.

### Texto

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-48/reading-sightseeing.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Yesterday in the city"></audio>

> Yesterday we did sightseeing in the city. We visited the most famous museum. It is the oldest building in town. In the square there is a tall statue. We did a guided tour of the monument. The guide explained the history. It was very interesting. We took photos.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige la respuesta correcta

1. What did they do yesterday? → a) Sightseeing in the city · b) Stay at a hotel · c) Go to the beach  
2. What museum did they visit? → a) The most famous · b) The smallest · c) The newest  
3. What is the building? → a) The oldest in town · b) The newest · c) The biggest  
4. Where is the statue? → a) In the square · b) In the museum · c) At home  
5. What did they do at the monument? → a) A guided tour · b) Shopping · c) Swimming

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Sightseeing in the city**  
2. **a) The most famous**  
3. **a) The oldest in town**  
4. **a) In the square**  
5. **a) A guided tour**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Comprensión

6. What did the guide explain? → a) The history · b) The price · c) The food  
7. Was it interesting? → a) Yes, very interesting · b) No · c) The text does not say  
8. *Guided tour* means ____. → a) a visit with a guide who explains · b) a museum only · c) a statue  
9. *The most famous* is ____. → a) a superlative · b) a comparative · c) the present only  
10. *Statue* means ____. → a) a figure in stone or metal · b) a museum · c) a monument only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) The history**  
7. **a) Yes, very interesting**  
8. **a) a visit with a guide who explains**  
9. **a) a superlative**  
10. **a) a figure in stone or metal**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Detalles

11. The text is about ____. → a) sightseeing: museum, monument, guided tour · b) a hotel · c) the beach  
12. *The oldest* is ____. → a) the superlative of old · b) a comparative · c) the present  
13. *Square* means ____. → a) an open place in town · b) a museum · c) a monument  
14. *They took photos* means ____. → a) they made photographs · b) they bought photos · c) they lost photos  
15. The main topic is ____. → a) sightseeing with museum, statue and guided tour · b) shopping · c) hotel

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) sightseeing: museum, monument, guided tour**  
12. **a) the superlative of old**  
13. **a) an open place in town**  
14. **a) they made photographs**  
15. **a) sightseeing with museum, statue and guided tour**

</details>

---

## Lección 4 — Listening: Sightseeing today

**Objetivo:** escuchar un diálogo sobre un día de turismo.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-48/listening-sightseeing.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Sightseeing today"></audio>

> **A:** What did you do today?  
> **B:** We did sightseeing. We visited the most famous museum. It is the oldest building in the city.  
> **A:** Did you do a guided tour?  
> **B:** Yes. We saw a big statue in the square. The guide explained the monument.  
> **A:** Was it good?  
> **B:** Yes, it was very interesting.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. What did B do today? → a) Sightseeing · b) Shopping · c) Stay at a hotel  
2. What museum did B visit? → a) The most famous · b) The smallest · c) The newest  
3. What is the building? → a) The oldest in the city · b) The biggest · c) The most beautiful  
4. Did B do a guided tour? → a) Yes · b) No · c) The dialogue does not say  
5. Where did they see the statue? → a) In the square · b) In the museum · c) At home

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Sightseeing**  
2. **a) The most famous**  
3. **a) The oldest in the city**  
4. **a) Yes**  
5. **a) In the square**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. What did the guide explain? → a) The monument · b) The price · c) The food  
7. Was it good? → a) Yes, very interesting · b) No · c) The dialogue does not say  
8. *The most famous* is ____. → a) a superlative · b) a comparative · c) the present  
9. *Guided tour* means ____. → a) a visit with a guide · b) a museum only · c) a statue  
10. *Statue* means ____. → a) a figure in stone or metal · b) a museum · c) a monument only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) The monument**  
7. **a) Yes, very interesting**  
8. **a) a superlative**  
9. **a) a visit with a guide**  
10. **a) a figure in stone or metal**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. The dialogue is about ____. → a) sightseeing, museum, guided tour · b) a hotel · c) shopping  
12. *The oldest* is ____. → a) the superlative of old · b) a comparative · c) the present  
13. *Square* means ____. → a) an open place in town · b) a museum · c) a monument  
14. *We saw* is ____. → a) the past of we see · b) the present · c) the future  
15. What tense is used for today? → a) Past (*did, visited, saw*) · b) Present only · c) Future only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) sightseeing, museum, guided tour**  
12. **a) the superlative of old**  
13. **a) an open place in town**  
14. **a) the past of we see**  
15. **a) Past (*did, visited, saw*)**

</details>

---

## Lección 5 — Writing: My sightseeing day

**Objetivo:** escribir sobre sightseeing con superlativos.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. This is ____ most famous monument in the city. → *the / a / this*  
2. It is ____ oldest church in town. → *the / a / this*  
3. We ____ the museum yesterday. → *visited / visit / visiting*  
4. There is a ____ in the square. → *statue / museum / guided tour*  
5. We did ____ guided tour of the monument. → *a / the / an*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **the**  
2. **the**  
3. **visited**  
4. **statue**  
5. **a**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. This is / the / most famous / monument / in / the city.  
7. We / did / a / guided tour / of / the museum.  
8. It is / the / oldest / church / in / town.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. This is the most famous monument in the city.  
7. We did a guided tour of the museum.  
8. It is the oldest church in town.

</details>

### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Escribe el monumento o museo más famoso de tu ciudad (*the most famous*).  
10. Escribe: hiciste una visita guiada ayer (*did a guided tour*).  
11. Dos frases: visitaste el edificio más antiguo y viste una estatua en la plaza.  
12. Pregunta *Did you do sightseeing?* y respuesta breve.  
13. Párrafo corto (3–4 frases): turismo ayer — museo, monumento, visita guiada, estatua.  
14. 2–3 frases con *the most famous* y *the oldest*.  
15. Qué viste en la plaza y si hiciste visita guiada.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución (ejemplos)</summary>

9. This is the most famous monument in my city.  
10. We did a guided tour of the museum yesterday.  
11. I visited the oldest building in town. There was a statue in the square.  
12. Did you do sightseeing? Yes, we visited the museum.  
13. Yesterday we did sightseeing. We visited the most famous museum. We did a guided tour. There was a tall statue in the square.  
14. This is the most famous monument. It is the oldest church in town.  
15. There was a big statue in the square. We did a guided tour of the monument.

</details>

---

## Resumen rápido

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **the + -est** | the **oldest** church |
| **the most + adj.** | the **most famous** museum |
| **museum / monument** | We visited the museum. |
| **statue / square** | a statue in the square |
| **guided tour** | We did a guided tour. |

---

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 49 del curso A1** (*Packing a Suitcase*) con **soluciones comentadas**. Corresponde a las lecciones del curso: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening y writing.

> **Guía teórica:** [Packing A1](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-49-maleta-need-to)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 49 — Packing a Suitcase](/curso-a1/unit-49)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Need to / don't need to](/blog/curso-a1/unit-49/a1-unit49-need-to.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática: need to / don't need to](#leccion-1--gramatica-need-to--dont-need-to)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario: equipaje y maleta](#leccion-2--vocabulario-equipaje-y-maleta)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: Pack tonight](#leccion-3--reading-pack-tonight)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: Do you need to pack?](#leccion-4--listening-do-you-need-to-pack)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing: My suitcase](#leccion-5--writing-my-suitcase)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática: need to / don't need to

**Objetivo:** *need to* + verbo base; *don't / doesn't need to*.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I ____ pack my suitcase tonight. → *need to / need / needs to*  
2. You ____ take your passport. → *need to / don't need to / need*  
3. She ____ bring so many clothes. → *doesn't need to / need to / don't need to*  
4. We ____ take toiletries – toothbrush, soap. → *need to / needs to / to need*  
5. They ____ pack heavy bags for one week. → *don't need to / need to / doesn't need to*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **need to** — *need to* + verbo base.  
2. **need to**  
3. **doesn't need to** — he/she/it → *doesn't need to*.  
4. **need to**  
5. **don't need to** — they → *don't need to*.

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. *Need to* = ____. → a) necessity, have to · b) past · c) only advice  
7. After *need to* we use ____. → a) base verb (*pack, take*) · b) *to* + verb again · c) *-ing* only  
8. *Don't need to* = ____. → a) no necessity · b) obligation · c) past  
9. He/She ____ pack. → a) needs to · b) need to · c) don't need to  
10. *Essential items* = ____. → a) things you need · b) optional things · c) heavy things only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) necessity, have to**  
7. **a) base verb (*pack, take*)**  
8. **a) no necessity**  
9. **a) needs to**  
10. **a) things you need**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–13 — Ordena

11. I / need to / pack / my / suitcase / tonight.  
12. You / don't need to / take / so many / clothes.  
13. We / need to / take / toiletries.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. I need to pack my suitcase tonight.  
12. You don't need to take so many clothes.  
13. We need to take toiletries.

</details>

### Ejercicios 14–15 — Verdadero o falso

14. *Need to* is followed by a base verb (*pack*, *take*). → True / False  
15. *Don't need to* means it is not necessary. → True / False

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

14. **True**  
15. **True**

</details>

---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario: equipaje y maleta

**Objetivo:** *suitcase, pack, clothes, toiletries, essential items, passport*.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige el significado

1. *Suitcase* = ____. → a) a bag for travel; you pack clothes · b) a passport · c) a toothbrush  
2. *Toiletries* = ____. → a) soap, toothbrush, shampoo, etc. · b) clothes · c) a suitcase  
3. *Essential items* = ____. → a) things you need for the trip · b) optional things · c) heavy things only  
4. *Pack* = ____. → a) put things in a suitcase · b) open the suitcase · c) buy a suitcase  
5. *Toothbrush* = ____. → a) you use it to brush your teeth · b) soap · c) a suitcase

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) a bag for travel; you pack clothes**  
2. **a) soap, toothbrush, shampoo, etc.**  
3. **a) things you need for the trip**  
4. **a) put things in a suitcase**  
5. **a) you use it to brush your teeth**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–7 — Empareja

6. Empareja: suitcase / toiletries / clothes / essential / pack → pack clothes · soap and toothbrush · shirt and trousers · necessary · put in bag  
7. Empareja: passport / shampoo / towel / underwear / toothpaste → need for travel · toiletries · dry yourself · clothes · with toothbrush

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **suitcase → pack clothes** · **toiletries → soap and toothbrush** · **clothes → shirt and trousers** · **essential → necessary** · **pack → put in bag**  
7. **passport → need for travel** · **shampoo → toiletries** · **towel → dry yourself** · **underwear → clothes** · **toothpaste → with toothbrush**

</details>

### Ejercicios 8–13 — Completa / elige

8. I need to ____ my suitcase before the trip. → *pack / packing / to pack*  
9. Don't forget ____ – toothbrush, soap, shampoo. → *toiletries / clothes / suitcase*  
10. Take ____ clothes – shirt, trousers, underwear. → *essential / suitcase / toiletries*  
11. *Soap* = ____. → a) for washing · b) for teeth · c) for hair only  
12. *Shampoo* = ____. → a) for washing hair · b) for the body only · c) for teeth  
13. What do you need to pack for a short trip? → a) Clothes, toiletries, passport · b) Only clothes · c) Nothing

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

8. **pack**  
9. **toiletries**  
10. **essential**  
11. **a) for washing**  
12. **a) for washing hair**  
13. **a) Clothes, toiletries, passport**

</details>

### Ejercicios 14–15 — Verdadero o falso

14. Toiletries include toothbrush, soap and shampoo. → True / False  
15. You need to pack your suitcase before a trip. → True / False

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

14. **True**  
15. **True**

</details>

## Lección 3 — Reading: Pack tonight

**Objetivo:** leer sobre hacer la maleta antes de un vuelo.

### Texto

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-49/reading-packing.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Pack tonight"></audio>

> I need to pack my suitcase tonight. My flight is tomorrow. I need to take clothes – shirts, trousers, underwear. I need to take toiletries too – toothbrush, soap, shampoo. I don't need to take so many things – only essential items. My suitcase is small. Passport and ticket are in my bag.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige la respuesta correcta

1. When does he/she need to pack? → a) Tonight · b) Tomorrow · c) Next week  
2. When is the flight? → a) Tomorrow · b) Tonight · c) Today  
3. What clothes does he/she need to take? → a) Shirts, trousers, underwear · b) Only shirts · c) Only toiletries  
4. What toiletries does he/she need? → a) Toothbrush, soap, shampoo · b) Only toothbrush · c) Only soap  
5. Does he/she need to take so many things? → a) No, only essential items · b) Yes · c) The text does not say

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Tonight**  
2. **a) Tomorrow**  
3. **a) Shirts, trousers, underwear**  
4. **a) Toothbrush, soap, shampoo**  
5. **a) No, only essential items**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Comprensión

6. How is the suitcase? → a) Small · b) Big · c) Heavy  
7. Where are passport and ticket? → a) In my bag · b) In the suitcase · c) At home  
8. *Need to* means ____. → a) necessity · b) past · c) only advice  
9. *Essential items* means ____. → a) things you need · b) optional things · c) heavy things only  
10. *Toiletries* means ____. → a) toothbrush, soap, shampoo, etc. · b) clothes · c) a suitcase

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Small**  
7. **a) In my bag**  
8. **a) necessity**  
9. **a) things you need**  
10. **a) toothbrush, soap, shampoo, etc.**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Detalles

11. The text is about ____. → a) packing a suitcase for a trip · b) the airport · c) a hotel  
12. *Don't need to* means ____. → a) no necessity · b) obligation · c) past  
13. *Pack* means ____. → a) put things in a suitcase · b) open a suitcase · c) buy a suitcase  
14. *Underwear* means ____. → a) clothes under outer clothes · b) a shirt · c) trousers only  
15. The main topic is ____. → a) what to pack: clothes, toiletries, essential items · b) the flight only · c) a hotel

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) packing a suitcase for a trip**  
12. **a) no necessity**  
13. **a) put things in a suitcase**  
14. **a) clothes under outer clothes**  
15. **a) what to pack: clothes, toiletries, essential items**

</details>

## Lección 4 — Listening: Do you need to pack?

**Objetivo:** escuchar un diálogo sobre hacer la maleta.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-49/listening-packing.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Do you need to pack?"></audio>

> **A:** Do you need to pack today?  
> **B:** Yes. I need to pack my suitcase. I need to take clothes and toiletries.  
> **A:** Do you need to take so many shirts?  
> **B:** No. I don't need to take so many. Only essential items.  
> **A:** Don't forget your passport and toothbrush.  
> **B:** I won't. They are in my bag.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Does B need to pack today? → a) Yes · b) No · c) The dialogue does not say  
2. What does B need to take? → a) Clothes and toiletries · b) Only clothes · c) Only toiletries  
3. Does B need to take so many shirts? → a) No, only essential items · b) Yes · c) The dialogue does not say  
4. What does A say not to forget? → a) Passport and toothbrush · b) Suitcase only · c) Clothes only  
5. Where are passport and toothbrush? → a) In B's bag · b) In the suitcase · c) At home

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Yes**  
2. **a) Clothes and toiletries**  
3. **a) No, only essential items**  
4. **a) Passport and toothbrush**  
5. **a) In B's bag**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. *Don't need to* means ____. → a) no necessity · b) obligation · c) past  
7. *Essential items* means ____. → a) things you need · b) optional things · c) heavy things only  
8. The dialogue is about ____. → a) packing for a trip · b) the airport · c) a hotel  
9. *Toiletries* means ____. → a) toothbrush, soap, shampoo, etc. · b) clothes · c) a suitcase  
10. *Pack* means ____. → a) put things in a suitcase · b) open a suitcase · c) buy a suitcase

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) no necessity**  
7. **a) things you need**  
8. **a) packing for a trip**  
9. **a) toothbrush, soap, shampoo, etc.**  
10. **a) put things in a suitcase**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *I won't* (forget) means ____. → a) I will not forget · b) I forgot · c) I forget  
12. *Need to* means ____. → a) necessity · b) past · c) only advice  
13. *Don't forget* means ____. → a) remember to take · b) forget · c) past  
14. *Suitcase* means ____. → a) a bag for travel · b) a passport · c) a toothbrush  
15. What tense is used for *need to / don't need to*? → a) Present (necessity) · b) Past · c) Future only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) I will not forget**  
12. **a) necessity**  
13. **a) remember to take**  
14. **a) a bag for travel**  
15. **a) Present (necessity)**

</details>

## Lección 5 — Writing: My suitcase

**Objetivo:** escribir sobre hacer la maleta con *need to / don't need to*.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I ____ pack my suitcase tonight. → *need to / need / needs to*  
2. You ____ take your passport. → *need to / don't need to / needs to*  
3. She ____ bring so many clothes. → *doesn't need to / need to / don't need to*  
4. Don't forget ____ – toothbrush, soap. → *toiletries / clothes / suitcase*  
5. We ____ take only essential items. → *need to / don't need to / needs to*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **need to**  
2. **need to**  
3. **doesn't need to**  
4. **toiletries**  
5. **need to**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. I / need to / pack / my / suitcase / tonight.  
7. You / don't need to / take / so many / clothes.  
8. We / need to / take / toiletries.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. I need to pack my suitcase tonight.  
7. You don't need to take so many clothes.  
8. We need to take toiletries.

</details>

### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Escribe qué necesitas hacer esta noche (*need to pack*).  
10. Escribe qué necesitas llevar (*clothes, toiletries*).  
11. Dos frases: algo que necesitas y algo que no necesitas.  
12. Lista corta de objetos esenciales (3–4 palabras).  
13. Párrafo corto (3–4 frases): qué necesitas y qué no.  
14. 2–3 frases *need to / don't need to* para un viaje de una semana.  
15. Qué no debes olvidar (*Don't forget…*).

<details>
<summary>Ver solución (ejemplos)</summary>

9. I need to pack my suitcase tonight.  
10. I need to take clothes and toiletries.  
11. I need to take my passport. I don't need to take so many shirts.  
12. Essential items: passport, toothbrush, clothes, soap.  
13. I need to pack my suitcase. I need to take clothes and toiletries. I don't need to take so many things. Only essential items.  
14. I need to take shirts, trousers, toothbrush. I don't need to take ten shirts.  
15. Don't forget your passport and toothbrush.

</details>

---

## Resumen rápido

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **need to** | I **need to** pack. |
| **don't need to** | You **don't need to** take so many. |
| **doesn't need to** | She **doesn't need to** bring… |
| **toiletries** | toothbrush, soap, shampoo |
| **essential items** | passport, ticket, clothes |

Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 50 del curso A1** (*Module 5 Review — Places & Travel*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [Repaso Módulo 5 A1](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-50-repaso-modulo-5)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 50 — Module 5 Review](/curso-a1/unit-50)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Module 5 map](/blog/curso-a1/unit-50/a1-unit50-module-map.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática: repaso](#leccion-1--gramatica-repaso)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario: repaso](#leccion-2--vocabulario-repaso)

## Lección 1 — Gramática: repaso

**Objetivo:** *take the / go by*, *It is*, *was/were*, *the most*, *need to*.

### Ejercicios 1–6 — Completa

1. I ____ train to London. → *take the / by the / take*  
2. We ____ bus to the airport. → *go by / go by the / take*  
3. It ____ sunny today. → *is / are / was*  
4. I ____ on the beach last week. → *was / were / am*  
5. This is ____ most famous monument in the city. → *the / a / this*  
6. I ____ pack my suitcase tonight. → *need to / need / needs to*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **take the** — *take the* + train/bus.  
2. **go by** — *go by* + bus/car/plane (sin *the*).  
3. **is**  
4. **was**  
5. **the**  
6. **need to**

</details>

### Ejercicios 7–10 — Elige

7. Correct: ____. → a) I go by bus · b) I go by the bus · c) I take bus  
8. Weather: ____ sunny. → a) It is · b) There is · c) Is it (statement)  
9. Past of *is/am* = ____. → a) was · b) were · c) is  
10. Superlative: ____ famous. → a) the most · b) more · c) most (alone)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

7. **a) I go by bus**  
8. **a) It is**  
9. **a) was**  
10. **a) the most**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–13 — Ordena

11. I / take the / train / to / work.  
12. It is / hot / in / summer.  
13. We / were / in / the mountains / last year.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. I take the train to work.  
12. It is hot in summer.  
13. We were in the mountains last year.

</details>

### Ejercicios 14–15 — Verdadero o falso

14. We say *take the train / take the bus*; we say *go by car / go by plane*. → True / False  
15. *Need to* and *don't need to* are followed by a base verb. → True / False

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

14. **True**  
15. **True**

</details>

---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario: repaso

**Objetivo:** aeropuerto, hotel, vacaciones, sightseeing, packing.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige el significado

1. *Check-in* = ____. → a) where you get a boarding pass · b) the plane · c) luggage only  
2. *Reception* = ____. → a) the desk where you check in at a hotel · b) your room · c) a key  
3. *Souvenir* = ____. → a) a thing you buy to remember a place · b) a beach · c) a ticket  
4. *Guided tour* = ____. → a) a visit with a guide who explains · b) a museum only · c) a statue  
5. *Toiletries* = ____. → a) toothbrush, soap, shampoo, etc. · b) clothes · c) a suitcase

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) where you get a boarding pass**  
2. **a) the desk where you check in at a hotel**  
3. **a) a thing you buy to remember a place**  
4. **a) a visit with a guide who explains**  
5. **a) toothbrush, soap, shampoo, etc.**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–7 — Empareja

6. Empareja: sunny / single room / sightseeing / pack / boarding pass → weather · one person · visit places · put in suitcase · get at check-in  
7. Empareja: take the train / was/were / the most famous / need to / Can I have…? → transport · past of be · superlative · necessity · polite request

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **sunny → weather** · **single room → one person** · **sightseeing → visit places** · **pack → put in suitcase** · **boarding pass → get at check-in**  
7. **take the train → transport** · **was/were → past of be** · **the most famous → superlative** · **need to → necessity** · **Can I have…? → polite request**

</details>

### Ejercicios 8–13 — Completa / elige

8. I ____ the bus to the airport. → *take / go by / by*  
9. It is ____ today – take an umbrella. → *rainy / sunny / hot*  
10. We ____ the museum yesterday. → *visited / visit / visiting*  
11. *Essential items* = ____. → a) things you need · b) optional things · c) heavy things only  
12. *Gate* = ____. → a) where you board the plane · b) check-in · c) passport  
13. *Room service* = ____. → a) food or help to your room · b) reception · c) a key

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

8. **take**  
9. **rainy**  
10. **visited**  
11. **a) things you need**  
12. **a) where you board the plane**  
13. **a) food or help to your room**

</details>

### Ejercicios 14–15 — Verdadero o falso

14. With seasons we use *in*: *in summer*, *in winter*. → True / False  
15. Module 5 covers travel: airport, hotel, holidays, sightseeing, packing. → True / False

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

14. **True**  
15. **True**

</details>

## Lección 3 — Reading: Last month

**Objetivo:** leer un viaje que mezcla temas del Módulo 5.

### Texto

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-50/reading-review.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Last month"></audio>

> Last month I went on holiday. I took the train to the airport. The weather was sunny. I was at the hotel for one week. I did sightseeing – I visited the most famous museum. I needed to pack my suitcase with clothes and toiletries. I didn't need to take so many things. It was great.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige la respuesta correcta

1. When did he/she go on holiday? → a) Last month · b) Last week · c) Yesterday  
2. How did he/she go to the airport? → a) By train (*took the train*) · b) By bus · c) By car  
3. How was the weather? → a) Sunny · b) Rainy · c) Cold  
4. Where was he/she for one week? → a) At the hotel · b) At the airport · c) At home  
5. What museum did he/she visit? → a) The most famous · b) The smallest · c) The newest

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Last month**  
2. **a) By train (*took the train*)**  
3. **a) Sunny**  
4. **a) At the hotel**  
5. **a) The most famous**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Comprensión

6. What did he/she need to pack? → a) Clothes and toiletries · b) Only clothes · c) Only toiletries  
7. Did he/she need to take so many things? → a) No · b) Yes · c) The text does not say  
8. *Took the train* means ____. → a) went by train · b) went by bus · c) went by car  
9. *The most famous* is ____. → a) a superlative · b) a comparative · c) the present only  
10. *Didn't need to* means ____. → a) no necessity in the past · b) obligation · c) future only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Clothes and toiletries**  
7. **a) No**  
8. **a) went by train**  
9. **a) a superlative**  
10. **a) no necessity in the past**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Detalles

11. The text is about ____. → a) a trip: transport, hotel, sightseeing, packing · b) only the airport · c) only a hotel  
12. *Was* is ____. → a) the past of is/am · b) the present · c) the future  
13. *Sightseeing* means ____. → a) visiting places as a tourist · b) staying at a hotel · c) packing  
14. *Toiletries* means ____. → a) toothbrush, soap, shampoo, etc. · b) clothes · c) a suitcase  
15. The main topic is ____. → a) a complete trip: transport, weather, hotel, sightseeing, packing · b) only packing · c) only the airport

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) a trip: transport, hotel, sightseeing, packing**  
12. **a) the past of is/am**  
13. **a) visiting places as a tourist**  
14. **a) toothbrush, soap, shampoo, etc.**  
15. **a) a complete trip: transport, weather, hotel, sightseeing, packing**

</details>

## Lección 4 — Listening: Review trip

**Objetivo:** escuchar un diálogo de repaso del Módulo 5.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-50/listening-review.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Review trip"></audio>

2. How was the weather yesterday? → a) Rainy · b) Sunny · c) Cold  
3. Was B at the hotel last week? → a) Yes · b) No · c) The dialogue does not say  
4. What did B visit? → a) The most famous museum · b) The beach · c) The mountains  
5. When does B need to pack? → a) Tonight · b) Tomorrow · c) Last week

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) By bus (*took the bus*)**  
2. **a) Rainy**  
3. **a) Yes**  
4. **a) The most famous museum**  
5. **a) Tonight**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. What does A say not to forget? → a) Passport · b) Suitcase · c) Ticket  
7. *Took the bus* means ____. → a) went by bus · b) went by train · c) went by car  
8. *Was* is ____. → a) the past of is/am · b) the present · c) the future  
9. *The most famous* is ____. → a) a superlative · b) a comparative · c) the present  
10. *Need to pack* means ____. → a) necessity to put things in a suitcase · b) past only · c) advice only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Passport**  
7. **a) went by bus**  
8. **a) the past of is/am**  
9. **a) a superlative**  
10. **a) necessity to put things in a suitcase**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. The dialogue covers ____. → a) transport, weather, hotel, sightseeing, packing · b) only the airport · c) only a hotel  
12. *I won't* means ____. → a) I will not forget · b) I forgot · c) I forget  
13. *Were you…?* is ____. → a) a past question with *you* · b) the present · c) the future  
14. *The weather was rainy* means ____. → a) It was rainy · b) It is rainy · c) It will be rainy  
15. Module 5 review is ____. → a) travel: airport, transport, weather, hotel, holidays, sightseeing, packing · b) only grammar · c) only vocabulary

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) transport, weather, hotel, sightseeing, packing**  
12. **a) I will not forget**  
13. **a) a past question with *you***  
14. **a) It was rainy**  
15. **a) travel: airport, transport, weather, hotel, holidays, sightseeing, packing**

</details>

## Lección 5 — Writing: My trip

**Objetivo:** escribir un viaje con estructuras del Módulo 5.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I ____ the bus to work. → *take / go by / by*  
2. It ____ rainy today. → *is / are / was*  
3. They ____ in the mountains last year. → *were / was / are*  
4. This is ____ oldest church in town. → *the / a / this*  
5. You ____ take so many shirts. → *don't need to / need to / needs to*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **take**  
2. **is**  
3. **were**  
4. **the**  
5. **don't need to**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. I / go by / bus / to / the airport.  
7. It was / sunny / last week.  
8. I / need to / take / clothes / and / toiletries.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. I go by bus to the airport.  
7. It was sunny last week.  
8. I need to take clothes and toiletries.

</details>

### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Cómo vas al aeropuerto (*take the / go by*).  
10. El tiempo ayer (*It was…*).  
11. Dos frases: dónde estuviste (*was/were*) y qué visitaste.  
12. Petición en el hotel + qué necesitas meter en la maleta.  
13. Párrafo corto (3–4 frases): transporte, tiempo, hotel/turismo, equipaje.  
14. 2–3 frases: *was/were*, *the most famous*, *need to / don't need to*.  
15. Qué debes hacer en el aeropuerto (*must*) + pregunta para el hotel (*Is there…?*).

<details>
<summary>Ver solución (ejemplos)</summary>

9. I take the train to the airport.  
10. It was sunny yesterday.  
11. I was on the beach last week. I visited the old town.  
12. Can I have a key? I need to take toiletries.  
13. I took the train to the airport. The weather was sunny. I was at the hotel for one week. I need to pack my suitcase.  
14. We were in the most famous museum. I don't need to take so many things.  
15. You must show your passport at check-in. Is there Wi-Fi in the hotel?

</details>

---

## Resumen rápido

| Bloque | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **take the / go by** | I **take the** train. I **go by** bus. |
| **weather** | It **is** sunny. It **was** rainy. |
| **was / were** | I **was** at the hotel. We **were** there. |
| **superlative** | the **most famous** museum |
| **need to** | I **need to** pack. |

---
