title: Feelings & Emotions A2: I feel…, excited, worried, proud
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 54 del curso A2: expresar sentimientos con I feel… / I'm… y vocabulario de emociones, con audios y ejercicios.
description: Expresa sentimientos en inglés A2: I feel…, I'm…, excited, worried, bored, disappointed, proud, nervous. Guía Unidad 54 con audios y ejercicios.
alt: Esquema Feelings & Emotions A2

faqs.question: ¿Se dice I feel bored o I am boring?
faqs.answer: I feel bored / I'm bored = me aburro. Boring describe algo/alguien que aburre: The film is boring.

faqs.question: ¿I feel o I'm con emociones?
faqs.answer: Ambos son frecuentes: I feel nervous. / I'm nervous. Con adjetivos de emoción suelen intercambiarse en A2.

faqs.question: ¿Excited o exciting?
faqs.answer: Excited = cómo te sientes. Exciting = cómo es la cosa: I'm excited about the trip. / The trip is exciting.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo pregunto cómo se siente alguien?
faqs.answer: How do you feel? / How are you feeling? / Are you OK?

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 54 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el [cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-54-feelings-emotions-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la Unidad 54 del curso A2 de Linguafly practicarás vocabulario de emociones y cómo te sientes.

content:
En la [Unidad 53](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-53-expressing-opinions) diste opiniones. En la **Unidad 54 del curso A2** (*Feelings & Emotions*) describes **cómo te sientes**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 54 — Feelings & Emotions](/curso-a2/unit-54)  
> **Antes:** [U53 — Expressing Opinions](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-53-expressing-opinions)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 54 (A2)

- Estructuras: **I feel…**, **I'm…**, **How do you feel?**
- Vocabulario: **excited**, **worried**, **bored**, **disappointed**, **proud**, **nervous**
- Diferencia *-ed* vs *-ing* (*bored / boring*)
- Hablar de emociones en experiencias cotidianas
- Describir cómo te sientes en 5–8 líneas

![Feelings & Emotions A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-54/a2-unit54-feelings-emotions.png)

---

## 1. Vocabulario de emociones

| Adjetivo | Idea | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **excited** | emocionado/a (ilusión) | I'm **excited** about the trip. |
| **worried** | preocupado/a | She's **worried** about the exam. |
| **bored** | aburrido/a (tú) | I'm **bored** at home. |
| **disappointed** | decepcionado/a | He felt **disappointed**. |
| **proud** | orgulloso/a | We're **proud** of you. |
| **nervous** | nervioso/a | I feel **nervous** before interviews. |
| **happy / sad** | feliz / triste | I feel **happy** today. |
| **angry / tired** | enfadado / cansado | He's **angry**. / I'm **tired**. |

![Emotion words](/blog/curso-a2/unit-54/a2-unit54-emotion-words.png)

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-54/i-feel-excited.mp3" title="🔊 I feel excited about the trip."></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-54/im-worried.mp3" title="🔊 I'm worried about the exam."></audio>

---

## 2. *I feel…* e *I'm…*

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| I feel + adjective | I **feel nervous**. |
| I'm + adjective | **I'm** proud of my team. |
| How do you feel? | **How do you feel** today? |
| I feel like + -ing | I **feel like** staying in. |

> **How are you feeling?** — A bit tired, but OK.  
> I **feel disappointed** about the result.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-54/how-do-you-feel.mp3" title="🔊 How do you feel today?"></audio>

---

## 3. *-ed* vs *-ing* (importante)

| Cómo te sientes (*-ed*) | Cómo es la cosa (*-ing*) |
| :--- | :--- |
| I'm **bored**. | The lesson is **boring**. |
| I'm **excited**. | The news is **exciting**. |
| I'm **interested**. | The book is **interesting**. |
| I'm **tired**. | The work is **tiring**. |

> The film was **boring**, so I felt **bored**.

---

## 4. Preposiciones útiles

| Patrón | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| excited **about** | excited about the concert |
| worried **about** | worried about money |
| proud **of** | proud of my sister |
| disappointed **with / about** | disappointed with the service |
| nervous **about** | nervous about the test |

---

## 5. Mapa rápido

| Quieres… | Usa… | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Decir cómo te sientes | I feel / I'm + adj | I feel proud. |
| Preguntar | How do you feel? | How do you feel? |
| Causa | about / of / with | worried about… |
| Emoción vs causa | -ed / -ing | bored / boring |

![Feelings scene](/blog/curso-a2/unit-54/a2-unit54-feelings-scene.png)

---

## 6. Lectura y diálogo

### Lectura — Before the interview

Tomorrow I have a job interview. I feel **nervous**, but also **excited**. My mum says I should be **proud** of my CV. Last week I was **disappointed** about another interview, so I'm a bit **worried**. I don't want to feel **bored** waiting all morning — I'll take a book. How do I feel right now? Hopeful!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-54/reading-interview.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Before the interview"></audio>

### Diálogo — After an exam

**Mia:** How do you **feel**?  
**Omar:** I'm **relieved** — and a bit **tired**.  
**Mia:** Were you **nervous**?  
**Omar:** Yes. I was also **worried** about the listening part.  
**Mia:** You should be **proud**. You studied a lot.  
**Omar:** Thanks. I was **disappointed** last time, so this feels better.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-54/dialogue-exam.mp3" title="🔊 Dialogue: After an exam"></audio>

### Mini práctica

1. I feel ___ about the trip. *(ilusión)*  
2. I'm ___ about the exam. *(preocupado)*  
3. How do you ___ ?  
4. The film is ___ , so I feel ___. *(aburrido / me aburro)*

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-54/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 Practice four sentences"></audio>

---

## 7. Errores frecuentes

1. ~~I am boring.~~ *(si te aburres)* → **I'm bored.**  
2. ~~I feel me happy.~~ → **I feel happy.**  
3. ~~I'm excite.~~ → **I'm excited.**  
4. ~~proud for you~~ → **proud of you**  
5. ~~worried of the exam~~ → **worried about** the exam  
6. ~~How you feel?~~ → **How do you feel?**

---

## 8. Ejercicios (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — Empareja

1. excited  
2. worried  
3. bored  
4. proud  
5. disappointed  

a) not happy with the result  
b) looking forward / full of energy about something  
c) thinking something bad may happen  
d) nothing interesting to do  
e) happy about someone's success (including yours)

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1 → b  
2 → c  
3 → d  
4 → e  
5 → a  

</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Completa con la emoción

1. The test is tomorrow → I feel ___.  
2. My team won → I'm ___.  
3. Nothing to do at home → I'm ___.  
4. The concert is next week → I'm ___ about it.  
5. We lost the final → I felt ___.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. nervous / worried  
2. proud / happy / excited  
3. bored  
4. excited  
5. disappointed / sad  

</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — *-ed* o *-ing*

1. I'm ___ (bore). The lesson is ___ (bore).  
2. She's ___ (excite) about the news. The news is ___ (excite).  
3. This job is ___ (tire). I feel ___ (tire).

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. bored / boring  
2. excited / exciting  
3. tiring / tired  

</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Preposiciones

1. excited ___ the party  
2. worried ___ the results  
3. proud ___ my brother  
4. nervous ___ flying

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. about  
2. about  
3. of  
4. about  

</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Corrige el error

1. I am boring today.  
2. I feel me sad.  
3. I'm proud for you.  
4. How you feel?  
5. I'm worry about money.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. I'm bored today.  
2. I feel sad.  
3. I'm proud of you.  
4. How do you feel?  
5. I'm worried about money.

</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Traduce al inglés

1. Estoy emocionado/a por el viaje.  
2. Me siento nervioso/a.  
3. Estoy preocupado/a por el examen.  
4. Estamos orgullosos de ti.  
5. ¿Cómo te sientes?

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. I'm excited about the trip. / I feel excited about the trip.  
2. I feel nervous. / I'm nervous.  
3. I'm worried about the exam.  
4. We're proud of you.  
5. How do you feel?

</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Completa el diálogo

**A:** How do you ___ ?  
**B:** A bit ___ about the interview.  
**A:** Don't worry — you should be ___ of your work.  
**B:** Thanks. Last time I was ___ , so I want this to go well.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

feel  
nervous / worried  
proud  
disappointed  

</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Ordena

1. feel / I / nervous  
2. about / worried / I'm / the / exam  
3. of / proud / We're / you

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. I feel nervous.  
2. I'm worried about the exam.  
3. We're proud of you.  

</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Elige la mejor opción

1. The film was ___, so I left.  
   a) bored  b) boring  c) bore  
2. I'm ___ about my driving test.  
   a) nervous  b) nervousing  c) nervously  
3. She's ___ of her daughter.  
   a) proud  b) pride  c) proudly

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. b  
2. a  
3. a  

</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Cómo te sientes (8–12 líneas)

Describe un momento reciente. Incluye:

- **I feel / I'm** + 3 emociones  
- 1 preposición (*about / of*)  
- 1 contraste *-ed / -ing*  
- **How do you feel?** (pregunta a alguien) o respuesta

**Modelo:** la lectura de la sección 6.

---

## 9. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Vocabulario + *I feel / I'm*  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–6.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha lectura y diálogo.  
4. **5–8 min** — Ejercicio 10.

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *I feel…* / *I'm…* con emociones  
- [ ] Distingo *bored / boring*, *excited / exciting*  
- [ ] Uso *about / of* correctamente  
- [ ] Pregunto *How do you feel?*  
- [ ] Evito *I am boring* e *I feel me…*

---

## 10. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Di en voz alta cada mañana: *Today I feel…*  
2. Etiqueta emociones en series/canciones (*She looks worried*).  
3. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 54](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-54-feelings-emotions-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 54 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-54).

La **Unidad 55** es **The Environment** (medio ambiente).

---

## Resumen rápido

| | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Sentir | I feel + adj | I feel nervous. |
| Estado | I'm + adj | I'm proud. |
| Preguntar | How do you feel? | How do you feel? |
| *-ed* | cómo te sientes | I'm bored. |
| *-ing* | cómo es la cosa | It's boring. |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 55** verás **The Environment**.

Curso:

- [Unidad 55 — The Environment](/curso-a2/unit-55)

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 54 A2 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-54-feelings-emotions-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [Unidad 54 — Feelings & Emotions](/curso-a2/unit-54)

Guías relacionadas:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 54 A2 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-54-feelings-emotions-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [U53 — Expressing Opinions](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-53-expressing-opinions)
- [U47 — Health & Body](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-47-health-body)
- [Inglés A2: guía del nivel](/blog/metodos/ingles-a2)

---

## Fuentes

- CEFR/MCER — Nivel A2: https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages
- Cambridge English — A2 Key: https://www.cambridgeenglish.org/exams-and-tests/key/
- British Council — Feelings: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/

title: The Environment A2: recycle, save water, should
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 55 del curso A2: hablar del medio ambiente con recycle, save, pollution y should, con audios y ejercicios.
description: Medio ambiente en inglés A2: recycle, save, pollute, plastic, pollution. Consejos con should. Guía Unidad 55 con audios y ejercicios.
alt: Esquema The Environment A2

faqs.question: ¿Environment o environmental?
faqs.answer: Environment es el sustantivo (the environment). Environmental es el adjetivo (environmental problems).

faqs.question: ¿Recycle o recycling?
faqs.answer: Recycle es el verbo: We recycle plastic. Recycling puede ser gerundio o sustantivo: Recycling is important.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo doy consejos ecológicos?
faqs.answer: Con should / shouldn't: You should recycle. You shouldn't waste water.

faqs.question: ¿Pollution o pollute?
faqs.answer: Pollution = contaminación (sustantivo). Pollute = contaminar (verbo): Factories pollute the air. / Air pollution is a problem.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 55 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el [cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-55-the-environment-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la Unidad 55 del curso A2 de Linguafly practicarás vocabulario y consejos sobre el medio ambiente.

content:
En la [Unidad 54](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-54-feelings-emotions) expresaste emociones. En la **Unidad 55 del curso A2** (*The Environment*) hablas del **medio ambiente** y de **acciones cotidianas**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 55 — The Environment](/curso-a2/unit-55)  
> **Antes:** [U54 — Feelings & Emotions](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-54-feelings-emotions)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 55 (A2)

- Vocabulario: **recycle**, **save water**, **pollution**, **plastic**, **environment**
- Verbos: **recycle**, **save**, **pollute**, **waste**, **reuse**
- Consejos: **should / shouldn't**
- Entender textos de sostenibilidad
- Decir qué haces tú por el planeta

![The Environment A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-55/a2-unit55-the-environment.png)

---

## 1. Vocabulario clave

| Palabra | Idea | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **environment** | medio ambiente | Protect the **environment**. |
| **recycle** | reciclar | We **recycle** glass and paper. |
| **pollution** | contaminación | Air **pollution** is a problem. |
| **pollute** | contaminar | Cars **pollute** the air. |
| **plastic** | plástico | Use less **plastic**. |
| **save** | ahorrar / salvar | **Save** water and energy. |
| **waste** | desperdiciar | Don't **waste** food. |
| **reuse** | reutilizar | **Reuse** your bags. |

También: **rubbish / trash**, **bin**, **public transport**, **energy**, **climate**.

---

## 2. Acciones cotidianas

| Acción | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| recycle | I **recycle** bottles every week. |
| save water | Turn off the tap — **save water**. |
| save energy | Turn off the lights to **save energy**. |
| use less plastic | I try to **use less plastic**. |
| walk / cycle / take the bus | I **go by bike** to work. |
| plant trees | They **plant trees** in the park. |

![Eco actions](/blog/curso-a2/unit-55/a2-unit55-eco-actions.png)

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-55/we-recycle.mp3" title="🔊 We recycle glass and paper."></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-55/save-water.mp3" title="🔊 Save water and energy."></audio>

---

## 3. Consejos con *should*

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| should + verbo | You **should** recycle. |
| shouldn't + verbo | You **shouldn't** waste water. |
| We should… | **We should** use public transport. |

> You **should** take a reusable bag.  
> People **shouldn't** throw plastic in the sea.

Repaso: [Should / Ought to](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-38-should-ought-to).

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-55/you-should-recycle.mp3" title="🔊 You should recycle."></audio>

---

## 4. Hablar de problemas

| Problema | Frase útil |
| :--- | :--- |
| pollution | There's a lot of **pollution** in cities. |
| plastic | **Plastic** stays in nature for years. |
| waste | Food **waste** is a big problem. |
| cutting trees | Cutting trees is bad for the **environment**. |

> Factories **pollute** rivers.  
> We need cleaner air.

---

## 5. Mapa rápido

| Quieres… | Usa… | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Acción positiva | recycle / save / reuse | Recycle plastic. |
| Problema | pollution / waste | Air pollution… |
| Consejo | should / shouldn't | You should walk more. |
| Tema general | the environment | Protect the environment. |

![Recycle scene](/blog/curso-a2/unit-55/a2-unit55-recycle-scene.png)

---

## 6. Lectura y diálogo

### Lectura — Green tips at home

Protecting the **environment** starts at home. You **should recycle** paper, glass and **plastic**. **Save water** when you brush your teeth, and turn off lights to **save energy**. **Don't waste** food. If you can, walk or take the bus — cars **pollute** the air. Small actions help every day.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-55/reading-tips.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Green tips at home"></audio>

### Diálogo — At the supermarket

**Ana:** We **shouldn't** buy so many plastic bags.  
**Leo:** You're right. We **should** reuse this one.  
**Ana:** Do you **recycle** at home?  
**Leo:** Yes — paper and bottles. I also try to **save water**.  
**Ana:** Good. **Pollution** is getting worse in the city.  
**Leo:** Let's walk more and use the bus.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-55/dialogue-shop.mp3" title="🔊 Dialogue: At the supermarket"></audio>

### Mini práctica

1. We ___ glass and paper. *(reciclar)*  
2. ___ water when you can.  
3. You ___ recycle. *(should)*  
4. Cars ___ the air. *(contaminan)*

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-55/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 Practice four sentences"></audio>

---

## 7. Errores frecuentes

1. ~~the nature~~ *(a menudo)* → **nature** / **the environment**  
2. ~~You should to recycle.~~ → **You should recycle.**  
3. ~~pollutions~~ → **pollution** (incontable en este uso)  
4. ~~recycle the environment~~ → **protect** the environment / **recycle** plastic  
5. ~~save the water always~~ → **save water**  
6. ~~I'm recycle~~ → **I recycle**

---

## 8. Ejercicios (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — Empareja

1. recycle  
2. pollution  
3. save  
4. waste  
5. plastic  

a) use less / not throw away energy or water  
b) material in bottles and bags  
c) dirty air, water or land  
d) use again after processing  
e) use badly or throw away useful things

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1 → d  
2 → c  
3 → a  
4 → e  
5 → b  

</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Completa

1. We ___ bottles every week.  
2. ___ water — turn off the tap.  
3. You ___ use public transport.  
4. You ___ throw plastic in the sea.  
5. Cars ___ the air.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. recycle  
2. Save  
3. should  
4. shouldn't  
5. pollute  

</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — *should* / *shouldn't*

1. People ___ recycle more.  
2. We ___ waste food.  
3. You ___ walk or cycle when you can.  
4. Factories ___ pollute rivers.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. should  
2. shouldn't  
3. should  
4. shouldn't  

</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Corrige el error

1. You should to recycle.  
2. There are many pollutions in the city.  
3. Save the water always.  
4. I am recycle at home.  
5. Protect the nature environment. *(elige una forma natural)*

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. You should recycle.  
2. There is a lot of pollution in the city.  
3. Always save water. / Save water.  
4. I recycle at home.  
5. Protect the environment. / Protect nature.

</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Traduce al inglés

1. Reciclamos papel y plástico.  
2. Ahorra agua.  
3. Deberías usar menos plástico.  
4. No deberías desperdiciar comida.  
5. Los coches contaminan el aire.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. We recycle paper and plastic.  
2. Save water.  
3. You should use less plastic.  
4. You shouldn't waste food.  
5. Cars pollute the air.

</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Completa el diálogo

**A:** Do you ___ at home?  
**B:** Yes. We also try to ___ water and energy.  
**A:** Good. We ___ buy so many plastic bags.  
**B:** Agreed. ___ is a big problem in the city.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

recycle  
save  
shouldn't  
Pollution  

</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Elige la mejor opción

1. ___ the environment is important.  
   a) Protect  b) Recycle  c) Pollute  
2. Don't ___ food.  
   a) save  b) waste  c) recycle  
3. Use ___ plastic.  
   a) less  b) many  c) much more always

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. a  
2. b  
3. a  

</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Ordena

1. should / You / recycle  
2. water / Save / energy / and  
3. pollute / Cars / the / air

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. You should recycle.  
2. Save water and energy.  
3. Cars pollute the air.  

</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — True / False

> You should recycle paper, glass and plastic. Save water when you brush your teeth.

1. Recycling plastic is a good idea.  
2. The tip says wasting water is fine.  
3. Paper can be recycled.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. True  
2. False  
3. True  

</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Tu plan verde (8–12 líneas)

Escribe qué haces (o deberías hacer) por el medio ambiente. Incluye:

- 2 acciones (*recycle / save / reuse…*)  
- 2 *should / shouldn't*  
- *pollution* o *plastic*  
- *the environment*

**Modelo:** la lectura de la sección 6.

---

## 9. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Vocabulario + acciones  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–6.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha tips y diálogo.  
4. **5–8 min** — Ejercicio 10.

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *recycle / save / reuse / waste / pollute*  
- [ ] Doy consejos con *should / shouldn't*  
- [ ] Hablo de *pollution* y *plastic*  
- [ ] Uso *the environment*  
- [ ] Evito *should to* y *pollutions*

---

## 10. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Lista 5 acciones verdes en voz alta cada día.  
2. Lee una tip card en inglés (ayuntamiento / ONG) y resume en 3 frases.  
3. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 55](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-55-the-environment-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 55 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-55).

La **Unidad 56** es **Technology & Communication**.

---

## Resumen rápido

| | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Reciclar | recycle | We recycle plastic. |
| Ahorrar | save | Save water. |
| Contaminar | pollute / pollution | Cars pollute. |
| Consejo | should | You should recycle. |
| Tema | the environment | Protect the environment. |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 56** verás **Technology & Communication**.

Curso:

- [Unidad 56 — Technology & Communication](/curso-a2/unit-56)

Practica ahora:

Guías relacionadas:

title: Technology & Communication A2: email, download, WiFi
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 56 del curso A2: hablar de tecnología e internet con send, download, WiFi y phrasal verbs básicos, con audios y ejercicios.
description: Tecnología en inglés A2: send, receive, download, upload; email, website, app, WiFi, password. Guía Unidad 56 con audios y ejercicios.
alt: Esquema Technology & Communication A2

faqs.question: ¿Download o upload?
faqs.answer: Download = bajar del internet al dispositivo. Upload = subir del dispositivo a internet/nube.

faqs.question: ¿WiFi se escribe con guion?
faqs.answer: Suele verse Wi‑Fi o WiFi. En conversación: What's the WiFi password?

faqs.question: ¿Turn on the computer o open the computer?
faqs.answer: Turn on / switch on = encender. Open suele ser abrir un archivo, app o carpeta.

faqs.question: ¿Send an email to o send to an email?
faqs.answer: Send an email to someone / Send someone an email. También email someone.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 56 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el [cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-56-technology-communication-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la Unidad 56 del curso A2 de Linguafly practicarás tecnología y comunicación digital.

content:
En la [Unidad 55](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-55-the-environment) hablaste del medio ambiente. En la **Unidad 56 del curso A2** (*Technology & Communication*) hablas de **internet, dispositivos y mensajes**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 56 — Technology & Communication](/curso-a2/unit-56)  
> **Antes:** [U55 — The Environment](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-55-the-environment)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 56 (A2)

- Verbos: **send**, **receive**, **download**, **upload**
- Phrasal verbs: **turn on/off**, **log in**, **print out**, **look up**
- Vocabulario: **email**, **website**, **app**, **WiFi**, **password**, **screen**
- Entender instrucciones tecnológicas sencillas
- Describir cómo usas la tecnología

![Technology & Communication A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-56/a2-unit56-technology-communication.png)

---

## 1. Vocabulario: dispositivos y red

| Palabra | Idea | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **email** | correo electrónico | I send an **email** every morning. |
| **website** | sitio web | Open the company **website**. |
| **app** | aplicación | There's a useful language **app**. |
| **WiFi** | wifi | What's the **WiFi** password? |
| **password** | contraseña | Don't share your **password**. |
| **screen** | pantalla | The **screen** is too bright. |
| **message** | mensaje | I got your **message**. |
| **link** | enlace | Click on the **link**. |

También: **phone**, **laptop**, **charger**, **keyboard**, **mouse**, **battery**.

---

## 2. Verbos clave

| Verbo | Idea | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **send** | enviar | **Send** me the file. |
| **receive / get** | recibir | Did you **receive** my email? |
| **download** | descargar | **Download** the app. |
| **upload** | subir | **Upload** your photo. |
| **click** | hacer clic | **Click** here. |
| **search** | buscar | **Search** for the address. |

![Tech verbs](/blog/curso-a2/unit-56/a2-unit56-tech-verbs.png)

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-56/send-an-email.mp3" title="🔊 Send me an email."></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-56/download-the-app.mp3" title="🔊 Download the app."></audio>

---

## 3. Phrasal verbs tecnológicos

| Phrasal verb | Idea | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **turn on / turn off** | encender / apagar | **Turn on** your laptop. |
| **log in / log out** | iniciar / cerrar sesión | **Log in** with your password. |
| **print out** | imprimir | Can you **print out** this page? |
| **look up** | buscar (info) | **Look up** the word online. |
| **go online** | conectarse | I **go online** every evening. |
| **charge up** *(informal)* | cargar | I need to **charge** my phone. |

> **Turn off** the screen at night.  
> I can't **log in** — wrong password.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-56/turn-on-wifi.mp3" title="🔊 Turn on the WiFi."></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-56/log-in.mp3" title="🔊 Log in with your password."></audio>

---

## 4. Comunicación cotidiana

| Situación | Frase |
| :--- | :--- |
| Pedir WiFi | What's the **WiFi** password? |
| Confirmar email | Did you **get** my email? |
| Problema | My **screen** is frozen. / It won't **turn on**. |
| Instrucción | **Click** the link and **download** the file. |
| Seguridad | Change your **password** often. |

---

## 5. Mapa rápido

| Quieres… | Usa… | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Enviar | send | Send an email. |
| Bajar / subir | download / upload | Download the app. |
| Encender | turn on | Turn on WiFi. |
| Entrar | log in | Log in here. |
| Red | WiFi / password | WiFi password? |

![Device scene](/blog/curso-a2/unit-56/a2-unit56-device-scene.png)

---

## 6. Lectura y diálogo

### Lectura — How to join the class online

Open the **website** and **log in** with your email and **password**. Then **download** the class **app**. Turn on **WiFi** and click the **link** in your email. If you don't **receive** the message, check your spam folder. Please **upload** your homework before Friday.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-56/reading-online.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: How to join the class online"></audio>

### Diálogo — Tech problem

**Sam:** I can't **log in**.  
**Alex:** Did you **turn on** the **WiFi**?  
**Sam:** Yes. I also **downloaded** the app.  
**Alex:** Try another **password**. Or **send** me a screenshot.  
**Sam:** OK. Can you **look up** the help page?  
**Alex:** Sure — I'll send you the **link**.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-56/dialogue-tech.mp3" title="🔊 Dialogue: Tech problem"></audio>

### Mini práctica

1. ___ me an email. *(enviar)*  
2. ___ the app. *(descargar)*  
3. ___ on the WiFi.  
4. ___ in with your password.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-56/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 Practice four sentences"></audio>

---

## 7. Errores frecuentes

1. ~~download an upload~~ → **download** / **upload** (direcciones opuestas)  
2. ~~open the computer~~ *(encender)* → **turn on** the computer  
3. ~~WiFi's password~~ → **the WiFi password** / **the password for the WiFi**  
4. ~~send me to an email~~ → **send me an email** / **send an email to me**  
5. ~~I am online go~~ → **I go online** / **I'm online**  
6. ~~click the website~~ → **open** the website / **go to** the website / **click the link**

---

## 8. Ejercicios (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — Empareja

1. download  
2. upload  
3. password  
4. WiFi  
5. screen  

a) secret code to log in  
b) wireless internet  
c) get a file from the internet  
d) put a file onto the internet  
e) the display on a phone or laptop

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1 → c  
2 → d  
3 → a  
4 → b  
5 → e  

</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Completa

1. ___ me the file, please.  
2. Did you ___ my message?  
3. ___ the app from the store.  
4. ___ your photo to the website.  
5. What's the ___ password?

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. Send  
2. receive / get  
3. Download  
4. Upload  
5. WiFi  

</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Phrasal verbs

1. ___ on your laptop.  
2. ___ in with your email.  
3. ___ up the word in a dictionary app.  
4. ___ off the screen at night.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. Turn  
2. Log  
3. Look  
4. Turn  

</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Corrige el error

1. Turn the WiFi.  
2. Download the photo to the cloud. *(quiere subir)*  
3. Send me to an email.  
4. I can't login me.  
5. Open the computer, please. *(encender)*

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. Turn on the WiFi.  
2. Upload the photo to the cloud.  
3. Send me an email.  
4. I can't log in.  
5. Turn on the computer, please.

</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Traduce al inglés

1. Envíame un email.  
2. Descarga la app.  
3. Enciende el WiFi.  
4. Inicia sesión con tu contraseña.  
5. ¿Cuál es la contraseña del WiFi?

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. Send me an email.  
2. Download the app.  
3. Turn on the WiFi.  
4. Log in with your password.  
5. What's the WiFi password?

</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Completa el diálogo

**A:** I can't ___ in.  
**B:** Did you turn ___ the WiFi?  
**A:** Yes. I also ___ the app.  
**B:** OK — I'll ___ you the link again.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

log  
on  
downloaded  
send  

</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Elige la mejor opción

1. Put a file on a website → ___  
   a) download  b) upload  c) receive  
2. Get a file from the internet → ___  
   a) upload  b) print  c) download  
3. Start using your account → ___  
   a) log in  b) turn off  c) look up

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. b  
2. c  
3. a  

</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Ordena

1. email / an / Send / me  
2. the / Download / app  
3. on / Turn / the / WiFi

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. Send me an email.  
2. Download the app.  
3. Turn on the WiFi.  

</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Instrucciones True / False

> Open the website and log in with your email and password. Then download the class app.

1. You need a password to log in.  
2. You should upload the class app first.  
3. The website comes before the app in these steps.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. True  
2. False (download)  
3. True  

</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Tu día digital (8–12 líneas)

Describe cómo usas la tecnología. Incluye:

- 2 verbos (*send / download / upload…*)  
- 2 phrasal verbs (*turn on / log in / look up…*)  
- *email* o *app*  
- *WiFi* o *password*

**Modelo:** la lectura de la sección 6.

---

## 9. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Vocabulario + verbos  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–6.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha instrucciones y diálogo.  
4. **5–8 min** — Ejercicio 10.

### Checklist

- [ ] Distingo *download* y *upload*  
- [ ] Uso *send / receive*  
- [ ] Uso *turn on/off* y *log in*  
- [ ] Pregunto por *WiFi password*  
- [ ] Evito *open the computer* para encender

---

## 10. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Narra en voz alta lo que haces en el móvil (1 minuto).  
2. Lee un email de instrucciones en inglés y marca los verbos.  
3. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 56](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-56-technology-communication-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 56 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-56).

La **Unidad 57** es **Work & Education**.

---

## Resumen rápido

| | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Enviar | send | Send an email. |
| Bajar / subir | download / upload | Download the app. |
| Encender | turn on | Turn on WiFi. |
| Sesión | log in | Log in here. |
| Red | WiFi / password | What's the WiFi password? |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 57** verás **Work & Education**.

Curso:

- [Unidad 57 — Work & Education](/curso-a2/unit-57)

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 56 A2 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-56-technology-communication-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [Unidad 56 — Technology & Communication](/curso-a2/unit-56)

Guías relacionadas:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 56 A2 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-56-technology-communication-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [U55 — The Environment](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-55-the-environment)
- [U31 — Phrasal verbs](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-31-phrasal-verbs-introduccion)
- [Email formal en inglés](/blog/trabajo/email-formal-ingles-estructura)
- [Inglés A2: guía del nivel](/blog/metodos/ingles-a2)

---

## Fuentes

- CEFR/MCER — Nivel A2: https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages
- Cambridge English — A2 Key: https://www.cambridgeenglish.org/exams-and-tests/key/

title: Work & Education A2: work as, study at, have to
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 57 del curso A2: hablar de trabajo y estudios con work as, study at y have to, con audios y ejercicios.
description: Trabajo y estudios en inglés A2: work as, study at, office, meeting, deadline, exam, have to. Guía Unidad 57 con audios y ejercicios.
alt: Esquema Work & Education A2

faqs.question: ¿Work as o work in?
faqs.answer: Work as + empleo/profesión: I work as a teacher. Work in + lugar/sector: I work in an office / in marketing.

faqs.question: ¿Study at o study in?
faqs.answer: Study at + institución: I study at university / at a language school. Study in + ciudad/país: I study in Madrid.

faqs.question: ¿Have to y must son lo mismo?
faqs.answer: En A2, have to expresa obligación (a menudo externa): I have to finish this today. Must es más fuerte/personal en muchos contextos. Repaso en U28.

faqs.question: ¿Job o work?
faqs.answer: Job es contable (a job). Work suele ser incontable (I have a lot of work).

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 57 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el [cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-57-work-education-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la Unidad 57 del curso A2 de Linguafly practicarás trabajo, estudios y obligaciones con have to.

content:
En la [Unidad 56](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-56-technology-communication) hablaste de tecnología. En la **Unidad 57 del curso A2** (*Work & Education*) describes tu **trabajo** o tus **estudios**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 57 — Work & Education](/curso-a2/unit-57)  
> **Antes:** [U56 — Technology & Communication](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-56-technology-communication)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 57 (A2)

- **Work as** / **work in** y **study at** / **study in**
- Present Simple para rutinas laborales y académicas
- Repaso: **have to / don't have to**
- Vocabulario: **office**, **meeting**, **deadline**, **subject**, **exam**, **graduation**
- Describir brevemente tu trabajo o tus estudios

![Work & Education A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-57/a2-unit57-work-education.png)

---

## 1. Vocabulario: trabajo

| Palabra | Idea | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **office** | oficina | I work in an **office**. |
| **meeting** | reunión | We have a **meeting** at 10. |
| **deadline** | fecha límite | The **deadline** is Friday. |
| **colleague** | compañero/a | My **colleagues** are friendly. |
| **boss / manager** | jefe/a | My **boss** is fair. |
| **salary** | sueldo | The **salary** is good. |
| **full-time / part-time** | jornada completa / parcial | I work **part-time**. |

---

## 2. Vocabulario: estudios

| Palabra | Idea | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **subject** | asignatura | My favourite **subject** is history. |
| **exam** | examen | I have an **exam** tomorrow. |
| **homework** | deberes | I do my **homework** at night. |
| **graduation** | graduación | **Graduation** is in June. |
| **degree** | titulación | She's doing a **degree** in law. |
| **student** | estudiante | I'm a university **student**. |

![Work or study](/blog/curso-a2/unit-57/a2-unit57-work-study.png)

---

## 3. *Work as / in* y *study at / in*

| Forma | Uso | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **work as** + job | profesión | I **work as** a nurse. |
| **work in** + place/field | lugar / sector | I **work in** a hospital. |
| **study at** + school/uni | institución | I **study at** university. |
| **study in** + city/country | ciudad / país | I **study in** Lisbon. |

> She **works as** a designer. She **works in** marketing.  
> He **studies at** a language school **in** Valencia.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-57/work-as.mp3" title="🔊 I work as a teacher."></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-57/study-at.mp3" title="🔊 I study at university."></audio>

---

## 4. Rutinas + *have to*

Present Simple para hábitos:

> I **start** work at 9.  
> She **studies** in the evening.

Obligación — **have to**:

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| have to / has to | I **have to** finish this today. |
| don't / doesn't have to | We **don't have to** wear a uniform. |
| Do/Does … have to…? | **Do** you **have to** work weekends? |

> I **have to** meet the **deadline**.  
> Students **have to** take an **exam** in June.

Repaso: [Have to / Don't have to](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-28-have-to-dont-have-to).

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-57/have-to-deadline.mp3" title="🔊 I have to finish this before the deadline."></audio>

---

## 5. Mapa rápido

| Quieres… | Usa… | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Profesión | work as | work as a teacher |
| Lugar de trabajo | work in | work in an office |
| Centro de estudios | study at | study at university |
| Obligación | have to | have to study |
| Vocab clave | meeting / exam… | a meeting at 10 |

![Office scene](/blog/curso-a2/unit-57/a2-unit57-office-scene.png)

---

## 6. Lectura y diálogo

### Lectura — Two routines

Mia **works as** a receptionist. She **works in** a small **office** and has many **meetings**. She often **has to** answer emails before the **deadline**. Leo **studies at** university. His favourite **subject** is biology. He **has to** take three **exams** this month. After **graduation**, he wants to work in a lab.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-57/reading-routines.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Two routines"></audio>

### Diálogo — At lunch

**Nora:** What do you do?  
**Pablo:** I **work as** a designer. I **work in** an advertising company.  
**Nora:** Do you **have to** go to many **meetings**?  
**Pablo:** Yes — almost every day. And you?  
**Nora:** I **study at** university. I have an **exam** on Monday.  
**Pablo:** Good luck!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-57/dialogue-lunch.mp3" title="🔊 Dialogue: At lunch"></audio>

### Mini práctica

1. I work ___ a nurse.  
2. I study ___ university.  
3. I ___ to finish this today.  
4. We have a ___ at 10. *(reunión)*

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-57/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 Practice four sentences"></audio>

---

## 7. Errores frecuentes

1. ~~I work like a teacher.~~ → **I work as a teacher.**  
2. ~~I study in university.~~ → **I study at university.**  
3. ~~I have to to go.~~ → **I have to go.**  
4. ~~I work in teacher.~~ → **I work as a teacher.** / **I work in a school.**  
5. ~~a work~~ → **a job** / **work** (incontable)  
6. ~~I am study~~ → **I study** / **I'm studying**

---

## 8. Ejercicios (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — Empareja

1. deadline  
2. meeting  
3. subject  
4. graduation  
5. office  

a) school subject like maths  
b) place where many people work at desks  
c) last day to finish something  
d) ceremony when you finish your studies  
e) planned discussion at work

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1 → c  
2 → e  
3 → a  
4 → d  
5 → b  

</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — *as / in / at*

1. I work ___ a waiter.  
2. I work ___ a restaurant.  
3. I study ___ a language school.  
4. I study ___ Berlin.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. as  
2. in  
3. at  
4. in  

</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — *have to*

1. I ___ finish this report today.  
2. She ___ wear a uniform. *(obligación)*  
3. We ___ come on Sunday. *(no es necesario)*  
4. ___ you ___ work late?

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. have to  
2. has to  
3. don't have to  
4. Do / have to  

</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Corrige el error

1. I work like a doctor.  
2. I study in university.  
3. I have to to study tonight.  
4. I have a work in Madrid.  
5. She work in an office.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. I work as a doctor.  
2. I study at university.  
3. I have to study tonight.  
4. I have a job in Madrid. / I work in Madrid.  
5. She works in an office.

</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Traduce al inglés

1. Trabajo de profesor/a.  
2. Estudio en la universidad.  
3. Tengo que terminar esto hoy.  
4. Tenemos una reunión a las 10.  
5. Mi asignatura favorita es historia.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. I work as a teacher.  
2. I study at university.  
3. I have to finish this today.  
4. We have a meeting at 10.  
5. My favourite subject is history.

</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Completa el diálogo

**A:** What do you do?  
**B:** I work ___ a nurse. I work ___ a hospital.  
**A:** Do you ___ to work nights?  
**B:** Sometimes. And you?  
**A:** I study ___ university. I have an ___ next week.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

as  
in  
have  
at  
exam  

</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Elige la mejor opción

1. The last day to finish a project is the ___.  
   a) meeting  b) deadline  c) subject  
2. After university you have your ___.  
   a) graduation  b) office  c) salary  
3. I ___ as an engineer.  
   a) work  b) study  c) have

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. b  
2. a  
3. a  

</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Ordena

1. as / work / I / a / designer  
2. at / study / I / university  
3. have / I / to / early / start

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. I work as a designer.  
2. I study at university.  
3. I have to start early.  

</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Lectura True / False

> Mia works as a receptionist in a small office. Leo studies at university and has to take three exams this month.

1. Mia's job is in an office.  
2. Leo doesn't have any exams.  
3. Mia works as a student.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. True  
2. False  
3. False  

</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Tu descripción (8–12 líneas)

Habla de tu trabajo o estudios. Incluye:

- *work as / work in* **o** *study at / study in*  
- 2 palabras de vocabulario (*meeting / deadline / subject / exam…*)  
- 1 *have to / don't have to*  
- 1 rutina en Present Simple

**Modelo:** la lectura de la sección 6.

---

## 9. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Vocabulario + *work as / study at*  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–6.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha lectura y diálogo.  
4. **5–8 min** — Ejercicio 10.

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *work as* y *work in*  
- [ ] Uso *study at* y *study in*  
- [ ] Aplico *have to / don't have to*  
- [ ] Uso *meeting, deadline, subject, exam*  
- [ ] Evito *work like* y *study in university*

---

## 10. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Graba 1 minuto sobre tu rutina laboral o de estudio.  
2. Reescribe tu LinkedIn/CV en inglés con *work as / study at*.  
3. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 57](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-57-work-education-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 57 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-57).

La **Unidad 58** es **Places & Buildings**.

---

## Resumen rápido

| | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Profesión | work as | I work as a teacher. |
| Lugar | work in | I work in an office. |
| Estudios | study at | I study at university. |
| Obligación | have to | I have to study. |
| Vocab | meeting / exam… | a meeting at 10 |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 58** verás **Places & Buildings**.

- [Unidad 58 — Places & Buildings](/curso-a2/unit-58)

Practica ahora:

title: Places & Buildings A2: There is/are, museum, located in
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 58 del curso A2: describir lugares y edificios con There is/are, located in y vocabulario urbano, con audios y ejercicios.
description: Describe lugares y edificios en inglés A2: There is/are, located in, museum, library, stadium. Guía Unidad 58 con audios y ejercicios.
alt: Esquema Places & Buildings A2

faqs.question: ¿There is o There are?
faqs.answer: There is + singular / incontable. There are + plural. There is a museum. / There are two libraries.

faqs.question: ¿Located in o situated in?
faqs.answer: Ambos sirven para ubicación. Located in es muy frecuente. The museum is located in the city centre.

faqs.question: ¿In the square o on the square?
faqs.answer: Suele decirse in the square / in the main square. On the corner es otra estructura útil.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo uso superlativos con edificios?
faqs.answer: The tallest building / the oldest church / the most famous museum in the city.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 58 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el [cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-58-places-buildings-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la Unidad 58 del curso A2 de Linguafly practicarás lugares, edificios y There is/are.

content:
En la [Unidad 57](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-57-work-education) hablaste de trabajo y estudios. En la **Unidad 58 del curso A2** (*Places & Buildings*) describes **lugares y edificios**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 58 — Places & Buildings](/curso-a2/unit-58)  
> **Antes:** [U57 — Work & Education](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-57-work-education)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 58 (A2)

- Repaso: **There is / There are**
- Ubicación: **located in**, **situated**, preposiciones de lugar
- Vocabulario: **museum**, **library**, **stadium**, **hospital**, **square**
- Superlativos con lugares (*the tallest*, *the most famous*)
- Describir un lugar o un edificio

![Places & Buildings A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-58/a2-unit58-places-buildings.png)

---

## 1. Vocabulario: lugares y edificios

| Palabra | Idea | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **museum** | museo | There's a modern **museum**. |
| **library** | biblioteca | The **library** opens at 9. |
| **stadium** | estadio | The **stadium** is huge. |
| **hospital** | hospital | The **hospital** is near the station. |
| **square** | plaza | We meet in the main **square**. |
| **bridge** | puente | There's an old **bridge**. |
| **tower** | torre | The **tower** is very tall. |
| **station** | estación | The train **station** is busy. |

También: **park**, **church**, **theatre / theater**, **shopping centre**, **city centre / downtown**.

---

## 2. *There is / There are* (repaso)

| Forma | Uso | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **There is** | singular / incontable | **There is** a museum. |
| **There are** | plural | **There are** three parks. |
| **Is there…?** | pregunta singular | **Is there** a library nearby? |
| **Are there…?** | pregunta plural | **Are there** any cafés? |
| **There isn't / aren't** | negativa | **There isn't** a stadium here. |

> **There is** a hospital next to the park.  
> **There are** two bridges over the river.

![There is / are](/blog/curso-a2/unit-58/a2-unit58-there-is-are.png)

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-58/there-is-a-museum.mp3" title="🔊 There is a museum in the centre."></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-58/there-are-two-parks.mp3" title="🔊 There are two parks near here."></audio>

---

## 3. Ubicación: *located in*, *situated*, preposiciones

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| is **located in** | The library is **located in** the city centre. |
| is **situated** near/on… | The hotel is **situated** near the river. |
| **next to / opposite / between** | The café is **opposite** the museum. |
| **in / on / at** | **in** the square / **on** the corner / **at** the station |

> The stadium is **located in** the north of the city.  
> The hospital is **next to** the bus station.

Repaso útil: [Preposiciones de lugar](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-9-preposiciones-lugar-movimiento).

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-58/located-in.mp3" title="🔊 The library is located in the city centre."></audio>

---

## 4. Superlativos con lugares

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| the + -est | the **tallest** building |
| the most + adj | the **most famous** museum |
| in + place | the oldest church **in** the town |

> It's the **biggest** square in the city.  
> This is the **most modern** library here.

Repaso: [Superlativos](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-6-superlativos-est-the-most).

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-58/tallest-building.mp3" title="🔊 It's the tallest building in the city."></audio>

---

## 5. Mapa rápido

| Quieres… | Usa… | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Presentar | There is/are | There is a museum. |
| Ubicar | located in / next to | located in the centre |
| Comparar | superlativo | the tallest tower |
| Nombrar | museum / square… | in the main square |

![City scene](/blog/curso-a2/unit-58/a2-unit58-city-scene.png)

---

## 6. Lectura y diálogo

### Lectura — A city guide

Welcome to Riverton. **There is** a beautiful main **square** in the centre. The art **museum** is **located** next to the square, and **there are** two cafés opposite it. The **library** is the **oldest** building in town. The football **stadium** is in the south. The **hospital** is near the station — easy to find.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-58/reading-guide.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: A city guide"></audio>

### Diálogo — Asking for places

**Tourist:** Excuse me. **Is there** a **library** near here?  
**Local:** Yes. It's **located in** Green Street, opposite the **museum**.  
**Tourist:** And **are there** any good cafés?  
**Local:** **There are** three in the main **square**.  
**Tourist:** Perfect. Is the **stadium** far?  
**Local:** No — it's the **biggest** building in the south.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-58/dialogue-tourist.mp3" title="🔊 Dialogue: Asking for places"></audio>

### Mini práctica

1. ___ is a museum in the centre.  
2. ___ are two parks near here.  
3. The library is ___ in the city centre.  
4. It's the ___ building in the city. *(más alto)*

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-58/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 Practice four sentences"></audio>

---

## 7. Errores frecuentes

1. ~~There is two museums.~~ → **There are** two museums.  
2. ~~It is locate in…~~ → **It is located in…**  
3. ~~the more tall building~~ → **the tallest** building  
4. ~~in the station~~ *(a menudo)* → **at the station**  
5. ~~Is there museums?~~ → **Are there** any museums?  
6. ~~There have a park.~~ → **There is** a park.

---

## 8. Ejercicios (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — Empareja

1. museum  
2. library  
3. stadium  
4. square  
5. hospital  

a) open space in a town where people meet  
b) place for books and study  
c) place for sports events  
d) place for art/history exhibitions  
e) place for medical care

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1 → d  
2 → b  
3 → c  
4 → a  
5 → e  

</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — *There is / There are*

1. ___ a stadium near the river.  
2. ___ three bridges in the city.  
3. ___ any hospitals here?  
4. ___ a library opposite the square.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. There is  
2. There are  
3. Are there  
4. There is  

</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Ubicación

1. The museum is located ___ the centre.  
2. The café is ___ the library. *(enfrente)*  
3. We meet ___ the main square.  
4. The hotel is situated ___ the river.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. in  
2. opposite  
3. in  
4. near / by / on *(near/by más natural en A2)*  

</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Superlativos

1. This is the ___ (tall) building in town.  
2. It's the ___ (famous) museum in the country.  
3. That square is the ___ (big) in the city.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. tallest  
2. most famous  
3. biggest  

</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Corrige el error

1. There is two libraries.  
2. The hospital is locate in the north.  
3. Is there any cafés?  
4. It's the more old church.  
5. There have a stadium.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. There are two libraries.  
2. The hospital is located in the north.  
3. Are there any cafés?  
4. It's the oldest church.  
5. There is a stadium.

</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Traduce al inglés

1. Hay un museo en el centro.  
2. Hay dos parques cerca.  
3. La biblioteca está situada en Green Street.  
4. Es el edificio más alto de la ciudad.  
5. ¿Hay un hospital cerca?

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. There is a museum in the centre.  
2. There are two parks nearby / near here.  
3. The library is located / situated in Green Street.  
4. It's the tallest building in the city.  
5. Is there a hospital nearby?

</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Completa el diálogo

**A:** ___ there a museum near here?  
**B:** Yes. It's ___ in the main square.  
**A:** ___ there any cafés?  
**B:** Yes — it's the ___ square in town, so there are many.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

Is  
located (or situated)  
Are  
biggest / most famous / busiest  

</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Ordena

1. is / There / a / library  
2. located / is / The / museum / in / the / centre  
3. tallest / the / It's / building

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. There is a library.  
2. The museum is located in the centre.  
3. It's the tallest building.  

</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Guía True / False

> There is a beautiful main square in the centre. The art museum is located next to the square.

1. The square is in the centre.  
2. The museum is far from the square.  
3. The text mentions an art museum.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. True  
2. False  
3. True  

</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Tu guía local (8–12 líneas)

Describe tu barrio o ciudad. Incluye:

- 2 *There is / There are*  
- 1 *located in / next to / opposite*  
- 2 lugares (*museum / library / square…*)  
- 1 superlativo

**Modelo:** la lectura de la sección 6.

---

## 9. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Vocabulario + *There is/are*  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–6.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha guía y diálogo.  
4. **5–8 min** — Ejercicio 10.

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *There is / There are* correctamente  
- [ ] Ubico con *located in / next to / opposite*  
- [ ] Nombró *museum, library, stadium, square…*  
- [ ] Uso un superlativo de lugar  
- [ ] Evito *There is two…* y *is locate*

---

## 10. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Describe tu camino a casa en voz alta (lugares que pasas).  
2. Lee una city guide en inglés y copia 5 frases útiles.  
3. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 58](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-58-places-buildings-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 58 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-58).

La **Unidad 59** es **Linking Words** (conectores).

---

## Resumen rápido

| | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Singular | There is | There is a museum. |
| Plural | There are | There are two parks. |
| Ubicación | located in | located in the centre |
| Superlativo | the -est / the most | the tallest building |
| Vocab | museum / square… | in the main square |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 59** verás **Linking Words**.

Curso:

- [Unidad 59 — Linking Words](/curso-a2/unit-59)

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 58 A2 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-58-places-buildings-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [Unidad 58 — Places & Buildings](/curso-a2/unit-58)

author: linguafly-team

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre but y although?
faqs.answer: Ambos contrastan. But une dos ideas en el mismo nivel: It's cold, but sunny. Although introduce una idea contrastiva (a menudo al inicio): Although it's cold, it's sunny.

faqs.question: ¿Because o so?
faqs.answer: Because = causa (por qué). So = consecuencia (resultado). I stayed home because it rained. / It rained, so I stayed home.

faqs.question: ¿However lleva coma?
faqs.answer: Sí, suele ir con coma: However, I disagree. También al final: I disagree, however.

faqs.question: ¿Therefore es muy formal para A2?
faqs.answer: Es un poco más formal que so. Úsalo en escritura: It was late; therefore, we left. En conversación, so es más natural.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 59 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el [cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-59-linking-words-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la Unidad 59 del curso A2 de Linguafly practicarás conectores para unir ideas.

content:
En la [Unidad 58](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-58-places-buildings) describiste lugares. En la **Unidad 59 del curso A2** (*Linking Words*) **conectas ideas** para escribir y hablar con más fluidez.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 59 — Linking Words](/curso-a2/unit-59)  
> **Antes:** [U58 — Places & Buildings](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-58-places-buildings)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 59 (A2)

- Suma: **and**
- Contraste: **but**, **although**, **however**
- Causa: **because**
- Consecuencia: **so**, **therefore**
- Escribir un párrafo corto con conectores

![Linking Words A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-59/a2-unit59-linking-words.png)

---

## 1. Mapa de conectores

| Función | Conector | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Añadir | **and** | I like tea **and** coffee. |
| Contrastar | **but** | It's cheap, **but** small. |
| Contrastar | **although** | **Although** it's cheap, it's good. |
| Contrastar | **however** | It's cheap. **However**, it's small. |
| Causa | **because** | I'm tired **because** I worked late. |
| Resultado | **so** | I worked late, **so** I'm tired. |
| Resultado | **therefore** | It was late; **therefore**, we left. |

![Connectors](/blog/curso-a2/unit-59/a2-unit59-connectors.png)

---

## 2. *And*, *but*, *because*, *so*

| Conector | Idea | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **and** | suma | She studied hard **and** passed. |
| **but** | contraste simple | I like the city, **but** it's noisy. |
| **because** | causa (por qué) | We stayed in **because** it rained. |
| **so** | consecuencia | It rained, **so** we stayed in. |

> I was hungry, **so** I made a sandwich.  
> I made a sandwich **because** I was hungry.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-59/because-so.mp3" title="🔊 It rained, so we stayed in."></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-59/but-contrast.mp3" title="🔊 I like the city, but it's noisy."></audio>

---

## 3. *Although* y *however*

| Forma | Uso | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Although** + clause | contraste (a menudo al inicio) | **Although** it was late, we went out. |
| …, **although** … | contraste en medio | We went out, **although** it was late. |
| **However**, … | contraste más formal / escrito | It was late. **However**, we went out. |

> **Although** the museum is small, it's interesting.  
> The museum is small. **However**, it's interesting.

No digas ~~Although… but…~~ en la misma frase.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-59/although.mp3" title="🔊 Although it was late, we went out."></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-59/however.mp3" title="🔊 It was late. However, we went out."></audio>

---

## 4. *Therefore* (resultado más formal)

| Informal / natural | Más formal |
| :--- | :--- |
| It was expensive, **so** I didn't buy it. | It was expensive; **therefore**, I didn't buy it. |

En A2, prioriza **so** en conversación y **therefore** en escritura cuidada.

---

## 5. Mapa rápido

| Quieres… | Usa… | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Añadir | and | tea and coffee |
| Contrastar | but / although / however | but it's noisy |
| Explicar por qué | because | because I'm tired |
| Dar resultado | so / therefore | so I left |

![Writing scene](/blog/curso-a2/unit-59/a2-unit59-writing-scene.png)

---

## 6. Lectura y diálogo

### Lectura — A short paragraph

I love my city **because** there are parks and museums. It's busy, **but** friendly. **Although** the centre is expensive, I enjoy living there. Last Saturday it rained, **so** we stayed at home. We watched a film **and** cooked dinner. The film was long; **however**, it was excellent.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-59/reading-paragraph.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: A short paragraph"></audio>

### Diálogo — Weekend plans

**Eva:** Shall we go out?  
**Nico:** I'd like to, **but** I'm tired **because** I worked late.  
**Eva:** OK — **so** let's stay in **and** watch a series.  
**Nico:** Good idea. **Although** I'm tired, I don't want to sleep yet.  
**Eva:** Perfect.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-59/dialogue-weekend.mp3" title="🔊 Dialogue: Weekend plans"></audio>

### Mini práctica

1. I like tea ___ coffee.  
2. It's cheap, ___ small.  
3. I'm tired ___ I worked late.  
4. It rained, ___ we stayed in.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-59/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 Practice four sentences"></audio>

---

## 7. Errores frecuentes

1. ~~Although it's cold, but sunny.~~ → **Although** it's cold, it's sunny. / It's cold, **but** sunny.  
2. ~~Because I was tired, so I slept.~~ → **Because** I was tired, I slept. / I was tired, **so** I slept.  
3. ~~I like coffee. And I like tea.~~ *(demasiado cortado a veces)* → **I like coffee and tea.**  
4. ~~However I agree~~ → **However, I agree.**  
5. ~~so that I tired~~ → **so I'm tired** / **because I'm tired**  
6. ~~therefore so…~~ → elige **uno**: *so* **o** *therefore*

---

## 8. Ejercicios (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — Empareja

1. and  
2. but  
3. because  
4. so  
5. although  

a) cause  
b) result  
c) contrast (clause)  
d) add ideas  
e) simple contrast

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1 → d  
2 → e  
3 → a  
4 → b  
5 → c  

</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Completa

1. I like pizza ___ pasta.  
2. The bag is nice, ___ expensive.  
3. She stayed home ___ she was ill.  
4. He was hungry, ___ he made a sandwich.  
5. ___ it was raining, we walked.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. and  
2. but  
3. because  
4. so  
5. Although  

</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — *because* o *so*

1. I took a taxi ___ I was late.  
2. I was late, ___ I took a taxi.  
3. We left early ___ the train was full.  
4. The train was full, ___ we left early.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. because  
2. so  
3. because  
4. so  

</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — *but* / *although* / *however*

1. It's small, ___ comfortable.  
2. ___ it's small, it's comfortable.  
3. It's small. ___, it's comfortable.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. but  
2. Although  
3. However  

</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Corrige el error

1. Although I'm tired, but I will go.  
2. Because it rained, so we stayed.  
3. However I disagree.  
4. I was hungry so that I ate.  
5. Therefore, so we left.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. Although I'm tired, I will go. / I'm tired, but I will go.  
2. Because it rained, we stayed. / It rained, so we stayed.  
3. However, I disagree.  
4. I was hungry, so I ate.  
5. Therefore, we left. / So we left.

</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Traduce al inglés

1. Me gusta el té y el café.  
2. Es barato, pero pequeño.  
3. Estoy cansado porque trabajé tarde.  
4. Llovió, así que nos quedamos en casa.  
5. Aunque era tarde, salimos.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. I like tea and coffee.  
2. It's cheap, but small.  
3. I'm tired because I worked late.  
4. It rained, so we stayed at home.  
5. Although it was late, we went out.

</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Completa el párrafo

I enjoy my job ___ the people are friendly. The salary is OK, ___ the hours are long. ___ I finish late, I usually cook at home. Last night I was very tired, ___ I went to bed early. The day was hard. ___, it was useful.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

because  
but  
Although  
so  
However  

</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Ordena

1. tired / because / I'm / late / I / worked  
2. rained / It / so / stayed / we / in  
3. cold / Although / it's / sunny / it's

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. I'm tired because I worked late.  
2. It rained, so we stayed in.  
3. Although it's cold, it's sunny.  

</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Elige la mejor opción

1. I like tea ___ coffee.  
   a) because  b) and  c) although  
2. ___ the café is small, the coffee is great.  
   a) So  b) Although  c) Therefore  
3. It was expensive; ___, I didn't buy it.  
   a) and  b) because  c) therefore

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. b  
2. b  
3. c  

</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Tu párrafo (8–12 líneas)

Escribe sobre tu ciudad, trabajo o fin de semana. Incluye:

- **and**  
- **but** o **although**  
- **because**  
- **so** o **however**

**Modelo:** la lectura de la sección 6.

---

## 9. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Mapa de conectores  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–6.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha párrafo y diálogo.  
4. **5–8 min** — Ejercicio 10.

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *and / but / because / so*  
- [ ] Uso *although* sin *but* en la misma frase  
- [ ] Uso *however* con puntuación correcta  
- [ ] Distingo causa (*because*) y resultado (*so*)  
- [ ] Evito *Although… but…* y *Because… so…*

---

## 10. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Reescribe 5 frases tuyas uniendo dos ideas con conectores.  
2. Marca conectores en un texto corto en inglés.  
3. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 59](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-59-linking-words-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 59 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-59).

La **Unidad 60** es el **Module 6 Review**.

---

## Resumen rápido

| | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Suma | and | tea and coffee |
| Contraste | but / although / however | but it's noisy |
| Causa | because | because I'm tired |
| Resultado | so / therefore | so I left |

---

faqs.question: ¿Shall we o Could you?
faqs.answer: Shall we…? sugiere un plan conjunto. Could you…? pide algo a otra persona.

faqs.question: ¿I think o In my opinion?
faqs.answer: Ambos dan opinión. In my opinion suena un poco más formal/escrito. I think es muy frecuente en conversación.

faqs.question: ¿Because o so?
faqs.answer: Because = causa. So = resultado. I stayed home because it rained. / It rained, so I stayed home.

En la [Unidad 59](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-59-linking-words) conectaste ideas. La **Unidad 60 del curso A2** (*Module 6 Review*) **integra** todo el Módulo 6 (U51–U59) en un solo repaso.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 60 — Module 6 Review](/curso-a2/unit-60)  
> **Antes:** [U59 — Linking Words](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-59-linking-words)

---

## Qué repasarás en la Unidad 60 (A2)

- **Suggestions** (U51) y **offers & requests** (U52)
- **Opinions** (U53) y **feelings** (U54)
- **Environment** (U55) y **technology** (U56)
- **Work & education** (U57) y **places** (U58)
- **Linking words** (U59)

![Module 6 Review A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-60/a2-unit60-module-6-review.png)

---

## 1. Mapa del Módulo 6

| U | Tema | Ejemplo clave |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 51 | Making Suggestions | **Shall we** go? / **Let's** stay in. |
| 52 | Offers & Requests | **Can I** help? / **Could you** wait? |
| 53 | Expressing Opinions | **I think** it's great. / **I agree.** |
| 54 | Feelings & Emotions | I **feel nervous**. / I'm **proud**. |
| 55 | The Environment | You **should recycle**. / **Save** water. |
| 56 | Technology | **Download** the app. / **Log in**. |
| 57 | Work & Education | I **work as** a teacher. / **study at** uni. |
| 58 | Places & Buildings | **There is** a museum. / **located in**… |
| 59 | Linking Words | **because** / **so** / **although** |

![Checklist](/blog/curso-a2/unit-60/a2-unit60-checklist.png)

---

## 2. Sugerencias, ofertas y peticiones (U51–U52)

| Idea | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Sugerir | Shall we…? / Let's… / How about…? | **Shall we** meet at 6? |
| Invitar | Would you like to…? | **Would you like to** come? |
| Ofrecer | Can I…? / Would you like me to…? | **Can I** help you? |
| Pedir | Could you…? / Can you…? | **Could you** open the window? |

| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Opinar | I think… / In my opinion… | **I think** it's useful. |
| Acordar / discrepar | I agree / I don't think so | **I agree** with you. |
| Sentir | I feel… / I'm… | I **feel excited**. |
| *-ed* vs *-ing* | bored / boring | I'm **bored**. / It's **boring**. |

## 5. Linking words (U59)

| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Suma | and | tea **and** coffee |
| Contraste | but / although / however | cheap, **but** small |
| Causa | because | tired **because**… |

## 6. Lectura integrada

### Reading — My A2 week

This week I felt **excited** **because** I finished Module 6. **Shall we** celebrate? **Let's** meet in the main **square** — **there is** a nice café **located** opposite the **library**. **In my opinion**, the course was useful, **although** some units were hard. I **work as** a student assistant, **so** I often **have to** **log in** and **send** emails. I also try to **recycle** at home. **Could you** help me print my certificate? That would be great!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-60/reading-week.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: My A2 week"></audio>

### Diálogo — After the course

**Lara:** How do you **feel** now?  
**Ben:** **Proud** — and a bit tired.  
**Lara:** **I agree.** **Shall we** go for a coffee?  
**Ben:** Yes. **Would you like me to** book a table?  
**Lara:** Please. **Although** it's late, I'm hungry, **so** let's eat too.  
**Ben:** Perfect. I'll **send** you the **location**.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-60/dialogue-after.mp3" title="🔊 Dialogue: After the course"></audio>

## 7. Errores frecuentes del módulo

1. ~~Let's to go.~~ → **Let's go.**  
2. ~~Can I to help you?~~ → **Can I help you?**  
3. ~~I am agree.~~ → **I agree.**  
4. ~~I am boring.~~ *(si te aburres)* → **I'm bored.**  
5. ~~You should to recycle.~~ → **You should recycle.**  
6. ~~Turn the WiFi.~~ → **Turn on** the WiFi.  
7. ~~I work like a teacher.~~ → **I work as** a teacher.  
8. ~~There is two museums.~~ → **There are** two museums.  
9. ~~Although… but…~~ → **Although…,** … / …, **but** …

### Ejercicio 4 — Conectores

2. It's cheap, ___ small.  
3. I'm tired ___ I worked late.  
4. ___ it was late, we went out.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. and

### Ejercicio 5 — Corrige el error

1. Let's to stay in.  
2. I am agree with you.  
3. Turn the computer.  
4. There is two libraries.  
5. Although I'm tired, but I'll go.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. Let's stay in.  
2. I agree with you.  
3. Turn on the computer.  
4. There are two libraries.  
5. Although I'm tired, I'll go. / I'm tired, but I'll go.

</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Traduce al inglés

1. ¿Salimos?  
2. ¿Puedo ayudarte?  
3. Creo que es útil.  
4. Deberías reciclar.  
5. Llovió, así que nos quedamos.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. Shall we go out?  
2. Can I help you?  
3. I think it's useful.  
4. You should recycle.  
5. It rained, so we stayed (in / at home).

</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Completa el diálogo

**A:** How do you ___ ?  
**B:** Excited ___ I finished the course.  
**A:** ___ we celebrate?  
**B:** Yes. ___ you book a table?  
**A:** Of course. There's a café ___ in the square.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

feel  
because  
Shall  
Could / Can  
located (or situated)  

</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Elige la mejor opción

1. ___ the window, please?  
   a) Shall we  b) Could you  c) Let's  
2. I'm ___ about the trip.  
   a) exciting  b) excited  c) excite  
3. Log ___ with your password.  
   a) on  b) in  c) up

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. b  
2. b  
3. b  

</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Lectura True / False

> Shall we celebrate? Let's meet in the main square — there is a nice café located opposite the library.

1. They suggest meeting in the square.  
2. The café is far from the library.  
3. There is a café in the text.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. True  
2. False (opposite)  
3. True  

</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Tu texto A2 (10–14 líneas)

Escribe un texto integrado. Incluye al menos:

- 1 sugerencia u oferta (*Shall we / Can I / Could you…*)  
- 1 opinión (*I think / In my opinion*)  
- 1 emoción (*I feel / I'm…*)  
- 1 idea de environment **o** technology **o** work/places  
- 2 conectores (*because / so / although / but…*)

**Modelo:** la lectura de la sección 6.

---

## 9. Plan de estudio (30–35 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Mapa del módulo (sección 1).  
2. **10 min** — Ejercicios 1–6.  
3. **8 min** — Escucha lectura y diálogo.  
4. **7–10 min** — Ejercicio 10.

### Checklist

- [ ] Suggestions / offers / requests  
- [ ] Opinions + feelings (*-ed/-ing*)  
- [ ] Environment + technology basics  
- [ ] Work/study + places (*There is/are*)  
- [ ] Linking words sin dobles (*Although… but…*)

---

## 10. Consejos y cierre del curso A2

1. Reescribe el texto “My A2 week” con tus datos.  
2. Repasa las guías U51–U59 donde falles más.  
3. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 60](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-60-module-6-review-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 60 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-60).

Con esta unidad cierras el **Módulo 6** y el recorrido editorial A2 U1–U60.

---

## Resumen rápido

| Bloque | Formas clave |
| :--- | :--- |
| Planes / cortesía | Shall we, Let's, Can I, Could you |
| Opinión / emoción | I think, I agree, I feel, excited/bored |
| Mundo real | recycle, download, work as, There is |
| Conectores | and, but, because, so, although |

---

## Siguiente paso

Has completado la serie de artículos del **curso A2**. Puedes:

- Volver al [índice del curso A2](/curso-a2)
- Repasar el [Module 5 Review](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-50-module-5-review)
- Seguir con la [guía del nivel A2](/blog/metodos/ingles-a2)

Practica ahora:

Guías del módulo:
