title: Going to A2: predicciones (It is going to rain)
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 22 del curso A2: going to para predicciones con evidencia, I think / I'm sure, audios y ejercicios.
description: Aprende going to para predicciones en inglés A2 basadas en evidencia: Look at the clouds! I think / I'm sure. Guía Unidad 22 con audios y ejercicios.
alt: Esquema de going to para predicciones A2

faqs.question: ¿Cuándo uso going to para predicciones?
faqs.answer: Cuando hay evidencia ahora: nubes → lluvia, alguien estudia mucho → va a aprobar. Ejemplo: Look at the clouds! It is going to rain.

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia con going to de planes (Unidad 21)?
faqs.answer: Misma forma (am/is/are + going to + infinitivo). En U21 = plan o intención que ya decidiste. En U22 = predicción por lo que ves o sabes ahora.

faqs.question: ¿Qué diferencia hay entre I think y I'm sure?
faqs.answer: I think expresa opinión u opinión con algo de duda. I'm sure expresa más certeza. Ejemplo: I think it is going to rain. / I'm sure my team is going to win.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo empiezo una predicción con evidencia?
faqs.answer: A menudo con Look at… / Be careful! y luego going to: Look at the clouds! It is going to rain. Be careful! That cup is going to fall.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 22 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el [cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-22-going-to-predicciones-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la Unidad 22 del curso A2 de Linguafly: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening, speaking y writing.

content:
En la [Unidad 21](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-21-going-to-planes-intenciones) usaste *going to* para **planes**. En la **Unidad 22 del curso A2** (*Going to: Predictions*) usas la **misma forma** para **predicciones** con evidencia: *Look at the clouds! It's going to rain.*

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 22 — Going to: Predictions](/curso-a2/unit-22)  
> **Antes:** [U21 — Going to: Plans & Intentions](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-21-going-to-planes-intenciones)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 22 (A2)

- Hacer **predicciones** con *going to* basadas en evidencia.
- Usar **Look at…!** / **Be careful!** para señalar lo que ves.
- Expresar opinión con **I think…** y certeza con **I'm sure…**
- Hablar del **tiempo**, resultados y consecuencias.
- Distinguir **plan** (U21) vs **predicción** (U22).

![Going to predicciones A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-22/a2-unit22-predictions.png)

---

## 1. Idea clave: evidencia → predicción

| Evidencia (ahora) | Predicción |
| :--- | :--- |
| dark clouds | It **is going to** rain. |
| cup near the edge | That cup **is going to** fall. |
| she studies hard | She **is going to** pass the exam. |
| good forecast | It **is going to** be sunny tomorrow. |

Fórmula (igual que en U21): **am / is / are** + **going to** + infinitivo.

---

## 2. Planes vs predicciones

![Planes vs predicciones con going to](/blog/curso-a2/unit-22/a2-unit22-plans-vs-predictions.png)

| | Unidad 21 — Plans | Unidad 22 — Predictions |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Idea | ya lo decidí | lo veo / lo sé ahora |
| Ejemplo | I **am going to** travel to Japan. | Look at the clouds! It **is going to** rain. |
| Pregunta mental | ¿Qué tengo planeado? | ¿Qué va a pasar según la evidencia? |

Misma forma. Uso distinto.

---

## 3. Predicciones con evidencia (*Look at…!*)

> **Look at** the clouds! It **is going to** rain.  
> **Be careful!** That cup **is going to** fall.  
> Look at those dark clouds! I think it **is going to** rain in the evening.  
> She studies hard. She **is going to** pass the exam.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-22/look-clouds-rain.mp3" title="🔊 Look at the clouds! It is going to rain"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-22/cup-going-to-fall.mp3" title="🔊 Be careful! That cup is going to fall"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-22/she-going-to-pass.mp3" title="🔊 She is going to pass the exam. She studies hard"></audio>

Patrón útil: **señala la evidencia** → **predice con going to**.

---

## 4. *I think…* vs *I'm sure…*

| Frase | Nivel | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **I think…** | opinión / algo de duda | I **think** they **are going to** win the match. |
| **I'm sure…** | más certeza | I **'m sure** he **is going to** get the job. |
| **Maybe…** | posibilidad | **Maybe** we should take an umbrella. |

> I **think** it **is going to** be warm and nice.  
> I **'m sure** we **are going to** have a good day at the beach.  
> I **think** it **is going to** rain in the afternoon.  
> I **'m sure** the match **is going to** be exciting tonight.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-22/i-think-they-win.mp3" title="🔊 I think they are going to win the match"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-22/im-sure-get-job.mp3" title="🔊 I'm sure he is going to get the job"></audio>

---

## 5. Tiempo, resultados y consecuencias

Vocabulario típico de esta unidad:

| Inglés | Uso en predicción |
| :--- | :--- |
| sunny / warm / nice | It is going to be **sunny**. |
| rain / clouds / umbrella | It is going to **rain**. Take an **umbrella**. |
| fall | That cup is going to **fall**. |
| pass / win / get the job | She is going to **pass**. / They are going to **win**. |
| exciting / good | The match is going to be **exciting**. |

Marcadores: *tomorrow, in the afternoon, in the evening, tonight*.

---

## 6. Texto modelo: un día de predicciones

> Tomorrow the weather is going to be sunny. I think it is going to be warm and nice. I'm sure we are going to have a good day at the beach. Look at the clouds! I think it is going to rain in the afternoon. Maybe we should take an umbrella. I'm sure the match is going to be exciting tonight. My team is going to win!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-22/reading-weather-day.mp3" title="🔊 Tomorrow the weather is going to be sunny…"></audio>

![Un día de predicciones](/blog/curso-a2/unit-22/a2-unit22-weather-day.png)

| Momento | Predicción |
| :--- | :--- |
| Tomorrow (morning) | sunny / warm and nice / good day at the beach |
| Afternoon | rain → take an umbrella |
| Tonight | exciting match / my team is going to win |

---

## 7. Listening: picnic y película

> Hi! I just checked the weather forecast. I think it is going to be sunny tomorrow. I'm sure we are going to have a great day for our picnic. But look at those dark clouds over there. I think it is going to rain in the evening. Maybe we should go home early. I'm sure the film is going to be good tonight. My friend said it is excellent.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-22/dialogue-picnic.mp3" title="🔊 Hi! I just checked the weather forecast…"></audio>

Preguntas rápidas:

1. ¿Qué tiempo mañana? → *sunny*  
2. ¿Plan de mañana? → *picnic*  
3. ¿Qué ve en el cielo? → *dark clouds*  
4. ¿Cuándo va a llover? → *in the evening*  
5. ¿Qué hay esta noche? → *a film* (va a ser buena)

---

## 8. Mini práctica oral

> Look at the clouds! What is going to happen?  
> I think it is going to…  
> I'm sure we are going to…  
> Be careful! That… is going to…

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-22/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 Look at the clouds! What is going to happen?…"></audio>

1. Di **2 predicciones** con evidencia (*Look at…!*).  
2. Di **1** con *I think* y **1** con *I'm sure*.  
3. Habla del tiempo de **mañana** y de **esta noche**.

---

## 9. Vocabulario (del curso)

| Inglés | Idea |
| :--- | :--- |
| prediction / evidence | predicción / evidencia |
| weather / forecast | tiempo / pronóstico |
| sunny / warm / nice | soleado / cálido / agradable |
| rain / clouds / dark clouds | llover / nubes / nubes oscuras |
| umbrella / picnic / beach | paraguas / picnic / playa |
| fall / pass / win | caer / aprobar / ganar |
| match / film / exciting | partido / película / emocionante |
| I think / I'm sure / Maybe | creo / estoy seguro / quizás |
| tomorrow / this afternoon / tonight | mañana / esta tarde / esta noche |
| in the evening / early | por la tarde-noche / temprano |

---

## 10. Errores frecuentes

| Incorrecto | Correcto | Por qué |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Look the clouds! | **Look at** the clouds! | *look at* + objeto |
| It going to rain. | It **is** going to rain. | Falta *is* |
| I think it going to rain. | I think it **is** going to rain. | *is going to* |
| I'm sure they is going to win. | I'm sure they **are** going to win. | *they* → *are* |
| It is going to raining. | It is going to **rain**. | Infinitivo, no *-ing* |
| (plan vs predicción mezclados sin contexto) | Decide: ¿plan mío o evidencia? | Mismo *going to*, uso distinto |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-22/sunny-tomorrow.mp3" title="🔊 I think it is going to be sunny tomorrow"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-22/team-going-to-win.mp3" title="🔊 My team is going to win"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-22/film-going-to-be-good.mp3" title="🔊 I'm sure the film is going to be good tonight"></audio>

---

## 11. Ejercicios

### Ejercicio 1 — Elige *am / is / are*

1. Look at the clouds! It ____ going to rain.  
2. I think they ____ going to win the match.  
3. She ____ going to pass the exam. She studies hard.  
4. I'm sure we ____ going to have a good day.  
5. Be careful! That cup ____ going to fall.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **is** · 2. **are** · 3. **is** · 4. **are** · 5. **is**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Completa la predicción

Usa: *rain / fall / pass / win / be*

1. Look at the clouds! It is going to ____.  
2. Be careful! That cup is going to ____.  
3. She studies hard. She is going to ____ the exam.  
4. I'm sure my team is going to ____.  
5. Tomorrow the weather is going to ____ sunny.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **rain** · 2. **fall** · 3. **pass** · 4. **win** · 5. **be**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — *I think* o *I'm sure*

Elige la que encaje mejor (ambas pueden ser gramaticales; sigue el modelo del curso):

1. ____ it is going to rain in the afternoon. *(opinión al ver nubes)*  
2. ____ the match is going to be exciting tonight. *(más certeza)*  
3. ____ he is going to get the job. *(certeza)*  
4. ____ it is going to be warm and nice. *(opinión)*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **I think** · 2. **I'm sure** · 3. **I'm sure** · 4. **I think**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Plan o predicción

Marca **P** (plan) o **Pred** (predicción):

1. I am going to travel to Japan next summer.  
2. Look at the clouds! It is going to rain.  
3. We are going to visit grandmother this weekend.  
4. She studies hard. She is going to pass.  
5. Be careful! That cup is going to fall.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **P** · 2. **Pred** · 3. **P** · 4. **Pred** · 5. **Pred**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Completa el texto del tiempo

Tomorrow the weather ____ going to be sunny. I ____ it is going to be warm and nice. I'm ____ we are going to have a good day at the beach. Look ____ the clouds! I think it is going to ____ in the afternoon.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**is** · **think** · **sure** · **at** · **rain**
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Completa el listening

I think it is going to be ____ tomorrow. I'm sure we are going to have a great day for our ____. Look at those dark ____. I think it is going to rain in the ____. I'm sure the ____ is going to be good tonight.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**sunny** · **picnic** · **clouds** · **evening** · **film**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Empareja

1. Look at the clouds!  
2. Be careful!  
3. I think…  
4. I'm sure…  
5. Maybe…  

a) más certeza · b) evidencia → lluvia · c) vaso que cae · d) posibilidad · e) opinión

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **b** · 2 → **c** · 3 → **e** · 4 → **a** · 5 → **d**
</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Corrige

1. *Look the clouds! It going to rain.*  
2. *I think they is going to win.*  
3. *I'm sure we is going to have a good day.*  
4. *It is going to raining.*  
5. *Be careful! That cup are going to fall.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Look at** the clouds! It **is** going to rain.  
2. I think they **are** going to win.  
3. I'm sure we **are** going to have a good day.  
4. It is going to **rain**.  
5. Be careful! That cup **is** going to fall.
</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Traduce

1. ¡Mira las nubes! Va a llover.  
2. ¡Ten cuidado! Ese vaso va a caer.  
3. Creo que van a ganar el partido.  
4. Estoy seguro de que va a conseguir el trabajo.  
5. Mañana el tiempo va a ser soleado.  
6. Creo que va a ser cálido y agradable.  
7. Estoy seguro de que vamos a tener un buen día en la playa.  
8. Quizás deberíamos llevar un paraguas.  
9. El partido va a ser emocionante esta noche.  
10. Mi equipo va a ganar.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. Look at the clouds! It is going to rain.  
2. Be careful! That cup is going to fall.  
3. I think they are going to win the match.  
4. I'm sure he is going to get the job.  
5. Tomorrow the weather is going to be sunny.  
6. I think it is going to be warm and nice.  
7. I'm sure we are going to have a good day at the beach.  
8. Maybe we should take an umbrella.  
9. The match is going to be exciting tonight.  
10. My team is going to win.
</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Tus predicciones

Escribe 8–12 líneas:

- 2 × predicción con evidencia (*Look at…! / Be careful!*)  
- 2 × *I think… is/are going to…*  
- 2 × *I'm sure… is/are going to…*  
- 1 × tiempo de mañana · 1 × esta noche  

**Modelo:** el texto del día soleado / picnic.

---

## 12. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Tabla evidencia → predicción + planes vs predicciones.  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–7.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha el texto del tiempo y el picnic; marca *I think / I'm sure*.  
4. **5–8 min** — Graba tus predicciones (Ejercicio 10).

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *going to* para predicciones con evidencia  
- [ ] Distingo plan (U21) y predicción (U22)  
- [ ] Uso *Look at…!* / *Be careful!*  
- [ ] Diferencio *I think* e *I'm sure*  
- [ ] Puedo hablar del tiempo y de resultados (*pass, win, rain…*)

---

## 13. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Primero mira la **evidencia** (nubes, estudio, pronóstico…).  
2. Luego elige *I think* o *I'm sure*.  
3. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 22](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-22-going-to-predicciones-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 22 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-22).

La **Unidad 23** introduce **will / won't** para predicciones generales, promesas y ofertas: *I'll help you.*

---

## Resumen rápido

| Idea | Forma / frase |
| :--- | :--- |
| Predicción + evidencia | *Look at…! It is going to…* |
| Opinión | *I think… is/are going to…* |
| Certeza | *I'm sure… is/are going to…* |
| Vs U21 | misma forma · plan ≠ predicción |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 23** verás **Will / Won't: Predictions & Promises**.

- [Unidad 23 — Will / Won't: predicciones y promesas](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-23-will-wont-predicciones-promesas)

Curso:

Practica ahora:

Guías relacionadas:

- [U21 — Going to: planes e intenciones](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-21-going-to-planes-intenciones)

faqs.question: ¿Cuándo uso will en A2?
faqs.answer: Para promesas (I will help you), ofertas (I'll buy the drinks), predicciones generales (I think the exam will be easy) y decisiones en el momento de hablar.

faqs.question: ¿Qué es won't?
faqs.answer: Won't = will not. Ejemplo: I won't forget. / I won't be late. / I won't give up.

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre will y going to?
faqs.answer: Going to (U21–22): planes ya decididos o predicciones con evidencia clara. Will (U23): promesas, ofertas y predicciones más generales o espontáneas.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo formo preguntas con will?
faqs.answer: Will + sujeto + infinitivo…? Ejemplo: Will you come to the party? — Yes, I will. / No, I won't.

content:
En la [Unidad 22](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-22-going-to-predicciones) predijiste con *going to* y evidencia. En la **Unidad 23 del curso A2** (*Will / Won't: Predictions & Promises*) aprendes **will** y **won't** para **promesas**, **ofertas** y **predicciones generales**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 23 — Will / Won't](/curso-a2/unit-23)  
> **Antes:** [U22 — Going to: Predictions](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-22-going-to-predicciones)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 23 (A2)

- Usar **will** + infinitivo (afirmativa).
- Usar **won't** (= *will not*) en negativa.
- Hacer preguntas: **Will you…?**
- Expresar **promesas**, **ofertas** y **predicciones**.
- Contrastar con *going to* (U21–22).

![Will y won't A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-23/a2-unit23-will-wont.png)

---

## 1. Idea clave

| Uso | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Promise** | I **will** help you. / I **won't** forget. |
| **Offer** | I **will** buy the drinks. / Maybe I **will** bring some music. |
| **Prediction** | I think the exam **will** be easy. / They **will** probably arrive late. |

Forma: **will / won't** + infinitivo (igual para *I, you, he, she, they…*).

---

## 2. Afirmativa, negativa e interrogativa

| Tipo | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| + | *will* + infinitivo | She **will** be here tomorrow. |
| − | *won't* + infinitivo | I **won't** forget your birthday. |
| ? | *Will* + sujeto + infinitivo…? | **Will** you come to the party? |

Contracciones: *I'll, you'll, he'll, she'll, we'll, they'll* · *won't* = *will not*.

Respuestas cortas: *Yes, I will. / No, I won't.*

> I **will** help you with that.  
> She **will** be here tomorrow.  
> I **won't** forget. I promise.  
> **Will** you come to the party?  
> They **will** probably arrive late.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-23/i-will-help-you.mp3" title="🔊 I will help you with that"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-23/wont-forget.mp3" title="🔊 I won't forget your birthday. I promise"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-23/will-you-come.mp3" title="🔊 Will you come to the party?"></audio>

---

## 3. Promesas y ofertas

Frases útiles del curso:

| Función | Frases |
| :--- | :--- |
| Promesa | I **promise**… · I **will** help you · I **won't** forget · I **won't** give up · I **will** be there for you |
| Oferta | I **will** buy the drinks · Maybe I **will** bring… · Don't worry! I **will**… |
| Ánimo | Don't worry! · Everyone **will** have fun |

> I promise I **will** help you with your homework tomorrow.  
> Don't worry! I **will** call you at 6 o'clock.  
> I **won't** be late. I promise!  
> Maybe I **will** bring some cookies too.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-23/promise-help-homework.mp3" title="🔊 I promise I will help you with your homework tomorrow"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-23/wont-be-late.mp3" title="🔊 I won't be late. I promise"></audio>

---

## 4. Predicciones generales

Con *will* a menudo usas *I think*, *probably*, *Maybe*:

> I think the exam **will** be easy next week.  
> They **will** probably arrive late.  
> I think the party **will** be great.  
> Everyone **will** have fun.

No hace falta evidencia visual (*Look at the clouds!*). Es una predicción más **general** u opinión.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-23/exam-will-be-easy.mp3" title="🔊 I think the exam will be easy next week"></audio>

---

## 5. *Going to* vs *will* (mapa rápido)

![Going to vs will](/blog/curso-a2/unit-23/a2-unit23-going-to-vs-will.png)

| | *going to* (U21–22) | *will* (U23) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Plan ya decidido | I **am going to** travel to Japan. | — |
| Evidencia ahora | Look! It **is going to** rain. | — |
| Promesa / oferta | — | I **will** help you. |
| Predicción general | — | I think it **will** be easy. |
| Decisión ahora | — | OK, I **'ll** buy the drinks. |

En la Unidad 25 compararás las tres formas de futuro juntas. Aquí domina **will / won't**.

---

## 6. Texto modelo: carta a Maria

> Dear Maria, I promise I will help you with your homework tomorrow. Don't worry! I will call you at 6 o'clock. I won't forget. Maybe I will bring some cookies too. I think the exam will be easy next week. I will study hard and I won't give up. I promise I will be there for you!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-23/reading-maria.mp3" title="🔊 Dear Maria, I promise I will help you…"></audio>

![Promesas a Maria](/blog/curso-a2/unit-23/a2-unit23-promises-maria.png)

| Promesa / predicción | Forma |
| :--- | :--- |
| help with homework | I will help… |
| call at 6 | I will call… |
| not forget | I won't forget |
| bring cookies | Maybe I will bring… |
| exam easy | I think the exam will be… |
| study / not give up | I will study… / I won't give up |
| be there for you | I will be there… |

---

## 7. Listening: fiesta de Sarah

> Hi Sarah! Don't worry about the party tomorrow. I will help you with the preparations. I will buy the drinks and I won't be late. I promise! Maybe I will bring some music too. I think the party will be great. Everyone will have fun. I won't forget the balloons!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-23/dialogue-sarah.mp3" title="🔊 Hi Sarah! Don't worry about the party…"></audio>

Preguntas rápidas:

1. ¿Qué hay mañana? → *a party*  
2. ¿Qué comprará? → *the drinks*  
3. ¿Llegará tarde? → *No* (*I won't be late*)  
4. ¿Qué más puede traer? → *music*  
5. ¿Qué no olvidará? → *the balloons*

---

## 8. Mini práctica oral

> I will help you with…  
> I won't forget…  
> Will you…?  
> I think … will be…

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-23/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 I will help you with… I won't forget…"></audio>

1. Di **2 promesas** (*I will… / I won't…*).  
2. Haz **1 oferta** a un compañero.  
3. Haz **1 predicción** con *I think… will…*.

---

## 9. Vocabulario (del curso)

| Inglés | Idea |
| :--- | :--- |
| promise / offer | promesa / oferta |
| I promise / Don't worry | lo prometo / no te preocupes |
| help / call / bring / buy | ayudar / llamar / traer / comprar |
| forget / give up / be late | olvidar / rendirse / llegar tarde |
| homework / exam / study hard | deberes / examen / estudiar mucho |
| party / preparations / drinks | fiesta / preparativos / bebidas |
| balloons / cookies / music | globos / galletas / música |
| probably / Maybe / tomorrow | probablemente / quizás / mañana |
| have fun / be there for you | divertirse / estar ahí para ti |
| next week / at 6 o'clock | la próxima semana / a las 6 |

---

## 10. Errores frecuentes

| Incorrecto | Correcto | Por qué |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| I will to help you. | I will help you. | Sin *to* después de *will* |
| She wills be here. | She **will** be here. | *will* no cambia con el sujeto |
| I will not to forget. | I **won't** forget. / I will not forget. | Infinitivo sin *to* |
| Will come you? | **Will you come?** | Orden: *Will* + sujeto |
| I don't will forget. | I **won't** forget. | Negativa = *won't*, no *don't will* |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-23/probably-arrive-late.mp3" title="🔊 They will probably arrive late"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-23/party-will-be-great.mp3" title="🔊 I think the party will be great"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-23/wont-forget-balloons.mp3" title="🔊 I won't forget the balloons"></audio>

---

## 11. Ejercicios

### Ejercicio 1 — *will* o *won't*

1. I ____ help you with that. *(promesa +)*  
2. I ____ forget your birthday. I promise.  
3. She ____ be here tomorrow. *(predicción +)*  
4. I ____ be late. I promise!  
5. They ____ probably arrive late.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **will** · 2. **won't** · 3. **will** · 4. **won't** · 5. **will**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Completa con el verbo

Usa: *help / call / bring / buy / forget*

1. I will ____ you with your homework.  
2. I will ____ you at 6 o'clock.  
3. Maybe I will ____ some cookies.  
4. I will ____ the drinks.  
5. I won't ____ the balloons!

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **help** · 2. **call** · 3. **bring** · 4. **buy** · 5. **forget**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Preguntas

1. ____ you come to the party?  
2. ____ she be here tomorrow?  
3. ____ they arrive late?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Will** you come to the party?  
2. **Will** she be here tomorrow?  
3. **Will** they arrive late?
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Promesa, oferta o predicción

Marca **Pr** (promesa), **O** (oferta) o **Pred** (predicción):

1. I will help you with the preparations.  
2. I think the exam will be easy.  
3. I won't forget. I promise!  
4. Maybe I will bring some music.  
5. They will probably arrive late.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Pr/O** (promesa u oferta de ayuda) · 2. **Pred** · 3. **Pr** · 4. **O** · 5. **Pred**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Completa la carta a Maria

Dear Maria, I promise I ____ help you with your homework tomorrow. Don't worry! I will ____ you at 6 o'clock. I ____ forget. Maybe I will ____ some cookies too. I think the exam ____ be easy next week.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**will** · **call** · **won't** · **bring** · **will**
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Completa a Sarah

I will help you with the ____. I will buy the ____ and I won't be ____. Maybe I will bring some ____ too. I won't forget the ____!

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**preparations** · **drinks** · **late** · **music** · **balloons**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Empareja

1. I promise  
2. Don't worry  
3. won't  
4. Will you…?  
5. probably  

a) pregunta · b) refuerza promesa · c) negativa de *will* · d) tranquiliza · e) predicción incierta

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **b** · 2 → **d** · 3 → **c** · 4 → **a** · 5 → **e**
</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Corrige

1. *I will to help you.*  
2. *She wills be here tomorrow.*  
3. *I don't will forget.*  
4. *Will come you to the party?*  
5. *I will not to be late.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I will help you.  
2. She **will** be here tomorrow.  
3. I **won't** forget.  
4. **Will you come** to the party?  
5. I **won't** be late. / I will not be late.
</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Traduce

1. Te ayudaré con eso.  
2. No olvidaré tu cumpleaños. Lo prometo.  
3. ¿Vendrás a la fiesta?  
4. Ella estará aquí mañana.  
5. Probablemente llegarán tarde.  
6. No te preocupes. Te llamaré a las 6.  
7. Compraré las bebidas.  
8. Creo que el examen será fácil.  
9. No me rendiré.  
10. No olvidaré los globos.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I will help you with that.  
2. I won't forget your birthday. I promise.  
3. Will you come to the party?  
4. She will be here tomorrow.  
5. They will probably arrive late.  
6. Don't worry. I will call you at 6.  
7. I will buy the drinks.  
8. I think the exam will be easy.  
9. I won't give up.  
10. I won't forget the balloons.
</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Tus promesas

Escribe 8–12 líneas (carta o mensaje):

- 2 × *I will…* (promesa/oferta)  
- 2 × *I won't…*  
- 1 × *Will you…?*  
- 1 × predicción (*I think… will…*)  
- Incluye *I promise* o *Don't worry*

**Modelo:** carta a Maria o mensaje a Sarah.

---

## 12. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Tabla *will / won't* + usos (promesa, oferta, predicción).  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–7.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha la carta y el mensaje de la fiesta; marca cada *will/won't*.  
4. **5–8 min** — Escribe y graba tu mensaje (Ejercicio 10).

### Checklist

- [ ] Formo *will / won't* + infinitivo  
- [ ] Pregunto con *Will you…?*  
- [ ] Uso *will* para promesas y ofertas  
- [ ] Hago predicciones generales con *I think / probably*  
- [ ] Distingo *will* de *going to* (mapa rápido)

---

## 13. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. ¿Prometes, ofreces o predices? → elige **will**.  
2. ¿Plan ya decidido o evidencia clara? → vuelve a **going to**.  
3. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 23](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-23-will-wont-predicciones-promesas-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 23 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-23).

La **Unidad 24** introduce el **Present Continuous for Future**: citas y planes ya fijados (*I'm meeting John tomorrow*).

---

## Resumen rápido

| Forma | Uso principal (U23) |
| :--- | :--- |
| *will* + infinitivo | promesa, oferta, predicción general |
| *won't* + infinitivo | negativa (*I won't forget*) |
| *Will* + sujeto…? | pregunta |
| vs *going to* | plan/evidencia ≠ promesa/oferta espontánea |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 24** verás **Present Continuous for Future**: agendas y citas.

author: linguafly-team

faqs.question: ¿Cuándo uso Present Continuous para el futuro?
faqs.answer: Para planes ya fijados en la agenda: citas, reuniones, vuelos, quedadas. Ejemplo: I am meeting John tomorrow at 3 o'clock. / She is flying to Paris next week.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo se forma?
faqs.answer: am/is/are + verbo en -ing, igual que el Present Continuous de ahora, pero con marcador de futuro: tomorrow, next week, on Monday, at 10.

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia con going to y will?
faqs.answer: Going to = intención o evidencia. Will = promesa, oferta o predicción general. Present Continuous = plan ya organizado (en el diary).

faqs.question: ¿Qué preguntas típicas hago?
faqs.answer: When / Where / What time + Present Continuous: What time are you meeting him? Where are you flying to? Are you free on Saturday?

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 24 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el [cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-24-present-continuous-futuro-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la Unidad 24 del curso A2 de Linguafly: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening, speaking y writing.

content:
En la [Unidad 23](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-23-will-wont-predicciones-promesas) usaste *will* para promesas. En la **Unidad 24 del curso A2** (*Present Continuous for Future*) hablas de **citas y planes ya fijados**: *I'm meeting John tomorrow.*

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 24 — Present Continuous for Future](/curso-a2/unit-24)  
> **Antes:** [U23 — Will / Won't](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-23-will-wont-predicciones-promesas)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 24 (A2)

- Usar **Present Continuous** para planes futuros ya organizados.
- Hablar de **citas**, **reuniones** y **eventos** en la agenda.
- Preguntar *when / where / what time*.
- Usar marcadores: *tomorrow, next week, on Monday, at 3 o'clock*.
- Situar esta forma junto a *going to* y *will* (vista previa de U25).

![Present Continuous for Future A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-24/a2-unit24-pc-future.png)

---

## 1. Idea clave: plan fijado = agenda

| Situación | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Cita / quedada | *am/is/are* + *-ing* | I **am meeting** John tomorrow. |
| Vuelo / viaje organizado | *is* + *-ing* | She **is flying** to Paris next week. |
| Cena / partido planificado | *are* + *-ing* | They **are having** dinner on Friday. |

Si está en tu **diary** (hora, día, persona o sitio), Present Continuous encaja muy bien.

---

## 2. Forma: *am / is / are* + *-ing*

| Sujeto | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| I | **am** + *-ing* | I **am meeting** the dentist at 10. |
| He / She | **is** + *-ing* | She **is flying** to Paris next week. |
| You / We / They | **are** + *-ing* | We **are playing** tennis this weekend. |

> I **am meeting** John tomorrow at 3 o'clock.  
> She **is flying** to Paris next week.  
> They **are having** dinner with us on Friday.  
> We **are playing** tennis with them this weekend.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-24/am-meeting-john.mp3" title="🔊 I am meeting John tomorrow at 3 o'clock"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-24/is-flying-paris.mp3" title="🔊 She is flying to Paris next week"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-24/are-having-dinner.mp3" title="🔊 They are having dinner with us on Friday"></audio>

Negativa: *I'm not meeting… / She isn't flying… / We aren't having…*  
Pregunta: *Are you meeting John tomorrow? / What time are you meeting him?*

---

## 3. Marcadores de tiempo (futuro)

| Marcador | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| tomorrow | I am meeting John **tomorrow**. |
| next week | She is flying to Paris **next week**. |
| on Monday / Tuesday… | **On Monday** I am meeting my boss. |
| this weekend | We are playing tennis **this weekend**. |
| at 3 o'clock / at 10 / at 1 pm | I am meeting him **at 3 o'clock**. |
| in the morning | I am having a dentist appointment **in the morning**. |

Sin marcador de futuro, la misma forma suele significar **ahora**. Con marcador (*tomorrow, on Friday…*), habla del **futuro fijado**.

---

## 4. Vocabulario de agenda

| Inglés | Idea |
| :--- | :--- |
| appointment / meeting | cita / reunión |
| diary / plans | agenda / planes |
| confirm / free | confirmar / libre |
| meet / have dinner / have lunch | quedar / cenar / comer |
| fly / play tennis / go to the cinema | volar / jugar al tenis / ir al cine |
| boss / dentist / conference | jefe / dentista / conferencia |
| what time / where / when | a qué hora / dónde / cuándo |

Preguntas útiles:

> **What time** are you meeting him?  
> **Where** are you flying to?  
> **Are you free** on Saturday?

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-24/what-time-meeting.mp3" title="🔊 What time are you meeting him?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-24/are-you-free-saturday.mp3" title="🔊 Are you free on Saturday?"></audio>

---

## 5. Vista previa: tres futuros

![Going to, will y Present Continuous](/blog/curso-a2/unit-24/a2-unit24-three-futures.png)

| Forma | Uso típico | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| *going to* | intención / evidencia | I **am going to** travel next summer. |
| *will* | promesa / oferta / predicción general | I **will** help you. |
| Present Continuous | plan ya fijado (diary) | I **am meeting** John tomorrow. |

La **Unidad 25** compara las tres juntas. Aquí practica sobre todo la agenda.

---

## 6. Texto modelo: la semana de Tom

> My name is Tom. This week I am very busy. On Monday I am meeting John at 3 o'clock. On Tuesday I am having a dentist appointment at 10 in the morning. On Wednesday I am flying to Paris for a meeting. On Thursday I am having dinner with my parents. On Friday I am playing tennis with my friend at 5 pm. I love having a full diary!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-24/reading-tom.mp3" title="🔊 My name is Tom. This week I am very busy…"></audio>

![Agenda de Tom](/blog/curso-a2/unit-24/a2-unit24-toms-week.png)

| Día | Plan |
| :--- | :--- |
| Monday | meeting John at 3 o'clock |
| Tuesday | dentist appointment at 10 |
| Wednesday | flying to Paris for a meeting |
| Thursday | dinner with parents |
| Friday | tennis at 5 pm |

---

## 7. Listening: llamada a Lisa

> Hi Lisa! I am calling to confirm our plans for next week. On Monday I am meeting my boss at 9 o'clock. On Wednesday I am flying to Barcelona for a conference. On Friday I am having lunch with my sister at 1 pm. Are you free on Saturday? I am going to the cinema and I would like you to come with me.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-24/dialogue-lisa.mp3" title="🔊 Hi Lisa! I am calling to confirm our plans…"></audio>

Preguntas rápidas:

1. ¿Por qué llama? → *to confirm plans*  
2. ¿Lunes? → *meeting his boss at 9*  
3. ¿Miércoles? → *flying to Barcelona for a conference*  
4. ¿Viernes? → *lunch with his sister at 1 pm*  
5. ¿Sábado? → *cinema* (¿está libre Lisa?)

---

## 8. Mini práctica oral

> What are you doing tomorrow?  
> What time are you meeting…?  
> Are you free on Saturday?  
> On Monday I am…

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-24/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 What are you doing tomorrow?…"></audio>

1. Di **5 planes** de tu semana con Present Continuous.  
2. Incluye **hora** o **día** en cada uno.  
3. Pregunta a un compañero: *Are you free on…?*

---

## 9. Vocabulario (del curso)

| Inglés | Idea |
| :--- | :--- |
| appointment / meeting / conference | cita / reunión / conferencia |
| diary / busy / full diary | agenda / ocupado / agenda llena |
| meet / confirm / free | quedar / confirmar / libre |
| fly / have dinner / have lunch | volar / cenar / comer |
| play tennis / go to the cinema | jugar al tenis / ir al cine |
| boss / dentist / parents / sister | jefe / dentista / padres / hermana |
| on Monday… / at 3 o'clock / next week | el lunes… / a las 3 / la próxima semana |
| tomorrow / this weekend / in the morning | mañana / este fin de semana / por la mañana |

---

## 10. Errores frecuentes

| Incorrecto | Correcto | Por qué |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| I meeting John tomorrow. | I **am** meeting John tomorrow. | Falta *am/is/are* |
| She are flying to Paris. | She **is** flying to Paris. | *she* → *is* |
| I am meet John tomorrow. | I am **meeting** John tomorrow. | Forma *-ing* |
| I will meeting John tomorrow. *(cita fijada)* | I **am meeting** John tomorrow. | Cita en agenda → PC |
| What time you are meeting him? | What time **are you** meeting him? | Orden en pregunta |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-24/dentist-appointment.mp3" title="🔊 I am having a dentist appointment at 10 in the morning"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-24/playing-tennis.mp3" title="🔊 I am playing tennis with my friend at 5 pm"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-24/flying-barcelona.mp3" title="🔊 I am flying to Barcelona for a conference"></audio>

---

## 11. Ejercicios

### Ejercicio 1 — *am / is / are*

1. I ____ meeting John tomorrow at 3 o'clock.  
2. She ____ flying to Paris next week.  
3. They ____ having dinner with us on Friday.  
4. We ____ playing tennis this weekend.  
5. He ____ meeting his boss at 9 o'clock.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **am** · 2. **is** · 3. **are** · 4. **are** · 5. **is**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Completa con *-ing*

Usa: *meeting / flying / having / playing / going*

1. I am ____ John at 3 o'clock.  
2. She is ____ to Paris next week.  
3. They are ____ dinner on Friday.  
4. We are ____ tennis this weekend.  
5. I am ____ to the cinema on Saturday.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **meeting** · 2. **flying** · 3. **having** · 4. **playing** · 5. **going**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Día de Tom

1. On Monday Tom is meeting ____.  
2. On Tuesday he is having a ____ appointment.  
3. On Wednesday he is flying to ____.  
4. On Thursday he is having dinner with his ____.  
5. On Friday he is playing ____ at 5 pm.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **John** · 2. **dentist** · 3. **Paris** · 4. **parents** · 5. **tennis**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Completa la llamada

On Monday I am ____ my boss at 9. On Wednesday I am ____ to Barcelona. On Friday I am ____ lunch with my sister. ____ you free on Saturday?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**meeting** · **flying** · **having** · **Are**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Elige la mejor forma

1. Cita con el dentista mañana a las 10 →  
   a) I will see the dentist. · b) I am seeing / having a dentist appointment tomorrow at 10. · c) Look! I am going to see the dentist.  
2. Promesa espontánea de ayuda →  
   a) I am helping you tomorrow. · b) I will help you. · c) I am going to rain.  
3. Intención de viajar el próximo verano (aún sin billetes) →  
   a) I am going to travel next summer. · b) I am travelling next summer at 3. · c) I will travelling.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **b** · 2. **b** · 3. **a**
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Preguntas

1. ____ you meeting John tomorrow?  
2. What time ____ you meeting him?  
3. Where ____ she flying to?  
4. ____ you free on Saturday?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Are** · 2. **are** · 3. **is** · 4. **Are**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Empareja

1. appointment  
2. diary  
3. meeting  
4. confirm  
5. free  

a) agenda · b) cita · c) reunión · d) libre · e) confirmar

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **b** · 2 → **a** · 3 → **c** · 4 → **e** · 5 → **d**
</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Corrige

1. *I meeting John tomorrow.*  
2. *She are flying to Paris.*  
3. *I am meet the dentist at 10.*  
4. *What time you are meeting him?*  
5. *They is having dinner on Friday.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I **am** meeting John tomorrow.  
2. She **is** flying to Paris.  
3. I am **meeting** the dentist at 10.  
4. What time **are you** meeting him?  
5. They **are** having dinner on Friday.
</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Traduce

1. Mañana quedo con John a las 3.  
2. El martes tengo cita con el dentista a las 10.  
3. El miércoles vuelo a París para una reunión.  
4. El jueves ceno con mis padres.  
5. El viernes juego al tenis a las 5.  
6. ¿Estás libre el sábado?  
7. ¿A qué hora quedas con él?  
8. El lunes me reúno con mi jefe a las 9.  
9. El miércoles vuelo a Barcelona para una conferencia.  
10. El viernes como con mi hermana a la 1.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. Tomorrow I am meeting John at 3.  
2. On Tuesday I am having a dentist appointment at 10.  
3. On Wednesday I am flying to Paris for a meeting.  
4. On Thursday I am having dinner with my parents.  
5. On Friday I am playing tennis at 5.  
6. Are you free on Saturday?  
7. What time are you meeting him?  
8. On Monday I am meeting my boss at 9.  
9. On Wednesday I am flying to Barcelona for a conference.  
10. On Friday I am having lunch with my sister at 1.
</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Tu agenda

Escribe 8–12 líneas sobre **tu** próxima semana:

- 5 días con Present Continuous + día/hora  
- 1 pregunta (*Are you free…? / What time…?*)  
- Vocabulario: *meeting, appointment, dinner, flying…*

**Modelo:** la semana de Tom o la llamada a Lisa.

---

## 12. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Tabla *am/is/are + -ing* + marcadores de futuro.  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–7.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha a Tom y la llamada; completa la agenda.  
4. **5–8 min** — Escribe y di en voz alta tu semana (Ejercicio 10).

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *am/is/are + -ing* con marcador de futuro  
- [ ] Hablo de citas y reuniones fijadas  
- [ ] Pregunto *what time / where / Are you free…?*  
- [ ] Distingo agenda (PC) de promesa (*will*) e intención (*going to*)  
- [ ] Puedo describir mi semana en 5–8 frases

---

## 13. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Si está en el **calendario** (día + hora/persona) → Present Continuous.  
2. Si es promesa u oferta → *will*.  
3. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 24](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-24-present-continuous-futuro-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 24 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-24).

La **Unidad 25** compara **Going to vs Will vs Present Continuous**.

---

## Resumen rápido

| Forma | Uso (U24) |
| :--- | :--- |
| *am/is/are* + *-ing* | planes ya fijados |
| + marcador | *tomorrow, on Monday, at 3…* |
| Preguntas | *What time / Where / Are you free…?* |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 25** verás el contraste completo de futuros.

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 24 A2 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-24-present-continuous-futuro-ejercicios-soluciones)

title: Futuro A2: going to vs will vs Present Continuous
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 25 del curso A2: contraste going to vs will vs Present Continuous, con audios y ejercicios.
description: Contrasta going to, will y Present Continuous para el futuro en inglés A2. Elige la forma correcta según plan, predicción o cita. Guía Unidad 25 con audios y ejercicios.
alt: Esquema de contraste de futuros A2 going to will Present Continuous

faqs.question: ¿Cuándo uso going to, will o Present Continuous?
faqs.answer: Going to: planes/intenciones o predicciones con evidencia. Will: promesas, ofertas, decisiones espontáneas o predicciones generales. Present Continuous: citas y planes ya fijados en la agenda.

faqs.question: ¿Pueden solaparse going to y Present Continuous?
faqs.answer: A veces sí. Si el plan está muy fijado (billete, reserva), Present Continuous es natural: I am flying to London. Si es intención con evidencia (ticket comprado), también going to: I am going to visit the museum.

faqs.question: ¿Qué forma uso para una promesa?
faqs.answer: Will: I will call you when I arrive. / I will send you the invitation tomorrow.

faqs.question: ¿Y si veo nubes oscuras?
faqs.answer: Going to con evidencia: Look! The sky is dark. It is going to rain soon.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 25 del curso A2?

content:
En las [unidades 21–24](/blog/curso-a2) aprendiste tres formas de futuro. En la **Unidad 25 del curso A2** (*Future: Going to vs Will vs Present Continuous*) **eliges** la forma correcta según el contexto.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 25 — Future Contrast](/curso-a2/unit-25)  
> **Antes:** [U24 — Present Continuous for Future](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-24-present-continuous-futuro)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 25 (A2)

- Contrastar **going to**, **will** y **Present Continuous**.
- Decidir según: intención, evidencia, promesa, espontáneo o cita fijada.
- Mezclar las tres formas en un mismo texto (viaje, boda, planes).
- Revisar marcadores temporales de futuro.
- Evitar mezclas incorrectas (*I will flying*, *I am go to…*).

![Tres formas de futuro A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-25/a2-unit25-three-futures.png)

---

## 1. Mapa rápido de las tres formas

| Forma | Uso principal | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **going to** | plan/intención · evidencia | I **am going to** visit the museum. / Look! It **is going to** rain. |
| **will** | promesa · oferta · espontáneo · predicción general | I **will** call you. / Maybe I **will** see a show. / I think it **will** be great. |
| **Present Continuous** | plan ya fijado (agenda) | I **am flying** to London. / On Saturday I **am having** dinner with my cousin. |

---

## 2. Mapa de decisión

![Mapa de decisión de futuros](/blog/curso-a2/unit-25/a2-unit25-decision-map.png)

1. ¿Está **ya organizado** (hora, reserva, billete en agenda)? → **Present Continuous**.  
2. ¿Es un **plan/intención** o hay **evidencia** ahora? → **going to**.  
3. ¿Es **promesa**, **oferta**, decisión **ahora** o predicción **general**? → **will**.

> She **is going to** fly to London next month. She already has the ticket.  
> Look! The sky is dark. It **is going to** rain soon.  
> We **are meeting** John at 3 o'clock tomorrow. It's fixed.  
> I **will** stay at home if it rains tomorrow.  
> I **will** send you the invitation tomorrow.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-25/going-to-ticket.mp3" title="🔊 She is going to fly to London. She already has the ticket"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-25/look-going-to-rain.mp3" title="🔊 Look! The sky is dark. It is going to rain soon"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-25/are-meeting-fixed.mp3" title="🔊 We are meeting John at 3 o'clock tomorrow. It's fixed"></audio>

---

## 3. Repaso rápido de cada forma

### Going to (U21–22)

> I **am going to** visit the British Museum — I have already bought the ticket.  
> I **am going to** wear a white dress — I have already chosen it.

### Will (U23)

> When I arrive, I **will** call you and we **will** meet.  
> Maybe I **will** see a show in the West End too.  
> I think the trip **will** be great!

### Present Continuous (U24)

> Next week I **am flying** to London — that is already arranged.  
> On Saturday I **am having** dinner with my cousin — we booked the restaurant last week.  
> Next Saturday I **am getting married** — it is already arranged!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-25/will-call-you.mp3" title="🔊 When I arrive, I will call you and we will meet"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-25/am-flying-london.mp3" title="🔊 Next week I am flying to London — that is already arranged"></audio>

---

## 4. Misma idea, forma distinta (elige el matiz)

| Situación | Mejor forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Billete / reserva hecha | PC o *going to* | I **am flying** / I **am going to** fly… |
| Decisión en el momento | *will* | OK, I **'ll** call you. |
| Nubes oscuras | *going to* | It **is going to** rain. |
| Opinión general | *will* | I think it **will** be perfect. |
| Cita en el diary | Present Continuous | I **am meeting** John at 3. |
| Promesa | *will* | I **will** send the invitation tomorrow. |

---

## 5. Texto modelo: viaje a Londres

> Next week I am flying to London — that is already arranged. When I arrive, I will call you and we will meet. I am going to visit the British Museum — I have already bought the ticket. Maybe I will see a show in the West End too. On Saturday I am having dinner with my cousin — we booked the restaurant last week. I think the trip will be great!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-25/reading-london.mp3" title="🔊 Next week I am flying to London…"></audio>

![Viaje a Londres con tres futuros](/blog/curso-a2/unit-25/a2-unit25-london-trip.png)

| Frase | Forma | Por qué |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| I am flying to London | Present Continuous | ya organizado |
| I will call you / we will meet | *will* | promesa / decisión al llegar |
| I am going to visit the museum | *going to* | plan + ticket |
| Maybe I will see a show | *will* | posibilidad espontánea |
| I am having dinner… | Present Continuous | reserva hecha |
| I think the trip will be great | *will* | predicción general |

---

## 6. Listening: boda de Anna

> Hi Anna! I am calling about our plans. Next Saturday I am getting married — it is already arranged! I will send you the invitation tomorrow. I am going to wear a white dress — I have already chosen it. Maybe I will have a party the day after too. I think everything will be perfect!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-25/dialogue-wedding.mp3" title="🔊 Hi Anna! I am calling about our plans…"></audio>

Preguntas rápidas:

1. ¿Qué pasa el sábado? → *getting married* (PC — ya organizado)  
2. ¿Qué hará mañana? → *will send the invitation* (*will* — promesa)  
3. ¿El vestido? → *am going to wear a white dress* (plan + ya elegido)  
4. ¿Fiesta después? → *Maybe I will have a party* (*will* — quizás)  
5. ¿Predicción final? → *everything will be perfect*

---

## 7. Mini práctica oral

> I am …ing … tomorrow.  
> I am going to…  
> I will…  
> Look! … is going to…

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-25/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 I am meeting… I am going to… I will…"></audio>

1. Di **1** frase con cada forma (PC / *going to* / *will*).  
2. Explica **por qué** elegiste cada una.  
3. Mezcla las tres en un mini relato (viaje o fin de semana).

---

## 8. Vocabulario (del curso)

| Inglés | Idea |
| :--- | :--- |
| arrangement / arranged / fixed | acuerdo / organizado / fijado |
| spontaneous / prediction / intention | espontáneo / predicción / intención |
| ticket / booked / chosen | billete·entrada / reservado / elegido |
| invitation / wedding / get married | invitación / boda / casarse |
| museum / show / restaurant | museo / espectáculo / restaurante |
| send / wear / visit / meet / call | enviar / llevar puesto / visitar / quedar / llamar |
| already / next week / the day after | ya / la próxima semana / al día siguiente |
| Maybe / I think / Look! | quizás / creo / ¡mira! |

---

## 9. Errores frecuentes

| Incorrecto | Correcto | Por qué |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| I will flying to London. | I **am flying** / I **will fly**… | No mezcles *will* + *-ing* |
| I am go to visit the museum. | I **am going to** visit… | *going to* + infinitivo |
| Look! It will rain. *(nubes ahora)* | Look! It **is going to** rain. | evidencia → *going to* |
| I promise I am helping you. | I promise I **will** help you. | promesa → *will* |
| Tomorrow I will meeting John at 3. *(cita fijada)* | Tomorrow I **am meeting** John at 3. | agenda → PC |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-25/will-send-invitation.mp3" title="🔊 I will send you the invitation tomorrow"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-25/going-to-wear-dress.mp3" title="🔊 I am going to wear a white dress"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-25/think-will-be-perfect.mp3" title="🔊 I think everything will be perfect"></audio>

---

## 10. Ejercicios

### Ejercicio 1 — Elige la forma

1. Look! The sky is dark. It ____ rain soon. (*going to / will / are*)  
2. We ____ meeting John at 3 tomorrow. It's fixed. (*will / are / are going to*)  
3. I ____ call you when I arrive. (*will / am / am going to*)  
4. She ____ fly to London next month. She already has the ticket. (*will / is going to / is*)  
5. I think the trip ____ be great. (*will / is going to / is*)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **is going to** · 2. **are** · 3. **will** · 4. **is going to** · 5. **will**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Etiqueta la forma

Escribe **GT** (*going to*), **W** (*will*) o **PC** (Present Continuous):

1. Next week I am flying to London.  
2. I will call you when I arrive.  
3. I am going to visit the British Museum.  
4. Maybe I will see a show.  
5. On Saturday I am having dinner with my cousin.  
6. I think the trip will be great.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **PC** · 2. **W** · 3. **GT** · 4. **W** · 5. **PC** · 6. **W**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Completa Londres

Next week I ____ flying to London. When I arrive, I ____ call you. I ____ going to visit the museum — I have already bought the ticket. On Saturday I ____ having dinner with my cousin.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**am** · **will** · **am** · **am**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Completa la boda

Next Saturday I ____ getting married. I ____ send you the invitation tomorrow. I ____ going to wear a white dress. Maybe I ____ have a party the day after. I think everything ____ be perfect!

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**am** · **will** · **am** · **will** · **will**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Empareja uso ↔ forma

1. evidencia ahora  
2. cita fijada  
3. promesa  
4. intención + ticket  
5. predicción general (*I think*)  

a) *will* · b) *going to* (evidencia) · c) Present Continuous · d) *going to* (plan) · e) *will*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **b** · 2 → **c** · 3 → **a/e** · 4 → **d** · 5 → **a/e**
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Elige la mejor opción

1. Prometo enviarte la invitación mañana.  
   a) I am sending you… tomorrow. · b) I will send you… tomorrow. · c) Look! I am going to send…  
2. Reserva del restaurante hecha.  
   a) I will have dinner… · b) I am having dinner… · c) Maybe I will having dinner…  
3. Nubes oscuras.  
   a) It will rain. · b) It is going to rain. · c) It is raining tomorrow.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **b** · 2. **b** · 3. **b**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Corrige

1. *I will flying to London next week.*  
2. *I am go to visit the museum.*  
3. *Look! It will rain.* *(ves nubes ahora)*  
4. *I promise I am helping you.*  
5. *Tomorrow I will meeting John at 3.* *(cita fijada)*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I **am flying** to London next week. / I **will fly**…  
2. I **am going to** visit the museum.  
3. Look! It **is going to** rain.  
4. I promise I **will** help you.  
5. Tomorrow I **am meeting** John at 3.
</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Traduce (elige la forma natural)

1. La próxima semana vuelo a Londres (ya organizado).  
2. Cuando llegue, te llamaré.  
3. Voy a visitar el museo (ya tengo la entrada).  
4. Quizás vea un espectáculo.  
5. El sábado ceno con mi primo (reserva hecha).  
6. Creo que el viaje será genial.  
7. El sábado que viene me caso (ya organizado).  
8. Te enviaré la invitación mañana.  
9. Voy a llevar un vestido blanco (ya lo he elegido).  
10. ¡Mira! Va a llover pronto.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. Next week I am flying to London.  
2. When I arrive, I will call you.  
3. I am going to visit the museum.  
4. Maybe I will see a show.  
5. On Saturday I am having dinner with my cousin.  
6. I think the trip will be great.  
7. Next Saturday I am getting married.  
8. I will send you the invitation tomorrow.  
9. I am going to wear a white dress.  
10. Look! It is going to rain soon.
</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Mini contraste

Completa con *will / going to / am-is-are + -ing* (una forma lógica):

1. A: The phone is ringing! B: OK, I ____ answer it.  
2. Look at those dark clouds! It ____ rain.  
3. I ____ meeting my boss at 9 tomorrow.  
4. I ____ wear this dress — I have already chosen it.  
5. I think everything ____ be perfect.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **'ll / will** · 2. **is going to** · 3. **am** · 4. **am going to** · 5. **will**
</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Tu texto mixto

Escribe 8–12 líneas mezclando las **tres** formas:

- 2 × Present Continuous (agenda)  
- 2 × *going to* (plan/evidencia)  
- 2 × *will* (promesa / Maybe / I think)  

**Modelo:** viaje a Londres o boda.

---

## 11. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Tabla de las 3 formas + mapa de decisión.  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–7.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha Londres y la boda; etiqueta cada verbo.  
4. **5–8 min** — Escribe tu texto mixto (Ejercicio 10).

### Checklist

- [ ] Distingo *going to / will / Present Continuous*  
- [ ] Uso PC para citas fijadas  
- [ ] Uso *going to* para plan o evidencia  
- [ ] Uso *will* para promesa, oferta y predicción general  
- [ ] Puedo mezclar las tres en un mismo relato

---

## 12. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Pregunta: ¿agenda, evidencia o promesa?  
2. Luego elige la forma.  
3. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 25](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-25-futuro-going-to-will-present-continuous-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 25 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-25).

La **Unidad 26** introduce el **First Conditional**: *If it rains, I'll stay at home.*

---

## Resumen rápido

| Forma | Pregunta clave |
| :--- | :--- |
| Present Continuous | ¿Ya está fijado en la agenda? |
| *going to* | ¿Plan/intención o evidencia ahora? |
| *will* | ¿Promesa, oferta, espontáneo o predicción general? |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 26** verás el **First Conditional**.

title: First Conditional A2: If it rains, I will stay at home
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 26 del curso A2: First Conditional (If + Present Simple, will + infinitivo), con audios y ejercicios.
description: Aprende el First Conditional en inglés A2: If + Present Simple, will + infinitivo. Condiciones reales y consecuencias. Guía Unidad 26 con audios y ejercicios.
alt: Esquema del First Conditional A2

faqs.question: ¿Qué es el First Conditional?
faqs.answer: Habla de una condición real o posible en el futuro y su resultado: If it rains, I will stay at home. Forma: If + Present Simple, will + infinitivo.

faqs.question: ¿Puedo cambiar el orden de las cláusulas?
faqs.answer: Sí. If it rains, I will stay at home. / I will stay at home if it rains. Con If al principio suele haber coma; si if va en medio, normalmente no.

faqs.question: ¿Uso will en la cláusula de If?
faqs.answer: No. Después de If usas Present Simple (If it rains…), no If it will rain. Will va en el resultado: … I will stay at home.

faqs.question: ¿Para qué sirve en A2?
faqs.answer: Para consejos, advertencias y planes condicionados: If you study hard, you will pass. If you need help, I will come.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 26 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el [cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-26-first-conditional-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la Unidad 26 del curso A2 de Linguafly: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening, speaking y writing.

content:
En la [Unidad 25](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-25-futuro-going-to-will-present-continuous) contrastaste futuros. En la **Unidad 26 del curso A2** (*First Conditional*) unes **condición** y **resultado**: *If it rains, I'll stay at home.*

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 26 — First Conditional](/curso-a2/unit-26)  
> **Antes:** [U25 — Futuro: going to vs will vs Present Continuous](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-25-futuro-going-to-will-present-continuous)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 26 (A2)

- Formar **If + Present Simple, will + infinitivo**.
- Hablar de condiciones **reales / posibles** en el futuro.
- Cambiar el **orden** de las cláusulas.
- Usar negativa: *If I don't pass… / I won't…*
- Dar consejos y advertencias (*If you need help…*).

![First Conditional A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/a2-unit26-first-conditional.png)

---

## 1. Idea clave

| Parte | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Condición | *If* + **Present Simple** | If it **rains**… |
| Resultado | **will** + infinitivo | … I **will stay** at home. |

Significado: **si pasa X (posible), entonces haré / pasará Y**.

> If it **rains**, I **will stay** at home.  
> If you **study** hard, you **will pass** the exam.  
> If she **comes** to the party, I **will be** very happy.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/if-rains-stay-home.mp3" title="🔊 If it rains, I will stay at home"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/if-study-pass.mp3" title="🔊 If you study hard, you will pass the exam"></audio>

---

## 2. Dos órdenes (mismo significado)

![Orden de cláusulas First Conditional](/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/a2-unit26-clause-order.png)

| Orden | Ejemplo | Coma |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| *If* primero | **If** it rains**,** I will stay at home. | Sí (normalmente) |
| Resultado primero | I will stay at home **if** it rains. | No |

> If the weather **is** nice, I **will go** for a walk in the park.  
> I **will make** coffee for you if you **come** to visit me.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/if-weather-nice.mp3" title="🔊 If the weather is nice, I will go for a walk in the park"></audio>

---

## 3. Negativa y *don't / won't*

| Tipo | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| Condición negativa | If I **don't pass**, I **will study** harder next time. |
| Resultado negativo | If we **miss** the bus, we **won't** be on time. / we **will be** late. |
| Ambos posibles | If you **don't** finish early, I **won't** let you go out. |

> If I **pass** the exam, I **will celebrate** with my friends.  
> If I **don't pass**, I **will study** harder next time.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/if-pass-celebrate.mp3" title="🔊 If I pass the exam, I will celebrate with my friends"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/if-dont-pass-study.mp3" title="🔊 If I don't pass, I will study harder next time"></audio>

---

## 4. Consejos, advertencias y planes

| Uso | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| Consejo / trato | If you **finish** your homework early, I **will let** you go out tonight. |
| Advertencia | If the bus **is** late, I **will be** late to work. |
| Oferta de ayuda | If you **need** help, just call me and I **will come**. |
| Plan condicionado | If it **rains** on Saturday, we **will stay** at home and play games. |
| Recompensa | If you **pass** the exam, I **will buy** you a present. |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/if-finish-homework.mp3" title="🔊 If you finish your homework early, I will let you go out tonight"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/if-need-help.mp3" title="🔊 If you need help, just call me and I will come"></audio>

---

## 5. Texto modelo: planes de mañana

> If it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home. I will watch a film and relax. If the weather is nice, I will go for a walk in the park. If you come to visit me, I will make coffee for you. If I pass the exam, I will celebrate with my friends. If I don't pass, I will study harder next time.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/reading-plans.mp3" title="🔊 If it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home…"></audio>

![Escenarios If… I will…](/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/a2-unit26-if-scenarios.png)

| If… | … will… |
| :--- | :--- |
| it rains | stay at home / watch a film |
| the weather is nice | go for a walk |
| you come to visit | make coffee |
| I pass the exam | celebrate |
| I don't pass | study harder |

---

## 6. Listening: reglas en casa

> If you finish your homework early, I will let you go out tonight. If it rains on Saturday, we will stay at home and play games. If you pass the exam, I will buy you a present. If the bus is late, I will be late to work. If you need help, just call me and I will come.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/dialogue-rules.mp3" title="🔊 If you finish your homework early…"></audio>

Preguntas rápidas:

1. ¿Deberes temprano? → *go out tonight*  
2. ¿Llueve el sábado? → *stay at home and play games*  
3. ¿Aprueba? → *buy a present*  
4. ¿Bus tarde? → *late to work*  
5. ¿Necesitas ayuda? → *call me / I will come*

---

## 7. Mini práctica oral

> If it rains tomorrow, I will…  
> If I pass the exam, I will…  
> If you need help, I will…  
> What will you do if…?

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 If it rains tomorrow, I will…"></audio>

1. Di **4** frases *If…, I will…*  
2. Incluye **1** con *don't* o *won't*.  
3. Pregunta a un compañero: *What will you do if…?*

---

## 8. Vocabulario (del curso)

| Inglés | Idea |
| :--- | :--- |
| condition / consequence | condición / consecuencia |
| if / unless *(más adelante)* | si / a menos que |
| rain / weather / nice | llover / tiempo / bueno |
| stay at home / go for a walk | quedarse en casa / ir a pasear |
| pass / don't pass / study harder | aprobar / no aprobar / estudiar más |
| finish / homework / go out | terminar / deberes / salir |
| miss the bus / be late | perder el bus / llegar tarde |
| need help / call / come | necesitar ayuda / llamar / venir |
| celebrate / present / play games | celebrar / regalo / jugar |
| tomorrow / on Saturday / next time | mañana / el sábado / la próxima vez |

---

## 9. Errores frecuentes

| Incorrecto | Correcto | Por qué |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| If it **will** rain, I will stay… | If it **rains**, I will stay… | Tras *If* → Present Simple |
| If she **come**, I will be happy. | If she **comes**, … | *she* → *-s* |
| If you study, you **pass**. *(futuro posible)* | If you study, you **will pass**. | Resultado con *will* en First |
| If we will miss the bus… | If we **miss** the bus… | No *will* en la condición |
| I will stay at home, if it rains. *(coma)* | I will stay at home if it rains. | Sin coma si *if* va en medio |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/if-miss-bus.mp3" title="🔊 If we miss the bus, we will be late"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/if-pass-present.mp3" title="🔊 If you pass the exam, I will buy you a present"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/if-rains-saturday.mp3" title="🔊 If it rains on Saturday, we will stay at home and play games"></audio>

---

## 10. Ejercicios

### Ejercicio 1 — Present Simple o *will*

1. If it ____ (rain), I will stay at home.  
2. If you study hard, you ____ (pass) the exam.  
3. If she ____ (come) to the party, I will be happy.  
4. If we miss the bus, we ____ (be) late.  
5. If you ____ (need) help, I will come.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **rains** · 2. **will pass** · 3. **comes** · 4. **will be** · 5. **need**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Completa

1. If it rains tomorrow, I will ____ at home.  
2. If the weather is nice, I will ____ for a walk.  
3. If you come to visit, I will ____ coffee.  
4. If I pass the exam, I will ____ with my friends.  
5. If I don't pass, I will ____ harder.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **stay** · 2. **go** · 3. **make** · 4. **celebrate** · 5. **study**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Une

1. If you finish your homework early,  
2. If it rains on Saturday,  
3. If you pass the exam,  
4. If the bus is late,  
5. If you need help,  

a) I will buy you a present.  
b) I will be late to work.  
c) I will let you go out tonight.  
d) just call me and I will come.  
e) we will stay at home and play games.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **c** · 2 → **e** · 3 → **a** · 4 → **b** · 5 → **d**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Ordena / reescribe

1. stay / If / rains / I / it / will / home / at → ____  
2. Rewrite without starting with *If*: *If it rains, I will stay at home.* → ____

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **If it rains, I will stay at home.**  
2. **I will stay at home if it rains.**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Negativa

1. If I ____ (not / pass), I will study harder.  
2. If you ____ (not / finish) early, I ____ (not / let) you go out.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **don't pass**  
2. **don't finish** · **won't let** / **will not let**
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Elige la correcta

1. ____  
   a) If it will rain, I will stay home. · b) If it rains, I will stay home. · c) If it rains, I stay home. *(First Conditional A2)*  
2. ____  
   a) If she come, I will be happy. · b) If she comes, I will be happy. · c) If she will come, I will be happy.  
3. ____  
   a) I will stay at home if it rains. · b) I will stay at home, if it rains. *(coma típica)* · c) I stay at home if it will rain.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **b** · 2. **b** · 3. **a**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Corrige

1. *If it will rain, I will stay at home.*  
2. *If she come, I will be happy.*  
3. *If you study hard, you pass the exam.* *(futuro posible)*  
4. *If we will miss the bus, we will be late.*  
5. *I will stay at home, if it rains.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. If it **rains**, I will stay at home.  
2. If she **comes**, I will be happy.  
3. If you study hard, you **will pass** the exam.  
4. If we **miss** the bus, we will be late.  
5. I will stay at home if it rains. *(sin coma)*
</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Traduce

1. Si llueve, me quedaré en casa.  
2. Si estudias mucho, aprobarás el examen.  
3. Si ella viene a la fiesta, estaré muy feliz.  
4. Si perdemos el autobús, llegaremos tarde.  
5. Si el tiempo es bueno, iré a pasear al parque.  
6. Si vienes a visitarme, te haré un café.  
7. Si apruebo, celebraré con mis amigos.  
8. Si no apruebo, estudiaré más la próxima vez.  
9. Si terminas los deberes temprano, te dejaré salir.  
10. Si necesitas ayuda, llámame y vendré.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. If it rains, I will stay at home.  
2. If you study hard, you will pass the exam.  
3. If she comes to the party, I will be very happy.  
4. If we miss the bus, we will be late.  
5. If the weather is nice, I will go for a walk in the park.  
6. If you come to visit me, I will make coffee for you.  
7. If I pass, I will celebrate with my friends.  
8. If I don't pass, I will study harder next time.  
9. If you finish your homework early, I will let you go out.  
10. If you need help, call me and I will come.
</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Completa el listening

If you ____ your homework early, I will let you ____ out. If it ____ on Saturday, we will stay at home and ____ games. If you ____ the exam, I will buy you a present.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**finish** · **go** · **rains** · **play** · **pass**
</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Tus condiciones

Escribe 8–12 líneas con First Conditional:

- 3 × *If…, I will…*  
- 1 × con *don't*  
- 1 × con el resultado primero (*I will… if…*)  
- Temas: tiempo, estudio, planes del fin de semana  

**Modelo:** el texto de planes de mañana.

---

## 11. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Fórmula *If + Present Simple, will + infinitivo*.  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–7.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha los dos textos; subraya cada *If / will*.  
4. **5–8 min** — Escribe y di tus condiciones (Ejercicio 10).

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso Present Simple tras *If* (no *will*)  
- [ ] Uso *will* + infinitivo en el resultado  
- [ ] Cambio el orden de las cláusulas  
- [ ] Formo negativas con *don't / won't*  
- [ ] Puedo dar consejos y planes condicionados

---

## 12. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Primero la **condición** (Present Simple).  
2. Luego el **resultado** (*will*).  
3. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 26](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-26-first-conditional-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 26 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-26).

La **Unidad 27** introduce el **Zero Conditional**: hechos generales (*If you heat water, it boils*).

---

## Resumen rápido

| Parte | Forma |
| :--- | :--- |
| Condición | *If* + Present Simple |
| Resultado | *will* + infinitivo |
| Uso | posibilidad real en el futuro |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 27** verás el **Zero Conditional**.

faqs.question: ¿Qué es el Zero Conditional?
faqs.answer: Habla de verdades generales y hechos científicos: If you heat water, it boils. Forma: If + Present Simple, Present Simple (sin will).

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia con el First Conditional?
faqs.answer: Zero = siempre verdadero (hechos/rutinas): If you heat water, it boils. First = posibilidad futura: If it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home.

faqs.question: ¿Uso will en el Zero Conditional?
faqs.answer: No. Ambas partes van en Present Simple. Incorrecto: If you heat water, it will boils. Correcto: If you heat water, it boils.
