<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/dialogue-take-bus.mp3" title="🔊 I take the bus"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/dialogue-by-car.mp3" title="🔊 I go by car"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/dialogue-sister-train.mp3" title="🔊 She travels by train to London"></audio>

---

## 8. Errores típicos de hispanohablantes

| ❌ Incorrecto | ✅ Correcto | Explicación |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| *by **the** bus* | *by bus* | sin artículo |
| *by **a** train* | *by train* | sin artículo |
| *take bus* | *take **the** bus* | con *the* |
| *I go **in** bus* | *I go **by** bus* | *by* para medio |
| *I go **with** the bus* | *I go **by** bus* | no *with* |
| *by the bicycle* | *by bicycle* | sin *the* |

---

## 9. Pronunciación útil

| Palabra / frase | Tip A1 |
| :--- | :--- |
| **by bus** | *bai BAS*. |
| **by train** | *bai TREIN*. |
| **by plane** | *bai PLEIN*. |
| **taxi** | *TAK-si*. |
| **bicycle** | *BAI-si-kel*. |
| **take the bus** | une: *teik-dha-BAS*. |
| **every day** | *EV-ri dei*. |

Practica: *by bus → by train → by plane → take the bus → take the train*.

---

## 10. Mini-diálogos para memorizar

> **A:** How do you go to work?  
> **B:** I go by bus. And you?  
> **A:** I take the train.

> **A:** Do you travel by plane?  
> **B:** Yes, for holidays.  
> **A:** How do you go to the airport?  
> **B:** By taxi.

> **A:** How does your brother go to school?  
> **B:** By bicycle — it's fast and cheap.

Cambia solo el medio: fijas ***by…*** o ***take the…***.

---

## 10b. Plantillas para copiar

1. I go to work by \_\_\_\_.  
2. She takes the \_\_\_\_ to London.  
3. We travel by \_\_\_\_ for holidays.  
4. How do you go to \_\_\_\_?  
5. Last week I went to the airport by \_\_\_\_.  
6. He goes to school by bicycle.

### Más frases para memorizar

> I go to work by bus every day.  
> She travels by train to London.  
> We take the bus every day.  
> She takes the train every Monday.  
> We travel by plane to Spain.  
> He goes by car to the office.  
> I went to the airport by taxi.  
> My brother goes to school by bicycle.  
> How do you go to work?  
> I take the bus.  
> I go by car.  
> She travels by train to London.  
> Do you ever go by plane?  
> Yes, for holidays.  
> It is fast and cheap.  
> We sometimes travel by plane for holidays.  
> My sister takes the train to London.  
> Last week I went to the airport by taxi.

Lee la lista dos veces. Luego escribe **cómo vas** tú al trabajo o al colegio.

### Rutina de 2 minutos

1. Di 4 frases *by + transport*.  
2. Di 3 con *take the + transport*.  
3. Pregunta *How do you go to work?* y responde.  
4. Añade *for holidays* / *every day*.

### Combinar U41 + U42

| Unidad | Aporta | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| U41 | aeropuerto | You must show your passport. |
| **U42** | cómo llegas | I go to the airport **by taxi**. |

### Mini-historia para reescribir

> I go to work by bus every day. My sister takes the train to London. We sometimes travel by plane for holidays. Last week I went to the airport by taxi. My brother goes to school by bicycle.

Cambia personas y medios; mantén *by* / *take the*.

### Tour guiado (modelo)

> I go to work by bus every day. My sister takes the train to London. We sometimes travel by plane for holidays. Last week I went to the airport by taxi. My brother goes to school by bicycle. He likes it because it is fast and cheap.

Grábate leyéndolo. Luego improvisa con **tus** medios reales.

### Frases extra para practicar en voz alta

> How do you go to work?  
> I take the bus.  
> I go by car.  
> She travels by train.  
> We travel by plane for holidays.  
> He goes by bicycle.  
> I went by taxi.

Personaliza destinos reales (*school, work, airport, London*).

### Checklist mental

- *by + transport* (sin *the*)  
- *take the + transport* (con *the*)  
- Vocab: bus · train · plane · taxi · bicycle · car  
- Pregunta: *How do you go…?*  
- Contextos: *every day* · *for holidays*

### Mapa rápido

| Unidad | Enfoque |
| :--- | :--- |
| U41 | At the Airport — must/should |
| **U42** | Transport — by / take the |
| U43 | Travel Verbs — arrive, depart, visit… |

---

## 11. Ejercicios prácticos (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — Completa *by* o *take*

1. I go to work \_\_\_\_ bus.  
2. We \_\_\_\_ the bus every day.  
3. She travels \_\_\_\_ train to London.  
4. They \_\_\_\_ the train to Paris.  
5. We travel \_\_\_\_ plane for holidays.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **by**  
2. **take**  
3. **by**  
4. **take**  
5. **by**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Elige el transporte

1. flies in the air → \_\_\_\_  
2. on rails → \_\_\_\_  
3. many people on the road → \_\_\_\_  
4. two wheels, you pedal → \_\_\_\_  
5. car you pay for → \_\_\_\_

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **plane**  
2. **train**  
3. **bus**  
4. **bicycle**  
5. **taxi**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Traduce

1. Voy al trabajo en autobús.  
2. Ella coge el tren a Londres.  
3. Viajamos en avión para vacaciones.  
4. Fui al aeropuerto en taxi.  
5. ¿Cómo vas al trabajo?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **I go to work by bus.**  
2. **She takes the train to London.**  
3. **We travel by plane for holidays.**  
4. **I went to the airport by taxi.**  
5. **How do you go to work?**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Ordena

1. bus / by / work / to / go / I  
2. the / takes / train / She  
3. plane / by / travel / We  
4. bicycle / by / school / to / goes / He

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **I go to work by bus.**  
2. **She takes the train.**  
3. **We travel by plane.**  
4. **He goes to school by bicycle.**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Reading corto

Lee el texto de la sección 6. Contesta:

1. How does the writer go to work?  
2. How does the sister travel to London?  
3. When do they travel by plane?  
4. How did the writer go to the airport last week?  
5. How does the brother go to school?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **By bus**  
2. **By train / takes the train**  
3. **For holidays**  
4. **By taxi**  
5. **By bicycle**
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Corrige el error

1. I go by the bus.  
2. She takes train.  
3. We travel by a plane.  
4. He goes in bicycle.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **I go by bus.**  
2. **She takes the train.**  
3. **We travel by plane.**  
4. **He goes by bicycle.**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Escribe tus viajes

Escribe 8–10 frases. Incluye:

- *by* (3 veces) y *take the* (2 veces)  
- al menos 4 medios (*bus, train, plane, taxi, bicycle, car*)  
- *How do you go…?*  
- *every day* o *for holidays*

**Modelo:** el texto de la sección 6.

### Ejercicio 8 — Elige la opción correcta

1. I go \_\_\_\_ bus. (by / by the / take)  
2. She \_\_\_\_ the train every Monday. (takes / by / take)  
3. We travel \_\_\_\_ plane. (by / the / take)  
4. How \_\_\_\_ you go to work? (do / does / are)  
5. He goes to school \_\_\_\_ bicycle. (by / by the / take)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **by**  
2. **takes**  
3. **by**  
4. **do**  
5. **by**
</details>

---

## 12. Plan de práctica (15 minutos)

1. **3 min** — Di 5 frases *by + transport*.  
2. **3 min** — Di 5 con *take the + transport*.  
3. **4 min** — Reescribe el reading con tu familia.  
4. **5 min** — Mini-entrevista *How do you go…?*

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *by* sin artículo  
- [ ] Uso *take the* con *the*  
- [ ] Conozco bus / train / plane / taxi / bicycle / car  
- [ ] Pregunto *How do you go…?*  
- [ ] Hablo de trabajo y vacaciones

---

## 13. Consejos para practicar

1. **Agenda real:** anota durante un día *by bus / by car / by bicycle*.  
2. **Pareja:** pregunta *How do you go to work/school?* y responde con las dos estructuras.  
3. **Combina** U41: *I went to the airport by taxi. I must show my passport.*  
4. Prepárate para la [Unidad 43](/curso-a1/unit-43): *Travel Verbs* (*arrive, depart, visit, stay*).  
5. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 42](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-42-transporte-by-take-the-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 42 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-42).

---

## Resumen rápido

| Tema | Lo esencial |
| :--- | :--- |
| by + transport | sin artículo (*by bus*) |
| take the + transport | con *the* (*take the bus*) |
| Vocab | bus · train · plane · taxi · bicycle · car |
| Pregunta | How do you go to…? |
| Tip | no mezcles: *by the bus* / *take bus* |
| Contextos | every day · for holidays |

---

faqs.question: ¿Qué tiempo uso para horarios de tren o avión en A1?
faqs.answer: Present Simple: The train leaves at nine. The plane arrives at three. Aunque el viaje sea futuro, el horario se expresa en Present Simple.

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre leave, depart y arrive?
faqs.answer: Leave y depart significan salir/partir. Arrive significa llegar. Ejemplo: The train leaves at 8 and arrives in London at 10:30.

faqs.question: ¿Se dice arrive in o arrive at?
faqs.answer: En A1: arrive in + ciudad (arrive in London) y arrive at + hora (arrives at half past ten). También arrive at + lugar concreto (arrive at the station).

faqs.question: ¿Qué verbos de viaje practico en la Unidad 43?
faqs.answer: Leave, depart, arrive, visit, stay y explore. Frases: stay at a hotel, visit museums, explore the city.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 43 del curso A1?
faqs.answer: En la Unidad 43 del curso A1 de Linguafly y en el cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones del blog: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening y speaking.

content:
En la [Unidad 42](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-42-transporte-by-take-the) hablaste de *by bus / take the train*. En la **Unidad 43 del curso A1** (*Travel Verbs*) usas el **Present Simple para horarios** y verbos como ***leave, arrive, visit, stay, explore***.

Conecta con el aeropuerto de la [Unidad 41](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-41-aeropuerto-must-should) y el Present Simple de la [Unidad 5](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-5-present-simple-rutinas). Incluye **audios**, **esquemas** y **ejercicios**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 43 — Travel Verbs](/curso-a1/unit-43)  
> **Repaso útil:** [Unidad 42 — Transport](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-42-transporte-by-take-the) · [Unidad 41 — At the Airport](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-41-aeropuerto-must-should)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 43 (A1)

Al terminar esta unidad serás capaz de:

- Usar ***Present Simple*** para horarios (*The train leaves at…*).
- Decir ***leave / depart*** (salir) y ***arrive*** (llegar).
- Usar ***visit, stay, explore*** en planes de viaje.
- Preguntar: ***When does your train leave?*** / ***What time does it arrive?***
- Describir un viaje: salida → llegada → hotel → museos → vuelo de vuelta.

---

## 1. Present Simple para horarios

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| The train **leaves** at… | The train **leaves** at nine o'clock. |
| The bus **departs** at… | The bus **departs** at half past seven. |
| The plane **arrives** at… | The plane **arrives** at three o'clock. |
| It **arrives in** London at… | It **arrives in** London at half past ten. |

![Horarios Present Simple A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/a1-unit43-schedules.png)

```
Present Simple (schedules)
→ The train leaves / arrives / departs at + time
→ 3.ª persona: leaves, arrives, departs (con -s)
```

### Tip

Aunque hables de **mañana** o la **próxima semana**, el horario fijo va en Present Simple: *My train leaves at eight tomorrow.* No digas *is leaving* para el horario tipográfico del billete (en A1 priorizamos Present Simple).

### Tercera persona

| Sujeto | Verbo |
| :--- | :--- |
| the train / the bus / the plane / it | leave**s**, arrive**s**, depart**s** |
| I / you / we / they | leave, arrive, depart |

---

## 2. Verbos de viaje

| Verbo | Significado | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **leave** | salir | The train **leaves** at eight. |
| **depart** | partir/salir | My flight **departs** on Sunday. |
| **arrive** | llegar | It **arrives** in London at 10:30. |
| **visit** | visitar | I want to **visit** the museums. |
| **stay** | quedarse | I **stay** at a hotel for three nights. |
| **explore** | explorar | I want to **explore** the city. |

![Verbos de viaje A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/a1-unit43-travel-verbs.png)

### arrive in / arrive at

| Uso | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| arrive **in** + ciudad | arrive **in** London |
| arrive **at** + hora | arrives **at** half past ten |
| arrive **at** + lugar | arrive **at** the station |

### stay at

> I **stay at** a hotel for two nights.  
> She **stays at** a hotel near the museum.

---

## 3. Ejemplos con audio

> The train **leaves** at nine o'clock.  
> The bus **departs** at half past seven.  
> My flight **leaves** at ten in the morning.  
> The plane **arrives** at three o'clock.  
> The train **arrives in** London at noon.  
> I **stay** at a hotel for three nights.  
> I want to **visit** the museums.  
> I want to **explore** the city.  
> My flight **departs** on Sunday at five.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/bus-departs.mp3" title="🔊 The bus departs at half past seven"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/flight-leaves-ten.mp3" title="🔊 My flight leaves at ten in the morning"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/arrives-in-london.mp3" title="🔊 The train arrives in London at noon"></audio>

---

## 4. Un día de viaje (flujo)

![Día de viaje A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/a1-unit43-travel-day.png)

| Paso | Inglés | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1 | **Leaves** | My train leaves at eight. |
| 2 | **Arrives** | It arrives in London at half past ten. |
| 3 | **Stay / visit / explore** | I stay at a hotel. I visit museums and explore the city. |
| 4 | **Departs** | My flight departs on Sunday at five. |

---

## 5. Preguntas y respuestas

> **When does your train leave?**  
> **It leaves at nine o'clock.**

> **What time does it arrive in London?**  
> **At half past eleven.**

> **Do you visit museums?**  
> **Yes — I want to explore the city.**

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/what-time-arrive.mp3" title="🔊 What time does it arrive in London?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/half-past-eleven.mp3" title="🔊 At half past eleven"></audio>

### Tabla de preguntas

| Pregunta | Respuesta |
| :--- | :--- |
| When does your train leave? | It leaves at nine. |
| What time does it arrive? | At half past ten. |
| Where do you stay? | At a hotel. |
| Do you visit museums? | Yes, I do. |

---

## 6. Reading modelo: viaje a Londres

> **I am going to London next week.** My train **leaves** at eight o'clock in the morning. It **arrives** in London at half past ten. I **stay** at a hotel for three nights. I want to **visit** the museums and **explore** the city. My flight **departs** on Sunday at five o'clock.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/reading-going-london.mp3" title="🔊 I am going to London next week"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/reading-train-leaves.mp3" title="🔊 My train leaves at eight o'clock in the morning"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/reading-arrives-london.mp3" title="🔊 It arrives in London at half past ten"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/reading-stay-hotel.mp3" title="🔊 I stay at a hotel for three nights"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/reading-visit-explore.mp3" title="🔊 I want to visit the museums and explore the city"></audio>

### Comprueba

1. ¿Adónde va? → **London**.  
2. ¿A qué hora sale el tren? → **At eight**.  
3. ¿A qué hora llega? → **At half past ten**.  
4. ¿Cuántas noches en hotel? → **Three**.  
5. ¿Qué quiere hacer? → **Visit museums and explore the city**.  
6. ¿Cuándo sale el vuelo? → **Sunday at five**.

---

## 7. Diálogo modelo

> **A:** When does your train leave?  
> **B:** It leaves at nine o'clock.  
> **A:** What time does it arrive in London?  
> **B:** At half past eleven. I stay at a hotel for two nights.  
> **A:** Do you visit museums?  
> **B:** Yes, I want to explore the city. My flight departs on Monday at six in the evening.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/dialogue-when-leave.mp3" title="🔊 When does your train leave?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/dialogue-leaves-nine.mp3" title="🔊 It leaves at nine o'clock"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/dialogue-arrive-london.mp3" title="🔊 What time does it arrive in London?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/dialogue-explore-flight.mp3" title="🔊 Yes, I want to explore the city. My flight departs on Monday at six"></audio>

---

## 8. Errores típicos de hispanohablantes

| ❌ Incorrecto | ✅ Correcto | Explicación |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| *The train **leave** at nine* | *The train **leaves** at nine* | 3.ª persona *-s* |
| *The train **is leave** at nine* | *The train **leaves** at nine* | Present Simple |
| *arrive **to** London* | *arrive **in** London* | *in* + ciudad |
| *stay **in** a hotel* (A1 tip) | *stay **at** a hotel* | *at* + hotel (muy frecuente) |
| *My flight **depart** on Sunday* | *My flight **departs** on Sunday* | *-s* |
| *I want **visit** museums* | *I want **to** visit museums* | *want to* + verbo |

---

## 9. Pronunciación útil

| Palabra / frase | Tip A1 |
| :--- | :--- |
| **leaves** | *liivz*. |
| **arrives** | *a-RAIVZ*. |
| **departs** | *di-PARTS*. |
| **visit** | *VI-zit*. |
| **stay** | *stei*. |
| **explore** | *ik-SPLOR*. |
| **half past** | *haaf paast* / *haf past*. |
| **o'clock** | *a-KLOK*. |

Practica: *leaves → arrives → departs → visit → stay → explore*.

---

## 10. Mini-diálogos para memorizar

> **A:** When does your train leave?  
> **B:** It leaves at eight.  
> **A:** What time does it arrive?  
> **B:** At half past ten.

> **A:** Where do you stay?  
> **B:** At a hotel for three nights.  
> **A:** Do you visit museums?  
> **B:** Yes — I explore the city.

> **A:** When does your flight depart?  
> **B:** On Sunday at five o'clock.

Cambia solo horas y ciudad: fijas ***leaves / arrives / stay / visit / explore***.

---

## 10b. Plantillas para copiar

1. The train leaves at \_\_\_\_.  
2. It arrives in \_\_\_\_ at \_\_\_\_.  
3. I stay at a hotel for \_\_\_\_ nights.  
4. I want to visit \_\_\_\_.  
5. I want to explore \_\_\_\_.  
6. My flight departs on \_\_\_\_ at \_\_\_\_.

### Más frases para memorizar

> The train leaves at nine o'clock.  
> The bus departs at half past seven.  
> My flight leaves at ten in the morning.  
> The plane arrives at three o'clock.  
> The train arrives in London at noon.  
> I stay at a hotel for three nights.  
> I want to visit the museums.  
> I want to explore the city.  
> My flight departs on Sunday at five.  
> When does your train leave?  
> It leaves at nine o'clock.  
> What time does it arrive in London?  
> At half past eleven.  
> I stay at a hotel for two nights.  
> Do you visit museums?  
> Yes, I want to explore the city.  
> My flight departs on Monday at six in the evening.  
> I am going to London next week.  
> My train leaves at eight o'clock in the morning.  
> It arrives in London at half past ten.

Lee la lista dos veces. Luego escribe **tu** viaje con horarios reales o inventados.

### Rutina de 2 minutos

1. Di 3 frases *leaves/departs at…*.  
2. Di 2 con *arrives in… at…*.  
3. Añade *stay at a hotel* + *visit* + *explore*.  
4. Pregunta *When does your train leave?*

### Combinar U42 + U43

| Unidad | Aporta | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| U42 | medio | I go **by train**. |
| **U43** | horario y verbos | The train **leaves** at eight. |

### Mini-historia para reescribir

> I am going to London next week. My train leaves at eight o'clock in the morning. It arrives in London at half past ten. I stay at a hotel for three nights. I want to visit the museums and explore the city. My flight departs on Sunday at five o'clock.

Cambia ciudad, horas y noches; mantén los verbos.

### Tour guiado (modelo)

> I am going to London next week. My train leaves at eight o'clock in the morning. It arrives in London at half past ten. I stay at a hotel for three nights. I want to visit the museums and explore the city. My flight departs on Sunday at five o'clock.

Grábate leyéndolo. Luego improvisa con **tu** destino.

### Frases extra para practicar en voz alta

> When does your train leave?  
> It leaves at nine.  
> What time does it arrive?  
> At half past eleven.  
> I stay at a hotel.  
> I visit museums.  
> I explore the city.  
> My flight departs on Monday.

Personaliza ciudad y horas.

### Checklist mental

- Present Simple para horarios (*leaves / arrives / departs*)  
- *-s* en 3.ª persona  
- *arrive in* + ciudad · *arrive at* + hora  
- *stay at a hotel* · *visit* · *explore*  
- Preguntas: *When does… leave?* / *What time does it arrive?*

### Mapa rápido

| Unidad | Enfoque |
| :--- | :--- |
| U42 | Transport — by / take the |
| **U43** | Travel Verbs — schedules |
| U44 | The Weather — *It is…* |

---

## 11. Ejercicios prácticos (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — Completa el verbo (3.ª persona)

1. The train \_\_\_\_ at nine o'clock. (leave)  
2. The plane \_\_\_\_ at three o'clock. (arrive)  
3. The bus \_\_\_\_ at half past seven. (depart)  
4. My flight \_\_\_\_ on Sunday at five. (depart)  
5. It \_\_\_\_ in London at noon. (arrive)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **leaves**  
2. **arrives**  
3. **departs**  
4. **departs**  
5. **arrives**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Elige el verbo

1. reach a place → \_\_\_\_  
2. leave / go away → \_\_\_\_ / \_\_\_\_  
3. go to see a place → \_\_\_\_  
4. remain in a place → \_\_\_\_  
5. discover / look around → \_\_\_\_

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **arrive**  
2. **leave** / **depart**  
3. **visit**  
4. **stay**  
5. **explore**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Traduce

1. El tren sale a las ocho.  
2. Llega a Londres a las diez y media.  
3. Me quedo en un hotel tres noches.  
4. Quiero visitar los museos.  
5. ¿Cuándo sale tu tren?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **The train leaves at eight.**  
2. **It arrives in London at half past ten.**  
3. **I stay at a hotel for three nights.**  
4. **I want to visit the museums.**  
5. **When does your train leave?**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Ordena

1. leaves / The / at / train / nine  
2. in / arrives / London / It  
3. at / stay / a / I / hotel  
4. explore / to / want / I / the city

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **The train leaves at nine.**  
2. **It arrives in London.**  
3. **I stay at a hotel.**  
4. **I want to explore the city.**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Reading corto

Lee el texto de la sección 6. Contesta:

1. Where is the writer going?  
2. What time does the train leave?  
3. What time does it arrive in London?  
4. How many nights does the writer stay?  
5. When does the flight depart?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **London**  
2. **At eight o'clock**  
3. **At half past ten**  
4. **Three**  
5. **On Sunday at five**
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Corrige el error

1. The train leave at nine.  
2. It arrives to London at ten.  
3. I stay in a hotel for two nights. (usa la forma A1 del curso)  
4. I want visit museums.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **The train leaves at nine.**  
2. **It arrives in London at ten.**  
3. **I stay at a hotel for two nights.**  
4. **I want to visit museums.**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Escribe tu viaje

Escribe 8–10 frases. Incluye:

- *leaves* / *arrives* / *departs*  
- *stay at a hotel*  
- *visit* y *explore*  
- al menos 2 horas (*at eight*, *at half past ten*…)  
- 1 pregunta *When does…?*

**Modelo:** el texto de la sección 6.

### Ejercicio 8 — Elige la opción correcta

1. The train \_\_\_\_ at eight. (leaves / leave / leaving)  
2. It arrives \_\_\_\_ London at 10:30. (in / to / at)  
3. I stay \_\_\_\_ a hotel. (at / to / on)  
4. When \_\_\_\_ your train leave? (does / do / is)  
5. My flight \_\_\_\_ on Sunday. (departs / depart / departing)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **leaves**  
2. **in**  
3. **at**  
4. **does**  
5. **departs**
</details>

---

## 12. Plan de práctica (15 minutos)

1. **3 min** — Di 5 frases de horarios (*leaves / arrives / departs*).  
2. **3 min** — Practica *visit / stay / explore*.  
3. **4 min** — Reescribe el reading con tu ciudad.  
4. **5 min** — Mini-entrevista *When does… leave?* / *What time does it arrive?*

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso Present Simple para horarios  
- [ ] Pongo *-s* en 3.ª persona  
- [ ] Distingo leave/depart vs arrive  
- [ ] Uso *stay at*, *visit*, *explore*  
- [ ] Pregunto horarios con *When/What time does…?*

---

## 13. Consejos para practicar

1. **Mira un horario real** (tren/avión) y di 5 frases *leaves/arrives at…*.  
2. **Pareja:** uno pregunta horarios; el otro responde + *stay/visit/explore*.  
3. **Combina** U42: *I go by train. The train leaves at eight.*  
4. Prepárate para la [Unidad 44](/curso-a1/unit-44): *The Weather* (*It is sunny / rainy…*).  
5. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 43](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-43-verbos-viaje-horarios-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 43 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-43).

---

## Resumen rápido

| Tema | Lo esencial |
| :--- | :--- |
| Horarios | Present Simple (*leaves / arrives*) |
| Salida | leave · depart |
| Llegada | arrive in + city · arrive at + time |
| En destino | stay · visit · explore |
| Pregunta | When does… leave? What time does it arrive? |
| Tip | 3.ª persona con *-s* |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A1

Practica ahora:

Guía dedicada y curso:

- [Unidad 44 — The Weather (It is…)](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-44-tiempo-atmosferico)
- [Unidad 44 — The Weather](/curso-a1/unit-44)

Antes de pasar de unidad, escribe un párrafo de 6–8 frases con un viaje completo (salida, llegada, hotel, visita, vuelo).

Guías relacionadas:

- [Inglés para viajar](/blog/viajes/ingles-para-viajar)

content:
En la [Unidad 43](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-43-verbos-viaje-horarios) hablaste de horarios de viaje. En la **Unidad 44 del curso A1** (*The Weather*) describes el **tiempo atmosférico**: ***It is sunny***, ***It is raining***, ***hot / cold***.

Repasas *It is…* del verbo *to be* y conectas con viajes del Módulo 5. Incluye **audios**, **esquemas** y **ejercicios**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 44 — The Weather](/curso-a1/unit-44)  
> **Repaso útil:** [Unidad 43 — Travel Verbs](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-43-verbos-viaje-horarios) · [Unidad 3 — To be](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-3-to-be-negativa-preguntas)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 44 (A1)

Al terminar esta unidad serás capaz de:

- Usar ***It is + adjetivo***: *sunny, rainy, cloudy, snowy, hot, cold*.
- Usar ***It is raining / It is snowing*** para la acción ahora.
- Preguntar: ***What is the weather like today?***
- Contrastar ***today (is)*** y ***yesterday (was)***.
- Decir qué tiempo prefieres (*I prefer sunny weather*).

---

## 1. It is + adjetivo de tiempo

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| It **is sunny** | It is sunny today. |
| It **is rainy** | It is rainy this morning. |
| It **is cloudy** | It is cloudy. |
| It **is snowy** | It is snowy in winter. |
| It **is hot** | It is hot in summer. |
| It **is cold** | It is cold today. |

![It is + weather A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/a1-unit44-it-is-weather.png)

```
It is + weather adjective
→ sunny · rainy · cloudy · snowy · hot · cold

It is + -ing (now)
→ It is raining · It is snowing
```

### Tip

Sujeto fijo: ***It***. No digas *The weather is sunny* al principio (también existe, pero en A1 priorizamos *It is sunny*).

### Adjetivo vs -ing

| Adjetivo | Acción ahora |
| :--- | :--- |
| It is **rainy**. | It is **raining**. |
| It is **snowy**. | It is **snowing**. |
| It is **sunny**. | — (no *It is sunning*) |

---

## 2. Vocabulario del tiempo

![Vocabulario weather A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/a1-unit44-weather-vocab.png)

| Inglés | Español | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| sunny | soleado | It is sunny. |
| rainy | lluvioso | It is rainy. |
| cloudy | nublado | It is cloudy. |
| snowy | con nieve | It is snowy. |
| hot | calor / caluroso | It is hot. |
| cold | frío | It is cold. |
| raining | lloviendo | It is raining. |
| snowing | nevando | It is snowing. |
| weather | tiempo (atmosférico) | the weather |
| umbrella | paraguas | I had an umbrella. |
| outside | fuera | go outside |
| prefer | preferir | I prefer sunny weather. |

---

## 3. Ejemplos con audio

> It **is sunny** today.  
> It **is raining** now.  
> It **is cloudy** this morning.  
> It **is snowing** in winter.  
> It **is hot** in summer.  
> It **is cold** today.  
> What **is the weather like** today?  
> It is sunny and hot.  
> I prefer sunny weather.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/it-is-sunny.mp3" title="🔊 It is sunny today"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/it-is-raining.mp3" title="🔊 It is raining now"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/it-is-cloudy.mp3" title="🔊 It is cloudy this morning"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/it-is-snowing.mp3" title="🔊 It is snowing in winter"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/it-is-hot.mp3" title="🔊 It is hot in summer"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/it-is-cold.mp3" title="🔊 It is cold today"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/what-weather-like.mp3" title="🔊 What is the weather like today?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/sunny-and-hot.mp3" title="🔊 It is sunny and hot"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/prefer-sunny.mp3" title="🔊 I prefer sunny weather"></audio>

---

## 4. Today vs yesterday

![Today vs yesterday A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/a1-unit44-today-yesterday.png)

| Tiempo | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Hoy | It **is**… | Today it is sunny and hot. |
| Ayer | It **was**… | Yesterday it was cloudy and rainy. |
| Acción ayer | It **was raining** | It was raining in the afternoon. |

### Tip

*Is* = ahora / hoy. *Was* = ayer. Misma estructura: *It + is/was + adjetivo* o *It + is/was + raining/snowing*.

---

## 5. Preguntas y respuestas

> **What is the weather like today?**  
> **It is sunny and hot.**

> **Was it rainy yesterday?**  
> **Yes — it was cloudy and it was raining.**

> **Do you prefer sunny weather?**  
> **Yes, I do. I can go outside.**

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/was-cloudy-rainy.mp3" title="🔊 Yesterday it was cloudy and rainy"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/had-umbrella.mp3" title="🔊 Yes, I had an umbrella"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/me-too.mp3" title="🔊 Me too"></audio>

### Tabla de preguntas

| Pregunta | Respuesta |
| :--- | :--- |
| What is the weather like today? | It is sunny. / It is cold. |
| Is it raining? | Yes, it is. / No, it isn't. |
| Was it cloudy yesterday? | Yes, it was. |
| Do you prefer hot weather? | Yes, I do. / No, I don't. |

---

## 6. Reading modelo: el tiempo

> **Today it is sunny and hot.** I like this weather. Yesterday it **was cloudy and rainy**. It **was raining** in the afternoon. In winter it is cold and sometimes it **is snowing**. In summer it is hot and sunny. I prefer sunny weather because I can go outside.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/reading-today-sunny.mp3" title="🔊 Today it is sunny and hot"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/reading-yesterday.mp3" title="🔊 Yesterday it was cloudy and rainy"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/reading-winter.mp3" title="🔊 In winter it is cold and sometimes it is snowing"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/reading-summer.mp3" title="🔊 In summer it is hot and sunny"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/reading-prefer.mp3" title="🔊 I prefer sunny weather because I can go outside"></audio>

### Comprueba

1. ¿Cómo está el tiempo hoy? → **Sunny and hot**.  
2. ¿Y ayer? → **Cloudy and rainy**.  
3. ¿Qué pasaba por la tarde? → **It was raining**.  
4. ¿Invierno? → **Cold / sometimes snowing**.  
5. ¿Verano? → **Hot and sunny**.  
6. ¿Qué prefiere? → **Sunny weather**.

---

## 7. Diálogo modelo

> **A:** What is the weather like today?  
> **B:** It is sunny and hot.  
> **A:** Great. Yesterday it was cloudy and it was raining.  
> **B:** Yes, I had an umbrella. In winter it is cold and sometimes it is snowing.  
> **A:** I prefer sunny weather.  
> **B:** Me too.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/dialogue-what-weather.mp3" title="🔊 What is the weather like today?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/dialogue-sunny-hot.mp3" title="🔊 It is sunny and hot"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/dialogue-yesterday-raining.mp3" title="🔊 Yesterday it was cloudy and it was raining"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/dialogue-prefer-sunny.mp3" title="🔊 I prefer sunny weather"></audio>

---

## 8. Errores típicos de hispanohablantes

| ❌ Incorrecto | ✅ Correcto | Explicación |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| *It **are** sunny* | *It **is** sunny* | sujeto *It* |
| *It is **sun*** | *It is **sunny*** | adjetivo |
| *It is **rain*** | *It is **rainy*** / *It is **raining*** | adjetivo o *-ing* |
| *The day is sunny* (menos A1) | *It is sunny* | fórmula estándar |
| *Yesterday it **is** rainy* | *Yesterday it **was** rainy* | pasado |
| *What weather is today?* | *What **is the weather like** today?* | pregunta fija |

---

## 9. Pronunciación útil

| Palabra / frase | Tip A1 |
| :--- | :--- |
| **sunny** | *SA-ni*. |
| **rainy** | *REI-ni*. |
| **cloudy** | *CLAU-di*. |
| **snowy** | *SNOU-i*. |
| **raining** | *REI-ning*. |
| **weather** | *WE-dher*. |
| **What is the weather like?** | une: *wots-dha-WE-dher-laik*. |

Practica: *sunny → rainy → cloudy → snowy → hot → cold*.

---

## 10. Mini-diálogos para memorizar

> **A:** What is the weather like today?  
> **B:** It is sunny. And yesterday?  
> **A:** It was rainy.

> **A:** Is it raining?  
> **B:** Yes, it is. Take an umbrella.  
> **A:** Thanks — it's cold too.

> **A:** Do you prefer hot weather?  
> **B:** I prefer sunny weather. I can go outside.

Cambia solo el adjetivo: fijas ***It is… / It was…***.

---

## 10b. Plantillas para copiar

1. It is \_\_\_\_ today.  
2. It is \_\_\_\_ now. (raining / snowing)  
3. Yesterday it was \_\_\_\_.  
4. What is the weather like today?  
5. In winter it is \_\_\_\_.  
6. I prefer \_\_\_\_ weather.

### Más frases para memorizar

> It is sunny today.  
> It is raining now.  
> It is cloudy this morning.  
> It is snowing in winter.  
> It is hot in summer.  
> It is cold today.  
> What is the weather like today?  
> It is sunny and hot.  
> Yesterday it was cloudy and rainy.  
> It was raining in the afternoon.  
> In winter it is cold and sometimes it is snowing.  
> In summer it is hot and sunny.  
> I prefer sunny weather.  
> I like this weather.  
> I can go outside.  
> I had an umbrella.  
> Me too.  
> Is it raining?  
> Yes, it is.  
> No, it isn't — it is sunny.

Lee la lista dos veces. Luego describe **hoy** y **ayer** en 6 frases.

### Rutina de 2 minutos

1. Di 4 adjetivos con *It is…*.  
2. Di *It is raining* y *It is snowing*.  
3. Contrasta *Today it is…* / *Yesterday it was…*.  
4. Pregunta *What is the weather like today?*

### Combinar U43 + U44

| Unidad | Aporta | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| U43 | viaje | I arrive in London at ten. |
| **U44** | tiempo | It is sunny in London today. |

### Mini-historia para reescribir

> Today it is sunny and hot. I like this weather. Yesterday it was cloudy and rainy. It was raining in the afternoon. In winter it is cold and sometimes it is snowing. In summer it is hot and sunny. I prefer sunny weather because I can go outside.

Cambia estaciones y adjetivos; mantén *It is / It was*.

### Tour guiado (modelo)

> Today it is sunny and hot. I like this weather. Yesterday it was cloudy and rainy. It was raining in the afternoon. In winter it is cold and sometimes it is snowing. In summer it is hot and sunny. I prefer sunny weather because I can go outside.

Grábate leyéndolo. Luego improvisa con el tiempo **real** de tu ciudad.

### Frases extra para practicar en voz alta

> What is the weather like today?  
> It is sunny.  
> It is cold.  
> It is raining.  
> Yesterday it was cloudy.  
> I prefer sunny weather.  
> Take an umbrella.

Personaliza con el tiempo de hoy.

### Checklist mental

- *It is + adjective*  
- *It is raining / snowing*  
- Pregunta: *What is the weather like…?*  
- Hoy *is* · ayer *was*  
- Vocab: sunny · rainy · cloudy · snowy · hot · cold

### Mapa rápido

| Unidad | Enfoque |
| :--- | :--- |
| U43 | Travel Verbs — schedules |
| **U44** | The Weather — It is… |
| U45 | Seasons — *in* + season |

---

## 11. Ejercicios prácticos (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — Completa *is / was*

1. Today it \_\_\_\_ sunny.  
2. Yesterday it \_\_\_\_ rainy.  
3. It \_\_\_\_ raining now.  
4. Yesterday it \_\_\_\_ raining in the afternoon.  
5. In summer it \_\_\_\_ hot.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **is**  
2. **was**  
3. **is**  
4. **was**  
5. **is**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Elige el adjetivo

1. the sun is shining → \_\_\_\_  
2. clouds in the sky → \_\_\_\_  
3. wet weather / rain → \_\_\_\_  
4. very low temperature → \_\_\_\_  
5. very high temperature → \_\_\_\_

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **sunny**  
2. **cloudy**  
3. **rainy**  
4. **cold**  
5. **hot**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Traduce

1. Hoy hace sol.  
2. Está lloviendo ahora.  
3. Ayer estaba nublado.  
4. ¿Qué tiempo hace hoy?  
5. Prefiero el tiempo soleado.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **It is sunny today.** / **Today it is sunny.**  
2. **It is raining now.**  
3. **Yesterday it was cloudy.**  
4. **What is the weather like today?**  
5. **I prefer sunny weather.**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Ordena

1. sunny / is / It / today  
2. raining / is / It / now  
3. weather / the / What / like / is  
4. prefer / sunny / I / weather

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **It is sunny today.**  
2. **It is raining now.**  
3. **What is the weather like?**  
4. **I prefer sunny weather.**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Reading corto

Lee el texto de la sección 6. Contesta:

1. What is the weather like today?  
2. What was the weather like yesterday?  
3. What was happening in the afternoon?  
4. What is winter like?  
5. Why does the writer prefer sunny weather?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Sunny and hot**  
2. **Cloudy and rainy**  
3. **It was raining**  
4. **Cold / sometimes snowing**  
5. **Because he/she can go outside**
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Corrige el error

1. It are sunny today.  
2. It is sun.  
3. Yesterday it is rainy.  
4. What weather like today?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **It is sunny today.**  
2. **It is sunny.**  
3. **Yesterday it was rainy.**  
4. **What is the weather like today?**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Escribe sobre el tiempo

Escribe 8–10 frases. Incluye:

- *It is…* (hoy) y *It was…* (ayer)  
- al menos 4 adjetivos (*sunny, rainy, cloudy, hot, cold…*)  
- *It is raining* o *It is snowing*  
- *What is the weather like…?*  
- *I prefer…*

**Modelo:** el texto de la sección 6.

### Ejercicio 8 — Elige la opción correcta

1. It \_\_\_\_ sunny today. (is / are / am)  
2. It is \_\_\_\_ now. (raining / rainying / rain)  
3. Yesterday it \_\_\_\_ cloudy. (was / is / were)  
4. What \_\_\_\_ the weather like? (is / are / does)  
5. I prefer \_\_\_\_ weather. (sunny / sun / sunning)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **is**  
2. **raining**  
3. **was**  
4. **is**  
5. **sunny**
</details>

---

## 12. Plan de práctica (15 minutos)

1. **3 min** — Di los 6 adjetivos con *It is…*.  
2. **3 min** — Practica *raining / snowing* y *was*.  
3. **4 min** — Reescribe el reading con tu ciudad.  
4. **5 min** — Mini-entrevista *What is the weather like…?*

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *It is + adjective*  
- [ ] Distingo *rainy* e *It is raining*  
- [ ] Contraste *is* (hoy) / *was* (ayer)  
- [ ] Pregunto *What is the weather like…?*  
- [ ] Digo qué tiempo prefiero

---

## 13. Consejos para practicar

1. **Cada mañana:** una frase *Today it is…* mirando por la ventana.  
2. **Pareja:** pregunta el tiempo de hoy y de ayer.  
3. **Combina** U43: *I arrive in London at ten. It is cold and rainy.*  
4. Prepárate para la [Unidad 45](/curso-a1/unit-45): *Seasons* (*in spring / summer / autumn / winter*).  
5. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 44](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-44-tiempo-atmosferico-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 44 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-44).

---

## Resumen rápido

| Tema | Lo esencial |
| :--- | :--- |
| Forma | It is + adjective |
| Ahora | It is raining / snowing |
| Ayer | It was… |
| Pregunta | What is the weather like…? |
| Vocab | sunny · rainy · cloudy · snowy · hot · cold |
| Tip | adjetivo (*sunny*), no *sun* |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A1

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 44 A1 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-44-tiempo-atmosferico-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [Unidad 44 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-44)

En la **Unidad 45** hablas de las **estaciones**: *in spring, in summer, in autumn, in winter*.

Guía dedicada y curso:

- [Unidad 45 — Seasons (in spring…)](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-45-estaciones-in-spring)
- [Unidad 45 — Seasons](/curso-a1/unit-45)

Antes de pasar de unidad, escribe un párrafo de 6–8 frases sobre el tiempo de hoy, ayer y tu estación favorita.

Guías relacionadas:

- [Inglés para viajar](/blog/viajes/ingles-para-viajar)
- [Inglés A1: guía para empezar](/blog/metodos/ingles-a1)

---

content:
En la [Unidad 44](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-44-tiempo-atmosferico) describiste el tiempo (*It is sunny*). En la **Unidad 45 del curso A1** (*Seasons*) hablas de las **estaciones** con ***in spring / summer / autumn / winter*** y vocabulario de **naturaleza**.

Conecta clima + estación: *It is hot in summer*. Incluye **audios**, **esquemas** y **ejercicios**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 45 — Seasons](/curso-a1/unit-45)  
> **Repaso útil:** [Unidad 44 — The Weather](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-44-tiempo-atmosferico) · [Unidad 19 — Meses y fechas](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-19-meses-fechas-cumpleanos)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 45 (A1)

Al terminar esta unidad serás capaz de:

- Usar ***in + season***: *in spring, in summer, in autumn, in winter*.
- Nombrar las **cuatro estaciones**.
- Hablar de naturaleza: ***flowers, leaves, trees, beach, snow***.
- Decir qué pasa en cada estación (*bloom*, *fall*, *hot*, *cold*).
- Preguntar: ***What is your favourite season?***

---

## 1. In + estación

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **in spring** | I like the flowers **in spring**. |
| **in summer** | It is hot **in summer**. |
| **in autumn** | The leaves fall **in autumn**. |
| **in winter** | It is cold **in winter**. |

![In + seasons A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-45/a1-unit45-in-seasons.png)

```
in + spring / summer / autumn / winter
(NO: on summer / at winter)
```

### Tip

Con estaciones siempre ***in***. Recuerda también: *in* + mes (*in July*), *on* + día (*on Monday*), *at* + hora (*at 8*). Aquí el foco es **estaciones**.

### Autumn / fall

| Variedad | Forma |
| :--- | :--- |
| British English | **autumn** |
| American English | **fall** |

En el curso A1 usamos sobre todo ***autumn***.

---

## 2. Las cuatro estaciones

![Four seasons A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-45/a1-unit45-four-seasons.png)

| Season | Español | Idea clave |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **spring** | primavera | flowers bloom, warm |
| **summer** | verano | hot and sunny, beach |
| **autumn** | otoño | leaves fall, orange and yellow |
| **winter** | invierno | cold, snowy / snowing |

---

## 3. Vocabulario de naturaleza

![Nature vocab A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-45/a1-unit45-nature-vocab.png)

| Inglés | Español | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| season | estación | four seasons |
| spring | primavera | in spring |
| summer | verano | in summer |
| autumn | otoño | in autumn |
| winter | invierno | in winter |
| nature | naturaleza | I love nature. |
| flowers | flores | The flowers bloom. |
| bloom | florecer | flowers bloom |
| leaves | hojas | The leaves fall. |
| fall | caer | leaves fall |
| trees | árboles | orange and yellow trees |
| beach | playa | go to the beach |
| snow | nieve | snow / snowy |
| favourite | favorito/a | favourite season |
| warm | templado | warm weather |

---

## 4. Ejemplos con audio

> I like the flowers **in spring**.  
> It is hot **in summer**.  
> The leaves fall **in autumn**.  
> It is cold **in winter**.  
> We go on holiday **in summer**.  
> The flowers **bloom** in spring.  
> I go to the **beach** in summer.  
> The trees are orange and yellow **in autumn**.  
> What is your **favourite season**?

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-45/flowers-in-spring.mp3" title="🔊 I like the flowers in spring"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-45/hot-in-summer.mp3" title="🔊 It is hot in summer"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-45/leaves-fall-autumn.mp3" title="🔊 The leaves fall in autumn"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-45/cold-in-winter.mp3" title="🔊 It is cold in winter"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-45/holiday-in-summer.mp3" title="🔊 We go on holiday in summer"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-45/flowers-bloom.mp3" title="🔊 The flowers bloom in spring"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-45/go-to-beach.mp3" title="🔊 I go to the beach in summer"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-45/trees-orange-yellow.mp3" title="🔊 The trees are orange and yellow in autumn"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-45/favourite-season.mp3" title="🔊 What is your favourite season?"></audio>

---

## 5. Preguntas y respuestas

> **What is your favourite season?**  
> **I like summer.** / **I prefer spring.**

> **What is the weather like in winter?**  
> **It is cold and sometimes it is snowing.**

> **Do you love nature?**  
> **Yes — I love nature in all the seasons.**

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-45/i-like-summer.mp3" title="🔊 I like summer"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-45/prefer-spring.mp3" title="🔊 I prefer spring"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-45/love-nature.mp3" title="🔊 I love nature in all the seasons"></audio>

### Tabla de preguntas

| Pregunta | Respuesta |
| :--- | :--- |
| What is your favourite season? | I like summer. |
| What happens in spring? | The flowers bloom. |
| What happens in autumn? | The leaves fall. |
| Where do you go in summer? | To the beach. |

---

## 6. Reading modelo: las cuatro estaciones

> **I love all the four seasons.** **In spring** the flowers bloom and the weather is warm. **In summer** it is hot and sunny; I go to the beach. **In autumn** the leaves fall and the trees are orange and yellow. **In winter** it is cold and sometimes it is snowing. I like nature in every season.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-45/reading-four-seasons.mp3" title="🔊 I love all the four seasons"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-45/reading-spring.mp3" title="🔊 In spring the flowers bloom and the weather is warm"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-45/reading-summer.mp3" title="🔊 In summer it is hot and sunny; I go to the beach"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-45/reading-autumn.mp3" title="🔊 In autumn the leaves fall and the trees are orange and yellow"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-45/reading-winter.mp3" title="🔊 In winter it is cold and sometimes it is snowing"></audio>

### Comprueba

1. ¿Cuántas estaciones ama? → **Four**.  
2. ¿Primavera? → **Flowers bloom / warm**.  
3. ¿Verano? → **Hot and sunny / beach**.  
4. ¿Otoño? → **Leaves fall / orange and yellow**.  
5. ¿Invierno? → **Cold / snowing**.  
6. ¿Qué le gusta en todas? → **Nature**.

---

## 7. Diálogo modelo

> **A:** What is your favourite season?  
> **B:** I like summer. It is hot and sunny in summer.  
> **A:** I prefer spring. The flowers bloom in spring.  
> **B:** In autumn the leaves fall. In winter it is cold and snowy.  
> **A:** I love nature in all the seasons.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-45/dialogue-favourite.mp3" title="🔊 What is your favourite season?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-45/dialogue-like-summer.mp3" title="🔊 I like summer. It is hot and sunny in summer"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-45/dialogue-prefer-spring.mp3" title="🔊 I prefer spring. The flowers bloom in spring"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-45/dialogue-autumn-winter.mp3" title="🔊 In autumn the leaves fall. In winter it is cold and snowy"></audio>

---

## 8. Errores típicos de hispanohablantes

| ❌ Incorrecto | ✅ Correcto | Explicación |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| *on summer* | *in summer* | *in* + estación |
| *at winter* | *in winter* | *in* + estación |
| *in the summer* (OK avanzado) | *in summer* (A1) | en A1 priorizamos sin *the* |
| *The leafs fall* | *The **leaves** fall* | plural irregular |
| *flowers bloom on spring* | *flowers bloom **in** spring* | *in* |
| *I like the summer season spring* | *I like summer* / *I like spring* | una estación clara |

---

## 9. Pronunciación útil

| Palabra | Tip A1 |
| :--- | :--- |
| **spring** | *spring*. |
| **summer** | *SA-mer*. |
| **autumn** | *O-tem* (la *n* final casi muda). |
| **winter** | *WIN-ter*. |
| **nature** | *NEI-cher*. |
| **flowers** | *FLAU-erz*. |
| **leaves** | *liivz*. |
| **bloom** | *bluum*. |

Practica: *spring → summer → autumn → winter*.

---

## 10. Mini-diálogos para memorizar

> **A:** What is your favourite season?  
> **B:** Summer — it is hot and sunny.  
> **A:** I prefer spring. The flowers bloom.

> **A:** What happens in autumn?  
> **B:** The leaves fall. The trees are orange and yellow.  
> **A:** And in winter?  
> **B:** It is cold and snowy.

> **A:** Do you like nature?  
> **B:** Yes — in every season.

Cambia solo la estación favorita: fijas ***in + season***.

---

## 10b. Plantillas para copiar

1. In spring \_\_\_\_.  
2. In summer it is \_\_\_\_.  
3. In autumn the leaves \_\_\_\_.  
4. In winter it is \_\_\_\_.  
5. My favourite season is \_\_\_\_.  
6. I love nature in \_\_\_\_.

### Más frases para memorizar

> I like the flowers in spring.  
> It is hot in summer.  
> The leaves fall in autumn.  
> It is cold in winter.  
> We go on holiday in summer.  
> The flowers bloom in spring.  
> I go to the beach in summer.  
> The trees are orange and yellow in autumn.  
> What is your favourite season?  
> I like summer.  
> I prefer spring.  
> I love nature in all the seasons.  
> In spring the weather is warm.  
> In summer it is hot and sunny.  
> In autumn the leaves fall.  
> In winter it is cold and sometimes it is snowing.  
> I love all the four seasons.  
> I like nature in every season.

Lee la lista dos veces. Luego escribe **tu** estación favorita y por qué.

### Rutina de 2 minutos

1. Di las 4 estaciones con *in…*.  
2. Añade clima (U44): *hot / cold / sunny / snowy*.  
3. Di *flowers bloom* y *leaves fall*.  
4. Pregunta *What is your favourite season?*

### Combinar U44 + U45

| Unidad | Aporta | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| U44 | clima | It is hot / cold / sunny. |
| **U45** | estación | It is hot **in summer**. |

### Mini-historia para reescribir

> I love all the four seasons. In spring the flowers bloom and the weather is warm. In summer it is hot and sunny; I go to the beach. In autumn the leaves fall and the trees are orange and yellow. In winter it is cold and sometimes it is snowing. I like nature in every season.

Cambia actividades; mantén *in + season*.

### Tour guiado (modelo)

> I love all the four seasons. In spring the flowers bloom and the weather is warm. In summer it is hot and sunny; I go to the beach. In autumn the leaves fall and the trees are orange and yellow. In winter it is cold and sometimes it is snowing. I like nature in every season.

Grábate leyéndolo. Luego improvisa con **tu** estación favorita.

### Frases extra para practicar en voz alta

> What is your favourite season?  
> I like summer.  
> I prefer spring.  
> The flowers bloom in spring.  
> The leaves fall in autumn.  
> It is cold in winter.  
> I love nature.

Personaliza con tu ciudad y clima real.

### Checklist mental

- *in* + season (nunca *on/at*)  
- spring · summer · autumn · winter  
- bloom / fall / beach / snow / nature  
- Pregunta: *What is your favourite season?*  
- Combina con U44 (*It is hot in summer*)

### Mapa rápido

| Unidad | Enfoque |
| :--- | :--- |
| U44 | The Weather — It is… |
| **U45** | Seasons — in + season |
| U46 | At the Hotel — Can I have…? |

---

## 11. Ejercicios prácticos (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — Completa *in*

1. I like the flowers \_\_\_\_ spring.  
2. It is hot \_\_\_\_ summer.  
3. The leaves fall \_\_\_\_ autumn.  
4. It is cold \_\_\_\_ winter.  
5. We go on holiday \_\_\_\_ summer.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **in**  
2. **in**  
3. **in**  
4. **in**  
5. **in**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Elige la estación

1. flowers bloom → \_\_\_\_  
2. hot and sunny / beach → \_\_\_\_  
3. leaves fall / orange trees → \_\_\_\_  
4. cold and snowy → \_\_\_\_

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **spring**  
2. **summer**  
3. **autumn**  
4. **winter**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Traduce

1. En verano hace calor.  
2. Las flores florecen en primavera.  
3. Las hojas caen en otoño.  
4. ¿Cuál es tu estación favorita?  
5. Me encanta la naturaleza.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **It is hot in summer.**  
2. **The flowers bloom in spring.**  
3. **The leaves fall in autumn.**  
4. **What is your favourite season?**  
5. **I love nature.**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Ordena

1. summer / in / hot / is / It  
2. spring / in / bloom / flowers / The  
3. autumn / in / fall / leaves / The  
4. favourite / your / What / season / is

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **It is hot in summer.**  
2. **The flowers bloom in spring.**  
3. **The leaves fall in autumn.**  
4. **What is your favourite season?**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Reading corto

Lee el texto de la sección 6. Contesta:

1. How many seasons does the writer love?  
2. What happens in spring?  
3. Where does the writer go in summer?  
4. What colour are the trees in autumn?  
5. What is winter like?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Four**  
2. **Flowers bloom / weather is warm**  
3. **To the beach**  
4. **Orange and yellow**  
5. **Cold / sometimes snowing**
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Corrige el error

1. It is hot on summer.  
2. The leafs fall in autumn.  
3. Flowers bloom at spring.  
4. I like the winter season summer.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **It is hot in summer.**  
2. **The leaves fall in autumn.**  
3. **Flowers bloom in spring.**  
4. **I like winter.** / **I like summer.**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Escribe sobre las estaciones

Escribe 8–10 frases. Incluye:

- las 4 estaciones con *in*  
- *bloom*, *fall*, *beach* o *snow*  
- *favourite season*  
- 2 frases de clima (U44)  
- *nature*

**Modelo:** el texto de la sección 6.

### Ejercicio 8 — Elige la opción correcta

1. It is hot \_\_\_\_ summer. (in / on / at)  
2. The flowers \_\_\_\_ in spring. (bloom / fall / snow)  
3. The leaves \_\_\_\_ in autumn. (fall / bloom / hot)  
4. What is your favourite \_\_\_\_? (season / weathering / leaf)  
5. I love \_\_\_\_ in every season. (nature / natures / natural)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **in**  
2. **bloom**  
3. **fall**  
4. **season**  
5. **nature**
</details>

---

## 12. Plan de práctica (15 minutos)

1. **3 min** — Di *in* + las 4 estaciones.  
2. **3 min** — Une cada estación con clima y naturaleza.  
3. **4 min** — Reescribe el reading con tu favorita primero.  
4. **5 min** — Mini-entrevista *What is your favourite season?*

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *in* (no *on/at*) con estaciones  
- [ ] Nombró spring / summer / autumn / winter  
- [ ] Uso *bloom*, *fall*, *beach*, *nature*  
- [ ] Combino con *It is hot/cold…*  
- [ ] Pregunto la estación favorita

---

## 13. Consejos para practicar

1. **Foto por estación:** una frase *In…* para cada foto del año.  
2. **Pareja:** estación favorita + por qué (*because it is sunny / I go to the beach*).  
3. **Combina** U44: *In winter it is cold and it is snowing.*  
4. Prepárate para la [Unidad 46](/curso-a1/unit-46): *At the Hotel* (*Can I have…?*, *Is there…?*).  
5. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 45](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-45-estaciones-in-spring-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 45 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-45).

---

## Resumen rápido

| Tema | Lo esencial |
| :--- | :--- |
| Preposición | in + season |
| Estaciones | spring · summer · autumn · winter |
| Naturaleza | flowers · leaves · trees · beach · snow |
| Acciones | bloom · fall · go to the beach |
| Pregunta | What is your favourite season? |
| Tip | no uses *on/at* con estaciones |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A1

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 45 A1 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-45-estaciones-in-spring-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [Unidad 45 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-45)

En la **Unidad 46** practicas inglés de **hotel**: *Can I have a room?*, *Is there Wi-Fi?*, peticiones y *there is/are*.

Guía dedicada y curso:

- [Unidad 46 — At the Hotel (Can I have…?)](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-46-hotel-can-i-have)
- [Unidad 46 — At the Hotel](/curso-a1/unit-46)

Antes de pasar de unidad, escribe un párrafo de 6–8 frases sobre las cuatro estaciones en tu ciudad.

Guías relacionadas:

- [Inglés para viajar](/blog/viajes/ingles-para-viajar)
- [A2 U8 — Preposiciones de tiempo (at/on/in)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-8-preposiciones-tiempo-at-on-in)
- [Inglés A1: guía para empezar](/blog/metodos/ingles-a1)

---

title: At the Hotel A1: Can I have…? e Is there…?
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 46 del curso A1: en el hotel con Can I have…? e Is there…?, con audios y ejercicios.
description: Aprende inglés de hotel nivel A1: Can I have a key?, Is there Wi-Fi?, single/ double room y room service. Guía Unidad 46 con audios y ejercicios.
alt: Esquema Can I have e Is there en el hotel para inglés A1

faqs.question: ¿Cómo pido algo en un hotel en inglés A1?
faqs.answer: Con Can I have…? + objeto: Can I have a key? Can I have room service? Usa el verbo en forma base después de Can I.

faqs.question: ¿Para qué sirve Is there…? en el hotel?
faqs.answer: Para preguntar si existe algo: Is there Wi-Fi? Is there a restaurant? Is there a double room available?

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre single room y double room?
faqs.answer: Single room = habitación individual (una persona). Double room = habitación doble (dos personas).

faqs.question: ¿Qué vocabulario de hotel practico en la Unidad 46?
faqs.answer: Reception, check in, key, key card, single/double room, room service, Wi-Fi, available, booking.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 46 del curso A1?
faqs.answer: En la Unidad 46 del curso A1 de Linguafly y en el cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones del blog: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening y speaking.

content:
En la [Unidad 45](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-45-estaciones-in-spring) hablaste de estaciones. En la **Unidad 46 del curso A1** (*At the Hotel*) haces **peticiones y preguntas** en recepción: ***Can I have…?***, ***Is there…?***.

Conecta con *Can I…?* de la [Unidad 38](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-38-pedir-permiso) y *Can I have…?* de la [Unidad 16](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-16-cafeteria-can-i-have-id-like). Incluye **audios**, **esquemas** y **ejercicios**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 46 — At the Hotel](/curso-a1/unit-46)  
> **Repaso útil:** [Unidad 38 — Pedir permiso](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-38-pedir-permiso) · [Unidad 16 — Cafetería](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-16-cafeteria-can-i-have-id-like)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 46 (A1)

Al terminar esta unidad serás capaz de:

- Pedir con ***Can I have…?*** / ***Can I get…?***
- Preguntar existencia con ***Is there…?***
- Usar vocabulario: ***reception, key, single/double room, room service***
- Hacer **check-in** básico en recepción.
- Entender y producir un diálogo corto de hotel.

---

## 1. Can I have…? / Is there…?

| Forma | Uso | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Can I have…?** | pedir algo | Can I have a key? |
| **Can I get…?** | pedir / conseguir | Can I get room service? |
| **Is there…?** | ¿hay…? | Is there Wi-Fi? |
| **I would like…** | me gustaría | I would like a single room. |

![Hotel requests A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-46/a1-unit46-hotel-requests.png)

```
Can I + base verb (+ object)
→ Can I have a key?
→ Can I get room service?

Is there + noun…?
→ Is there Wi-Fi?
→ Is there a double room available?
```

### Tip

Después de ***Can I*** va el **verbo base** (*have*, *get*), no *to have* ni *having*.  
***Is there*** pregunta si algo existe en el hotel.

---

## 2. Vocabulario de hotel

![Hotel vocab A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-46/a1-unit46-hotel-vocab.png)

| Inglés | Español | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| hotel | hotel | at the hotel |
| reception | recepción | go to reception |
| check in | registrarse / facturar | check in at reception |
| booking | reserva | I have a booking. |
| key / key card | llave / tarjeta | Here is your key. |
| single room | habitación individual | a single room |
| double room | habitación doble | a double room |
| available | disponible | Is there a room available? |
| room service | servicio de habitaciones | Can I have room service? |
| Wi-Fi | Wi-Fi | Is there Wi-Fi? |
| password | contraseña | The password is on the key card. |
| restaurant | restaurante | Is there a restaurant? |
| clean / quiet | limpio / tranquilo | The room is clean and quiet. |
| receptionist | recepcionista | The receptionist says yes. |

---

## 3. Ejemplos con audio

> Can I **have** a key for room ten?  
> **Is there** a double room available?  
> Can I **get** room service?  
> Is there **Wi-Fi** in the hotel?  
> I would **like** a single room.  
> Hello. I have a **booking**.  
> Here is your **key** for room eight.  
> The password is on the **key card**.  
> Call **reception**.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-46/can-i-have-key.mp3" title="🔊 Can I have a key for room ten?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-46/is-there-double.mp3" title="🔊 Is there a double room available?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-46/can-i-get-room-service.mp3" title="🔊 Can I get room service?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-46/is-there-wifi.mp3" title="🔊 Is there Wi-Fi in the hotel?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-46/would-like-single.mp3" title="🔊 I would like a single room"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-46/have-booking.mp3" title="🔊 Hello. I have a booking"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-46/here-is-key.mp3" title="🔊 Here is your key for room eight"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-46/password-key-card.mp3" title="🔊 The password is on the key card"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-46/call-reception.mp3" title="🔊 Call reception"></audio>

---

## 4. Flujo de check-in

![Check-in flow A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-46/a1-unit46-check-in-flow.png)

| Paso | Inglés |
| :--- | :--- |
| 1 | Hello. I have a booking. |
| 2 | Can I have your name? |
| 3 | Here is your key for room… |
| 4 | Is there Wi-Fi? / Can I have room service? |

---

## 5. Preguntas y respuestas

> **Can I have a key for room twelve?**  
> **Yes.** / **Here is your key.**

> **Is there a restaurant?**  
> **Yes, there is.** / **No, there isn't.**

> **Can I have room service?**  
> **Yes. Call reception.**

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-46/yes-there-is.mp3" title="🔊 Yes, there is"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-46/here-is-your-key.mp3" title="🔊 Here is your key"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-46/thank-you.mp3" title="🔊 Thank you"></audio>

### Tabla de preguntas

| Pregunta | Respuesta |
| :--- | :--- |
| Can I have a key? | Yes. / Here you are. |
| Is there Wi-Fi? | Yes, there is. |
| Is there a double room? | Yes, there is. / No, there isn't. |
| Can I get room service? | Yes. Call reception. |

---

## 6. Reading modelo: en el hotel

> **I am at the hotel today.** I go to **reception** to **check in**. Can I have a key for room twelve? The receptionist says yes. Is there a restaurant? Yes, there is. I would like **room service** tonight. I have a **single room**. It is clean and quiet.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-46/reading-at-hotel.mp3" title="🔊 I am at the hotel today"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-46/reading-reception.mp3" title="🔊 I go to reception to check in"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-46/reading-key-twelve.mp3" title="🔊 Can I have a key for room twelve?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-46/reading-restaurant.mp3" title="🔊 Is there a restaurant? Yes, there is"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-46/reading-single-room.mp3" title="🔊 I have a single room. It is clean and quiet"></audio>

### Comprueba

1. ¿Dónde está? → **At the hotel**.  
2. ¿Adónde va? → **Reception (to check in)**.  
3. ¿Qué pide? → **A key for room twelve**.  
4. ¿Hay restaurante? → **Yes**.  
5. ¿Qué quiere esta noche? → **Room service**.  
6. ¿Qué tipo de habitación? → **Single room**.

---

## 7. Diálogo modelo

> **A:** Hello. I have a booking.  
> **B:** Welcome. Can I have your name?  
> **A:** John.  
> **B:** Here is your key for room eight.  
> **A:** Is there Wi-Fi in the hotel?  
> **B:** Yes, there is. The password is on the key card.  
> **A:** Can I have room service?  
> **B:** Yes. Call reception.  
> **A:** Thank you.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-46/dialogue-booking.mp3" title="🔊 Hello. I have a booking"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-46/dialogue-name.mp3" title="🔊 Welcome. Can I have your name?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-46/dialogue-wifi.mp3" title="🔊 Is there Wi-Fi in the hotel?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-46/dialogue-room-service.mp3" title="🔊 Can I have room service? Yes. Call reception"></audio>

---

## 8. Errores típicos de hispanohablantes

| ❌ Incorrecto | ✅ Correcto | Explicación |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| *Can I **to** have a key?* | *Can I **have** a key?* | verbo base |
| *Can I **having** room service?* | *Can I **have** room service?* | verbo base |
| *Are there Wi-Fi?* | *Is there Wi-Fi?* | *Wi-Fi* como singular aquí |
| *Have I a key?* | *Can I have a key?* | petición cortés |
| *I want key* | *Can I have a key?* / *I would like a key* | más natural |
| *single for two people* | *double room* | single = 1 persona |

---

## 9. Pronunciación útil

| Palabra / frase | Tip A1 |
| :--- | :--- |
| **reception** | *ri-SEP-shen*. |
| **single** | *SING-gel*. |
| **double** | *DA-bel*. |
| **available** | *a-VEI-la-bel*. |
| **Wi-Fi** | *WAI-fai*. |
| **key card** | *kii kard*. |
| **Can I have…?** | une: *ca-nai-hav*. |

Practica: *Can I have…? → Is there…? → Yes, there is.*

---

## 10. Mini-diálogos para memorizar

> **A:** Can I have a key for room ten?  
> **B:** Yes. Here is your key.  
> **A:** Is there Wi-Fi?  
> **B:** Yes, there is.

> **A:** Is there a double room available?  
> **B:** Yes. Would you like room service?  
> **A:** Yes, please. Call reception later.

> **A:** Hello. I have a booking.  
> **B:** Can I have your name?  
> **A:** Ana.  
> **B:** Welcome. Here is your key.

Cambia solo el número de habitación: fijas ***Can I have…?*** e ***Is there…?***.

---

## 10b. Plantillas para copiar

1. Can I have a key for room \_\_\_\_?  
2. Is there \_\_\_\_ in the hotel?  
3. Can I get room service?  
4. I would like a \_\_\_\_ room.  
5. I have a booking.  
6. Here is your key.

### Más frases para memorizar

> Can I have a key for room ten?  
> Is there a double room available?  
> Can I get room service?  
> Is there Wi-Fi in the hotel?  
> I would like a single room.  
> Hello. I have a booking.  
> Can I have your name?  
> Here is your key for room eight.  
> The password is on the key card.  
> Call reception.  
> Yes, there is.  
> Thank you.  
> I go to reception to check in.  
> I have a single room.  
> It is clean and quiet.  
> Is there a restaurant?  
> I would like room service tonight.  
> Welcome.

Lee la lista dos veces. Luego escribe **tu** check-in en 6–8 frases.

### Rutina de 2 minutos

1. Di 3 peticiones *Can I have…?*.  
2. Di 3 preguntas *Is there…?*.  
3. Responde *Yes, there is / No, there isn't*.  
4. Practica *single room / double room / room service*.

### Combinar U16 + U38 + U46

| Unidad | Aporta | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| U16 | Can I have…? (café) | Can I have a coffee? |
| U38 | permiso | Can I use…? |
| **U46** | hotel | Can I have a key? Is there Wi-Fi? |

### Mini-historia para reescribir

> I am at the hotel today. I go to reception to check in. Can I have a key for room twelve? Is there a restaurant? Yes, there is. I would like room service tonight. I have a single room. It is clean and quiet.

Cambia número de habitación y tipo (*single/double*); mantén *Can I have* e *Is there*.

### Tour guiado (modelo)

> I am at the hotel today. I go to reception to check in. Can I have a key for room twelve? The receptionist says yes. Is there a restaurant? Yes, there is. I would like room service tonight. I have a single room. It is clean and quiet.

Grábate leyéndolo. Luego improvisa con **tu** reserva.

### Frases extra para practicar en voz alta

> Hello. I have a booking.  
> Can I have your name?  
> Here is your key.  
> Is there Wi-Fi?  
> Can I have room service?  
> Thank you.

Personaliza nombre y número de habitación.

### Checklist mental

- *Can I + base verb*  
- *Is there + noun?*  
- Vocab: reception · key · single/double · room service · Wi-Fi  
- Check-in: booking → name → key → questions  
- Respuestas: *Yes, there is* / *Here is your key*

### Mapa rápido

| Unidad | Enfoque |
| :--- | :--- |
| U45 | Seasons |
| **U46** | At the Hotel — Can I have / Is there |
| U47 | Holidays — was/were + past |

---

## 11. Ejercicios prácticos (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — Completa

1. Can I \_\_\_\_ a key for room ten? (have)  
2. \_\_\_\_ there a double room available?  
3. Can I \_\_\_\_ room service? (get)  
4. Is there \_\_\_\_ in the hotel? (Wi-Fi)  
5. I would \_\_\_\_ a single room. (like)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **have**  
2. **Is**  
3. **get**  
4. **Wi-Fi**  
5. **like**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Elige el vocabulario

1. desk where you check in → \_\_\_\_  
2. room for one person → \_\_\_\_  
3. room for two people → \_\_\_\_  
4. food to your room → \_\_\_\_  
5. opens the door → \_\_\_\_

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **reception**  
2. **single room**  
3. **double room**  
4. **room service**  
5. **key** / **key card**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Traduce

1. ¿Puedo tener una llave para la habitación diez?  
2. ¿Hay Wi-Fi en el hotel?  
3. Me gustaría una habitación individual.  
4. Tengo una reserva.  
5. Aquí tienes tu llave.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Can I have a key for room ten?**  
2. **Is there Wi-Fi in the hotel?**  
3. **I would like a single room.**  
4. **I have a booking.**  
5. **Here is your key.** / **Here you are.**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Ordena

1. have / I / Can / a key  
2. there / Is / Wi-Fi  
3. room / a / like / would / I / single  
4. booking / a / have / I

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Can I have a key?**  
2. **Is there Wi-Fi?**  
3. **I would like a single room.**  
4. **I have a booking.**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Reading corto

Lee el texto de la sección 6. Contesta:

1. Where is the writer?  
2. Why does the writer go to reception?  
3. What room number?  
4. Is there a restaurant?  
5. What type of room?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **At the hotel**  
2. **To check in**  
3. **Twelve**  
4. **Yes**  
5. **Single room**
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Corrige el error

1. Can I to have a key?  
2. Are there Wi-Fi in the hotel?  
3. Can I having room service?  
4. I want single for two people.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Can I have a key?**  
2. **Is there Wi-Fi in the hotel?**  
3. **Can I have room service?**  
4. **I would like a double room.** / **Can I have a double room?**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Escribe tu check-in

Escribe 8–10 frases. Incluye:

- *I have a booking*  
- *Can I have…?* (2 veces)  
- *Is there…?* (2 veces)  
- *single* o *double room*  
- *room service* o *Wi-Fi*

**Modelo:** el texto de la sección 6.

### Ejercicio 8 — Elige la opción correcta

1. Can I \_\_\_\_ a key? (have / to have / having)  
2. \_\_\_\_ there a restaurant? (Is / Are / Do)  
3. I would like a \_\_\_\_ room for one person. (single / double / key)  
4. The password is on the \_\_\_\_. (key card / reception / booking)  
5. Yes, there \_\_\_\_. (is / are / am)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **have**  
2. **Is**  
3. **single**  
4. **key card**  
5. **is**
</details>

---

## 12. Plan de práctica (15 minutos)

1. **3 min** — Di 5 peticiones *Can I have…?*.  
2. **3 min** — Di 5 preguntas *Is there…?*.  
3. **4 min** — Reescribe el reading con tu habitación.  
4. **5 min** — Practica el diálogo de check-in en voz alta.

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *Can I + base verb*  
- [ ] Pregunto con *Is there…?*  
- [ ] Distingo single / double room  
- [ ] Conozco reception / key / room service / Wi-Fi  
- [ ] Hago un check-in corto

---

## 13. Consejos para practicar

1. **Simula recepción:** una persona es recepcionista; la otra el huésped.  
2. **Lista de necesidades:** Wi-Fi, room service, restaurant, double room → convierte cada una en *Is there…?* o *Can I have…?*.  
3. **Combina** U16: misma forma *Can I have…* en café y hotel.  
4. Prepárate para la [Unidad 47](/curso-a1/unit-47): *Holidays & Vacation* (*was/were*, pasado regular).  
5. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 46](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-46-hotel-can-i-have-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 46 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-46).

---

## Resumen rápido

| Tema | Lo esencial |
| :--- | :--- |
| Pedir | Can I have / get…? |
| Preguntar | Is there…? |
| Habitaciones | single · double |
| Vocab | reception · key · room service · Wi-Fi |
| Check-in | booking → name → key → questions |
| Tip | verbo base después de Can I |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A1

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 46 A1 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-46-hotel-can-i-have-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [Unidad 46 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-46)

En la **Unidad 47** hablas de **vacaciones en pasado**: *was/were* y verbos regulares (*visited, stayed*).

Guía dedicada y curso:

faqs.question: ¿Cuándo uso was y cuándo were?
faqs.answer: Was con I/he/she/it: I was on the beach. Were con we/you/they: We were in the mountains.
