content:
En la [Unidad 46](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-46-hotel-can-i-have) pediste cosas en el hotel. En la **Unidad 47 del curso A1** (*Holidays & Vacation*) cuentas **vacaciones en pasado** con ***was/were*** y verbos regulares (***visited, played***).

Conecta con clima ([U44](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-44-tiempo-atmosferico)) y estaciones ([U45](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-45-estaciones-in-spring)). Incluye **audios**, **esquemas** y **ejercicios**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 47 — Holidays & Vacation](/curso-a1/unit-47)  
> **Repaso útil:** [Unidad 46 — At the Hotel](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-46-hotel-can-i-have) · [Unidad 44 — The Weather](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-44-tiempo-atmosferico)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 47 (A1)

Al terminar esta unidad serás capaz de:

- Usar ***was / were*** para lugares y situaciones pasadas.
- Formar pasado regular con ***-ed*** (*visited, played, stayed*).
- Hablar de ***beach, mountains, sightseeing, souvenir***.
- Preguntar: ***Where were you last week?***
- Contar unas vacaciones cortas en pasado.

---

## 1. Was / were

| Sujeto | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| I / he / she / it | **was** | I **was** on the beach. |
| we / you / they | **were** | We **were** in the mountains. |
| Negativa | was not / weren't | I **was not** at home. |

![Was were A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-47/a1-unit47-was-were.png)

```
I/he/she/it + was
we/you/they + were
+ last week / last year / yesterday / last summer
```

### Tip

*Was/were* = pasado de *am/is/are*. Para vacaciones: *I was on holiday* / *We were in Spain*.

---

## 2. Verbos regulares: + -ed

| Presente | Pasado | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| visit | **visited** | She **visited** Paris. |
| play | **played** | We **played** volleyball. |
| stay | **stayed** | I **stayed** at a hotel. |
| walk | **walked** | They **walked** in the old town. |

![Regular past A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-47/a1-unit47-regular-past.png)

```
regular verb + -ed
→ visited · played · stayed · walked
```

### Tip

En A1 empieza con regulares. Combina: *I was on the beach. I played volleyball.*

---

## 3. Vocabulario de vacaciones

![Holiday vocab A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-47/a1-unit47-holiday-vocab.png)

| Inglés | Español | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| holiday / vacation | vacaciones | on holiday |
| beach | playa | on the beach |
| mountains | montañas | in the mountains |
| sightseeing | turismo / visitas | do sightseeing |
| souvenir | recuerdo | buy a souvenir |
| last week | la semana pasada | last week |
| last summer | el verano pasado | last summer |
| last year | el año pasado | last year |
| volleyball | voleibol | play volleyball |
| great | genial | It was great. |
| old town | casco antiguo | visited the old town |

---

## 4. Ejemplos con audio

> I **was** on the beach last week.  
> We **were** in the mountains in August.  
> She **visited** Paris last year.  
> They **played** football on the beach.  
> I **was not** at home yesterday.  
> We **did sightseeing** yesterday.  
> I **bought** a souvenir.  
> Where **were** you last week?  
> It **was** great.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-47/was-on-beach.mp3" title="🔊 I was on the beach last week"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-47/were-in-mountains.mp3" title="🔊 We were in the mountains in August"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-47/visited-paris.mp3" title="🔊 She visited Paris last year"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-47/played-football.mp3" title="🔊 They played football on the beach"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-47/was-not-home.mp3" title="🔊 I was not at home yesterday"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-47/did-sightseeing.mp3" title="🔊 We did sightseeing yesterday"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-47/bought-souvenir.mp3" title="🔊 I bought a souvenir"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-47/it-was-great.mp3" title="🔊 It was great"></audio>

---

## 5. Preguntas y respuestas

> **Where were you last week?**  
> **I was on the beach.**

> **Were you in the mountains too?**  
> **No, I was not.** / **Yes, we were.**

> **Did you do sightseeing?**  
> **Yes. I visited the old town.**

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-47/i-was-on-beach.mp3" title="🔊 I was on the beach"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-47/no-i-was-not.mp3" title="🔊 No, I was not"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-47/visited-old-town.mp3" title="🔊 Yes. I visited the old town"></audio>

### Tabla de preguntas

| Pregunta | Respuesta |
| :--- | :--- |
| Where were you last week? | I was on the beach. |
| Were you on holiday? | Yes, I was. |
| Did you visit Paris? | Yes. I visited Paris. |
| Was the weather sunny? | Yes, it was. |

---

## 6. Reading modelo: vacaciones en España

> **Last summer I was on holiday in Spain.** I was on the beach every day. My friends **visited** the mountains too. We did **sightseeing** in Barcelona. I bought a **souvenir** – a small statue. The weather **was** sunny. We **played** volleyball on the beach. It **was** great.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-47/reading-last-summer.mp3" title="🔊 Last summer I was on holiday in Spain"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-47/reading-beach-every-day.mp3" title="🔊 I was on the beach every day"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-47/reading-sightseeing.mp3" title="🔊 We did sightseeing in Barcelona"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-47/reading-souvenir.mp3" title="🔊 I bought a souvenir – a small statue"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-47/reading-volleyball.mp3" title="🔊 We played volleyball on the beach. It was great"></audio>

### Comprueba

1. ¿Cuándo? → **Last summer**.  
2. ¿Dónde? → **Spain / on the beach**.  
3. ¿Qué visitaron los amigos? → **The mountains**.  
4. ¿Qué hicieron en Barcelona? → **Sightseeing**.  
5. ¿Qué compró? → **A souvenir**.  
6. ¿Cómo fue? → **Great** (sunny weather).

---

## 7. Diálogo modelo

> **A:** Where were you last week?  
> **B:** I was on the beach. I played volleyball and swam.  
> **A:** Nice. Did you do sightseeing?  
> **B:** Yes. I visited the old town. I bought a souvenir.  
> **A:** Were you in the mountains too?  
> **B:** No, I was not. Next year I will go to the mountains.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-47/dialogue-where.mp3" title="🔊 Where were you last week?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-47/dialogue-beach-volleyball.mp3" title="🔊 I was on the beach. I played volleyball and swam"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-47/dialogue-sightseeing.mp3" title="🔊 Did you do sightseeing? Yes. I visited the old town"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-47/dialogue-mountains-no.mp3" title="🔊 Were you in the mountains too? No, I was not"></audio>

---

## 8. Errores típicos de hispanohablantes

| ❌ Incorrecto | ✅ Correcto | Explicación |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| *I **were** on the beach* | *I **was** on the beach* | I → was |
| *We **was** in Spain* | *We **were** in Spain* | we → were |
| *She **visit** Paris* | *She **visited** Paris* | *-ed* |
| *I **play** volleyball yesterday* | *I **played** volleyball yesterday* | pasado |
| *Where **was** you?* | *Where **were** you?* | you → were |
| *on the mountains* | *in the mountains* | *in* + mountains |

---

## 9. Pronunciación útil

| Palabra / frase | Tip A1 |
| :--- | :--- |
| **was** | *woz* / *waz*. |
| **were** | *wer*. |
| **visited** | *VI-zi-tid* (sílaba extra). |
| **played** | *pleid* (una sílaba). |
| **sightseeing** | *SAIT-sii-ing*. |
| **souvenir** | *su-ve-NIR*. |
| **beach** | *biich*. |

Practica: *was → were → visited → played → sightseeing*.

---

## 10. Mini-diálogos para memorizar

> **A:** Where were you last summer?  
> **B:** I was on holiday in Spain.  
> **A:** Were you on the beach?  
> **B:** Yes, I was — every day.

> **A:** Did you visit the mountains?  
> **B:** Yes. We visited the mountains too.  
> **A:** Did you buy a souvenir?  
> **B:** Yes — a small statue.

> **A:** Was the weather sunny?  
> **B:** Yes, it was. We played volleyball. It was great.

Cambia solo el lugar: fijas ***was/were*** y ***-ed***.

---

## 10b. Plantillas para copiar

1. I was on the \_\_\_\_ last week.  
2. We were in the \_\_\_\_.  
3. She visited \_\_\_\_ last year.  
4. We played \_\_\_\_ on the beach.  
5. Where were you last week?  
6. It was great.

### Más frases para memorizar

> I was on the beach last week.  
> We were in the mountains in August.  
> She visited Paris last year.  
> They played football on the beach.  
> I was not at home yesterday.  
> We did sightseeing yesterday.  
> I bought a souvenir.  
> Where were you last week?  
> It was great.  
> Last summer I was on holiday in Spain.  
> I was on the beach every day.  
> My friends visited the mountains too.  
> We did sightseeing in Barcelona.  
> The weather was sunny.  
> We played volleyball on the beach.  
> Were you in the mountains too?  
> No, I was not.  
> Yes, I was.  
> I visited the old town.

Lee la lista dos veces. Luego cuenta **tus** últimas vacaciones en 6–8 frases.

### Rutina de 2 minutos

1. Di 3 frases con *was* y 3 con *were*.  
2. Di 3 verbos con *-ed* (*visited, played, stayed*).  
3. Pregunta *Where were you last week?*  
4. Añade *beach / mountains / souvenir*.

### Combinar U44 + U46 + U47

| Unidad | Aporta | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| U44 | clima | The weather **was** sunny. |
| U46 | hotel | I **stayed** at a hotel. |
| **U47** | vacaciones pasado | I **was** on the beach. I **visited** the old town. |

### Mini-historia para reescribir

> Last summer I was on holiday in Spain. I was on the beach every day. My friends visited the mountains too. We did sightseeing in Barcelona. I bought a souvenir. The weather was sunny. We played volleyball on the beach. It was great.

Cambia país y actividades; mantén *was/were* y *-ed*.

### Tour guiado (modelo)

> Last summer I was on holiday in Spain. I was on the beach every day. My friends visited the mountains too. We did sightseeing in Barcelona. I bought a souvenir – a small statue. The weather was sunny. We played volleyball on the beach. It was great.

Grábate leyéndolo. Luego improvisa con **tu** viaje real o inventado.

### Frases extra para practicar en voz alta

> Where were you last week?  
> I was on the beach.  
> We were in the mountains.  
> I visited the old town.  
> I bought a souvenir.  
> It was great.

Personaliza ciudad y actividades.

### Checklist mental

- *I/he/she/it → was* · *we/you/they → were*  
- Regulares: *verb + -ed*  
- Vocab: beach · mountains · sightseeing · souvenir  
- Marcadores: last week / last summer / yesterday  
- Pregunta: *Where were you…?*

### Mapa rápido

| Unidad | Enfoque |
| :--- | :--- |
| U46 | At the Hotel |
| **U47** | Holidays — was/were + -ed |
| U48 | Sightseeing — superlatives |

---

## 11. Ejercicios prácticos (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — Completa *was / were*

1. I \_\_\_\_ on the beach last week.  
2. We \_\_\_\_ in the mountains in August.  
3. She \_\_\_\_ on holiday in Spain.  
4. They \_\_\_\_ in Barcelona yesterday.  
5. I \_\_\_\_ not at home yesterday.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **was**  
2. **were**  
3. **was**  
4. **were**  
5. **was**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Forma el pasado (-ed)

1. visit → \_\_\_\_  
2. play → \_\_\_\_  
3. stay → \_\_\_\_  
4. walk → \_\_\_\_

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **visited**  
2. **played**  
3. **stayed**  
4. **walked**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Traduce

1. Estuve en la playa la semana pasada.  
2. Estuvimos en las montañas.  
3. Ella visitó París el año pasado.  
4. ¿Dónde estuviste la semana pasada?  
5. Fue genial.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **I was on the beach last week.**  
2. **We were in the mountains.**  
3. **She visited Paris last year.**  
4. **Where were you last week?**  
5. **It was great.**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Ordena

1. beach / the / on / was / I  
2. visited / She / Paris  
3. were / mountains / the / in / We  
4. were / you / Where / last week

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **I was on the beach.**  
2. **She visited Paris.**  
3. **We were in the mountains.**  
4. **Where were you last week?**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Reading corto

Lee el texto de la sección 6. Contesta:

1. When was the holiday?  
2. Where was the writer every day?  
3. What did the friends visit?  
4. What did the writer buy?  
5. Was the weather sunny?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Last summer**  
2. **On the beach**  
3. **The mountains**  
4. **A souvenir**  
5. **Yes**
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Corrige el error

1. I were on the beach.  
2. We was in Spain.  
3. She visit Paris last year.  
4. Where was you last week?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **I was on the beach.**  
2. **We were in Spain.**  
3. **She visited Paris last year.**  
4. **Where were you last week?**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Escribe tus vacaciones

Escribe 8–10 frases. Incluye:

- *was* y *were*  
- 2 verbos con *-ed*  
- *beach* o *mountains*  
- *sightseeing* o *souvenir*  
- *last summer / last week*

**Modelo:** el texto de la sección 6.

### Ejercicio 8 — Elige la opción correcta

1. I \_\_\_\_ on holiday last summer. (was / were / am)  
2. We \_\_\_\_ in the mountains. (were / was / is)  
3. She \_\_\_\_ Paris. (visited / visit / visits)  
4. Where \_\_\_\_ you last week? (were / was / are)  
5. We \_\_\_\_ volleyball on the beach. (played / play / playing)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **was**  
2. **were**  
3. **visited**  
4. **were**  
5. **played**
</details>

---

## 12. Plan de práctica (15 minutos)

1. **3 min** — Di 5 frases *was/were* + lugar.  
2. **3 min** — Di 5 con *-ed* (*visited, played, stayed*).  
3. **4 min** — Reescribe el reading con tu viaje.  
4. **5 min** — Mini-entrevista *Where were you…?*

### Checklist

- [ ] Distingo *was* y *were*  
- [ ] Formo regulares con *-ed*  
- [ ] Uso beach / mountains / sightseeing / souvenir  
- [ ] Pregunto *Where were you…?*  
- [ ] Cuento unas vacaciones cortas en pasado

---

## 13. Consejos para practicar

1. **Foto de viaje:** 5 frases en pasado por foto (*I was… / We visited…*).  
2. **Pareja:** uno pregunta *Where were you?* / *Did you visit…?*; el otro responde.  
3. **Combina** U46: *I stayed at a hotel. The room was clean.*  
4. Prepárate para la [Unidad 48](/curso-a1/unit-48): *Sightseeing* (superlativos: *the biggest, the most famous*).  
5. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 47](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-47-vacaciones-was-were-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 47 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-47).

---

## Resumen rápido

| Tema | Lo esencial |
| :--- | :--- |
| was | I / he / she / it |
| were | we / you / they |
| Regulares | verb + -ed |
| Vocab | beach · mountains · sightseeing · souvenir |
| Tiempo | last week · last summer · yesterday |
| Tip | I was / we were (no al revés) |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A1

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 47 A1 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-47-vacaciones-was-were-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [Unidad 47 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-47)

En la **Unidad 48** practicas **sightseeing** con **superlativos**: *the biggest museum*, *the most famous square*.

Guía dedicada y curso:

- [Unidad 48 — Sightseeing (superlativos)](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-48-sightseeing-superlativos)
- [Unidad 48 — Sightseeing](/curso-a1/unit-48)

Antes de pasar de unidad, escribe un párrafo de 6–8 frases sobre tus últimas vacaciones.

Guías relacionadas:

- [Past Simple: usos y reglas](/blog/gramatica/past-simple-usos-reglas)
- [Errores de tiempos de pasado](/blog/gramatica/errores-tiempos-pasado-espanoles)

title: Sightseeing A1: the most famous, the oldest y guided tours
author: linguafly-team

description: Aprende superlativos básicos en inglés A1 para turismo: the most famous, the oldest, museum, monument, statue y guided tour. Guía Unidad 48 con audios y ejercicios.
alt: Esquema de superlativos básicos para sightseeing en inglés A1

faqs.question: ¿Cómo formo superlativos cortos en A1?
faqs.answer: Con the + adjetivo + -est: old → the oldest, big → the biggest, tall → the tallest.

faqs.question: ¿Y con adjetivos largos como famous?
faqs.answer: Con the most + adjetivo: the most famous, the most beautiful, the most interesting.

faqs.question: ¿Qué vocabulario de sightseeing practico?
faqs.answer: Museum, monument, statue, guided tour, square, guide, sightseeing y take photos.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo digo «el museo más famoso»?
faqs.answer: The most famous museum. Ejemplo: We visited the most famous museum in the city.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 48 del curso A1?
faqs.answer: En el cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones y en la Unidad 48 del curso A1 de Linguafly: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening, speaking y writing.

content:
En la [Unidad 47](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-47-vacaciones-was-were) contaste vacaciones en pasado. En la **Unidad 48 del curso A1** (*Sightseeing*) describes lugares con **superlativos**: ***the most famous***, ***the oldest***, y vocabulario de turismo.

Conecta con *visited* / *sightseeing* de la U47. Incluye **audios**, **esquemas** y **ejercicios**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 48 — Sightseeing](/curso-a1/unit-48)  
> **Repaso útil:** [Unidad 47 — Holidays](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-47-vacaciones-was-were) · [Unidad 43 — Travel Verbs](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-43-verbos-viaje-horarios)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 48 (A1)

Al terminar esta unidad serás capaz de:

- Usar ***the + -est*** (*the oldest, the biggest, the tallest*).
- Usar ***the most + adjective*** (*the most famous, the most beautiful*).
- Nombrar ***museum, monument, statue, guided tour, square***.
- Describir un día de sightseeing.
- Combinar pasado (U47) + superlativos: *We visited the most famous museum*.

---

## 1. Superlativos básicos

| Tipo | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Corto | **the + -est** | the **oldest**, the **biggest**, the **tallest** |
| Largo | **the most + adj.** | the **most famous**, the **most beautiful** |

![Superlatives A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-48/a1-unit48-superlatives.png)

```
short:  the + adjective + -est  → the oldest / the biggest
long:   the most + adjective    → the most famous / the most beautiful
```

### Tip

El superlativo compara **uno con todos**: *This is the oldest building in town* = el más antiguo del pueblo.

### Tabla rápida

| Adjetivo | Superlativo |
| :--- | :--- |
| old | the oldest |
| big | the biggest |
| tall | the tallest |
| famous | the most famous |
| beautiful | the most beautiful |
| interesting | the most interesting |

---

## 2. Vocabulario de sightseeing

![Sightseeing vocab A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-48/a1-unit48-sightseeing-vocab.png)

| Inglés | Español | Ejemplo |

| museum | museo | the most famous museum |

| guided tour | visita guiada | do a guided tour |
| guide | guía | The guide explained… |
| building | edificio | the oldest building |
| church | iglesia | the oldest church |
| take photos | hacer fotos | We took photos. |
| interesting | interesante | very interesting |
| history | historia | explained the history |

---

## 3. Ejemplos con audio

> This is **the most famous** monument in the city.  
> It is **the oldest** church in town.  
> That is **the biggest** museum here.  
> We saw **the tallest** statue in the square.

## 4. Un día de sightseeing

## 5. Preguntas y respuestas

> **What did you do today?**  
> **We did sightseeing.**

### Tabla de preguntas

| Pregunta | Respuesta |
| :--- | :--- |
| What did you visit? | The most famous museum. |
| Is it the oldest building? | Yes, it is. |
| Did you do a guided tour? | Yes, we did. |

---

## 6. Reading modelo: sightseeing en la ciudad

> **Yesterday we did sightseeing in the city.** We visited **the most famous museum**. It is **the oldest** building in town. In the square there is a tall **statue**. We did a **guided tour** of the monument. The guide explained the history. It was very interesting. We took photos.

### Comprueba

1. ¿Qué hicieron? → **Sightseeing**.  
2. ¿Qué museo? → **The most famous**.  
3. ¿El edificio? → **The oldest in town**.  
4. ¿Qué hay en la plaza? → **A tall statue**.  
5. ¿Hicieron visita guiada? → **Yes**.  
6. ¿Cómo fue? → **Very interesting**.

---

## 7. Diálogo modelo

> **A:** What did you do today?  
> **B:** We did sightseeing. We visited the most famous museum. It is the oldest building in the city.  
> **A:** Did you do a guided tour?  
> **B:** Yes. We saw a big statue in the square. The guide explained the monument.  
> **A:** Was it good?

---

## 8. Errores típicos de hispanohablantes

| ❌ Incorrecto | ✅ Correcto | Explicación |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| *the **more** famous* | *the **most** famous* | superlativo |
| ***most** famous museum* | ***the** most famous museum* | falta *the* |
| *the **older** church* (aquí) | *the **oldest** church* | superlativo, no comparativo |
| *the most **old*** | *the **oldest*** | corto → *-est* |
| *the famousest* | *the **most** famous* | largo → *the most* |
| *biggest museum* (sin the) | ***the** biggest museum* | casi siempre *the* |

---

## 9. Pronunciación útil

| Palabra / frase | Tip A1 |
| :--- | :--- |
| **the most** | *dha moust*. |
| **oldest** | *OL-dist*. |
| **biggest** | *BIG-guist*. |
| **famous** | *FEI-mos*. |
| **museum** | *miu-ZII-om*. |
| **monument** | *MON-iu-ment*. |
| **statue** | *STA-chuu*. |
| **guided tour** | *GAI-did tur*. |

Practica: *the oldest → the biggest → the most famous*.

---

## 10. Mini-diálogos para memorizar

> **A:** What did you visit?  
> **B:** The most famous museum.  
> **A:** Is it the oldest building?  
> **B:** Yes, it is.

> **A:** Did you do a guided tour?  
> **B:** Yes. The guide explained the monument.  
> **A:** Was there a statue?  
> **B:** Yes — a tall statue in the square.

> **A:** Was it interesting?  
> **B:** Yes, very. We took photos.

Cambia solo el lugar: fijas ***the most / the -est***.

---

## 10b. Plantillas para copiar

1. This is the most \_\_\_\_ museum in the city.  
2. It is the \_\_\_\_ building in town. (old → oldest)  
3. That is the \_\_\_\_ museum here. (big → biggest)  
4. We did a guided tour of the \_\_\_\_.  
5. There is a statue in the \_\_\_\_.  
6. It was very interesting.

### Más frases para memorizar

> This is the most famous monument in the city.  
> It is the oldest church in town.  
> That is the biggest museum here.  
> We saw the tallest statue in the square.  
> This is the most beautiful building in the city.  
> We visited the most famous museum.  
> We did a guided tour.  
> There is a tall statue in the square.  
> It was very interesting.  
> Yesterday we did sightseeing in the city.  
> It is the oldest building in town.  
> The guide explained the history.  
> We took photos.  
> What did you do today?  
> We did sightseeing.  
> Did you do a guided tour?  
> Was it good?  
> Yes, it was very interesting.

Lee la lista dos veces. Luego describe **tu** ciudad con 2 superlativos.

### Rutina de 2 minutos

1. Di 3 superlativos cortos (*oldest, biggest, tallest*).  
2. Di 3 con *the most* (*famous, beautiful, interesting*).  
3. Une con *museum / monument / statue*.  
4. Pregunta *Did you do a guided tour?*

### Combinar U47 + U48

| Unidad | Aporta | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| U47 | pasado | We **visited**… / We **did** sightseeing. |
| **U48** | superlativo | …**the most famous** museum. |

### Mini-historia para reescribir

> Yesterday we did sightseeing in the city. We visited the most famous museum. It is the oldest building in town. In the square there is a tall statue. We did a guided tour of the monument. The guide explained the history. It was very interesting. We took photos.

Cambia ciudad y lugares; mantén *the most / the -est*.

### Tour guiado (modelo)

> Yesterday we did sightseeing in the city. We visited the most famous museum. It is the oldest building in town. In the square there is a tall statue. We did a guided tour of the monument. The guide explained the history. It was very interesting. We took photos.

Grábate leyéndolo. Luego improvisa con **tu** ciudad.

### Frases extra para practicar en voz alta

> We did sightseeing.  
> We visited the most famous museum.  
> It is the oldest building.  
> We saw a statue in the square.  
> We did a guided tour.  
> It was very interesting.

Personaliza museos y plazas reales.

### Checklist mental

- Cortos: *the + -est*  
- Largos: *the most + adj.*  
- Vocab: museum · monument · statue · guided tour · square  
- Combina con pasado: *visited / did*  
- Pregunta: *Did you do a guided tour?*

### Mapa rápido

| Unidad | Enfoque |
| :--- | :--- |
| U47 | Holidays — was/were |
| **U48** | Sightseeing — superlatives |
| U49 | Packing — need to |

---

## 11. Ejercicios prácticos (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — Completa el superlativo

1. This is \_\_\_\_ famous monument in the city. (the most)  
2. It is \_\_\_\_ old church in town. (the oldest)  
3. That is \_\_\_\_ big museum here. (the biggest)  
4. We saw \_\_\_\_ tall statue in the square. (the tallest)  
5. This is \_\_\_\_ beautiful building. (the most)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **the most**  
2. **the oldest**  
3. **the biggest**  
4. **the tallest**  
5. **the most**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Elige el vocabulario

1. place with art and history → \_\_\_\_  
2. figure in stone/metal → \_\_\_\_  
3. visit with a guide → \_\_\_\_  
4. open area in a city → \_\_\_\_  
5. building to remember someone/something → \_\_\_\_

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **museum**  
2. **statue**  
3. **guided tour**  
4. **square**  
5. **monument**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Traduce

1. Este es el monumento más famoso de la ciudad.  
2. Es el edificio más antiguo del pueblo.  
3. Hicimos una visita guiada.  
4. Hay una estatua en la plaza.  
5. Fue muy interesante.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **This is the most famous monument in the city.**  
2. **It is the oldest building in town.**  
3. **We did a guided tour.**  
4. **There is a statue in the square.**  
5. **It was very interesting.**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Ordena

1. most / the / famous / museum  
2. oldest / the / is / It / building  
3. guided / a / did / We / tour  
4. square / the / in / statue / a / is / There

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **the most famous museum**  
2. **It is the oldest building.**  
3. **We did a guided tour.**  
4. **There is a statue in the square.**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Reading corto

Lee el texto de la sección 6. Contesta:

1. What did they do yesterday?  
2. Which museum did they visit?  
3. Is the building old?  
4. What is in the square?  
5. Did they take photos?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Sightseeing**  
2. **The most famous museum**  
3. **Yes — the oldest in town**  
4. **A tall statue**  
5. **Yes**
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Corrige el error

1. This is the more famous museum.  
2. It is oldest building in town.  
3. That is the most old church.  
4. We did guided tour.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **This is the most famous museum.**  
2. **It is the oldest building in town.**  
3. **That is the oldest church.**  
4. **We did a guided tour.**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Escribe tu sightseeing

Escribe 8–10 frases. Incluye:

- *the most famous* y *the oldest* (o *biggest*)  
- *museum / monument / statue*  
- *guided tour*  
- *square*  
- 1 frase en pasado (*Yesterday we…*)

**Modelo:** el texto de la sección 6.

### Ejercicio 8 — Elige la opción correcta

1. This is \_\_\_\_ famous museum. (the most / the more / most)  
2. It is \_\_\_\_ oldest building. (the / a / —)  
3. That is the \_\_\_\_ museum. (biggest / most big / bigger)  
4. We did a \_\_\_\_ tour. (guided / guiding / guide)  
5. There is a statue in the \_\_\_\_. (square / museum / key)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **the most**  
2. **the**  
3. **biggest**  
4. **guided**  
5. **square**
</details>

---

## 12. Plan de práctica (15 minutos)

1. **3 min** — Di 5 superlativos (*oldest, biggest, most famous…*).  
2. **3 min** — Une cada uno a *museum / monument / statue*.  
3. **4 min** — Reescribe el reading con tu ciudad.  
4. **5 min** — Mini-entrevista *What did you visit?* / *Was it interesting?*

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *the + -est* con adjetivos cortos  
- [ ] Uso *the most* con adjetivos largos  
- [ ] Conozco museum / monument / statue / guided tour  
- [ ] Combino con pasado (*visited / did*)  
- [ ] Describo un día de sightseeing

---

## 13. Consejos para practicar

1. **Guía turística de 1 minuto:** presenta tu ciudad con 3 superlativos.  
2. **Pareja:** uno pregunta *What is the most famous…?*; el otro responde.  
3. **Combina** U47: *Last summer we visited the oldest church in town.*  
4. Prepárate para la [Unidad 49](/curso-a1/unit-49): *Packing a Suitcase* (*need to / don't need to*).  
5. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 48](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-48-sightseeing-superlativos-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 48 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-48).

---

## Resumen rápido

| Tema | Lo esencial |
| :--- | :--- |
| Cortos | the + -est |
| Largos | the most + adj. |
| Vocab | museum · monument · statue · guided tour |
| Lugar | square · city · town |
| Tip | casi siempre *the* antes del superlativo |
| Combo | visited + the most famous… |

---

title: Packing a Suitcase A1: need to / don't need to
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 49 del curso A1: hacer la maleta con need to / don't need to, con audios y ejercicios.
description: Aprende a hablar de hacer la maleta en inglés A1 con need to / don't need to, suitcase, clothes y toiletries. Guía Unidad 49 con audios y ejercicios.
alt: Esquema need to y don't need to para hacer la maleta en inglés A1

faqs.question: ¿Qué significa need to en A1?
faqs.answer: Need to = necesitar hacer algo. Va seguido de verbo base: I need to pack my suitcase. You need to take your passport.

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre need to y don't need to?
faqs.answer: Need to expresa necesidad. Don't need to / doesn't need to expresa que no es necesario: I don't need to take so many clothes.

faqs.question: ¿Qué vocabulario de maleta practico?
faqs.answer: Suitcase, pack, clothes, toiletries (toothbrush, soap, shampoo), essential items, passport, ticket.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo digo «no necesito llevar tantas cosas»?
faqs.answer: I don't need to take so many things. / She doesn't need to bring so many clothes.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 49 del curso A1?
faqs.answer: En el cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones y en la Unidad 49 del curso A1 de Linguafly: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening, speaking y writing.

content:
En la [Unidad 48](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-48-sightseeing-superlativos) visitaste museos. En la **Unidad 49 del curso A1** (*Packing a Suitcase*) preparas el viaje: ***need to / don't need to*** + ***suitcase, clothes, toiletries***.

Conecta con *passport / ticket* de la [Unidad 41](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-41-aeropuerto-must-should). Incluye **audios**, **esquemas** y **ejercicios**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 49 — Packing a Suitcase](/curso-a1/unit-49)  
> **Repaso útil:** [Unidad 48 — Sightseeing](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-48-sightseeing-superlativos) · [Unidad 41 — At the Airport](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-41-aeropuerto-must-should)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 49 (A1)

Al terminar esta unidad serás capaz de:

- Usar ***need to + verbo base*** para necesidades.
- Usar ***don't need to / doesn't need to*** cuando algo no es necesario.
- Nombrar ***suitcase, clothes, toiletries, essential items***.
- Hacer una **lista de maleta** en inglés.
- Recordar *passport* y *toothbrush* antes del viaje.

---

## 1. Need to / don't need to

| Forma | Uso | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **need to** | necesario | I **need to** pack my suitcase. |
| **don't need to** | no necesario (I/you/we/they) | I **don't need to** take so many clothes. |
| **doesn't need to** | no necesario (he/she/it) | She **doesn't need to** bring so many clothes. |

![Need to A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-49/a1-unit49-need-to.png)

```
need to + base verb
→ need to pack · need to take · need to bring

don't need to / doesn't need to + base verb
→ don't need to take so many things
```

### Tip

Después de ***need to*** va el **verbo base** (*pack*, *take*), no *to pack* doble ni *-ing*: ~~need to packing~~.

### Contraste con must (U41)

| Forma | Idea | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **must** | obligación fuerte | You **must** show your passport. |
| **need to** | necesidad práctica | I **need to** pack tonight. |
| **don't need to** | no hace falta | You **don't need to** take heavy bags. |

---

## 2. Vocabulario de packing

![Packing vocab A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-49/a1-unit49-packing-vocab.png)

| Inglés | Español | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| suitcase | maleta | pack my suitcase |
| pack | hacer la maleta / meter | I need to pack. |
| clothes | ropa | take clothes |
| shirt / trousers | camisa / pantalones | shirts and trousers |
| underwear | ropa interior | underwear |
| toiletries | artículos de aseo | take toiletries |
| toothbrush | cepillo de dientes | toothbrush |
| soap | jabón | soap |
| shampoo | champú | shampoo |
| essential items | cosas esenciales | only essential items |
| bag | bolsa / bolso | in my bag |
| passport / ticket | pasaporte / billete | in my bag |
| heavy | pesado | heavy bags |

---

## 3. Ejemplos con audio

> I **need to** pack my suitcase tonight.  
> You **need to** take your passport.  
> She **doesn't need to** bring so many clothes.  
> We **need to** take toiletries.  
> They **don't need to** pack heavy bags.  
> Do you **need to** pack today?  
> Only **essential items**.  
> Don't forget your **passport** and **toothbrush**.  
> My suitcase is **small**.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-49/need-to-pack.mp3" title="🔊 I need to pack my suitcase tonight"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-49/need-to-passport.mp3" title="🔊 You need to take your passport"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-49/doesnt-need-clothes.mp3" title="🔊 She doesn't need to bring so many clothes"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-49/need-toiletries.mp3" title="🔊 We need to take toiletries"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-49/dont-need-heavy.mp3" title="🔊 They don't need to pack heavy bags"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-49/do-you-need-pack.mp3" title="🔊 Do you need to pack today?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-49/essential-items.mp3" title="🔊 Only essential items"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-49/suitcase-small.mp3" title="🔊 My suitcase is small"></audio>

---

## 4. Checklist de maleta

![Packing checklist A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-49/a1-unit49-packing-checklist.png)

| Need to take | Don't need to take |
| :--- | :--- |
| passport, ticket | so many clothes |
| clothes (shirts, trousers…) | heavy bags (for one week) |
| toiletries (toothbrush, soap, shampoo) | unnecessary things |
| essential items only | — |

---

## 5. Preguntas y respuestas

> **Do you need to pack today?**  
> **Yes. I need to pack my suitcase.**

> **Do you need to take so many shirts?**  
> **No. I don't need to take so many.**

> **Don't forget your passport.**  
> **I won't. They are in my bag.**

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-49/yes-need-pack.mp3" title="🔊 Yes. I need to pack my suitcase"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-49/dont-need-so-many.mp3" title="🔊 No. I don't need to take so many"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-49/in-my-bag.mp3" title="🔊 I won't. They are in my bag"></audio>

### Tabla de preguntas

| Pregunta | Respuesta |
| :--- | :--- |
| Do you need to pack tonight? | Yes, I do. / No, I don't. |
| What do you need to take? | Clothes and toiletries. |
| Do I need to take so many things? | No. Only essential items. |
| Where is your passport? | In my bag. |

---

## 6. Reading modelo: hacer la maleta

> **I need to pack my suitcase tonight.** My flight is tomorrow. I need to take **clothes** – shirts, trousers, underwear. I need to take **toiletries** too – toothbrush, soap, shampoo. I **don't need to** take so many things – only **essential items**. My suitcase is small. Passport and ticket are in my bag.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-49/reading-need-pack.mp3" title="🔊 I need to pack my suitcase tonight"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-49/reading-clothes.mp3" title="🔊 I need to take clothes – shirts, trousers, underwear"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-49/reading-toiletries.mp3" title="🔊 I need to take toiletries too – toothbrush, soap, shampoo"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-49/reading-essential.mp3" title="🔊 I don't need to take so many things – only essential items"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-49/reading-passport-bag.mp3" title="🔊 Passport and ticket are in my bag"></audio>

### Comprueba

1. ¿Cuándo hace la maleta? → **Tonight**.  
2. ¿Cuándo es el vuelo? → **Tomorrow**.  
3. ¿Qué ropa? → **Shirts, trousers, underwear**.  
4. ¿Toiletries? → **Toothbrush, soap, shampoo**.  
5. ¿Muchas cosas? → **No — only essential items**.  
6. ¿Dónde están passport y ticket? → **In my bag**.

---

## 7. Diálogo modelo

> **A:** Do you need to pack today?  
> **B:** Yes. I need to pack my suitcase. I need to take clothes and toiletries.  
> **A:** Do you need to take so many shirts?  
> **B:** No. I don't need to take so many. Only essential items.  
> **A:** Don't forget your passport and toothbrush.  
> **B:** I won't. They are in my bag.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-49/dialogue-pack-today.mp3" title="🔊 Do you need to pack today?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-49/dialogue-clothes-toiletries.mp3" title="🔊 I need to take clothes and toiletries"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-49/dialogue-so-many-shirts.mp3" title="🔊 Do you need to take so many shirts?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-49/dialogue-forget-passport.mp3" title="🔊 Don't forget your passport and toothbrush"></audio>

---

## 8. Errores típicos de hispanohablantes

| ❌ Incorrecto | ✅ Correcto | Explicación |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| *I need pack* | *I need **to** pack* | falta *to* |
| *I need to **packing*** | *I need to **pack*** | verbo base |
| *She **don't** need to…* | *She **doesn't** need to…* | 3.ª persona |
| *I **no** need to take…* | *I **don't** need to take…* | auxiliar |
| *need to **to** take* | *need to take* | un solo *to* |
| *toiletry* (lista) | *toiletries* | suele usarse en plural |

---

## 9. Pronunciación útil

| Palabra / frase | Tip A1 |
| :--- | :--- |
| **need to** | *niid tu* (a menudo *niid-tu*). |
| **don't need to** | *dount niid tu*. |
| **suitcase** | *SUT-keis*. |
| **toiletries** | *TOI-le-triz*. |
| **toothbrush** | *TUTH-brash*. |
| **essential** | *i-SEN-shel*. |
| **shampoo** | *sham-PUU*. |

Practica: *need to pack → need to take → don't need to take*.

---

## 10. Mini-diálogos para memorizar

> **A:** Do you need to pack tonight?  
> **B:** Yes. I need to pack my suitcase.  
> **A:** What do you need to take?  
> **B:** Clothes and toiletries.

> **A:** Do you need to take so many things?  
> **B:** No. I don't need to. Only essential items.  
> **A:** Don't forget your passport.  
> **B:** It's in my bag.

> **A:** Does she need to bring heavy bags?  
> **B:** No. She doesn't need to.

Cambia solo los objetos: fijas ***need to / don't need to***.

---

## 10b. Plantillas para copiar

1. I need to pack my \_\_\_\_ tonight.  
2. You need to take your \_\_\_\_.  
3. I don't need to take so many \_\_\_\_.  
4. She doesn't need to bring \_\_\_\_.  
5. Only essential items.  
6. Don't forget your passport and toothbrush.

### Más frases para memorizar

> I need to pack my suitcase tonight.  
> You need to take your passport.  
> She doesn't need to bring so many clothes.  
> We need to take toiletries.  
> They don't need to pack heavy bags.  
> Do you need to pack today?  
> Only essential items.  
> Don't forget your passport and toothbrush.  
> My suitcase is small.  
> My flight is tomorrow.  
> I need to take clothes – shirts, trousers, underwear.  
> I need to take toiletries too – toothbrush, soap, shampoo.  
> I don't need to take so many things.  
> Passport and ticket are in my bag.  
> Yes. I need to pack my suitcase.  
> No. I don't need to take so many.  
> I won't. They are in my bag.

Lee la lista dos veces. Luego escribe **tu** checklist de maleta.

### Rutina de 2 minutos

1. Di 4 frases *I need to…*.  
2. Di 3 con *don't need to / doesn't need to*.  
3. Lista toiletries: *toothbrush, soap, shampoo*.  
4. Cierra con *Only essential items*.

### Combinar U41 + U49

| Unidad | Aporta | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| U41 | aeropuerto | You **must** show your passport. |
| **U49** | maleta | I **need to** take my passport. |

### Mini-historia para reescribir

> I need to pack my suitcase tonight. My flight is tomorrow. I need to take clothes – shirts, trousers, underwear. I need to take toiletries too – toothbrush, soap, shampoo. I don't need to take so many things – only essential items. My suitcase is small. Passport and ticket are in my bag.

Cambia ropa y toiletries; mantén *need to / don't need to*.

### Tour guiado (modelo)

> I need to pack my suitcase tonight. My flight is tomorrow. I need to take clothes – shirts, trousers, underwear. I need to take toiletries too – toothbrush, soap, shampoo. I don't need to take so many things – only essential items. My suitcase is small. Passport and ticket are in my bag.

Grábate leyéndolo. Luego improvisa con **tu** viaje.

### Frases extra para practicar en voz alta

> Do you need to pack today?  
> I need to pack my suitcase.  
> I need to take clothes.  
> I don't need to take so many.  
> Don't forget your passport.  
> Only essential items.

Personaliza con tu destino y clima (U44/U45).

### Checklist mental

- *need to + base verb*  
- *don't / doesn't need to*  
- Vocab: suitcase · clothes · toiletries · essential items  
- No olvides: passport · toothbrush  
- Tip: maleta pequeña = fewer things

### Mapa rápido

| Unidad | Enfoque |
| :--- | :--- |
| U48 | Sightseeing |
| **U49** | Packing — need to |
| U50 | Module 5 Review |

---

## 11. Ejercicios prácticos (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — Completa *need to / don't need to / doesn't need to*

1. I \_\_\_\_ pack my suitcase tonight.  
2. You \_\_\_\_ take your passport.  
3. She \_\_\_\_ bring so many clothes.  
4. We \_\_\_\_ take toiletries.  
5. They \_\_\_\_ pack heavy bags for one week.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **need to**  
2. **need to**  
3. **doesn't need to**  
4. **need to**  
5. **don't need to**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Elige el vocabulario

1. bag for travel → \_\_\_\_  
2. soap, toothbrush, shampoo → \_\_\_\_  
3. things you really need → \_\_\_\_  
4. put clothes in a suitcase → \_\_\_\_  
5. for cleaning teeth → \_\_\_\_

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **suitcase**  
2. **toiletries**  
3. **essential items**  
4. **pack**  
5. **toothbrush**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Traduce

1. Necesito hacer la maleta esta noche.  
2. Necesitas llevar tu pasaporte.  
3. No necesito llevar tantas cosas.  
4. Ella no necesita traer tanta ropa.  
5. Solo cosas esenciales.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **I need to pack my suitcase tonight.**  
2. **You need to take your passport.**  
3. **I don't need to take so many things.**  
4. **She doesn't need to bring so many clothes.**  
5. **Only essential items.**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Ordena

1. pack / to / need / I / my suitcase  
2. need / don't / I / so many / to / take  
3. toiletries / to / need / We / take  
4. passport / your / forget / Don't

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **I need to pack my suitcase.**  
2. **I don't need to take so many.**  
3. **We need to take toiletries.**  
4. **Don't forget your passport.**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Reading corto

Lee el texto de la sección 6. Contesta:

1. When does the writer pack?  
2. When is the flight?  
3. What clothes?  
4. What toiletries?  
5. Where are passport and ticket?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Tonight**  
2. **Tomorrow**  
3. **Shirts, trousers, underwear**  
4. **Toothbrush, soap, shampoo**  
5. **In my bag**
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Corrige el error

1. I need pack my suitcase.  
2. She don't need to take so many clothes.  
3. I need to packing tonight.  
4. You need to to take your passport.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **I need to pack my suitcase.**  
2. **She doesn't need to take so many clothes.**  
3. **I need to pack tonight.**  
4. **You need to take your passport.**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Escribe tu packing list

Escribe 8–10 frases. Incluye:

- *need to* (3 veces) y *don't need to* (1–2)  
- *suitcase, clothes, toiletries*  
- *passport*  
- *essential items*

**Modelo:** el texto de la sección 6.

### Ejercicio 8 — Elige la opción correcta

1. I need \_\_\_\_ pack tonight. (to / — / too)  
2. She \_\_\_\_ need to bring so many clothes. (doesn't / don't / isn't)  
3. We need to take \_\_\_\_. (toiletries / toiletrying / toilet)  
4. Only \_\_\_\_ items. (essential / essentially / essence)  
5. Don't forget your \_\_\_\_. (passport / packing / square)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **to**  
2. **doesn't**  
3. **toiletries**  
4. **essential**  
5. **passport**
</details>

---

## 12. Plan de práctica (15 minutos)

1. **3 min** — Di 5 frases *I need to…*.  
2. **3 min** — Di 4 con *don't/doesn't need to*.  
3. **4 min** — Reescribe el reading con tu viaje.  
4. **5 min** — Mini-diálogo *Do you need to pack…?*

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *need to + base verb*  
- [ ] Distingo *don't* / *doesn't need to*  
- [ ] Conozco suitcase / clothes / toiletries  
- [ ] Hablo de *essential items*  
- [ ] Recuerdo passport y toothbrush

---

## 13. Consejos para practicar

1. **Lista real:** escribe 8 objetos de tu maleta con *I need to take…*.  
2. **Pareja:** uno sugiere cosas de más; el otro responde *I don't need to…*.  
3. **Combina** U41: *I need to take my passport. At the airport I must show it.*  
4. Prepárate para la [Unidad 50](/curso-a1/unit-50): *Module 5 Review* (Places & Travel).  
5. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 49](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-49-maleta-need-to-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 49 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-49).

---

## Resumen rápido

| Tema | Lo esencial |
| :--- | :--- |
| Necesidad | need to + base verb |
| No necesario | don't / doesn't need to |
| Maleta | suitcase · pack · clothes |
| Aseo | toiletries · toothbrush · soap · shampoo |
| Tip | only essential items |
| No olvides | passport · ticket |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A1

Practica ahora:

En la **Unidad 50** harás el **repaso del Módulo 5** (*Places & Travel*): aeropuerto, transporte, verbos de viaje, clima, estaciones, hotel, vacaciones, sightseeing y packing.

Guía dedicada y curso:

- [Unidad 50 — Repaso Módulo 5](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-50-repaso-modulo-5)

Antes de pasar de unidad, escribe tu checklist de maleta en 6–8 frases.

Guías relacionadas:

faqs.question: ¿Qué repasa la Unidad 50 del curso A1?
faqs.answer: Es el Module 5 Review: aeropuerto (must/should), transporte (by / take the), verbos de viaje, weather (It is…), seasons (in + estación), hotel (Can I have…?), holidays (was/were), sightseeing (superlativos) y packing (need to).

faqs.question: ¿Cuáles son las estructuras clave del Módulo 5?
faqs.answer: You must show your passport; I take the train / go by car; It is sunny; in summer; Can I have a single room?; I was on holiday; the most famous museum; I need to pack my suitcase.

content:
En la [Unidad 49](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-49-maleta-need-to) cerraste el viaje con la maleta. La **Unidad 50 del curso A1** (*Module 5 Review*) consolida todo el **Módulo 5: Places & Travel**. No introduce gramática nueva: **repasa** las unidades 41–49 para que puedas narrar un viaje completo en inglés A1.

Esta guía es un **mapa de repaso** con tablas, checklist, audios y ejercicios. Úsala para detectar huecos y volver a la [unidad concreta](/blog/curso-a1) si algo falla.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 50 — Module 5 Review](/curso-a1/unit-50)  
> **Guías del módulo:** [U41](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-41-aeropuerto-must-should) · [U42](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-42-transporte-by-take-the) · [U44](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-44-tiempo-atmosferico) · [U47](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-47-vacaciones-was-were) · [U48](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-48-sightseeing-superlativos) · [U49](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-49-maleta-need-to)

---

## Qué deberías poder hacer al terminar el Módulo 5

- Usar ***must / should*** en el aeropuerto (*passport, check-in, gate*).
- Elegir bien ***take the*** + tren/bus vs ***go by*** + car/plane.
- Hablar de **horarios** y verbos de viaje (*arrive, leave, depart*).
- Describir el **tiempo**: ***It is*** sunny / rainy / hot / cold.
- Usar ***in*** + estación (*in summer, in winter*).
- Pedir en el **hotel**: ***Can I have…?*** (*single room, key, room service*).
- Hablar de **vacaciones** con ***was / were*** y pasado regular.
- Describir lugares con **superlativos**: ***the most famous***.
- Preparar la **maleta** con ***need to / don't need to***.

---

## Mapa rápido del Módulo 5 (U41–U49)

| U | Tema | Idea clave |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 41 | At the Airport | **must** / **should** · passport · gate |
| 42 | Transport | **take the** train · **go by** car |
| 43 | Travel Verbs | arrive / leave · schedules |
| 44 | The Weather | **It is** sunny / rainy |
| 45 | Seasons | **in** spring / summer / autumn / winter |
| 46 | At the Hotel | **Can I have…?** · reception |
| 47 | Holidays | **was / were** · beach · mountains |
| 48 | Sightseeing | **the most** famous · museum · tour |
| 49 | Packing | **need to** pack · toiletries |

![Mapa Module 5 Review A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-50/a1-unit50-module-map.png)

---

## 1. Aeropuerto: *must / should* (U41)

| Forma | Uso | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **must** | obligación fuerte | You **must** show your passport. |
| **should** | consejo | You **should** go to the gate early. |

Vocabulario: *check-in, boarding pass, gate, luggage, passport, ticket*.

> You must show your passport at check-in.  
> Passengers should go to the gate before boarding.  
> I must have my ticket ready.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-50/must-show-passport.mp3" title="🔊 You must show your passport at check-in"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-50/should-go-gate.mp3" title="🔊 Passengers should go to the gate before boarding"></audio>

Guía: [U41 — At the Airport](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-41-aeropuerto-must-should)

---

## 2. Transporte: *by* / *take the* (U42)

| Patrón | Cuándo | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **take the** + train/bus/metro | transporte público con *the* | I **take the** train to London. |
| **go by** + car/plane/taxi | medio genérico (sin *the*) | We **go by** bus to the airport. |

Regla rápida del curso: *take the train / take the bus*; *go by car / go by plane*.

> I take the train to work.  
> We go by bus to the airport.  
> How did you go to the airport? — I took the bus.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-50/take-the-train.mp3" title="🔊 I take the train to work"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-50/go-by-bus.mp3" title="🔊 We go by bus to the airport"></audio>

Guía: [U42 — Transport](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-42-transporte-by-take-the)

---

## 3. Verbos de viaje y horarios (U43)

| Verbo | Idea | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **arrive** | llegar | The train arrives at 9. |
| **leave / depart** | salir | The bus leaves at 10. |
| **catch** | coger (a tiempo) | I catch the 8 o'clock train. |

Present Simple para horarios fijos: *The flight leaves at 7*.

> The train arrives at nine.  
> The bus leaves at ten.  
> Don't miss your flight.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-50/train-arrives.mp3" title="🔊 The train arrives at nine"></audio>

Guía: [U43 — Travel Verbs](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-43-verbos-viaje-horarios)

---

## 4. El tiempo atmosférico: *It is…* (U44)

Patrón fijo: ***It is*** + adjetivo de clima.

| Clima | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| sunny | It is sunny today. |
| rainy | It is rainy — take an umbrella. |
| hot / cold | It is hot in summer. / It is cold today. |
| cloudy / windy | It is cloudy. / It is windy. |

En pasado del viaje: *The weather **was** sunny* / *It **was** rainy yesterday*.

> It is sunny today.  
> It is rainy today — take an umbrella.  
> The weather was rainy yesterday.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-50/it-is-sunny.mp3" title="🔊 It is sunny today"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-50/weather-was-rainy.mp3" title="🔊 The weather was rainy yesterday"></audio>

Guía: [U44 — The Weather](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-44-tiempo-atmosferico)

---

## 5. Estaciones: *in* + season (U45)

| Estación | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| spring | It is warm **in spring**. |
| summer | It is hot **in summer**. |
| autumn / fall | Leaves fall **in autumn**. |
| winter | It is cold **in winter**. |

Siempre ***in*** + estación (sin artículo en A1): *in summer*, no *\*in the summer* como forma prioritaria del curso.

> It is hot in summer.  
> We go to the beach in summer.  
> It is cold in winter.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-50/hot-in-summer.mp3" title="🔊 It is hot in summer"></audio>

Guía: [U45 — Seasons](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-45-estaciones-in-spring)

---

## 6. En el hotel: *Can I have…?* (U46)

| Petición | Respuesta útil |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Can I have** a single room? | Yes, of course. |
| Can I have the key, please? | Here you are. |
| Can I have room service? | Sure. What would you like? |

Vocabulario: *reception, single room, double room, key, room service, breakfast*.

> Can I have a single room, please?  
> Can I have the key?  
> I was at the hotel for one week.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-50/can-i-single-room.mp3" title="🔊 Can I have a single room, please?"></audio>

Guía: [U46 — At the Hotel](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-46-hotel-can-i-have)

---

## 7. Vacaciones: *was / were* (U47)

Pasado de *to be*:

| Sujeto | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| I / he / she / it | **was** | I **was** on the beach last week. |
| you / we / they | **were** | We **were** in the mountains last year. |

Pregunta: ***Were** you at the hotel last week?* → *Yes, I **was**.*

> I was on the beach last week.  
> We were in the mountains last year.  
> Were you at the hotel last week? — Yes, I was there.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-50/i-was-beach.mp3" title="🔊 I was on the beach last week"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-50/we-were-mountains.mp3" title="🔊 We were in the mountains last year"></audio>

También practicas pasado regular de viaje: *I **visited** the museum* / *I **went** on holiday*.

Guía: [U47 — Holidays](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-47-vacaciones-was-were)

---

## 8. Sightseeing: superlativos (U48)

Patrón A1 prioritario con adjetivos largos: ***the most*** + adjetivo.

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| the most famous | This is **the most famous** monument in the city. |
| the most beautiful | It is **the most beautiful** museum. |
| the biggest / the oldest | (formas cortas también aparecen en el curso) |

Vocabulario: *sightseeing, guided tour, souvenir, museum, monument, statue*.

> This is the most famous monument in the city.  
> I visited the most famous museum.  
> We did sightseeing yesterday.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-50/most-famous-museum.mp3" title="🔊 I visited the most famous museum"></audio>

Guía: [U48 — Sightseeing](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-48-sightseeing-superlativos)

---

## 9. Maleta: *need to / don't need to* (U49)

| Forma | Uso | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **need to** + base | necesario | I **need to** pack my suitcase. |
| **don't need to** | no necesario | I **don't need to** take so many clothes. |
| **doesn't need to** | he/she | She **doesn't need to** bring so many clothes. |

Vocabulario: *suitcase, pack, clothes, toiletries, essential items, passport, toothbrush*.

> I need to pack my suitcase tonight.  
> You need to take your passport.  
> I don't need to take so many things — only essential items.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-50/need-to-pack.mp3" title="🔊 I need to pack my suitcase tonight"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-50/dont-need-so-many.mp3" title="🔊 I don't need to take so many things"></audio>

Guía: [U49 — Packing a Suitcase](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-49-maleta-need-to)

---

## 10. Grammar check del módulo

![Grammar check Module 5 A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-50/a1-unit50-grammar-check.png)

| Estructura | Recuerda |
| :--- | :--- |
| must / should | must = obligación; should = consejo |
| take the / go by | *take the train*; *go by car* |
| It is + weather | It is sunny / rainy |
| in + season | in summer |
| Can I have…? | petición educada en hotel |
| was / were | pasado de *be* |
| the most + adj. | superlativo largo |
| need to + base | necesidad; don't need to = no hace falta |

Errores típicos a evitar:

1. *\*I go by the bus* → **I take the bus** / **I go by bus**.  
2. *\*It are sunny* → **It is sunny**.  
3. *\*We was on holiday* → **We were on holiday**.  
4. *\*most famous museum* (sin *the*) → **the most famous museum**.  
5. *\*I need pack* → **I need to pack**.

---

## 11. Una historia de viaje (todo junto)

Une el módulo en un solo relato —como hace el reading del curso:

> Last month I went on holiday. I took the train to the airport. The weather was sunny. I was at the hotel for one week. I did sightseeing — I visited the most famous museum. I needed to pack my suitcase with clothes and toiletries. I didn't need to take so many things. It was great.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-50/trip-story.mp3" title="🔊 Last month I went on holiday…"></audio>

![Trip story Module 5 A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-50/a1-unit50-trip-story.png)

### Diálogo de repaso

> **A:** How did you go to the airport?  
> **B:** I took the bus. The weather was rainy yesterday.  
> **A:** Were you at the hotel last week?  
> **B:** Yes. I was there. I visited the most famous museum. I need to pack my suitcase tonight.  
> **A:** Don't forget your passport.  
> **B:** I won't.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-50/dialogue-review.mp3" title="🔊 How did you go to the airport?…"></audio>

---

## 12. Vocabulario esencial del módulo (checklist)

| Bloque | Palabras |
| :--- | :--- |
| Aeropuerto | passport, ticket, check-in, boarding pass, gate |
| Transporte | train, bus, car, plane, taxi |
| Clima | sunny, rainy, hot, cold, cloudy, windy |
| Estaciones | spring, summer, autumn, winter |
| Hotel | reception, single room, key, room service |
| Vacaciones | beach, mountains, holiday, last week / last year |
| Turismo | sightseeing, museum, monument, souvenir, guided tour |
| Maleta | suitcase, pack, clothes, toiletries, essential items |

---

## 13. Mini diálogos por escenario

### Aeropuerto

> You must show your passport.  
> You should go to gate number ten.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-50/gate-number-ten.mp3" title="🔊 You should go to gate number ten"></audio>

### Transporte + clima

> I take the train when it is rainy.  
> We go by car in summer.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-50/train-when-rainy.mp3" title="🔊 I take the train when it is rainy"></audio>

### Hotel + sightseeing

> Can I have a map, please?  
> Where is the most famous museum?

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-50/where-famous-museum.mp3" title="🔊 Where is the most famous museum?"></audio>

### Packing

> Do you need to pack today?  
> Yes. I need to pack my suitcase. Don't forget your toothbrush.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-50/do-you-need-pack.mp3" title="🔊 Do you need to pack today?"></audio>

---

## 14. Errores frecuentes del Módulo 5

| Incorrecto | Correcto | Por qué |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| I go by the bus | I take the bus / I go by bus | *the* con *take the*; no con *go by* |
| It are sunny | It is sunny | sujeto *It* + *is* |
| We was at the hotel | We were at the hotel | *we* → *were* |
| most famous museum | the most famous museum | falta *the* |
| I need pack | I need to pack | *need to* + verbo base |
| in the summer (prioridad A1) | in summer | patrón del curso: *in* + season |
| Can I having a room? | Can I have a room? | *have* (base), no *-ing* |

---

## 15. Ejercicios de repaso

### Ejercicio 1 — *must / should*

1. You \_\_\_\_ show your passport at check-in. (obligación)  
2. You \_\_\_\_ go to the gate early. (consejo)  
3. Passengers \_\_\_\_ have their boarding pass ready. (obligación)  
4. You \_\_\_\_ arrive early for your flight. (consejo)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **must**  
2. **should**  
3. **must**  
4. **should**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — *take the* / *go by*

1. I \_\_\_\_ the train to London.  
2. We \_\_\_\_ by bus to the airport.  
3. She \_\_\_\_ the metro every day.  
4. They \_\_\_\_ by car in summer.  
5. Correcto: ____.

a) I go by the bus · b) I take the bus · c) I take bus

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **take**  
2. **go**  
3. **takes**  
4. **go**  
5. **b**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Weather y seasons

1. It \_\_\_\_ sunny today.  
2. It is hot \_\_\_\_ summer.  
3. The weather \_\_\_\_ rainy yesterday.  
4. It is cold \_\_\_\_ winter.  
5. Take an umbrella — it is \_\_\_\_.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **is**  
2. **in**  
3. **was**  
4. **in**  
5. **rainy**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — *was / were* y hotel

1. I \_\_\_\_ on the beach last week.  
2. We \_\_\_\_ in the mountains last year.  
3. \_\_\_\_ you at the hotel last week?  
4. Can I \_\_\_\_ a single room, please?  
5. She \_\_\_\_ at reception yesterday.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **was**  
2. **were**  
3. **Were**  
4. **have**  
5. **was**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Superlativos y *need to*

1. This is \_\_\_\_ most famous monument in the city.  
2. I visited \_\_\_\_ most beautiful museum.  
3. I \_\_\_\_ to pack my suitcase tonight.  
4. I don't \_\_\_\_ to take so many clothes.  
5. She \_\_\_\_ need to bring so many things.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **the**  
2. **the**  
3. **need**  
4. **need**  
5. **doesn't**
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Corrige

1. *I go by the train.*  
2. *It are rainy today.*  
3. *We was on holiday.*  
4. *I visited most famous museum.*  
5. *I need pack my suitcase.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I **take the** train. / I go **by** train.  
2. It **is** rainy today.  
3. We **were** on holiday.  
4. I visited **the** most famous museum.  
5. I need **to** pack my suitcase.
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Empareja unidad y tema

1. U41  
2. U42  
3. U44  
4. U46  
5. U47  
6. U48  
7. U49  

a) Can I have…?  
b) must / should  
c) the most famous  
d) take the / go by  
e) need to pack  
f) It is sunny  
g) was / were

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **b** · 2 → **d** · 3 → **f** · 4 → **a** · 5 → **g** · 6 → **c** · 7 → **e**
</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Completa el texto de viaje

Last month I \_\_\_\_ on holiday. I \_\_\_\_ the train to the airport. The weather \_\_\_\_ sunny. I \_\_\_\_ at the hotel for one week. I visited \_\_\_\_ most famous museum. I \_\_\_\_ to pack my suitcase with clothes and toiletries. I didn't \_\_\_\_ to take so many things.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**went** · **took** · **was** · **was** · **the** · **needed** · **need**
</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Traduce

1. Debes mostrar el pasaporte.  
2. Voy en autobús al aeropuerto.  
3. Hoy hace sol.  
4. Estuve en la playa la semana pasada.  
5. Visité el museo más famoso.  
6. Necesito hacer la maleta esta noche.  
7. ¿Puedo tener una habitación individual?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. You must show your passport.  
2. I go by bus to the airport. / I take the bus to the airport.  
3. It is sunny today.  
4. I was on the beach last week.  
5. I visited the most famous museum.  
6. I need to pack my suitcase tonight.  
7. Can I have a single room?
</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Escribe tu repaso personal

Escribe 10–12 frases que incluyan:

- 1 × *must* o *should*  
- 1 × *take the* y 1 × *go by*  
- 1 × *It is…* (clima) y 1 × *in* + estación  
- 1 × *Can I have…?*  
- 2 × *was / were*  
- 1 × *the most…*  
- 2 × *need to / don't need to*

**Modelo:** el texto de “Last month I went on holiday…” (sección 11).

---

## 16. Plan de repaso (30–40 minutos)

1. **8 min** — Relee el mapa U41–U49 y marca 2 unidades débiles.  
2. **10 min** — Haz los ejercicios 1–6 de esta guía.  
3. **8 min** — Escucha y repite 10 audios de esta página (incluye la historia de viaje).  
4. **8–10 min** — Escribe tu párrafo de viaje personalizado y grábate.

### Checklist final

- [ ] Uso *must/should* en el aeropuerto  
- [ ] Distingo *take the* y *go by*  
- [ ] Describo el clima con *It is…*  
- [ ] Uso *was/were* para vacaciones  
- [ ] Formo *the most* + adjetivo  
- [ ] Preparo la maleta con *need to / don't need to*

---

## 17. Consejos antes del Módulo 6

1. No memorices listas sueltas: **cuenta un viaje** (aeropuerto → transporte → clima → hotel → museo → maleta).  
2. Si fallas solo en *take the / go by*, vuelve a [U42](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-42-transporte-by-take-the).  
3. Si fallas en *was/were*, vuelve a [U47](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-47-vacaciones-was-were).  
4. Si fallas en superlativos, vuelve a [U48](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-48-sightseeing-superlativos).  
5. Si fallas en *need to*, vuelve a [U49](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-49-maleta-need-to).  
6. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 50](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-50-repaso-modulo-5-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 50 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-50).

El Módulo 6 empieza en el supermercado (*At the Supermarket*): plurales, frutas, verduras y pasillos. Llevarás contigo el vocabulario de viaje y la capacidad de narrar experiencias en pasado.

---

## Resumen rápido

| Bloque | Lo esencial |
| :--- | :--- |
| Aeropuerto | must · should · passport · gate |
| Transporte | take the · go by |
| Horarios | arrive · leave · Present Simple |
| Clima | It is sunny / rainy |
| Estaciones | in summer · in winter |
| Hotel | Can I have…? · reception |
| Vacaciones | was · were · last week |
| Turismo | the most famous · sightseeing |
| Maleta | need to · don't need to · toiletries |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A1

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 50 A1 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-50-repaso-modulo-5-ejercicios-soluciones)

Tras el Módulo 5, el curso continúa con el **Módulo 6** (*Shopping & Food*). La siguiente unidad es **At the Supermarket** (plurales, frutas, verduras, carne, pescado).
