title: Superlativos A2: the … -est, the most, in y of
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 6 del curso A2: superlativos con the … -est, the most, the best/worst e in/of, con audios y ejercicios.
description: Aprende superlativos en inglés A2: the tallest, the most beautiful, the best / the worst, e in/of. Guía Unidad 6 con audios y ejercicios.
alt: Esquema de superlativos the -est y the most para inglés A2

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre comparativo y superlativo?
faqs.answer: Comparativo (U5) compara dos: taller than. Superlativo (U6) elige el extremo de un grupo: the tallest in the class / of all my friends.

faqs.question: ¿Cuándo uso -est y cuándo the most?
faqs.answer: Adjetivos cortos: the + -est (the biggest, the hottest). Adjetivos largos: the most + adj (the most beautiful, the most interesting).

faqs.question: ¿Cuándo uso in y cuándo of con superlativos?
faqs.answer: in + lugar (in the world, in the city, in my class). of + grupo (of all my friends, of all the towns).

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es el superlativo de good y bad?
faqs.answer: good → the best. bad → the worst. No uses *the goodest* ni *the baddest*.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 6 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones y en la Unidad 6 del curso A2 de Linguafly: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening, speaking y writing.

content:
En la [Unidad 5](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-5-comparativos-er-more-than) comparaste **dos** cosas (*taller than*). En la **Unidad 6 del curso A2** (*Superlatives*) eliges **el extremo de un grupo**: ***the tallest***, ***the most beautiful***, ***the best*** — con ***in*** / ***of***.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 6 — Superlativos](/curso-a2/unit-6)  
> **Antes:** [U5 — Comparativos](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-5-comparativos-er-more-than)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 6 (A2)

Al terminar esta unidad serás capaz de:

- Formar superlativos cortos: ***the + -est*** (*the biggest, the hottest*).
- Formar superlativos largos: ***the most + adjective***.
- Usar irregulares ***the best*** / ***the worst***.
- Elegir ***in*** (lugar) u ***of*** (grupo).
- Describir tu ciudad o un lugar favorito con varios superlativos.

---

## 1. Comparativo vs superlativo

| Tipo | Idea | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Comparativo (U5) | 2 elementos | Maria is **taller than** me. |
| Superlativo (U6) | 1 entre muchos | He is **the tallest** boy in the school. |

![Superlatives the -est and the most A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-6/a2-unit6-superlatives.png)

---

## 2. Forma: *the … -est* / *the most …*

| Tipo | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Corto | **the** + adj + **-est** | the tallest, the biggest, the hottest |
| Largo | **the most** + adj | the most beautiful, the most interesting |
| Irregular | formas especiales | **the best**, **the worst** |

> Mount Everest is **the highest** mountain in the world.  
> She is **the most intelligent** student in the class.  
> This is **the coldest** day of the year.  
> He is **the tallest** boy in the school.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-6/highest-mountain.mp3" title="🔊 Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-6/most-intelligent.mp3" title="🔊 She is the most intelligent student in the class"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-6/coldest-day.mp3" title="🔊 This is the coldest day of the year"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-6/tallest-boy.mp3" title="🔊 He is the tallest boy in the school"></audio>

---

## 3. Adjetivos cortos frecuentes

| Adjetivo | Superlativo | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| tall | **the tallest** | the tallest building in town |
| big | **the biggest** | the biggest park in town |
| small | **the smallest** | the smallest room in the hotel |
| high | **the highest** | the highest mountain in the world |
| hot | **the hottest** | the hottest month of the year |
| cold | **the coldest** | the coldest month |
| old | **the oldest** | the oldest church in the region |
| fast | **the fastest** | the fastest runner of all the students |
| quiet | **the quietest** | the quietest time |

Ortografía (como en U5): *big → the biggest*, *hot → the hottest*, *happy → the happiest*.

---

## 4. Adjetivos largos: *the most …*

| Adjetivo | Superlativo | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| beautiful | **the most beautiful** | the most beautiful view |
| interesting | **the most interesting** | the most interesting book |
| expensive | **the most expensive** | the most expensive shop |
| delicious | **the most delicious** | the most delicious food |
| peaceful | **the most peaceful** | the most peaceful place |
| intelligent | **the most intelligent** | the most intelligent student |

> This is **the most interesting** book I have ever read.  
> This is **the most beautiful** film I have ever seen.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-6/most-interesting-book.mp3" title="🔊 This is the most interesting book I have ever read"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-6/most-beautiful-film.mp3" title="🔊 This is the most beautiful film I have ever seen"></audio>

(*I have ever…* aparece en ejemplos del curso; el Present Perfect se profundiza más adelante.)

---

## 5. Irregulares: *the best* / *the worst*

| Adjetivo | Superlativo | Incorrecto |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| good | **the best** | *the goodest* |
| bad | **the worst** | *the baddest* |

> This is **the best** film I have ever seen.  
> He is **the worst** of all my friends. *(ejemplo de forma; úsalo con cuidado en contexto real)*  
> The **best** restaurant in town serves the **most delicious** food.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-6/best-film.mp3" title="🔊 This is the best film I have ever seen"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-6/best-restaurant.mp3" title="🔊 The best restaurant in town…"></audio>

---

## 6. *in* vs *of*

| Preposición | Uso | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **in** | lugar / grupo espacial | in the world · in the city · in my class · in town |
| **of** | conjunto / lista | of the year · of all my friends · of all the towns |

![in and of with superlatives A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-6/a2-unit6-in-of-places.png)

> July is the hottest month **of** the year.  
> The main square is the biggest **of** all the towns near.  
> It is the most peaceful place **in** the world.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-6/hottest-month.mp3" title="🔊 July is the hottest month of the year"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-6/biggest-of-towns.mp3" title="🔊 The main square is the biggest of all the towns near"></audio>

---

## 7. Texto modelo: mi pueblo

> My hometown is small but beautiful. It has the oldest church in the region. The main square is the biggest of all the towns near. In summer, July is the hottest month of the year. My grandmother lives in the tallest building in town. She says it is the most beautiful view she has ever seen. The best restaurant in town serves the most delicious food. I think my hometown is the best place in the world!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-6/reading-hometown.mp3" title="🔊 My hometown is small but beautiful…"></audio>

Marca: *the oldest · the biggest · the hottest · the tallest · the most beautiful · the best · the most delicious*.

---

## 8. Listening: el parque favorito

> Hi! Today I want to tell you about my favourite place in the city. It is the biggest park in town. It has the tallest trees I have ever seen. In the centre there is a lake with the most beautiful swans. The best time to visit is early in the morning when it is the quietest. My sister says it is the most peaceful place in the world. I agree!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-6/dialogue-park.mp3" title="🔊 Hi! Today I want to tell you about my favourite place…"></audio>

![Favourite place superlatives A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-6/a2-unit6-favourite-place.png)

---

## 9. Más modelos del curso

> The most beautiful place in my city is the main park. It has the tallest trees and the best view.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-6/beautiful-park.mp3" title="🔊 The most beautiful place in my city…"></audio>

> The coldest month in my country is January. The hottest is August.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-6/coldest-hottest.mp3" title="🔊 The coldest month… The hottest…"></audio>

> My city has the biggest park in the region. The oldest church is in the centre. The best restaurant serves the most delicious food. I think my city is the most beautiful place in the world!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-6/city-summary.mp3" title="🔊 My city has the biggest park…"></audio>

---

## 10. Errores frecuentes

| Incorrecto | Correcto | Por qué |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| the most tall | **the tallest** | corto → *-est* |
| the beautifulest | **the most beautiful** | largo → *the most* |
| the goodest | **the best** | irregular |
| tallest mountain (sin *the*) | **the** tallest mountain | casi siempre *the* |
| the biggest in all my friends | the biggest **of** all my friends | grupo → *of* |
| the hottest month in the year | the hottest month **of** the year | *of the year* (frecuente) |

---

## 11. Mini prácticas orales

1. Di el edificio / persona **the tallest** de tu entorno.  
2. Di **the most beautiful** lugar de tu ciudad.  
3. Di **the best** restaurante o parque.  
4. Une 4–5 superlativos en un mini-texto (como el del pueblo).

> The tallest person in my family is my brother.  
> The best restaurant in my town is called La Luna.  
> It is the most peaceful place in the world.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-6/practice-three.mp3" title="🔊 The tallest person… The best restaurant… the most peaceful place…"></audio>

---

## 12. Ejercicios

### Ejercicio 1 — *-est* o *the most*

1. Mount Everest is \_\_\_\_ mountain in the world. (high)  
2. She is \_\_\_\_ student in the class. (intelligent)  
3. This is \_\_\_\_ day of the year. (cold)  
4. He is \_\_\_\_ boy in the school. (tall)  
5. This is \_\_\_\_ book I have ever read. (interesting)  
6. July is \_\_\_\_ month of the year. (hot)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **the highest** · 2. **the most intelligent** · 3. **the coldest** · 4. **the tallest** · 5. **the most interesting** · 6. **the hottest**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — *best / worst*

1. This is \_\_\_\_ film I have ever seen. (good)  
2. He is \_\_\_\_ of all my friends. (bad)  
3. The \_\_\_\_ restaurant in town serves pizza. (good)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **the best** · 2. **the worst** · 3. **best** (*the best restaurant*)
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — *in* / *of*

1. the tallest building \_\_\_\_ town  
2. the hottest month \_\_\_\_ the year  
3. the biggest \_\_\_\_ all the towns near  
4. the most peaceful place \_\_\_\_ the world  
5. the most intelligent student \_\_\_\_ the class

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **in** · 2. **of** · 3. **of** · 4. **in** · 5. **in**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Empareja

1. big  
2. beautiful  
3. good  
4. bad  
5. old  
6. hot  

a) the hottest · b) the biggest · c) the best · d) the oldest · e) the most beautiful · f) the worst

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **b** · 2 → **e** · 3 → **c** · 4 → **f** · 5 → **d** · 6 → **a**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Completa el texto del pueblo

It has the \_\_\_\_ church in the region. The main square is the \_\_\_\_ of all the towns near. July is the \_\_\_\_ month of the year. She lives in the \_\_\_\_ building in town. It is the \_\_\_\_ beautiful view. The \_\_\_\_ restaurant serves the \_\_\_\_ delicious food. My hometown is the \_\_\_\_ place in the world!

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**oldest** · **biggest** · **hottest** · **tallest** · **most** · **best** · **most** · **best**
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Completa el listening (park)

It is the \_\_\_\_ park in town. It has the \_\_\_\_ trees. There are the \_\_\_\_ beautiful swans. The \_\_\_\_ time to visit is early morning when it is the \_\_\_\_. It is the \_\_\_\_ peaceful place in the world.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**biggest** · **tallest** · **most** · **best** · **quietest** · **most**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Corrige

1. *She is the most tall in the class.*  
2. *This is beautifulest film.*  
3. *This is the goodest restaurant.*  
4. *He is tallest boy in the school.*  
5. *July is the hottest month in the year.*  
6. *the biggest in all my friends*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. She is **the tallest** in the class.  
2. This is **the most beautiful** film.  
3. This is **the best** restaurant.  
4. He is **the** tallest boy in the school.  
5. July is the hottest month **of** the year.  
6. the biggest **of** all my friends
</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Comparativo o superlativo

1. Maria is \_\_\_\_ than me. (tall)  
2. He is \_\_\_\_ boy in the school. (tall)  
3. This book is \_\_\_\_ than that one. (interesting)  
4. This is \_\_\_\_ book I have ever read. (interesting)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **taller** · 2. **the tallest** · 3. **more interesting** · 4. **the most interesting**
</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Traduce

1. Es el edificio más alto del pueblo.  
2. Es el mes más caluroso del año.  
3. Es la iglesia más antigua de la región.  
4. Es el mejor restaurante de la ciudad.  
5. Es el lugar más tranquilo del mundo.  
6. Es la película más bonita que he visto.  
7. Es el parque más grande del pueblo.  
8. Es el estudiante más inteligente de la clase.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. It is the tallest building in town.  
2. It is the hottest month of the year.  
3. It is the oldest church in the region.  
4. It is the best restaurant in the city / in town.  
5. It is the most peaceful / quietest place in the world.  
6. It is the most beautiful film I have ever seen.  
7. It is the biggest park in town.  
8. He/She is the most intelligent student in the class.
</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Escribe tu ciudad / lugar favorito

Escribe 8–12 frases. Incluye:

- 3 × *the … -est*  
- 2 × *the most …*  
- 1 × *the best*  
- *in* y *of* al menos una vez cada uno

**Modelo:** sección 7 (hometown) o sección 8 (park).

---

## 13. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Repasa *-est* vs *the most* y *best/worst*.  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–7.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha el pueblo y el parque; marca cada superlativo.  
4. **5–8 min** — Escribe y graba tu descripción.

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *the* + *-est* con adjetivos cortos  
- [ ] Uso *the most* con adjetivos largos  
- [ ] Recuerdo *the best / the worst*  
- [ ] Distingo *in* (lugar) y *of* (grupo)  
- [ ] Puedo describir mi ciudad con 5+ superlativos

---

## 14. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Si en U5 usaste *-er / more*, aquí pasa a *-est / the most* + **the**.  
2. Memoriza pares: *bigger → the biggest*, *more beautiful → the most beautiful*.  
3. Practica *in the world / in my city / of the year / of all…*.  
4. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 6](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-6-superlativos-est-the-most-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 6 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-6).

La **Unidad 7** entra en **adverbios de modo**: *quickly, slowly, well, badly* y *-ly*.

---

## Resumen rápido

| Caso | Forma |
| :--- | :--- |
| Corto | **the** + adj + **-est** |
| Largo | **the most** + adj |
| good / bad | **the best** / **the worst** |
| Lugar | **in** the city / world |
| Grupo | **of** the year / of all… |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 7** estudiarás **Adverbs of Manner**: *quickly, slowly, well, badly* y la formación con *-ly*.

Guía dedicada y curso:

- [Unidad 7 — Adverbios de modo](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-7-adverbios-modo-ly)
- [Unidad 7 — Adverbios de modo](/curso-a2/unit-7)

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 6 A2 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-6-superlativos-est-the-most-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [Unidad 6 — Superlativos](/curso-a2/unit-6)

Guías relacionadas:

- [Gramática inglesa: guía por niveles](/blog/gramatica/gramatica-inglesa-guia)
- [Inglés en museos y turismo cultural](/blog/viajes/ingles-museos-turismo-cultural)
- [A1 U48 — Sightseeing y superlativos](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-48-sightseeing-superlativos)

---

- CEFR/MCER — Nivel A2: https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages
- Cambridge English — A2 Key: https://www.cambridgeenglish.org/exams-and-tests/key/

title: Adverbios de modo A2: quickly, slowly, well, badly y -ly
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 7 del curso A2: adverbios de modo con -ly, well/badly y excepciones fast/hard, con audios y ejercicios.
description: Aprende adverbios de modo en inglés A2: adjective + -ly, well/badly, fast/hard. Guía Unidad 7 con audios, ortografía y ejercicios.
alt: Esquema de adverbios de modo con -ly para inglés A2

faqs.question: ¿Cómo se forman la mayoría de los adverbios de modo?
faqs.answer: Adjetivo + -ly: quick → quickly, slow → slowly, careful → carefully, beautiful → beautifully.

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es el adverbio de good y bad?
faqs.answer: good → well (She sings well). bad → badly (He played badly). No digas She sings good.

faqs.question: ¿Fast y hard llevan -ly?
faqs.answer: En A2, fast y hard suelen ser iguales como adjetivo y adverbio: He runs fast. He works hard. No uses *fastly*; hardly significa otra cosa (casi no).

faqs.question: ¿Dónde va el adverbio en la frase?
faqs.answer: Suele ir después del verbo (o del objeto): She speaks English fluently. / She answered the question correctly.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 7 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones y en la Unidad 7 del curso A2 de Linguafly: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening, speaking y writing.

content:
En la [Unidad 6](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-6-superlativos-est-the-most) elegiste “el más…”. En la **Unidad 7 del curso A2** (*Adverbs of Manner*) describes **cómo** se hace algo: ***quickly, slowly, carefully, well, badly***.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 7 — Adverbios de modo](/curso-a2/unit-7)  
> **Antes:** [U6 — Superlativos](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-6-superlativos-est-the-most)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 7 (A2)

Al terminar esta unidad serás capaz de:

- Formar adverbios con ***adjective + -ly***.
- Usar excepciones: ***well*** (de *good*), ***badly*** (de *bad*), ***fast***, ***hard***.
- Colocar el adverbio **después del verbo** (o del objeto).
- Contar acciones con *fluently, carefully, beautifully, loudly…*.
- Evitar *\*She sings good* → **She sings well**.

---

## 1. Adjetivo vs adverbio

| Tipo | Pregunta | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Adjetivo** | ¿cómo es? | She is a **careful** driver. |
| **Adverbio** | ¿cómo lo hace? | She drives **carefully**. |

![Adverbs of manner -ly A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-7/a2-unit7-adverbs-manner.png)

Regla prioritaria A2: **adjective + -ly**.

> She runs **quickly**.  
> He speaks **slowly** because he is tired.  
> They work **carefully**.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-7/runs-quickly.mp3" title="🔊 She runs quickly"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-7/speaks-slowly.mp3" title="🔊 He speaks slowly because he is tired"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-7/work-carefully.mp3" title="🔊 They work carefully"></audio>

---

## 2. Tabla de adverbios del curso

| Adjetivo | Adverbio | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| quick | **quickly** | She learned **quickly**. |
| slow | **slowly** | She reads books **slowly**. |
| careful | **carefully** | She writes **carefully**. / She drives **carefully**. |
| correct | **correctly** | She answered the question **correctly**. |
| fluent | **fluently** | She speaks English **fluently**. |
| beautiful | **beautifully** | She sang **beautifully**. |
| quiet | **quietly** | Please speak **quietly** in the library. |
| easy | **easily** | She passed the exam **easily**. |
| loud | **loudly** | The audience clapped **loudly**. |
| patient | **patiently** | The teacher explained **patiently**. |
| happy | **happily** | They danced **happily**. |

> She speaks English fluently.  
> She sang beautifully at the concert.  
> Please speak quietly in the library.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-7/speaks-fluently.mp3" title="🔊 She speaks English fluently"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-7/sang-beautifully.mp3" title="🔊 She sang beautifully at the concert"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-7/speak-quietly.mp3" title="🔊 Please speak quietly in the library"></audio>

---

## 3. Excepciones: *well, badly, fast, hard*

| Adjetivo | Adverbio | Incorrecto típico |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| good | **well** | *She sings good* |
| bad | **badly** | *He played bad* |
| fast | **fast** | *fastly* |
| hard | **hard** | *hardly* (= casi no; otro significado) |

> She sings **well**.  
> He played **badly** in the match.  
> He works **hard** every day.  
> She runs **fast**.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-7/sings-well.mp3" title="🔊 She sings well"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-7/played-badly.mp3" title="🔊 He played badly in the match"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-7/works-hard.mp3" title="🔊 He works hard every day"></audio>

---

## 4. Ortografía de *-ly*

![Spelling -ly A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-7/a2-unit7-spelling-ly.png)

| Regla | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| + **-ly** | quick → quickly · slow → slowly |
| **-y** → **-ily** | happy → happily · easy → easily |
| **-ful** → **-fully** | careful → carefully · beautiful → beautifully |
| **-le** → **-ly** (cuando aplica) | possible → possibly |

---

## 5. Posición en la frase

En A2, el adverbio de modo suele ir:

1. **Después del verbo:** She runs quickly.  
2. **Después del objeto:** She answered the question correctly. / She speaks English fluently.

| Correcto | Menos natural / incorrecto en A2 |
| :--- | :--- |
| She speaks English **fluently**. | *She fluently speaks English* (menos prioritario aquí) |
| She answered **correctly**. | *She correctly answered* (posible, pero el curso prioriza final) |

---

## 6. Texto modelo: Maria

> My friend Maria speaks English very fluently. She learned quickly because she practises every day. She reads books slowly to understand everything well. Last week she sang beautifully at the concert. The audience clapped loudly. Maria also writes carefully and she never makes mistakes. She drives very carefully too. I think she does everything well!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-7/reading-maria.mp3" title="🔊 My friend Maria speaks English very fluently…"></audio>

Marca: *fluently · quickly · slowly · well · beautifully · loudly · carefully · well*.

---

## 7. Listening: clase de baile

> Hi! Yesterday I went to a dance class. The teacher moved very quickly and we had to follow him. At first I danced badly because I couldn't remember the steps. But the teacher explained everything slowly and patiently. Then I practised carefully and by the end I danced well! My friend sang beautifully at the karaoke after. We had a great time!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-7/dialogue-dance.mp3" title="🔊 Hi! Yesterday I went to a dance class…"></audio>

![Dance class adverbs A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-7/a2-unit7-dance-class.png)

Progresión: *quickly → badly → slowly / patiently → carefully → well → beautifully*.

---

## 8. Más modelos del curso

> I speak English slowly but I am learning quickly. I hope to speak fluently one day.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-7/speak-slowly-learn-quickly.mp3" title="🔊 I speak English slowly…"></audio>

> Yesterday I finished my homework quickly. Then I drove slowly to the shop.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-7/homework-drove.mp3" title="🔊 Yesterday I finished my homework quickly…"></audio>

> I study carefully every day. I work hard at my job. I drive slowly in the city. I speak English fluently now. I do everything well!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-7/study-work-drive.mp3" title="🔊 I study carefully every day…"></audio>

---

## 9. Errores frecuentes

| Incorrecto | Correcto | Por qué |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| She sings good. | She sings **well**. | *good* → *well* |
| He played bad. | He played **badly**. | adverbio *-ly* / *badly* |
| She runs quick. | She runs **quickly**. | falta *-ly* |
| He works hardly. | He works **hard**. | *hardly* ≠ *hard* |
| She speaks fluent English. *(si quieres adverbio)* | She speaks English **fluently**. | adverbio de modo |
| She carefully writes. *(prioridad A2)* | She writes **carefully**. | posición final |

---

## 10. Mini prácticas orales

1. Di cómo hablas inglés (*slowly / fluently / carefully*).  
2. Di cómo estudias o trabajas (*hard / carefully / quickly*).  
3. Cuenta un momento: *At first I … badly. Then I … carefully. Finally I … well.*

> She runs quickly.  
> She sings well.  
> He played badly.  
> They work carefully.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-7/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 She runs quickly… She sings well…"></audio>

---

## 11. Ejercicios

### Ejercicio 1 — Forma el adverbio

1. She runs \_\_\_\_. (quick)  
2. He speaks \_\_\_\_ because he is tired. (slow)  
3. They work \_\_\_\_. (careful)  
4. She answered the question \_\_\_\_. (correct)  
5. He speaks \_\_\_\_ English. (fluent)  
6. Please speak \_\_\_\_ in the library. (quiet)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **quickly** · 2. **slowly** · 3. **carefully** · 4. **correctly** · 5. **fluently** · 6. **quietly**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — *well / badly / hard / fast*

1. She sings \_\_\_\_. (good)  
2. He played \_\_\_\_ in the match. (bad)  
3. He works \_\_\_\_ every day. (hard)  
4. She runs \_\_\_\_. (fast)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **well** · 2. **badly** · 3. **hard** · 4. **fast**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Empareja

1. quick  
2. careful  
3. beautiful  
4. good  
5. bad  
6. happy  

a) carefully · b) well · c) quickly · d) happily · e) badly · f) beautifully

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **c** · 2 → **a** · 3 → **f** · 4 → **b** · 5 → **e** · 6 → **d**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Completa el texto de Maria

Maria speaks English very \_\_\_\_. She learned \_\_\_\_. She reads books \_\_\_\_ to understand everything \_\_\_\_. She sang \_\_\_\_. The audience clapped \_\_\_\_. She writes \_\_\_\_ and drives \_\_\_\_. She does everything \_\_\_\_!

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**fluently** · **quickly** · **slowly** · **well** · **beautifully** · **loudly** · **carefully** · **carefully** · **well**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Completa el listening

The teacher moved very \_\_\_\_. At first I danced \_\_\_\_. He explained everything \_\_\_\_ and \_\_\_\_. I practised \_\_\_\_ and by the end I danced \_\_\_\_! My friend sang \_\_\_\_.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**quickly** · **badly** · **slowly** · **patiently** · **carefully** · **well** · **beautifully**
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Corrige

1. *She sings good.*  
2. *He played bad.*  
3. *She runs quick.*  
4. *He works hardly every day.* *(si quieres “con esfuerzo”)*  
5. *She speaks fluent.* *(como adverbio de modo)*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. She sings **well**.  
2. He played **badly**.  
3. She runs **quickly**.  
4. He works **hard** every day.  
5. She speaks **fluently**. / She speaks fluent English. *(adjetivo + noun)*
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Adjetivo o adverbio

1. She is a \_\_\_\_ driver. (careful)  
2. She drives \_\_\_\_. (careful)  
3. He is a \_\_\_\_ student. (good)  
4. He studies \_\_\_\_. (good → well)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **careful** · 2. **carefully** · 3. **good** · 4. **well**
</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Elige la correcta

1. ____  
   a) She speaks English fluent. · b) She speaks English fluently. · c) She speaks English fluentlyly.  
2. ____  
   a) He works hard. · b) He works hardly. · c) He works hardily. *(esfuerzo)*  
3. Most adverbs of manner add: ____  
   a) -ing · b) -ed · c) -ly

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **b** · 2. **a** · 3. **c**
</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Traduce

1. Ella corre rápido.  
2. Él habla despacio.  
3. Ella canta bien.  
4. Él jugó mal.  
5. Trabajan con cuidado.  
6. Habla inglés con fluidez.  
7. Por favor, habla bajo en la biblioteca.  
8. El profesor explicó todo con paciencia.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. She runs quickly. / She runs fast.  
2. He speaks slowly.  
3. She sings well.  
4. He played badly.  
5. They work carefully.  
6. She/He speaks English fluently.  
7. Please speak quietly in the library.  
8. The teacher explained everything patiently.
</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Escribe tu día con adverbios

Escribe 8–12 frases. Incluye:

- 4 × adverbios con *-ly*  
- 1 × *well*  
- 1 × *badly* o *hard* / *fast*  
- un mini-relato *At first… Then… Finally…* (como el baile)

**Modelo:** sección 6 (Maria) o sección 7 (dance class).

---

## 12. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Repasa *-ly* y excepciones *well/badly/fast/hard*.  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–7.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha a Maria y la clase de baile; repite los adverbios.  
4. **5–8 min** — Escribe y graba tu párrafo.

### Checklist

- [ ] Formo adverbios con *-ly*  
- [ ] Uso *well* (no *good*) con verbos  
- [ ] Distingo *hard* y *hardly*  
- [ ] Coloco el adverbio tras el verbo/objeto  
- [ ] Puedo contar una actividad con 5+ adverbios

---

## 13. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Pregunta: ¿describo **la cosa** (adjetivo) o **la acción** (adverbio)?  
2. Lista de 10: *quick, slow, careful, quiet, easy, beautiful, fluent, loud, patient, happy* → di el adverbio.  
3. Grábate diciendo: *I study carefully. I speak slowly. I want to speak fluently.*  
4. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 7](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-7-adverbios-modo-ly-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 7 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-7).

La **Unidad 8** entra en **preposiciones de tiempo**: *at, on, in*.

---

## Resumen rápido

| Caso | Forma |
| :--- | :--- |
| Regla general | adj + **-ly** |
| good / bad | **well** / **badly** |
| fast / hard | **fast** / **hard** (sin *-ly*) |
| Posición | tras verbo / objeto |
| Ortografía | happily · carefully · easily |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 8** estudiarás **Prepositions of Time**: *at* (hora), *on* (días/fechas), *in* (meses/años/partes del día).

Curso:

- [Unidad 8 — Preposiciones de tiempo](/curso-a2/unit-8)

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 7 A2 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-7-adverbios-modo-ly-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [Unidad 7 — Adverbios de modo](/curso-a2/unit-7)

Guías relacionadas:

- [Gramática inglesa: guía por niveles](/blog/gramatica/gramatica-inglesa-guia)

---

title: Preposiciones de tiempo A2: at, on, in (horas, días y periodos)
author: linguafly-team

alt: Esquema at on in para preposiciones de tiempo en inglés A2

faqs.question: ¿Cuándo uso at en inglés?
faqs.answer: Con horas y momentos concretos: at 7 o'clock, at noon, at midnight, at night, at the weekend (British English).

faqs.question: ¿Cuándo uso on?
faqs.answer: Con días y fechas: on Monday, on Saturday morning, on the 15th of March, on weekdays.

faqs.question: ¿Cuándo uso in?
faqs.answer: Con periodos más largos: in August, in 1990, in summer, in the morning / in the afternoon / in the evening.

faqs.question: ¿Es in the night o at night?
faqs.answer: Para “por la noche” en general se usa at night. Con partes del día: in the morning, in the afternoon, in the evening (no *at the morning*).

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 8 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones y en la Unidad 8 del curso A2 de Linguafly: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening, speaking y writing.

content:
En la [Unidad 7](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-7-adverbios-modo-ly) describiste **cómo** se hace algo. En la **Unidad 8 del curso A2** (*Prepositions of Time*) dices **cuándo** ocurre: ***at*** (hora), ***on*** (día/fecha), ***in*** (mes, año, parte del día).

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 8 — Preposiciones de tiempo](/curso-a2/unit-8)  
> **Antes:** [U7 — Adverbios de modo](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-7-adverbios-modo-ly)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 8 (A2)

- Usar **at** con horas y momentos (*at 7 o'clock*, *at noon*, *at night*).
- Usar **on** con días y fechas (*on Monday*, *on the 15th of March*).
- Usar **in** con meses, años, estaciones y partes del día (*in August*, *in 1990*, *in the morning*).
- Combinarlas en horarios reales: *On Friday at 3 pm* / *at 8 o'clock in the morning*.
- Evitar errores típicos: *on 7 o'clock*, *in Monday*, *at August*.

![Preposiciones de tiempo at on in A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-8/a2-unit8-prepositions-time.png)

---

## 1. La regla en una frase

Piensa en el **tamaño** del tiempo:

| Preposición | Tipo de tiempo | Ejemplos |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **at** | punto concreto (hora / momento) | *at 7 o'clock*, *at noon*, *at midnight*, *at night* |
| **on** | día / fecha | *on Monday*, *on Saturday*, *on the 15th of March* |
| **in** | periodo más amplio | *in August*, *in 1990*, *in summer*, *in the morning* |

![Escala de tiempo at on in](/blog/curso-a2/unit-8/a2-unit8-time-scale.png)

Truco rápido: **hora → at · día → on · mes/año/parte del día → in**.

---

## 2. *At*: horas y momentos

Usa **at** con:

- horas: *at 6 o'clock*, *at 7 am*, *at 3 pm*
- *noon* / *midnight*: *at noon*, *at midnight*
- *night*: *at night*
- fin de semana (British): *at the weekend*
- expresiones fijas: *at Christmas*, *at the moment* (cuando las veas en el curso)

> I get up **at** 7 o'clock every morning.  
> The film starts **at** midnight.  
> I have lunch **at** noon.  
> I sleep **at** night.  
> **At** the weekend I relax.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-8/at-seven.mp3" title="🔊 I get up at 7 o'clock every morning"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-8/at-midnight.mp3" title="🔊 The film starts at midnight"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-8/at-noon.mp3" title="🔊 I have lunch at noon"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-8/at-night.mp3" title="🔊 I sleep at night"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-8/at-the-weekend.mp3" title="🔊 At the weekend I relax"></audio>

| Correcto | Incorrecto típico |
| :--- | :--- |
| at 7 o'clock | *on 7 o'clock* / *in 7 o'clock* |
| at noon | *in noon* |
| at night | *in the night* (en A2 prioriza *at night*) |

---

## 3. *On*: días y fechas

Usa **on** con:

- días de la semana: *on Monday*, *on Friday*
- partes concretas de un día: *on Saturday morning*, *on Monday evening*
- fechas: *on the 15th of March*, *on 12 May*
- *weekdays* / *weekends* (según variedad): *on weekdays*; en AmE a menudo *on the weekend*

> I have a meeting **on** Monday.  
> My birthday is **on** the 15th of March.  
> **On** weekdays I start work at 9 o'clock.  
> **On** Saturday I sleep until 10 o'clock.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-8/on-monday.mp3" title="🔊 I have a meeting on Monday"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-8/on-fifteenth.mp3" title="🔊 My birthday is on the 15th of March"></audio>

En español dices “el lunes”; en inglés no traduzcas *the* con el día: **on Monday** (no *in the Monday*).

---

## 4. *In*: meses, años, estaciones y partes del día

Usa **in** con:

- meses: *in January*, *in August*, *in December*
- años: *in 1990*, *in 2024*
- estaciones: *in summer*, *in winter*
- partes del día: *in the morning*, *in the afternoon*, *in the evening*

> We go on holiday **in** August.  
> I was born **in** 1990.  
> We go to the beach **in** summer.  
> We meet **in** the morning.  
> **In** the afternoon I have meetings.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-8/in-august.mp3" title="🔊 We go on holiday in August"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-8/in-1990.mp3" title="🔊 I was born in 1990"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-8/in-summer.mp3" title="🔊 We go to the beach in summer"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-8/in-the-morning.mp3" title="🔊 We meet in the morning"></audio>

Excepción importante: **at night** (no *in the night* como forma básica A2). El resto de partes del día va con **in the…**.

| Parte del día | Preposición |
| :--- | :--- |
| morning | **in** the morning |
| afternoon | **in** the afternoon |
| evening | **in** the evening |
| night | **at** night |

---

## 5. Combinar *at*, *on* e *in*

En horarios reales suelen aparecer **dos** preposiciones:

> I have breakfast **at** 8 o'clock **in** the morning.  
> The meeting is **on** Friday **at** 3 pm.  
> **On** Monday and Wednesday I go to work **at** 8 o'clock **in** the morning.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-8/breakfast-morning.mp3" title="🔊 I have breakfast at 8 o'clock in the morning"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-8/meeting-friday.mp3" title="🔊 The meeting is on Friday at 3 pm"></audio>

Orden natural: **día (*on*) → hora (*at*) → periodo (*in*)** cuando hace falta.

---

## 6. Texto modelo: la semana de Tom

> My name is Tom and I have a busy week. On Monday and Wednesday I go to work at 8 o'clock in the morning. On Tuesday I have a meeting at noon. On Friday I finish early at 3 pm and I go to the gym. At the weekend I relax. On Saturday morning I sleep until 10 o'clock. In the afternoon I meet my friends. In summer I go on holiday in August.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-8/reading-tom.mp3" title="🔊 My name is Tom and I have a busy week…"></audio>

![Horario semanal con at on in](/blog/curso-a2/unit-8/a2-unit8-weekly-schedule.png)

Marca: *On Monday… at 8… in the morning · at noon · at 3 pm · At the weekend · On Saturday morning · In the afternoon · In summer · in August*.

---

## 7. Listening: un día típico

> Hi! I want to tell you about my typical day. I wake up at 6 o'clock in the morning. I have breakfast at 7 am. On weekdays I start work at 9 o'clock. I have lunch at noon. In the afternoon I have meetings. On Saturday I sleep until 10 o'clock and I meet my friends in the evening. In December I go on holiday for two weeks.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-8/dialogue-typical-day.mp3" title="🔊 Hi! I want to tell you about my typical day…"></audio>

Preguntas rápidas (respóndete en voz alta):

1. ¿A qué hora se despierta? → *at 6 o'clock in the morning*  
2. ¿Cuándo empieza a trabajar? → *On weekdays… at 9 o'clock*  
3. ¿Cuándo va de vacaciones? → *In December*

---

## 8. Más frases del curso

> We go to the beach in summer.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-8/beach-summer.mp3" title="🔊 We go to the beach in summer"></audio>

> I wake up at 6 o'clock. I work on Monday. I was born in 1990. We meet in the morning.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-8/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 I wake up at 6 o'clock…"></audio>

---

## 9. Errores frecuentes

| Incorrecto | Correcto | Por qué |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| I have dinner on 7 o'clock. | I have dinner **at** 7 o'clock. | hora → *at* |
| I wake up in 6 o'clock. | I wake up **at** 6 o'clock. | hora → *at* |
| The meeting is in Monday. | The meeting is **on** Monday. | día → *on* |
| We go on holiday at August. | We go on holiday **in** August. | mes → *in* |
| I was born on 1990. | I was born **in** 1990. | año → *in* |
| We meet at the morning. | We meet **in** the morning. | parte del día → *in the…* |
| I sleep in night. | I sleep **at** night. | excepción: *at night* |

---

## 10. Mini prácticas orales

1. Di a qué hora te levantas y desayunas (*at…*).  
2. Di dos cosas de tu semana (*on Monday… / on Saturday…*).  
3. Di un mes, un año o una estación (*in…*).  
4. Cuenta tu mañana: *I wake up at… in the morning. On weekdays I…*

> I wake up at 6 o'clock.  
> I work on Monday.  
> I was born in 1990.  
> We meet in the morning.

---

## 11. Ejercicios

### Ejercicio 1 — Elige *at / on / in*

1. I get up ____ 7 o'clock every morning.  
2. I have a meeting ____ Monday.  
3. We go on holiday ____ August.  
4. The film starts ____ midnight.  
5. My birthday is ____ the 15th of March.  
6. I was born ____ 1990.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **at** · 2. **on** · 3. **in** · 4. **at** · 5. **on** · 6. **in**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Partes del día y momentos

1. We meet ____ the morning.  
2. I have lunch ____ noon.  
3. I sleep ____ night.  
4. In the afternoon I have meetings. *(¿correcto?)*  
5. ____ the weekend I relax. (British)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **in** · 2. **at** · 3. **at** · 4. **Sí** (*in the afternoon*) · 5. **At**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Empareja

1. 7 o'clock  
2. Monday  
3. August  
4. noon  
5. the 15th of March  
6. summer  
7. the morning  
8. night  

a) on · b) at · c) in · d) at · e) on · f) in · g) in · h) at  

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **b/d/h (*at*)** · 2 → **a/e (*on*)** · 3 → **c/f/g (*in*)** · 4 → **at** · 5 → **on** · 6 → **in** · 7 → **in** · 8 → **at**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Completa el texto de Tom

____ Monday and Wednesday I go to work ____ 8 o'clock ____ the morning. ____ Tuesday I have a meeting ____ noon. ____ Friday I finish early ____ 3 pm. ____ the weekend I relax. ____ summer I go on holiday ____ August.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**On** · **at** · **in** · **On** · **at** · **On** · **at** · **At** · **In** · **in**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Completa el listening

I wake up ____ 6 o'clock ____ the morning. I have breakfast ____ 7 am. ____ weekdays I start work ____ 9 o'clock. I have lunch ____ noon. ____ the afternoon I have meetings. ____ Saturday I sleep until 10. ____ December I go on holiday.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**at** · **in** · **at** · **On** · **at** · **at** · **In** · **On** · **In**
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Corrige

1. *I have dinner on 7 o'clock.*  
2. *The meeting is in Friday.*  
3. *We go on holiday at August.*  
4. *I was born on 1990.*  
5. *We meet at the morning.*  
6. *I sleep in night.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I have dinner **at** 7 o'clock.  
2. The meeting is **on** Friday.  
3. We go on holiday **in** August.  
4. I was born **in** 1990.  
5. We meet **in** the morning.  
6. I sleep **at** night.
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Elige la correcta

1. ____  
   a) I wake up on 6 o'clock. · b) I wake up at 6 o'clock. · c) I wake up in 6 o'clock.  
2. ____  
   a) I have a meeting on Monday. · b) I have a meeting in Monday. · c) I have a meeting at Monday.  
3. ____  
   a) We go on holiday at August. · b) We go on holiday on August. · c) We go on holiday in August.  
4. What preposition do we use for days? ____  
   a) at · b) on · c) in  
5. We use *in* for: ____  
   a) months, years and seasons · b) only hours · c) only days

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **b** · 2. **a** · 3. **c** · 4. **b** · 5. **a**
</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Ordena

1. breakfast / I / at / have / 8 / o'clock / in / the / morning  
2. meeting / The / is / on / Friday / at / 3 / pm  
3. go / We / to / the / beach / in / summer

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I have breakfast at 8 o'clock in the morning.  
2. The meeting is on Friday at 3 pm.  
3. We go to the beach in summer.
</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Traduce

1. Me levanto a las 7 en punto.  
2. Tengo una reunión el lunes.  
3. Vamos de vacaciones en agosto.  
4. La película empieza a medianoche.  
5. Mi cumpleaños es el 15 de marzo.  
6. Nací en 1990.  
7. Nos vemos por la mañana.  
8. Por la noche duermo.  
9. El fin de semana me relajo.  
10. La reunión es el viernes a las 3 de la tarde.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I get up / wake up at 7 o'clock.  
2. I have a meeting on Monday.  
3. We go on holiday in August.  
4. The film starts at midnight.  
5. My birthday is on the 15th of March.  
6. I was born in 1990.  
7. We meet in the morning.  
8. I sleep at night.  
9. At the weekend I relax. / I relax at the weekend.  
10. The meeting is on Friday at 3 pm.
</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Escribe tu semana

Escribe 8–12 frases. Incluye:

- 3 × **at** (hora / noon / night / weekend)  
- 3 × **on** (días o fechas)  
- 3 × **in** (mes, año, parte del día o estación)  
- al menos una combinación: *on… at…* o *at… in the…*

**Modelo:** sección 6 (Tom) o sección 7 (typical day).

---

## 12. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Repasa la tabla *at / on / in* y la excepción *at night*.  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–7.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha a Tom y el día típico; repite las preposiciones en voz alta.  
4. **5–8 min** — Escribe y graba tu párrafo de la semana.

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *at* con horas, *noon*, *midnight*, *night*  
- [ ] Uso *on* con días y fechas  
- [ ] Uso *in* con meses, años, estaciones y *the morning/afternoon/evening*  
- [ ] Combino *on Friday at 3 pm* / *at 8 in the morning*  
- [ ] Evito *on 7 o'clock* e *in Monday*

---

## 13. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Pregunta siempre: ¿es **hora**, **día** o **periodo**?  
2. Lista de 12: *7 o'clock, Monday, August, noon, night, morning, 1990, summer, Friday, midnight, weekend, December* → di la preposición.  
3. Grábate: *I wake up at… On Monday I… In summer I…*  
4. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 8](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-8-preposiciones-tiempo-at-on-in-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 8 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-8).

La **Unidad 9** entra en **preposiciones de lugar y movimiento**: *in, on, at, into, out of, through…*

---

## Resumen rápido

| Caso | Preposición |
| :--- | :--- |
| Hora / noon / midnight / night | **at** |
| Día / fecha | **on** |
| Mes / año / estación / morning–evening | **in** |
| Fin de semana (BrE) | **at** the weekend |
| Combinación típica | **on** Friday **at** 3 pm |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 9** estudiarás **Prepositions of Place & Movement**: posición (*in, on, at, under, behind*) y movimiento (*to, from, into, out of, through, across*).

Guía blog:

- [Unidad 9 — Preposiciones de lugar y movimiento (*into, out of, through, across*)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-9-preposiciones-lugar-movimiento)

Curso:

- [Unidad 9 — Preposiciones de lugar y movimiento](/curso-a2/unit-9)

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 8 A2 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-8-preposiciones-tiempo-at-on-in-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [Unidad 8 — Preposiciones de tiempo](/curso-a2/unit-8)

Guías relacionadas:

- [Gramática inglesa: guía por niveles](/blog/gramatica/gramatica-inglesa-guia)
- [A1 U12 — Días de la semana](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-12-dias-semana)
- [A1 U19 — Meses, fechas y cumpleaños](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-19-meses-fechas-cumpleanos)
- [Inglés A2: guía del nivel](/blog/metodos/ingles-a2)

---

## Fuentes

- CEFR/MCER — Nivel A2: https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages
- Cambridge English — A2 Key: https://www.cambridgeenglish.org/exams-and-tests/key/
- British Council — Prepositions of time: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/grammar/a1-a2-grammar/prepositions-time-at-in-on

title: Preposiciones de lugar y movimiento A2: into, out of, through, across
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 9 del curso A2: preposiciones de lugar y movimiento into, out of, through y across, con audios y ejercicios.
description: Aprende into, out of, through y across en inglés A2: entrar, salir y cruzar. Guía Unidad 9 con audios, esquemas y ejercicios.
alt: Esquema into out of through across para inglés A2

faqs.question: ¿Qué significa into?
faqs.answer: Movimiento hacia dentro: She went into the room. I put the books into my bag. Entra desde fuera hacia el interior.

faqs.question: ¿Qué significa out of?
faqs.answer: Movimiento hacia fuera: He ran out of the building. He got out of the car. Sales desde el interior hacia fuera.

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre through y across?
faqs.answer: through = a través del interior de algo (park, forest, tunnel, rooms). across = de un lado al otro de una superficie (street, bridge, river, road).

faqs.question: ¿Se dice go in o go into?
faqs.answer: Ambos pueden expresar entrada, pero en A2 el curso prioriza go into para movimiento claro hacia el interior: She went into the room.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 9 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones y en la Unidad 9 del curso A2 de Linguafly: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening, speaking y writing.

content:
En la [Unidad 8](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-8-preposiciones-tiempo-at-on-in) dijiste **cuándo**. En la **Unidad 9 del curso A2** (*Prepositions of Place & Movement*) describes **dónde te mueves**: ***into***, ***out of***, ***through***, ***across***.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 9 — Preposiciones de lugar y movimiento](/curso-a2/unit-9)  
> **Antes:** [U8 — Preposiciones de tiempo](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-8-preposiciones-tiempo-at-on-in)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 9 (A2)

- Usar **into** para entrar / meter algo dentro.
- Usar **out of** para salir / sacar algo fuera.
- Usar **through** para atravesar el *interior* de un espacio.
- Usar **across** para cruzar una *superficie* (calle, puente, río).
- Distinguir *through* vs *across* y evitar *She went in the room* cuando quieres marcar movimiento claro.

![Preposiciones de movimiento into out of through across](/blog/curso-a2/unit-9/a2-unit9-prepositions-movement.png)

---

## 1. Lugar vs movimiento (repaso rápido)

Antes de las cuatro estrellas de la unidad, recuerda:

| Tipo | Idea | Ejemplos A2 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Lugar** (dónde estás) | posición | *in* the room · *on* the table · *at* the door · *under* the bed · *behind* the sofa |
| **Movimiento** (hacia dónde vas) | dirección / trayectoria | *into* · *out of* · *through* · *across* · *to* · *from* |

Esta unidad se centra en el **movimiento**: no solo “estoy en…”, sino “entro / salgo / atravieso / cruzo…”.

---

## 2. La regla en una frase

| Preposición | Movimiento | Imagen mental |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **into** | fuera → **dentro** | entrar en una habitación / meter en una bolsa |
| **out of** | dentro → **fuera** | salir de un edificio / bajarse del coche |
| **through** | de un lado al otro **por dentro** | parque, bosque, túnel, salas |
| **across** | de un lado al otro **por encima / sobre superficie** | calle, puente, río, patio |

Truco: **into / out of** = entrar o salir. **through / across** = cruzar (interior vs superficie).

---

## 3. *Into*: entrar o meter dentro

Usa **into** con movimiento hacia el interior:

> She went **into** the room and closed the door.  
> I put the books **into** my bag.  
> She went **into** the shop to buy bread.  
> I went **into** a cafe.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-9/went-into-room.mp3" title="🔊 She went into the room and closed the door"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-9/put-into-bag.mp3" title="🔊 I put the books into my bag"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-9/went-into-shop.mp3" title="🔊 She went into the shop to buy bread"></audio>

| Correcto (movimiento) | Menos claro / evitar en A2 |
| :--- | :--- |
| She went **into** the room. | *She went in the room.* (el curso prioriza *into*) |
| Put it **into** the bag. | *Put it in the bag* (posible, pero *into* marca movimiento) |

---

## 4. *Out of*: salir o sacar fuera

Usa **out of** con movimiento desde el interior hacia fuera:

> He ran **out of** the building when he heard the fire alarm.  
> He got **out of** the car and walked away.  
> When I came **out of** the park…  
> When I came **out of** the museum…

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-9/ran-out-of.mp3" title="🔊 He ran out of the building…"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-9/got-out-of-car.mp3" title="🔊 He got out of the car and walked away"></audio>

Parejas útiles:

| Entrar | Salir |
| :--- | :--- |
| go **into** the room | come / go / run **out of** the room |
| get **into** the car | get **out of** the car |
| put **into** the bag | take **out of** the bag |

---

## 5. *Through*: a través del interior

Usa **through** cuando pasas **por dentro** de un espacio (hay “volumen” o un interior):

> We walked **through** the park to get to the other side.  
> They drove **through** the tunnel to reach the city.  
> We walked **through** the forest to reach the lake.  
> I walked **through** several rooms.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-9/walked-through-park.mp3" title="🔊 We walked through the park…"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-9/drove-through-tunnel.mp3" title="🔊 They drove through the tunnel…"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-9/walked-through-forest.mp3" title="🔊 We walked through the forest…"></audio>

Piensa: *park · forest · tunnel · rooms · city centre* → a menudo **through**.

---

## 6. *Across*: de un lado al otro (superficie)

Usa **across** cuando cruzas una **superficie** o vas al otro lado de algo plano/línea:

> The cat ran **across** the street to the other side.  
> We swam **across** the river.  
> People were running **across** the bridge.  
> I walked **across** the courtyard.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-9/ran-across-street.mp3" title="🔊 The cat ran across the street…"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-9/swam-across-river.mp3" title="🔊 We swam across the river"></audio>

Piensa: *street · road · bridge · river · courtyard* → a menudo **across**.

---

## 7. *Through* vs *across*

![Through vs across A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-9/a2-unit9-through-vs-across.png)

| | **through** | **across** |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Idea | por el **interior** | por encima / al **otro lado** de una superficie |
| Ejemplos | through the park / forest / tunnel / rooms | across the street / bridge / river / road |
| Pregunta | ¿paso *dentro* de algo? | ¿cruzo una línea o superficie? |

> We walked **through** the park.  
> The cat ran **across** the street.

No digas *walked across the tunnel* si quieres “por dentro del túnel”: usa **through**.

---

## 8. Texto modelo: aventura en la ciudad

> Yesterday I had an adventure in the city. First I went into an old bookshop to buy a book. Then I walked through the park to get to the other side. I saw many people running across the bridge. When I came out of the park I crossed the street and went into a cafe. I had coffee and read my new book. It was a great day!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-9/reading-adventure.mp3" title="🔊 Yesterday I had an adventure in the city…"></audio>

![Aventura en la ciudad con preposiciones](/blog/curso-a2/unit-9/a2-unit9-city-adventure.png)

Marca: *went into · walked through · running across · came out of · went into*.

---

## 9. Listening: el museo

> Hi! Last weekend I went to the museum. I went into the main entrance and walked through several rooms. First I saw the paintings and then I walked across the courtyard to get to the sculpture section. When I came out of the museum I crossed the street and went into a cafe for coffee. I really enjoyed the day!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-9/dialogue-museum.mp3" title="🔊 Hi! Last weekend I went to the museum…"></audio>

Preguntas rápidas:

1. ¿Cómo entra? → *went into the main entrance*  
2. ¿Cómo se mueve dentro? → *walked through several rooms* / *across the courtyard*  
3. ¿Cómo sale? → *came out of the museum*

---

## 10. Mini práctica oral

> She went into the room.  
> He ran out of the building.  
> We walked through the park.  
> The cat ran across the street.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-9/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 She went into the room…"></audio>

1. Di cómo entras en casa / una tienda (*into*).  
2. Di cómo sales del coche / de un edificio (*out of*).  
3. Di un recorrido: *through the park* + *across the street* + *into a cafe*.

---

## 11. Errores frecuentes

| Incorrecto / confuso | Correcto (prioridad A2) | Por qué |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| She went in the room. *(si marcas movimiento)* | She went **into** the room. | *into* = entrar |
| He ran of the building. | He ran **out of** the building. | falta *out* |
| We walked across the tunnel. | We walked / drove **through** the tunnel. | túnel = interior |
| We walked through the street. *(cruzar al otro lado)* | We walked **across** the street. / We crossed the street. | calle = superficie |
| She went into the bridge. | She walked **across** the bridge. | puente se cruza *across* |
| Get out the car. | Get **out of** the car. | *out of* + objeto |

---

## 12. Ejercicios

### Ejercicio 1 — Elige *into / out of / through / across*

1. She went ____ the room and closed the door.  
2. He ran ____ the building when he heard the fire alarm.  
3. We walked ____ the park to get to the other side.  
4. The cat ran ____ the street to the other side.  
5. I put the books ____ my bag.  
6. They drove ____ the tunnel to reach the city.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **into** · 2. **out of** · 3. **through** · 4. **across** · 5. **into** · 6. **through**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — *through* o *across*

1. We walked ____ the forest.  
2. We swam ____ the river.  
3. I walked ____ several rooms.  
4. People were running ____ the bridge.  
5. They drove ____ the tunnel.  
6. The cat ran ____ the road.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **through** · 2. **across** · 3. **through** · 4. **across** · 5. **through** · 6. **across**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Empareja

1. into  
2. out of  
3. through  
4. across  

a) leave a place / vehicle · b) enter · c) over a surface (street, bridge) · d) inside something from one side to the other

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **b** · 2 → **a** · 3 → **d** · 4 → **c**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Completa la aventura

First I went ____ an old bookshop. Then I walked ____ the park. I saw people running ____ the bridge. When I came ____ the park I crossed the street and went ____ a cafe.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**into** · **through** · **across** · **out of** · **into**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Completa el museo

I went ____ the main entrance and walked ____ several rooms. Then I walked ____ the courtyard. When I came ____ the museum I crossed the street and went ____ a cafe.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**into** · **through** · **across** · **out of** · **into**
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Corrige

1. *She went in the room.* *(movimiento claro)*  
2. *He ran of the building.*  
3. *We walked across the tunnel.*  
4. *We walked through the street to the other side.* *(cruzar la calle)*  
5. *Get out the car.*  
6. *She went into the bridge.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. She went **into** the room.  
2. He ran **out of** the building.  
3. We walked / drove **through** the tunnel.  
4. We walked **across** the street. / We crossed the street.  
5. Get **out of** the car.  
6. She walked **across** the bridge.
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Elige la correcta

1. ____  
   a) She went into the room. · b) She went across the room. *(entrar)* · c) She went out of the room. *(entrar)*  
2. ____  
   a) through = over a surface · b) through = inside something; across = over a surface · c) through and across are the same  
3. ____  
   a) He got out of the car. · b) He got into of the car. · c) He got out the car.  
4. We use *across* for: ____  
   a) tunnels · b) roads / bridges / rivers · c) bags

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a** · 2. **b** · 3. **a** · 4. **b**
</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Ordena

1. into / She / the / shop / went / to / buy / bread  
2. out of / He / the / building / ran / when / the / alarm / sounded  
3. through / We / the / forest / walked / to / reach / the / lake

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. She went into the shop to buy bread.  
2. He ran out of the building when the alarm sounded.  
3. We walked through the forest to reach the lake.
</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Traduce

1. Ella entró en la habitación.  
2. Él salió corriendo del edificio.  
3. Caminamos a través del parque.  
4. El gato cruzó la calle.  
5. Puse los libros en mi bolso.  
6. Condujeron por el túnel.  
7. Se bajó del coche.  
8. Nadamos al otro lado del río.  
9. Caminamos a través del bosque.  
10. Entré en un café.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. She went into the room.  
2. He ran out of the building.  
3. We walked through the park.  
4. The cat ran / went across the street. / The cat crossed the street.  
5. I put the books into my bag.  
6. They drove through the tunnel.  
7. He got out of the car.  
8. We swam across the river.  
9. We walked through the forest.  
10. I went into a cafe.
</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Escribe tu recorrido

Escribe 8–12 frases sobre un día en la ciudad. Incluye:

- 2 × **into**  
- 2 × **out of**  
- 2 × **through**  
- 2 × **across**  

**Modelo:** sección 8 (aventura) o sección 9 (museo).

---

## 13. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Repasa la tabla *into / out of / through / across* y *through* vs *across*.  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–7.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha la aventura y el museo; repite las preposiciones.  
4. **5–8 min** — Escribe y graba tu recorrido.

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *into* para entrar / meter  
- [ ] Uso *out of* para salir / bajarme  
- [ ] Uso *through* para interiores (park, tunnel, rooms)  
- [ ] Uso *across* para superficies (street, bridge, river)  
- [ ] Distingo *through* y *across*

---

## 14. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Pregunta: ¿entro, salgo o cruzo? ¿Cruzo por **dentro** o por una **superficie**?  
2. Lista: *room, bag, car, park, forest, tunnel, street, bridge, river, cafe* → di la preposición típica.  
3. Grábate: *I went into… I walked through… I ran across… I came out of…*  
4. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 9](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-9-preposiciones-lugar-movimiento-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 9 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-9).

La **Unidad 10** es el **repaso del Módulo 1**: Past Simple, comparativos, superlativos, adverbios y preposiciones.

---

## Resumen rápido

| Caso | Preposición |
| :--- | :--- |
| Entrar / meter | **into** |
| Salir / sacar / bajarse | **out of** |
| Por el interior | **through** |
| Por una superficie / al otro lado | **across** |
| Posición (repaso) | *in / on / at / under / behind* |

---

title: Rutinas Diarias y la Hora en Inglés (A1): What Time…? y at + Time

faqs.question: ¿Cómo pregunto a qué hora haces algo en inglés?
faqs.answer: What time do you…? Por ejemplo: What time do you get up? What time do you have breakfast? Con he/she: What time does she go to work?

faqs.question: ¿Cómo digo la hora en inglés A1?
faqs.answer: Usa at + hora: at seven o'clock (a las siete en punto), at half past seven (a las siete y media). O'clock = en punto; half past = y media.

faqs.question: ¿Qué preposición uso con la hora?
faqs.answer: At con horas concretas: at seven, at half past nine. In con partes del día: in the morning, in the afternoon, in the evening.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo conjugan get up / have breakfast en Present Simple?
faqs.answer: I/you/we/they get up / have breakfast. He/she/it gets up / has breakfast. En 3.ª persona añade -s (gets, has, goes, finishes).
