![Vocabulario de muebles en inglés A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-22/a1-unit22-furniture.png)

### Tips

- *fridge* = forma corta de *refrigerator*.  
- *sofa* ≈ *couch* (más AmE).  
- *wardrobe* = armario de ropa.  
- Preposiciones: *sit **on** the sofa* · *sleep **in** a bed* · *put clothes **in** the wardrobe*.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-22/i-sit-on-the-sofa.mp3" title="🔊 I sit on the sofa"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-22/there-is-a-bed.mp3" title="🔊 There is a bed and a wardrobe in the bedroom"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-22/the-fridge-is-in.mp3" title="🔊 The fridge is in the kitchen"></audio>

---

## 2. *My* vs *mine* (y el resto)

| Determinante (+ nombre) | Pronombre (solo) |
| :--- | :--- |
| **my** sofa | **mine** |
| **your** chair | **yours** |
| **his** bed | **his** |
| **her** bag | **hers** |
| **our** table | **ours** |
| **their** keys | **theirs** *(intro)* |

**Regla clave:**

- Con nombre → *my / your / her…*  
- Sin nombre → *mine / yours / hers…*

> This is **my** sofa. → This sofa is **mine**.  
> That is **your** chair. → That chair is **yours**.  
> This is **her** bag. → This bag is **hers**.  
> The bed is **his**.  
> That table is **ours**.

![Esquema mine yours his hers en inglés A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-22/a1-unit22-mine-yours.png)

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-22/this-sofa-is-mine.mp3" title="🔊 This sofa is mine"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-22/that-chair-is-yours.mp3" title="🔊 That chair is yours"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-22/the-bed-is-his.mp3" title="🔊 The bed is his"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-22/this-bag-is-hers.mp3" title="🔊 This bag is hers"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-22/that-table-is-ours.mp3" title="🔊 That table is ours"></audio>

### Parejas que más confunden

| ❌ | ✅ |
| :--- | :--- |
| *This is my.* | This is **mine**. / This is **my** sofa. |
| *This is mine sofa.* | This is **my** sofa. / This sofa is **mine**. |
| *This bag is her.* | This bag is **hers**. |
| *Is this pen your?* | Is this pen **yours**? |

*His* no cambia: *his bed* / *The bed is his.*

---

## 3. *Whose…?* e *Is this yours?*

```
Whose + (noun) + is this/that?
Is this + noun + yours/mine/his/hers?
```

| Pregunta | Respuesta |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Whose** is this? | It's **mine**. / It's **hers**. |
| **Whose sofa** is this? | It's **mine**. |
| **Is this pen yours?** | Yes, it's **mine**. / No, it's **his**. |
| Whose keys are these? | They're **ours**. |

![Esquema Whose is this en inglés A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-22/a1-unit22-whose.png)

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-22/whose-is-this.mp3" title="🔊 Whose is this? It's hers"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-22/is-this-pen-yours.mp3" title="🔊 Is this pen yours?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-22/yes-its-mine.mp3" title="🔊 Yes, it's mine"></audio>

---

## 4. Muebles + habitaciones (juntar U21 + U22)

> There is a **bed** and a **wardrobe** in the **bedroom**.  
> There is a **sofa** in the **living room**.  
> The **fridge** is in the **kitchen**.  
> There is a **table** and four **chairs** in the dining room.  
> I sit on the **sofa**. I sleep in the **bed**.

### Texto modelo

> In my bedroom there is a bed, a wardrobe and a lamp. The bed is mine. The desk is also mine.  
> In the living room there is a sofa and a table. The sofa is ours.  
> In the kitchen there is a fridge. Whose fridge is it? It's ours!

---

## 5. Diálogo modelo

> **Ana:** Whose sofa is this?  
> **Luis:** It's mine. And that chair is yours.  
> **Ana:** Nice! Is this bag yours?  
> **Luis:** No, it's hers — Sara's bag.  
> **Ana:** And the bed upstairs?  
> **Luis:** The bed is his. Tom sleeps there.  
> **Ana:** Cool. In my flat there is a sofa in the living room and a fridge in the kitchen.  
> **Luis:** Same here. That table is ours.

---

## 6. Errores típicos de hispanohablantes

| ❌ Incorrecto | ✅ Correcto | Explicación |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| *This is my* | *This is **mine*** | Falta nombre o usa pronombre |
| *This is mine sofa* | *This is **my** sofa* | Con nombre → *my* |
| *This bag is her* | *This bag is **hers*** | Pronombre = *hers* |
| *Is this pen your?* | *Is this pen **yours**?* | Pregunta con *yours* |
| *Whose is this sofa is?* | *Whose sofa is this?* | Orden fijo |
| *I sit in the sofa* | *I sit **on** the sofa* | *on* para sofá/silla |
| *The fridge is on the kitchen* | *The fridge is **in** the kitchen* | *in* la habitación |

---

## 7. Pronunciación útil

| Forma | Tip A1 |
| :--- | :--- |
| **mine / yours** | *yours* suena *yorz*. |
| **hers** | Con *-s* final: *herz*. |
| **whose** | Como *huuz* (/huːz/), no como *who is* escrito raro. |
| **wardrobe** | *WOR-drobe*. |
| **fridge** | Una sílaba: *frij*. |

Escucha los audios de posesivos y repite el par: *This is my sofa* → *This sofa is mine.*

---

## 7b. Mini-diálogos para memorizar

> **A:** Is this chair yours?  
> **B:** Yes, it's mine.  
> **A:** And that bag?  
> **B:** It's hers.

> **A:** Whose bed is this?  
> **B:** It's his.  
> **A:** Whose table is that?  
> **B:** It's ours.

> **A:** Where is the fridge?  
> **B:** It's in the kitchen. There is a table too.

Cambia solo el mueble: fijas *mine/yours/his/hers* sin diálogos largos.

---

## 7c. Plantillas para copiar

1. This is my \_\_\_\_. → This \_\_\_\_ is mine.  
2. That chair is \_\_\_\_. (yours / his / hers)  
3. Whose \_\_\_\_ is this? — It's \_\_\_\_.  
4. There is a \_\_\_\_ in the \_\_\_\_.  
5. Is this \_\_\_\_ yours? — Yes, it's mine.

### Más frases para memorizar

> This sofa is mine.  
> That chair is yours.  
> The bed is his.  
> This bag is hers.  
> That table is ours.  
> Is this pen yours? — Yes, it's mine.  
> Whose is this? — It's hers.  
> There is a bed and a wardrobe in the bedroom.  
> The fridge is in the kitchen.  
> I sit on the sofa.

Lee la lista dos veces. Señala objetos reales en tu casa y di *This … is mine*. Si estudias con alguien, intercambiad *Is this yours?*

### Conexión con Unidad 6

| U6 (determinante) | U22 (pronombre) |
| :--- | :--- |
| This is **my** book. | This book is **mine**. |
| Is this **your** pen? | Is this pen **yours**? |
| **His** name is Tom. | The bag is **his**. |
| **Her** bag is red. | The bag is **hers**. |

No sustituyas una por otra al azar: mira si hay **nombre** después o no.

### Rutina de 2 minutos

1. Nombra 8 muebles.  
2. Di 4 frases *There is a … in the …*.  
3. Di 4 frases *This … is mine/yours/his/hers*.  
4. Pregunta en voz alta: *Whose is this?*

Si lo haces cada día junto a tu escritorio, *mine/yours* deja de mezclarse con *my/your*.

### Mini-juego en casa (muy efectivo)

Señala cinco objetos y di en voz alta la pareja completa:

> This is my lamp. → This lamp is mine.  
> This is my chair. → This chair is mine.  
> This is our table. → This table is ours.

Luego inventa tres frases con *his* y *hers* (hermanos, compañeros, vecinos imaginarios). Ese contraste *my/mine* + *his/hers* es el núcleo gramatical de la unidad.

### Tour de muebles (modelo para imitar)

> Welcome to my flat. In the hall there is a lamp. In the living room there is a sofa and a shelf. The sofa is ours. In the bedroom there is a bed, a wardrobe and a desk. The bed is mine. The desk is mine too. In the kitchen there is a fridge and a table. Whose chair is this? It's yours!

Cambia los posesivos y los muebles a tu realidad. Es un speaking de un minuto perfecto para esta unidad.

---

## 8. Ejercicios prácticos (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — *my/mine, your/yours, her/hers*

1. This is \_\_\_\_ sofa. (my / mine)  
2. This sofa is \_\_\_\_. (my / mine)  
3. Is this pen \_\_\_\_? (your / yours)  
4. This bag is \_\_\_\_. (her / hers)  
5. That is \_\_\_\_ chair. (your / yours)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **my**  
2. **mine**  
3. **yours**  
4. **hers**  
5. **your**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Completa con *mine / yours / his / hers / ours*

1. This sofa is \_\_\_\_. (mío)  
2. That chair is \_\_\_\_. (tuyo)  
3. The bed is \_\_\_\_. (de él)  
4. This bag is \_\_\_\_. (de ella)  
5. That table is \_\_\_\_. (nuestro)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **mine**  
2. **yours**  
3. **his**  
4. **hers**  
5. **ours**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Mueble y habitación

1. bed → \_\_\_\_  
2. sofa → \_\_\_\_  
3. fridge → \_\_\_\_  
4. wardrobe → \_\_\_\_  

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **bedroom**  
2. **living room**  
3. **kitchen**  
4. **bedroom**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Traduce

1. Este sofá es mío.  
2. Esa silla es tuya.  
3. ¿De quién es esto? — Es de ella.  
4. ¿Es este bolígrafo tuyo? — Sí, es mío.  
5. Hay una cama y un armario en el dormitorio.  
6. La nevera está en la cocina.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. This sofa is mine.  
2. That chair is yours.  
3. Whose is this? — It's hers.  
4. Is this pen yours? — Yes, it's mine.  
5. There is a bed and a wardrobe in the bedroom.  
6. The fridge is in the kitchen.
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Corrige

1. *This is my.*  
2. *This is mine sofa.*  
3. *This bag is her.*  
4. *Is this pen your?*  
5. *I sit in the sofa.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. This is **mine**. / This is **my** sofa.  
2. This is **my** sofa. / This sofa is **mine**.  
3. This bag is **hers**.  
4. Is this pen **yours**?  
5. I sit **on** the sofa.
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Empareja

1. Whose is this?  
2. Is this yours?  
3. Where is the fridge?  
4. Where do you sleep?  

a) In a bed / In the bedroom.  
b) It's mine.  
c) Yes, it's mine. / No, it's his.  
d) In the kitchen.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **b** · 2 → **c** · 3 → **d** · 4 → **a**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Escribe sobre tu casa

Escribe 6–8 frases: 4 muebles (dónde están) y 3 posesivos (*mine / ours / his…*).

**Modelo:**

> In my bedroom there is a bed, a wardrobe and a desk. The bed is mine. The desk is mine too. In the living room there is a sofa. The sofa is ours. The fridge is in the kitchen. Whose lamp is this? It's hers!

### Ejercicio 8 — Elige la opción correcta

1. This chair is \_\_\_\_. (my / mine)  
2. That is \_\_\_\_ table. (our / ours)  
3. \_\_\_\_ bag is this? (Who / Whose)  
4. There \_\_\_\_ a lamp on the desk. (is / are)  
5. I sit \_\_\_\_ the sofa. (on / in)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **mine**  
2. **our**  
3. **Whose**  
4. **is**  
5. **on**
</details>

---



### Checklist mental antes del speaking

- ¿Usé *mine/yours/hers* **sin** nombre detrás?  
- ¿Usé *my/your/her* **con** nombre (*my sofa*)?  
- ¿Pregunté con *Whose…?* al menos una vez?  
- ¿Coloqué al menos tres muebles con *There is… in the…*?  
- ¿Evité *This is my* y *This is mine sofa*?

Si marcas sí en todos, tu descripción de casa + posesivos ya está lista para la Unidad 22.



### Un último tip

Cuando dudes entre *my* y *mine*, pregunta: ¿viene un nombre justo después? Si sí → *my*. Si no → *mine*. La misma prueba vale para *your/yours* y *her/hers*. Practícala con diez objetos de tu habitación y el error desaparece en pocos días.
También puedes grabarte haciendo el tour de muebles y escucharlo al día siguiente: si oyes *This is my* solo, corrígelo en el momento a *This is mine* o *This is my sofa*.


## 9. Plan de práctica (15 minutos)

1. **3 min** — Repite los 9 muebles con audio.  
2. **4 min** — Transforma: *This is my X* → *This X is mine* (6 objetos).  
3. **4 min** — Preguntas *Whose…?* / *Is this yours?*  
4. **4 min** — Escribe tu párrafo de muebles + posesivos.

### Checklist

- [ ] Sé bed, sofa, table, chair, fridge, wardrobe…  
- [ ] Distingo *my* / *mine* y *your* / *yours*  
- [ ] Uso *his* y *hers* correctamente  
- [ ] Pregunto *Whose is this?*  
- [ ] Coloco muebles con *There is… in the…*

---

## 10. Consejos para practicar

1. **Etiqueta** 5 objetos en casa: *mine* en un post-it (juego mental).  
2. **Haz fotos** de habitaciones y descríbelas en inglés.  
3. **Combina** con U21: habitación + mueble + adjetivo (*The bedroom is cozy. The bed is mine.*).  
4. Prepárate para la [Unidad 23](/curso-a1/unit-23): más *There is / There are*.  
5. Practica en la [Unidad 22 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-22) o el [cuaderno con soluciones](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-22-muebles-posesivos-mine-yours-ejercicios-soluciones).

---

## Resumen rápido

| Tema | Lo esencial |
| :--- | :--- |
| Muebles | bed, sofa, table, chair, fridge, wardrobe… |
| + nombre | my / your / his / her / our |
| Solo | mine / yours / his / hers / ours |
| Pregunta | Whose is this? Is this yours? |
| Lugar | There is a bed in the bedroom |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A1

En la **Unidad 23** profundizarás en ***There is / There are*** para describir espacios con más precisión.

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 22 A1 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-22-muebles-posesivos-mine-yours-ejercicios-soluciones)

Guía dedicada:

- [Unidad 23 — There is / There are](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-23-there-is-there-are)

Guías relacionadas:

- [Gramática inglesa: guía por niveles](/blog/gramatica/gramatica-inglesa-guia)
- [Inglés A1: guía para empezar](/blog/metodos/ingles-a1)

---

title: There is / There are (A1): afirmativa, negativa y preguntas
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 23 del curso A1: There is/There are en afirmativa, negativa y preguntas, más preposiciones in, on, under, behind. Con audios, esquemas y ejercicios.
description: Aprende There is/There are en inglés A1: afirmativa, negativa, Is there…?, Are there…? y preposiciones in, on, under, behind. Guía Unidad 23 con audios y ejercicios.
alt: Esquema There is There are en inglés nivel A1
keywords: there is a book on the table

faqs.question: ¿Cuándo uso There is y cuándo There are?
faqs.answer: There is + singular (There is a book). There are + plural (There are two chairs). Negativa: There isn't / There aren't. Preguntas: Is there…? / Are there…?

faqs.question: ¿Qué preposiciones practico con There is/are en la Unidad 23?
faqs.answer: In (dentro), on (encima), under (debajo) y behind (detrás). Ejemplo: There is a book on the table. The cat is behind the sofa.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo respondo a Is there…? y Are there…?
faqs.answer: Yes, there is. / No, there isn't. Yes, there are. / No, there aren't. En negativas y preguntas plurales suele aparecer any: Are there any chairs?

faqs.question: ¿There is o It is?
faqs.answer: There is presenta algo en un lugar (There is a lamp on the table). It is describe o identifica (It is big. It is my lamp.).

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 23 del curso A1?
faqs.answer: En la Unidad 23 del curso A1 de Linguafly y en el cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones del blog: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening y writing.

content:
En las [Unidades 21](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-21-habitaciones-casa) y [22](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-22-muebles-posesivos-mine-yours) hablaste de habitaciones y muebles. En la **Unidad 23 del curso A1** (*There is / There are*) aprendes a **decir qué hay** en un sitio, también en **negativa** y **pregunta**, y a situar objetos con ***in, on, under, behind***.

Esta guía profundiza lo que ya viste en [lugares de la ciudad](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-11-lugares-ciudad) y lo aplica a la **casa**. Incluye **audios**, **esquemas** y **ejercicios**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 23 — There is / There are](/curso-a1/unit-23)  
> **Repaso útil:** [Unidad 22 — Muebles](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-22-muebles-posesivos-mine-yours) · [Unidad 11 — Lugares](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-11-lugares-ciudad)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 23 (A1)

Al terminar esta unidad serás capaz de:

- Usar ***There is*** (singular) y ***There are*** (plural).
- Formar negativas: ***There isn't / There aren't***.
- Preguntar: ***Is there…? / Are there…?***.
- Responder: *Yes, there is / No, there aren't…*.
- Situar objetos con ***in, on, under, behind***.

---

## 1. Afirmativa: *There is / There are*

| Forma | Uso | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **There is** | 1 cosa (singular) | There is a book on the table. |
| **There are** | 2+ cosas (plural) | There are two chairs in the room. |

```
There is + a/an + singular
There are + número/plural
```

> There is a window in the room.  
> There is a lamp on the table.  
> There are three books under the bed.  
> There are two pillows on the bed.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-23/there-is-a-book.mp3" title="🔊 There is a book on the table"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-23/there-are-two-chairs.mp3" title="🔊 There are two chairs in the room"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-23/there-is-a-lamp-on.mp3" title="🔊 There is a lamp on the table"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-23/there-are-three-books.mp3" title="🔊 There are three books under the bed"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-23/there-is-a-window.mp3" title="🔊 There is a window in the room"></audio>

![Esquema There is There are afirmativa negativa preguntas A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-23/a1-unit23-there-is-are.png)

### Tip

En habla rápida, *There is* a menudo suena *there's*. En A1 practica primero la forma completa.

---

## 2. Negativa: *There isn't / There aren't*

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **There isn't** (+ singular) | There isn't a pen in my bag. |
| **There aren't** (+ plural) | There aren't any apples. |
| Con incontables | There isn't any milk in the fridge. |

> There isn't a bathroom upstairs.  
> There aren't any chairs in the hall.  
> There isn't any milk in the fridge.

*Any* aparece mucho en **negativas** y **preguntas** (intro A1; más adelante en U25/U53).

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-23/there-isnt-a-pen.mp3" title="🔊 There isn't a pen in my bag"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-23/there-arent-any-apples.mp3" title="🔊 There aren't any apples"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-23/there-isnt-any-milk.mp3" title="🔊 There isn't any milk in the fridge"></audio>

---

## 3. Preguntas: *Is there…? / Are there…?*

| Pregunta | Sí | No |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Is there** a bathroom upstairs? | Yes, **there is**. | No, **there isn't**. |
| **Are there** any chairs? | Yes, **there are**. | No, **there aren't**. |

```
Is there + a/an + singular…?
Are there + (any) + plural…?
```

![Esquema Is there Are there respuestas cortas A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-23/a1-unit23-questions.png)

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-23/is-there-a-bathroom.mp3" title="🔊 Is there a bathroom upstairs?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-23/are-there-any-chairs.mp3" title="🔊 Are there any chairs?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-23/yes-there-is.mp3" title="🔊 Yes, there is"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-23/no-there-isnt.mp3" title="🔊 No, there isn't"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-23/yes-there-are.mp3" title="🔊 Yes, there are"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-23/no-there-arent.mp3" title="🔊 No, there aren't"></audio>

### No confundir con *Do you have…?*

| There is/are | Have |
| :--- | :--- |
| Hay algo en un lugar | Alguien posee algo |
| Is there a sofa in the room? | Do you have a sofa? |
| There is a fridge in the kitchen. | We have a fridge. |

Ambas son útiles; en esta unidad el foco es **existencia en un sitio**.

---

## 4. Preposiciones: *in, on, under, behind*

| Preposición | Significado | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **in** | dentro de | The book is **in** the bag. |
| **on** | encima de | The cup is **on** the table. |
| **under** | debajo de | The ball is **under** the bed. |
| **behind** | detrás de | The cat is **behind** the sofa. |

![Esquema in on under behind inglés A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-23/a1-unit23-prepositions.png)

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-23/in-the-bag.mp3" title="🔊 The book is in the bag"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-23/on-the-table.mp3" title="🔊 The cup is on the table"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-23/under-the-bed.mp3" title="🔊 The ball is under the bed"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-23/behind-the-sofa.mp3" title="🔊 The cat is behind the sofa"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-23/the-bag-is-behind.mp3" title="🔊 The bag is behind the chair"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-23/where-is-the-clock.mp3" title="🔊 Where is the clock? It is on the wall"></audio>

### Combinar *There is/are* + preposición

> There is a pen **on** the desk.  
> There is a book **in** my bag.  
> There are three books **under** the bed.  
> The bag is **behind** the chair.  
> There is a lamp **on** the table.

También: *The book is on the table* (sujeto = el objeto). *There is* presenta; *The book is…* localiza algo ya conocido.

---

## 5. Más ejemplos en contexto (casa)

> In my bedroom there is a bed and a wardrobe. There is a lamp on the desk. There are two pillows on the bed. There isn't a TV in the bedroom.  
> Is there a bathroom upstairs? — Yes, there is.  
> Are there any chairs in the hall? — No, there aren't.  
> The cat is under the table. My bag is behind the sofa. The keys are in the bag.

### Diálogo modelo

> **Ana:** Is there a sofa in your living room?  
> **Luis:** Yes, there is. There is a table too.  
> **Ana:** Are there any chairs?  
> **Luis:** Yes, there are four chairs.  
> **Ana:** Where is your bag?  
> **Luis:** It's behind the chair. And my book is on the table.  
> **Ana:** Is there any milk in the fridge?  
> **Luis:** No, there isn't. There aren't any apples either!

---

## 6. Errores típicos de hispanohablantes

| ❌ Incorrecto | ✅ Correcto | Explicación |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| *There is two chairs* | *There **are** two chairs* | Plural → are |
| *There are a book* | *There **is** a book* | Singular → is |
| *It is a book on the table* (presentar) | *There is a book on the table* | Presentar con *There* |
| *Is there chairs?* | *Are there (any) chairs?* | Plural → Are |
| *There isn't any chairs* | *There **aren't** any chairs* | Plural negativo |
| *The book is in the table* | *The book is **on** the table* | Encima → on |
| *The cat is under of the bed* | *The cat is **under** the bed* | Sin *of* |

---

## 7. Pronunciación útil

| Forma | Tip A1 |
| :--- | :--- |
| **There is / There's** | *There's* = *therz* (contracción). |
| **There are** | A menudo *ther-er* rápido. |
| **Is there…?** | Empieza por *Is*, no por *There*. |
| **under / behind** | *UN-der* · *bi-HAIND*. |
| **any** | *E-ni* /ˈeni/. |

Escucha afirmativa → negativa → pregunta del mismo objeto: *There is a lamp* → *There isn't a lamp* → *Is there a lamp?*

---

## 7b. Mini-diálogos para memorizar

> **A:** Is there a bathroom upstairs?  
> **B:** Yes, there is.  
> **A:** Are there any towels?  
> **B:** No, there aren't.

> **A:** Where is the book?  
> **B:** It's on the table.  
> **A:** And the keys?  
> **B:** They're in the bag.

> **A:** Is there a cat in the room?  
> **B:** Yes — it's under the table!  
> **A:** Oh! And the bag?  
> **B:** Behind the sofa.

Cambia solo el objeto y la preposición: fijas la estructura en minutos.

---

## 7c. Plantillas para copiar

1. There is a \_\_\_\_ on/in/under/behind the \_\_\_\_.  
2. There are \_\_\_\_ \_\_\_\_ in the \_\_\_\_.  
3. There isn't a \_\_\_\_ in the \_\_\_\_.  
4. There aren't any \_\_\_\_.  
5. Is there a \_\_\_\_? — Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.  
6. Are there any \_\_\_\_? — Yes, there are. / No, there aren't.

### Más frases para memorizar

> There is a book on the table.  
> There are two chairs in the room.  
> There isn't a pen in my bag.  
> There aren't any apples.  
> Is there a bathroom upstairs? — Yes, there is.  
> Are there any chairs? — No, there aren't.  
> The book is in the bag.  
> The cup is on the table.  
> The ball is under the bed.  
> The cat is behind the sofa.

Lee la lista dos veces. Luego describe **tu** habitación con 6 frases *There is/are* + 4 preposiciones distintas.

### Mapa rápido U11 → U23

| Unidad | Enfoque |
| :--- | :--- |
| U11 | There is/are en la ciudad (bank, park…) |
| U21–22 | Habitaciones y muebles |
| **U23** | There is/are completo + in/on/under/behind |
| U24 | Más preposiciones de lugar |

### Rutina de 2 minutos

1. Di 3 frases *There is…* y 3 *There are…*.  
2. Di 2 negativas (*isn't / aren't*).  
3. Haz 2 preguntas (*Is there…? / Are there…?*) y respóndelas.  
4. Sitúa 4 objetos: *in / on / under / behind*.

Si lo haces mirando tu escritorio real, el vocabulario y la gramática se unen solos.

### Tour guiado (modelo)

> In my room there is a bed. There is a lamp on the desk. There are three books on the shelf. There isn't a TV. Is there a chair? Yes, there is — behind the desk. My bag is under the bed. The keys are in the bag.

Grábate leyéndolo y luego improvísarlo sin mirar. Ese es el speaking típico de esta unidad.

### Frases extra para practicar en voz alta

> There is a window in the kitchen.  
> There are four chairs around the table.  
> There isn't any milk in the fridge.  
> Are there any pillows on the bed? — Yes, there are.  
> Where is the clock? — It's on the wall.  
> The shoes are under the bed.  
> The car is behind the tree.

Personaliza con tu casa. Cuanto más concreto el lugar, mejor recuerdas la preposición correcta.

### Checklist mental

- Singular → *is / isn't / Is there…?*  
- Plural → *are / aren't / Are there…?*  
- Negativa/pregunta plural → suele ir *any*  
- Encima de superficie → *on* (no *in the table*)  
- Dentro → *in*; debajo → *under*; detrás → *behind*

Si fallas solo en preposiciones, practica con objetos reales 5 minutos; si fallas en *is/are*, vuelve a contar: ¿uno o más?

---

## 8. Ejercicios prácticos (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — *is* o *are*

1. There \_\_\_\_ a book on the table.  
2. There \_\_\_\_ two chairs in the room.  
3. There \_\_\_\_ a window in the kitchen.  
4. There \_\_\_\_ three books under the bed.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **is**  
2. **are**  
3. **is**  
4. **are**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Negativa y pregunta

1. There \_\_\_\_ a pen in my bag. (isn't)  
2. There \_\_\_\_ any apples. (aren't)  
3. \_\_\_\_ there a bathroom upstairs?  
4. \_\_\_\_ there any chairs?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **isn't**  
2. **aren't**  
3. **Is**  
4. **Are**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Preposiciones

1. The book is \_\_\_\_ the bag. (dentro)  
2. The cup is \_\_\_\_ the table. (encima)  
3. The ball is \_\_\_\_ the bed. (debajo)  
4. The cat is \_\_\_\_ the sofa. (detrás)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **in**  
2. **on**  
3. **under**  
4. **behind**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Traduce

1. Hay un libro en la mesa.  
2. Hay dos sillas en la habitación.  
3. No hay un bolígrafo en mi bolso.  
4. ¿Hay un baño arriba? — Sí.  
5. ¿Hay sillas? — No.  
6. El gato está detrás del sofá.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. There is a book on the table.  
2. There are two chairs in the room.  
3. There isn't a pen in my bag.  
4. Is there a bathroom upstairs? — Yes, there is.  
5. Are there any chairs? — No, there aren't.  
6. The cat is behind the sofa.
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Corrige

1. *There is two chairs.*  
2. *There are a book on the desk.*  
3. *Is there any chairs?*  
4. *The book is in the table.*  
5. *There isn't any chairs.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. There **are** two chairs.  
2. There **is** a book on the desk.  
3. **Are** there any chairs?  
4. The book is **on** the table.  
5. There **aren't** any chairs.
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Empareja pregunta y respuesta

1. Is there a lamp?  
2. Are there any apples?  
3. Where is the ball?  
4. Where are the keys?  

a) Under the bed.  
b) Yes, there is.  
c) In the bag.  
d) No, there aren't.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **b** · 2 → **d** · 3 → **a** · 4 → **c**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Escribe tu habitación

Escribe 7–9 frases: qué hay, qué no hay, y 3 ubicaciones con preposiciones distintas.

**Modelo:**

> In my room there is a bed and a desk. There is a lamp on the desk. There are three books on the shelf. There isn't a TV. Is there a chair? Yes, there is — behind the desk. My bag is under the bed. The keys are in the bag.

### Ejercicio 8 — Elige la opción correcta

1. There \_\_\_\_ a fridge in the kitchen. (is / are)  
2. \_\_\_\_ there any pillows on the bed? (Is / Are)  
3. There isn't \_\_\_\_ milk. (a / any)  
4. The shoes are \_\_\_\_ the bed. (under / behind)  
5. Yes, there \_\_\_\_. (is / are) — respuesta a *Is there a sofa?*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **is**  
2. **Are**  
3. **any**  
4. **under**  
5. **is**
</details>

---

## 9. Plan de práctica (15 minutos)

1. **3 min** — 6 frases afirmativas (*is/are*).  
2. **3 min** — 4 negativas + 4 preguntas.  
3. **4 min** — Preposiciones con objetos reales.  
4. **5 min** — Escribe y lee tu descripción de habitación.

### Checklist

- [ ] Sé elegir *There is / There are*  
- [ ] Formo *isn't / aren't*  
- [ ] Pregunto *Is there…? / Are there…?*  
- [ ] Respondo con *there is/are/isn't/aren't*  
- [ ] Uso *in, on, under, behind* con confianza

---

## 10. Consejos para practicar

1. **Foto de habitación:** escribe 8 frases *There is/are*.  
2. **Esconde** un objeto y di dónde está (*under/behind…*).  
3. **Combina** con U22: *There is a sofa in the living room. The sofa is mine.*  
4. Prepárate para la [Unidad 24](/curso-a1/unit-24): más preposiciones de lugar.  
5. Practica en la [Unidad 23 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-23) o el [cuaderno con soluciones](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-23-there-is-there-are-ejercicios-soluciones).

---

## Resumen rápido

| Tema | Lo esencial |
| :--- | :--- |
| Singular | There **is** / isn't · Is there…? |
| Plural | There **are** / aren't · Are there…? |
| Respuestas | Yes, there is/are. No, there isn't/aren't. |
| Preposiciones | in · on · under · behind |
| Tip | *any* en negativas/preguntas (plural/incontable) |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A1

En la **Unidad 24** ampliarás las **preposiciones de lugar** para describir posiciones con más detalle.

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 23 A1 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-23-there-is-there-are-ejercicios-soluciones)

Guía dedicada:

- [Unidad 24 — Preposiciones de lugar (next to, between, in front of, opposite)](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-24-preposiciones-lugar-next-to-between)

Guías relacionadas:

- [Gramática inglesa: guía por niveles](/blog/gramatica/gramatica-inglesa-guia)
- [Preposiciones de movimiento](/blog/gramatica/preposiciones-movimiento-ingles)
- [Inglés A1: guía para empezar](/blog/metodos/ingles-a1)

---

faqs.question: ¿Qué significa next to en inglés?
faqs.answer: Next to significa al lado de / junto a. Ejemplo: The shop is next to the bank. There is a cafe next to the supermarket.

faqs.question: ¿Cuándo uso between?
faqs.answer: Between = entre dos cosas. Suele ir con and: The pharmacy is between the bank and the supermarket. No uses between con una sola cosa.

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre opposite e in front of?
faqs.answer: In front of = delante de (misma zona, de cara al objeto). Opposite = enfrente / al otro lado (a menudo con una calle en medio). The car is in front of the house. The cinema is opposite the park.

faqs.question: ¿Puedo combinar There is/are con estas preposiciones?
faqs.answer: Sí. There is a park next to the library. There are two cafes next to the cinema. There is a bus stop in front of the school.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 24 del curso A1?
faqs.answer: En la Unidad 24 del curso A1 de Linguafly y en el cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones del blog: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening y writing.

content:
En la [Unidad 23](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-23-there-is-there-are) aprendiste a decir **qué hay** (*There is / There are*) y a situar objetos con ***in, on, under, behind***. En la **Unidad 24 del curso A1** (*Prepositions of Place*) amplías el mapa: ***next to, between, in front of, opposite*** para describir el **barrio** y dar ubicaciones más precisas.

Esta guía conecta con [lugares de la ciudad](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-11-lugares-ciudad) y con *There is/are*. Incluye **audios**, **esquemas** y **ejercicios**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 24 — Prepositions of Place](/curso-a1/unit-24)  
> **Repaso útil:** [Unidad 23 — There is / There are](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-23-there-is-there-are) · [Unidad 11 — Lugares](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-11-lugares-ciudad)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 24 (A1)

Al terminar esta unidad serás capaz de:

- Usar ***next to*** (al lado de).
- Usar ***between A and B*** (entre A y B).
- Usar ***in front of*** (delante de).
- Usar ***opposite*** (enfrente / al otro lado).
- Combinar estas preposiciones con ***There is / There are***.
- Describir un **barrio** y responder *Where is…?*

---

## 1. Las cuatro preposiciones clave

| Preposición | Significado | Idea visual | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **next to** | al lado de | A ‖ B | The shop is **next to** the bank. |
| **between** | entre (dos) | A — B — C | The pharmacy is **between** the bank **and** the supermarket. |
| **in front of** | delante de | → objeto | There is a tree **in front of** the house. |
| **opposite** | enfrente / al otro lado | A ↔ calle ↔ B | The cinema is **opposite** the park. |

```
next to + noun
between + noun + and + noun
in front of + noun
opposite + noun
```

![Esquema next to between in front of opposite A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-24/a1-unit24-prepositions.png)

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-24/next-to-the-bank.mp3" title="🔊 The shop is next to the bank"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-24/between-bank-and-supermarket.mp3" title="🔊 The pharmacy is between the bank and the supermarket"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-24/in-front-of-the-house.mp3" title="🔊 There is a tree in front of the house"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-24/opposite-the-park.mp3" title="🔊 The cinema is opposite the park"></audio>

### Tip

*Between* casi siempre necesita **dos puntos de referencia** unidos con ***and***: *between the bank and the library*.

---

## 2. *Next to* — al lado de

*Next to* = *beside* / junto a. Dos cosas **tocan** o están muy cerca en la misma línea.

> The shop is **next to** the bank.  
> My flat is **next to** the cinema.  
> There is a cafe **next to** the supermarket.  
> There are two cafes **next to** the cinema.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-24/flat-next-to-cinema.mp3" title="🔊 My flat is next to the cinema"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-24/there-is-a-cafe-next-to.mp3" title="🔊 There is a cafe next to the supermarket"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-24/two-cafes-next-to.mp3" title="🔊 There are two cafes next to the cinema"></audio>

### No digas

| ❌ | ✅ |
| :--- | :--- |
| *next the bank* | *next **to** the bank* |
| *next of the bank* | *next **to** the bank* |

---

## 3. *Between* — entre A y B

*Between* sitúa algo **en medio de dos** cosas. Estructura fija:

```
between + A + and + B
```

> The pharmacy is **between** the bank **and** the supermarket.  
> The cinema is **between** the park **and** the library.  
> There is a supermarket **between** the pharmacy **and** the library.  
> There are two shops **between** the bank **and** the pharmacy.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-24/pharmacy-between-bank.mp3" title="🔊 The pharmacy is between the bank and the supermarket"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-24/supermarket-between.mp3" title="🔊 There is a supermarket between the pharmacy and the library"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-24/there-are-two-shops-between.mp3" title="🔊 There are two shops between the bank and the pharmacy"></audio>

### Tip para hispanohablantes

En español a veces decimos “entre el banco” sin segundo elemento; en inglés A1 **completa siempre** *A and B*.

---

## 4. *In front of* — delante de

*In front of* = delante, de cara al objeto, **sin** necesariamente cruzar una calle.

> There is a tree **in front of** the house.  
> The bus stop is **in front of** the school.  
> There is a bench **in front of** the tree.  
> The car is **in front of** the house.  
> The library is **in front of** the school.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-24/bus-stop-in-front.mp3" title="🔊 The bus stop is in front of the school"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-24/bench-in-front-of-tree.mp3" title="🔊 There is a bench in front of the tree"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-24/car-in-front-of-house.mp3" title="🔊 The car is in front of the house"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-24/library-in-front-of-school.mp3" title="🔊 The library is in front of the school"></audio>

### Contrario útil (repaso U23)

| Delante | Detrás |
| :--- | :--- |
| **in front of** | **behind** |
| The car is in front of the house. | The car is behind the house. |

---

## 5. *Opposite* — enfrente / al otro lado

*Opposite* = *across from*: dos lugares **se miran**, a menudo con una **calle** o espacio en medio.

> The cinema is **opposite** the park.  
> There is a park **opposite** the library.  
> My school is **opposite** the supermarket.  
> The bus stop is **opposite** the bank.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-24/opposite-the-park.mp3" title="🔊 The cinema is opposite the park"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-24/park-opposite-library.mp3" title="🔊 There is a park opposite the library"></audio>

![Esquema opposite vs in front of A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-24/a1-unit24-opposite-vs-front.png)

### *Opposite* vs *in front of* (el error más frecuente)

| Situación | Preposición | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| El coche está delante de la puerta (misma acera) | **in front of** | The car is in front of the house. |
| El cine está al otro lado de la calle del parque | **opposite** | The cinema is opposite the park. |

No son siempre intercambiables. Si hay **cara a cara** con separación (calle), piensa en ***opposite***.

---

## 6. *There is / There are* + preposición de lugar

En U23 presentabas existencia; aquí **añades ubicación precisa**.

| Estructura | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| There is + singular + prep + lugar | There is a cafe **next to** the supermarket. |
| There are + plural + prep + lugar | There are two cafes **next to** the cinema. |
| Subject + is/are + prep | The cinema **is opposite** the park. |

![There is There are con preposiciones de lugar A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-24/a1-unit24-there-is-place.png)

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-24/there-is-a-cafe-next-to.mp3" title="🔊 There is a cafe next to the supermarket"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-24/neighbourhood-nice.mp3" title="🔊 My neighbourhood is nice. There is a park next to the library"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-24/review-sentence.mp3" title="🔊 The bank is next to the supermarket. The cinema is opposite the park"></audio>

### Dos formas correctas

> **There is** a park next to the library.  
> **The park is** next to the library.

La primera **presenta**; la segunda **localiza** algo ya conocido. Ambas son A1 y útiles.

---

## 7. Vocabulario del barrio (para practicar)

| Inglés | Español |
| :--- | :--- |
| bank | banco |
| pharmacy | farmacia |
| supermarket | supermercado |
| library | biblioteca |
| park | parque |
| cinema | cine |
| cafe / café | café |
| bus stop | parada de autobús |
| school | colegio / escuela |
| shop | tienda |
| flat / apartment | piso |
| neighbourhood / neighborhood | barrio |
| station | estación |

Combínalos con las cuatro preposiciones nuevas + el repaso de U23 (*in, on, under, behind*).

---

## 8. Preguntar y responder: *Where is…?*

```
Where is the + place?
It is / It's + preposition + place.
There is a + place + preposition + place.
```

> **A:** Where is the pharmacy?  
> **B:** It is next to the bank.  
> **A:** Where is the cinema?  
> **B:** It is opposite the park.  
> **A:** Excuse me. Where is the bus stop?  
> **B:** It is in front of the library.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-24/where-is-the-pharmacy.mp3" title="🔊 Where is the pharmacy? It is next to the bank"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-24/where-is-the-cinema.mp3" title="🔊 Where is the cinema? It is opposite the park"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-24/ask-directions.mp3" title="🔊 Excuse me. Where is the bus stop? It is in front of the library"></audio>

### Diálogo modelo (barrio)

> **Ana:** Where is the pharmacy?  
> **Luis:** It’s next to the bank.  
> **Ana:** And the supermarket?  
> **Luis:** There is a supermarket between the pharmacy and the library.  
> **Ana:** Where is the cinema?  
> **Luis:** The cinema is opposite the park. There is a bus stop in front of the library.  
> **Ana:** Perfect. Thanks!

---

## 9. Mapa mental: U23 + U24

| Grupo | Preposiciones | Uso típico |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| U23 (objetos / habitación) | in, on, under, behind | The book is **on** the table. |
| U24 (lugares / barrio) | next to, between, in front of, opposite | The bank is **next to** the shop. |
| Ambas | There is / There are | There is a cafe next to the bank. |

No “sustituyes” U23: **amplías** el kit. En casa usas mucho *in/on/under/behind*; en la calle, *next to/between/opposite/in front of*.

### Texto modelo del curso (reading)

> My neighbourhood is nice. There is a supermarket next to the bank. There is a pharmacy between the bank and the supermarket. There is a park in front of the library. The cinema is opposite the park. I like to walk in the park. There are two cafes next to the cinema. The bus stop is in front of the library.

Léelo en voz alta dos veces. Luego **cierra el texto** y descríbelo con tus palabras.

---

## 10. Errores típicos de hispanohablantes

| ❌ Incorrecto | ✅ Correcto | Explicación |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| *next the bank* | *next **to** the bank* | Falta *to* |
| *between the bank* | *between the bank **and** the shop* | Hacen falta dos referencias |
| *in front the house* | *in front **of** the house* | Falta *of* |
| *opposite of the park* (A1) | *opposite the park* | En A1: *opposite + noun* |
| *The cinema is in front of the park* (si están al otro lado de la calle) | *The cinema is **opposite** the park* | Cara a cara → opposite |
| *There is two cafes next to…* | *There **are** two cafes next to…* | Plural → are |
| *The shops is between…* | *The shops **are** between…* | Sujeto plural |

---

## 11. Pronunciación útil

| Forma | Tip A1 |
| :--- | :--- |
| **next to** | *NEKST-tu* (la *t* de next a menudo se suaviza). |
| **between** | *bi-TWIN* /bɪˈtwiːn/. |
| **in front of** | *in FRUNT əv* (of → sonido suave). |
| **opposite** | *O-pə-zit* /ˈɒpəzɪt/ (UK) · /ˈɑːpəzɪt/ (US). |
| **pharmacy** | *FAR-mə-si*. |
| **neighbourhood** | UK *nei-bə-hud*; US *neighborhood*. |

Practica el contraste: *in front of the house* vs *opposite the park* — cambia solo la preposición y el lugar.

---

## 11b. Mini-diálogos para memorizar

> **A:** Where is the bank?  
> **B:** It’s next to the supermarket.  
> **A:** And the pharmacy?  
> **B:** Between the bank and the supermarket.

> **A:** Is there a park near here?  
> **B:** Yes. There is a park opposite the cinema.  
> **A:** Where is the bus stop?  
> **B:** In front of the library.

> **A:** Where is your flat?  
> **B:** It’s next to the cinema. There are two cafes next to the cinema too!

Cambia solo los nombres de lugares: la estructura se queda fija.

---

## 11c. Plantillas para copiar

1. The \_\_\_\_ is next to the \_\_\_\_.  
2. The \_\_\_\_ is between the \_\_\_\_ and the \_\_\_\_.  
3. There is a \_\_\_\_ in front of the \_\_\_\_.  
4. The \_\_\_\_ is opposite the \_\_\_\_.  
5. Where is the \_\_\_\_? — It’s \_\_\_\_ the \_\_\_\_.  
6. There are \_\_\_\_ \_\_\_\_ next to the \_\_\_\_.

### Más frases para memorizar

> The shop is next to the bank.  
> The pharmacy is between the bank and the supermarket.  
> There is a tree in front of the house.  
> The cinema is opposite the park.  
> There is a cafe next to the supermarket.  
> There are two shops between the bank and the pharmacy.  
> The bus stop is in front of the school.  
> My flat is next to the cinema.  
> There is a park opposite the library.  
> There is a bench in front of the tree.

Lee la lista dos veces. Luego dibuja un **mapa simple** de 6 edificios y descríbelo en inglés.

### Rutina de 2 minutos

1. Di 2 frases con *next to*.  
2. Di 2 frases con *between … and …*.  
3. Di 1 frase con *in front of* y 1 con *opposite*.  
4. Pregunta y responde: *Where is the …?*

Si lo haces con un mapa real de tu barrio (Google Maps o papel), el vocabulario se pega más rápido.

### Tour guiado (modelo)

> In my neighbourhood there is a supermarket next to the bank. There is a pharmacy between the bank and the supermarket. There is a park in front of the library. The cinema is opposite the park. There are two cafes next to the cinema. The bus stop is in front of the library. My flat is next to the cinema.

Grábate leyéndolo y luego improvísalo sin mirar. Ese es el speaking típico de esta unidad.

### Frases extra para practicar en voz alta

> Excuse me. Where is the pharmacy?  
> It’s next to the bank.  
> Is there a cinema near here?  
> Yes. The cinema is opposite the park.  
> Where is the bus stop?  
> It’s in front of the school.  
> There is a supermarket between the pharmacy and the library.  
> My school is opposite the supermarket.

Personaliza con **tu** calle. Cuanto más concreto el lugar, mejor eliges *next to* u *opposite*.

### Checklist mental

- Al lado → *next **to***  
- Entre dos → *between A **and** B*  
- Delante (misma zona) → *in front **of***  
- Enfrente / al otro lado → *opposite*  
- Singular/plural → *There is / There are*  
- Pregunta de ubicación → *Where is…?*

Si fallas solo en *opposite* vs *in front of*, dibuja una calle: si cruzas, suele ser *opposite*.

### Comparación rápida con U23

| Quieres decir… | U23 | U24 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| El libro está encima de la mesa | on the table | — |
| El gato está detrás del sofá | behind the sofa | — |
| El café está al lado del banco | — | next to the bank |
| La farmacia está entre A y B | — | between A and B |
| El coche está delante de la casa | — (o *in front of*) | in front of the house |
| El cine está enfrente del parque | — | opposite the park |

### Mapa rápido del módulo

| Unidad | Enfoque |
| :--- | :--- |
| U11 | Lugares de la ciudad + There is/are intro |
| U21–22 | Casa y muebles |
| U23 | There is/are completo + in/on/under/behind |
| **U24** | next to, between, in front of, opposite |
| U25 | Barrio + *the / a/an / some/any* |

---

## 12. Ejercicios prácticos (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — Elige la preposición

1. The shop is \_\_\_\_ the bank. (al lado)  
2. The pharmacy is \_\_\_\_ the bank and the supermarket. (entre)  
3. There is a tree \_\_\_\_ the house. (delante)  
4. The cinema is \_\_\_\_ the park. (enfrente)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **next to**  
2. **between**  
3. **in front of**  
4. **opposite**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Completa *between*

1. The pharmacy is between the bank \_\_\_\_ the supermarket.  
2. There are two shops between the cafe \_\_\_\_ the library.  
3. The park is between the school \_\_\_\_ the cinema.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **and**  
2. **and**  
3. **and**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — *is* o *are* + preposición

1. There \_\_\_\_ a cafe next to the supermarket.  
2. There \_\_\_\_ two cafes next to the cinema.  
3. The bus stop \_\_\_\_ in front of the school.  
4. My flat \_\_\_\_ next to the cinema.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **is**  
2. **are**  
3. **is**  
4. **is**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Traduce

1. La tienda está al lado del banco.  
2. La farmacia está entre el banco y el supermercado.  
3. Hay un árbol delante de la casa.  
4. El cine está enfrente del parque.  
5. ¿Dónde está la parada? — Delante de la biblioteca.  
6. Hay dos cafés al lado del cine.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. The shop is next to the bank.  
2. The pharmacy is between the bank and the supermarket.  
3. There is a tree in front of the house.  
4. The cinema is opposite the park.  
5. Where is the bus stop? — It’s / It is in front of the library.  
6. There are two cafes next to the cinema.
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Corrige

1. *The shop is next the bank.*  
2. *The pharmacy is between the bank.*  
3. *There is a tree in front the house.*  
4. *There is two cafes next to the cinema.*  
5. *The cinema is opposite of the park.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. The shop is next **to** the bank.  
2. The pharmacy is between the bank **and** the supermarket. (añade el segundo lugar)  
3. There is a tree in front **of** the house.  
4. There **are** two cafes next to the cinema.  
5. The cinema is opposite the park. (*sin of* en A1)
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — *Opposite* u *in front of*

1. El coche está delante de la puerta de mi casa.  
2. El colegio está al otro lado de la calle del parque.  
3. Hay un banco (asiento) delante del árbol.  
4. La estación está enfrente del supermercado (cruzando la calle).

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. The car is **in front of** the house.  
2. The school is **opposite** the park.  
3. There is a bench **in front of** the tree.  
4. The station is **opposite** the supermarket.
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Empareja

1. next to  
2. between  
3. in front of  
4. opposite  

a) enfrente / al otro lado  
b) al lado de  
c) delante de  
d) entre (dos cosas)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **b** · 2 → **d** · 3 → **c** · 4 → **a**
</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Escribe tu barrio

Escribe 8–10 frases sobre tu barrio o un mapa inventado. Usa las **cuatro** preposiciones al menos una vez y combina con *There is/are*.

**Modelo:**

> My neighbourhood is nice. There is a supermarket next to the bank. There is a pharmacy between the bank and the supermarket. There is a park in front of the library. The cinema is opposite the park. There are two cafes next to the cinema. The bus stop is in front of the library. My flat is next to the cinema.

### Ejercicio 9 — Elige la opción correcta

1. The bank is \_\_\_\_ the shop. (next to / between)  
2. The cafe is between the bank \_\_\_\_ the library. (and / or)  
3. There \_\_\_\_ a park opposite the cinema. (is / are)  
4. The car is \_\_\_\_ the house. (in front of / opposite) — delante de la puerta  
5. Where \_\_\_\_ the pharmacy? (is / are)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **next to**  
2. **and**  
3. **is**  
4. **in front of**  
5. **is**
</details>

---

## 13. Plan de práctica (15 minutos)

1. **3 min** — 4 frases *next to* + 4 *between … and …*.  
2. **3 min** — Contraste *in front of* vs *opposite* (dibuja 2 situaciones).  
3. **4 min** — Describe un mapa con *There is/are*.  
4. **5 min** — Diálogo *Where is…?* con un compañero o grabándote.

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *next to* sin olvidar *to*  
- [ ] Completo *between A and B*  
- [ ] Distingo *in front of* y *opposite*  
- [ ] Combino con *There is / There are*  
- [ ] Pregunto y respondo *Where is…?*

---

## 14. Consejos para practicar

1. **Dibuja** 6 edificios en un papel y etiquétalos en inglés.  
2. **Explica** el mapa a alguien: *The X is next to / opposite…*  
3. **Combina** con U23: *There is a lamp on the table. There is a cafe next to the bank.*  
4. Prepárate para la [Unidad 25](/curso-a1/unit-25): *My Neighborhood* (*the / a/an / some/any*).  
5. Practica en la [Unidad 24 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-24) o el [cuaderno con soluciones](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-24-preposiciones-lugar-next-to-between-ejercicios-soluciones).

---

## Resumen rápido

| Preposición | Lo esencial |
| :--- | :--- |
| **next to** | al lado de (+ *to*) |
| **between** | entre A **and** B |
| **in front of** | delante de (+ *of*) |
| **opposite** | enfrente / al otro lado |
| **There is/are** | presenta + ubicación |
| **Where is…?** | pregunta de lugar |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A1

En la **Unidad 25** describirás tu **barrio** con más detalle y practicarás ***the* vs *a/an*** y ***some/any***.

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 24 A1 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-24-preposiciones-lugar-next-to-between-ejercicios-soluciones)

Guía dedicada:

- [Unidad 25 — My Neighborhood (the / a/an / some/any)](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-25-barrio-the-a-an-some-any)

Guías relacionadas:

- [Preposiciones de movimiento](/blog/gramatica/preposiciones-movimiento-ingles)
- [Inglés para viajar](/blog/viajes/ingles-para-viajar)
- [A2 U9 — Preposiciones de lugar y movimiento](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-9-preposiciones-lugar-movimiento)

---

## Fuentes

- CEFR/MCER — Nivel A1: https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages
- British Council — Prepositions of place: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/grammar/a1-a2-grammar/prepositions-place
- British Council — There is / There are: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/grammar/a1-a2-grammar/there-there-are

title: My Neighborhood A1: the vs a/an y some/any
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 25 del curso A1: describe tu barrio con the vs a/an, some/any y lugares como park, supermarket, cinema, library y pharmacy.
description: Aprende a describir tu barrio en inglés A1 con the vs a/an, some/any y vocabulario park, supermarket, cinema, library, pharmacy. Guía Unidad 25 con audios y ejercicios.
alt: Esquema the a an some any para describir el barrio en inglés A1

faqs.question: ¿Cuándo uso a/an y cuándo the en el barrio?
faqs.answer: A/an = primera mención o no específico (There is a supermarket). The = específico o ya conocido (I go to the park every day. We go to the cinema.).

faqs.question: ¿Cuándo uso some y cuándo any?
faqs.answer: Some en afirmativas (There are some shops. I need some milk). Any en negativas y preguntas (There aren't any pharmacies. Are there any cafes?).

faqs.question: ¿Se dice go to the cinema o go to a cinema?
faqs.answer: En A1 es muy frecuente go to the cinema / the park / the supermarket cuando hablas del lugar típico o conocido. Primera mención genérica: There is a cinema opposite the park.

faqs.question: ¿Qué vocabulario de barrio practico en la Unidad 25?
faqs.answer: Park, supermarket, cinema, library, pharmacy, neighbourhood/neighborhood, street, shop, cafe. Combínalo con There is/are y preposiciones de U23–U24.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 25 del curso A1?
faqs.answer: En la Unidad 25 del curso A1 de Linguafly y en el cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones del blog: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening y speaking.

content:
En las [Unidades 23](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-23-there-is-there-are) y [24](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-24-preposiciones-lugar-next-to-between) aprendiste a decir **qué hay** y **dónde está**. En la **Unidad 25 del curso A1** (*My Neighborhood*) unes todo para **describir tu barrio** con precisión: ***the* vs *a/an***, intro de ***some/any***, y vocabulario clave (*park, supermarket, cinema, library, pharmacy*).

Repasas artículos de la [Unidad 4](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-4-articulos-plurales-demostrativos) y lugares de la [Unidad 11](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-11-lugares-ciudad). Incluye **audios**, **esquemas** y **ejercicios**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 25 — My Neighborhood](/curso-a1/unit-25)  
> **Repaso útil:** [Unidad 24 — Preposiciones](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-24-preposiciones-lugar-next-to-between) · [Unidad 23 — There is/are](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-23-there-is-there-are)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 25 (A1)

Al terminar esta unidad serás capaz de:

- Elegir ***a / an / the*** al hablar de lugares del barrio.
- Usar ***some*** (afirmativa) y ***any*** (negativa / pregunta).
- Nombrar y usar: ***park, supermarket, cinema, library, pharmacy***.
- Describir tu *neighbourhood* con *There is/are* + preposiciones.
- Hablar de hábitos: *I go to the park…*, *I buy some food…*.

---

## 1. Vocabulario del barrio

| Inglés | Español | Uso típico |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **neighbourhood** (UK) / **neighborhood** (US) | barrio | My neighbourhood is quiet. |
| **park** | parque | I go to the park every weekend. |
| **supermarket** | supermercado | I buy some food at the supermarket. |
| **cinema** | cine | We watch films at the cinema. |
| **library** | biblioteca | I go to the library to borrow books. |
| **pharmacy** | farmacia | I buy medicine at the pharmacy. |
| **street** | calle | There is a supermarket in the street. |
| **shop / cafe** | tienda / café | There are some shops in my street. |

![Mapa My Neighborhood vocabulario A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-25/a1-unit25-neighborhood.png)

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-25/quiet-neighbourhood.mp3" title="🔊 My neighbourhood is quiet and nice"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-25/park-near-house.mp3" title="🔊 There is a park near my house"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-25/at-the-pharmacy.mp3" title="🔊 I buy medicine at the pharmacy"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-25/like-the-park.mp3" title="🔊 I like the park because it is quiet"></audio>

### Tip

*Pharmacy* (inglés general) ≈ *chemist’s* (UK). En el curso usamos ***pharmacy***.

---

## 2. *A / an* — primera mención

| Forma | Cuándo | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **a** | sonido de **consonante** | There is **a** supermarket near my house. |
| **an** | sonido de **vocal** | There is **an** apple on the table. |

```
There is + a/an + singular (primera mención / no específico)
```

> There is **a** park near my house.  
> There is **a** supermarket in the street.  
> There is **a** cinema opposite the park.  
> There is **a** library next to the school.  
> There is **an** apple on the table.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-25/a-supermarket-near.mp3" title="🔊 There is a supermarket near my house"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-25/an-apple-on-table.mp3" title="🔊 There is an apple on the table"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-25/cinema-opposite-park.mp3" title="🔊 There is a cinema opposite the park"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-25/library-next-to-school.mp3" title="🔊 There is a library next to the school"></audio>

### Importante

No miras la letra escrita sola: miras el **sonido**. *An hour* (suena con vocal), *a university* (suena /juː/).

---

## 3. *The* — específico o conocido

***The*** = el/la/los/las **que conocemos** o que son únicos en el contexto.

> I go to **the** park every day.  
> I want to go to **the** cinema.  
> We watch films at **the** cinema.  
> I need some milk from **the** supermarket.  
> I go to **the** library to borrow books.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-25/go-to-the-park.mp3" title="🔊 I go to the park every day"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-25/go-to-the-cinema.mp3" title="🔊 I want to go to the cinema"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-25/watch-films.mp3" title="🔊 We sometimes watch films at the cinema"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-25/some-milk.mp3" title="🔊 I need some milk from the supermarket"></audio>

![Esquema a an the A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-25/a1-unit25-a-an-the.png)

### Patrón típico del barrio

1. **Presentas** con *a/an*: *There is a park near my house.*  
2. **Luego** usas *the*: *I go to the park every weekend.*

También: *go to the cinema / the supermarket / the library* = el lugar “de siempre” o el tipo de actividad.

---

## 4. *Some* y *any* (intro A1)

| Palabra | Uso A1 | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **some** | afirmativa | There are **some** shops in my street. |
| **any** | negativa | There aren’t **any** pharmacies here. |
| **any** | pregunta | Are there **any** cafes near here? |

```
afirmativa → some
negativa / pregunta → any
```

![Esquema some any A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-25/a1-unit25-some-any.png)

> There are **some** shops in my street.  
> I buy **some** food at the supermarket.  
> I need **some** milk from the supermarket.  
> Are there **any** cafes near here?  
> Do you have **any** bread?  
> There aren’t **any** pharmacies here.  
> There aren’t **any** cafes in this street.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-25/some-shops.mp3" title="🔊 There are some shops in my street"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-25/buy-some-food.mp3" title="🔊 I buy some food at the supermarket"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-25/any-cafes.mp3" title="🔊 Are there any cafes near here?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-25/any-bread.mp3" title="🔊 Do you have any bread?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-25/arent-any-pharmacies.mp3" title="🔊 There aren't any pharmacies here"></audio>

### Tip

*Some/any* van con **plurales** e **incontables** (*milk, bread, food*). Con singular contable sueles usar *a/an*: *There isn’t a pharmacy* (no *any pharmacy* en el modelo A1 del curso; también verás *There isn’t any milk*).

Más adelante (U52–54) profundizarás cuantificadores; aquí basta la regla **afirmativa = some / neg-preg = any**.

---

## 5. Combinar: *There is/are* + artículos + barrio

| Idea | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| Presentar singular | There is **a** park near my house. |
| Presentar plural | There are **some** shops in my street. |
| Negativa singular | There **isn’t a** pharmacy in my street. |
| Negativa plural | There **aren’t any** cafes in this street. |
| Pregunta | Are there **any** cafes near here? |
| Lugar conocido | I go to **the** park every weekend. |

> My neighbourhood is quiet and nice.  
> There is a park near my house. I go there every weekend.  
> There is a supermarket in the street. I buy some food there.  
> There is a cinema opposite the park. We sometimes watch films.  
> There is a library next to the school.  
> There isn’t a pharmacy in my street, but there is one in the next street.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-25/isnt-a-pharmacy.mp3" title="🔊 There isn't a pharmacy in my street"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-25/pharmacy-next-street.mp3" title="🔊 There is a pharmacy in the next street"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-25/describe-neighbourhood.mp3" title="🔊 There is a supermarket in the street. There are some shops near the park"></audio>

### Diálogo modelo

> **Ana:** Is your neighbourhood nice?  
> **Luis:** Yes. It’s quiet. There is a park near my house.  
> **Ana:** Are there any shops?  
> **Luis:** Yes. There are some shops in my street. And there is a supermarket.  
> **Ana:** Is there a pharmacy?  
> **Luis:** There isn’t a pharmacy in my street, but there is one in the next street.  
> **Ana:** And the cinema?  
> **Luis:** It’s opposite the park. We sometimes go to the cinema at the weekend.

---

## 6. Preposiciones + artículos (repaso U24)

Sigue usando *next to, between, in front of, opposite, near* con *a/the*:

> There is a pharmacy **next to** the supermarket.  
> There is a cinema **opposite** the park.  
> There is a library **next to** the school.  
> There is a park **near** my house.  
> There is a supermarket **in** the street.

*Near* = cerca de (ya lo usas mucho en esta unidad).

---

## 7. Errores típicos de hispanohablantes

| ❌ Incorrecto | ✅ Correcto | Explicación |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| *There is supermarket* | *There is **a** supermarket* | Falta artículo |
| *I go to park* | *I go to **the** park* | Lugar conocido / actividad |
| *There are any shops* (afirm.) | *There are **some** shops* | Afirmativa → some |
| *Are there some cafes?* (A1) | *Are there **any** cafes?* | Pregunta → any (regla A1) |
| *There aren’t some pharmacies* | *There aren’t **any** pharmacies* | Negativa → any |
| *There is an supermarket* | *There is **a** supermarket* | /s/ = consonante |
| *I buy the food* (cantidad indefinida) | *I buy **some** food* | Cantidad no exacta |

---

## 8. Pronunciación útil

| Forma | Tip A1 |
| :--- | :--- |
| **a / an / the** | *the* antes de vocal suele sonar *thi*; antes de consonante *thə*. |
| **some / any** | *sam* (débil) · *E-ni*. |
| **neighbourhood** | UK *nei-bə-hud*; US *neighborhood*. |
| **pharmacy** | *FAR-mə-si*. |
| **supermarket** | acento en *SU-* · *super-market*. |
| **cinema** | *SI-nə-mə*. |

Practica el cambio: *There is **a** park* → *I go to **the** park*.

---

## 8b. Mini-diálogos para memorizar

> **A:** Is there a park near your house?  
> **B:** Yes, there is. I go to the park every weekend.  
> **A:** Are there any shops?  
> **B:** Yes. There are some shops in my street.

> **A:** Do you have any bread?  
> **B:** No, I don’t. I need some milk from the supermarket too.  
> **A:** Is there a pharmacy here?  
> **B:** There isn’t a pharmacy in this street.

> **A:** Where is the cinema?  
> **B:** It’s opposite the park.  
> **A:** Let’s go to the cinema!  
> **B:** Good idea.

Cambia solo los lugares: fijas *a/the* y *some/any*.

---

## 8c. Plantillas para copiar

1. There is a \_\_\_\_ near my house.  
2. There are some \_\_\_\_ in my street.  
3. There isn’t a \_\_\_\_ in my street.  
4. There aren’t any \_\_\_\_ here.  
5. Are there any \_\_\_\_ near here?  
6. I go to the \_\_\_\_ every \_\_\_\_.  
7. I buy some \_\_\_\_ at the supermarket.  
8. I need some \_\_\_\_ from the \_\_\_\_.

### Más frases para memorizar

> My neighbourhood is quiet and nice.  
> There is a park near my house.  
> There is a supermarket in the street.  
> There are some shops in my street.  
> There is a cinema opposite the park.  
> There is a library next to the school.  
> There isn’t a pharmacy in my street.  
> There is a pharmacy in the next street.  
> I go to the park every weekend.  
> I buy some food at the supermarket.  
> Are there any cafes near here?  
> There aren’t any pharmacies here.  
> I want to go to the cinema.  
> I like the park because it is quiet.

Lee la lista dos veces. Luego describe **tu** barrio con 8 frases (mínimo: 2 *a/an*, 2 *the*, 1 *some*, 1 *any*).

### Rutina de 2 minutos

1. Di 3 frases *There is a…*.  
2. Di 2 frases *There are some…*.  
3. Di 1 negativa con *any* y 1 pregunta con *any*.  
4. Di 2 hábitos con *the*: *I go to the…*.

Si miras un mapa real de tu calle, eliges *a/the* con más naturalidad.

### Tour guiado (modelo)

> My neighbourhood is quiet and nice. There is a park near my house. I go there every weekend. There is a supermarket in the street. I buy some food there. There is a cinema opposite the park. We sometimes watch films. There is a library next to the school. There isn’t a pharmacy in my street, but there is one in the next street. There are some shops near the park.

Grábate leyéndolo y luego improvísalo sin mirar. Ese es el speaking típico de esta unidad.

### Frases extra para practicar en voz alta

> Excuse me. Are there any cafes near here?  
> Yes. There are some cafes next to the cinema.  
> Where is the library?  
> It’s next to the school.  
> I need some milk from the supermarket.  
> Do you have any bread?  
> There aren’t any pharmacies in this street.  
> Let’s go to the park!

Personaliza con tu ciudad. Cuanto más concreto, mejor decides entre *a* y *the*.

### Checklist mental

- Primera mención singular → *a/an*  
- Conocido / específico / “el de siempre” → *the*  
- Afirmativa (cantidad) → *some*  
- Negativa / pregunta → *any*  
- Singular negativo de lugar → *There isn’t a…*  
- Plural negativo → *There aren’t any…*

### Mapa rápido U4 → U25

| Unidad | Enfoque |
| :--- | :--- |
| U4 | *a/an*, plurales, *this/that* |
| U11 | Lugares + *There is/are* intro |
| U23–24 | Existencia + preposiciones |
| **U25** | Barrio + *the/a/an* + *some/any* |
| U26 | Direcciones (imperativos) |

### Repaso exprés 21–25

Antes de U26, recuerda también:

- Habitaciones (U21) y muebles / *mine/yours* (U22).  
- *There is/are* + *in/on/under/behind* (U23).  
- *next to / between / in front of / opposite* (U24).  
- Descripción de barrio con artículos y *some/any* (U25).

---

## 9. Ejercicios prácticos (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — *a / an / the*

1. There is \_\_\_\_ supermarket near my house.  
2. There is \_\_\_\_ apple on the table.  
3. I go to \_\_\_\_ park every day.  
4. I want to go to \_\_\_\_ cinema.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a**  
2. **an**  
3. **the**  
4. **the**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — *some* o *any*

1. There are \_\_\_\_ shops in my street.  
2. Are there \_\_\_\_ cafes near here?  
3. There aren’t \_\_\_\_ pharmacies here.  
4. I need \_\_\_\_ milk from the supermarket.  
5. Do you have \_\_\_\_ bread?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **some**  
2. **any**  
3. **any**  
4. **some**  
5. **any**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Vocabulario

1. Lugar con árboles para pasear → \_\_\_\_  
2. Compras comida → \_\_\_\_  
3. Ves películas → \_\_\_\_  
4. Tomas libros prestados → \_\_\_\_  
5. Compras medicina → \_\_\_\_

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **park**  
2. **supermarket**  
3. **cinema**  
4. **library**  
5. **pharmacy**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Traduce

1. Hay un parque cerca de mi casa.  
2. Voy al parque todos los fines de semana.  
3. Hay algunas tiendas en mi calle.  
4. ¿Hay cafés cerca de aquí?  
5. No hay farmacias aquí.  
6. Necesito algo de leche del supermercado.  
7. Quiero ir al cine.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. There is a park near my house.  
2. I go to the park every weekend.  
3. There are some shops in my street.  
4. Are there any cafes near here?  
5. There aren’t any pharmacies here.  
6. I need some milk from the supermarket.  
7. I want to go to the cinema.
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Corrige

1. *There is supermarket near my house.*  
2. *I go to park every day.*  
3. *There are any shops in my street.*  
4. *Are there some cafes near here?* (según regla A1 del curso)  
5. *There aren’t some pharmacies here.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. There is **a** supermarket near my house.  
2. I go to **the** park every day.  
3. There are **some** shops in my street.  
4. Are there **any** cafes near here?  
5. There aren’t **any** pharmacies here.
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Empareja lugar y acción

1. supermarket  
2. pharmacy  
3. library  
4. cinema  
5. park  

a) borrow books  
b) buy medicine  
c) watch films  
d) buy food  
e) walk / play outside

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **d** · 2 → **b** · 3 → **a** · 4 → **c** · 5 → **e**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Escribe tu barrio

Escribe 8–10 frases. Usa:

- al menos 2 × *a/an*  
- al menos 2 × *the*  
- al menos 1 × *some* y 1 × *any*  
- 3 lugares distintos del vocabulario

**Modelo:**

> My neighbourhood is quiet and nice. There is a park near my house. I go to the park every weekend. There is a supermarket in the street. I buy some food there. There is a cinema opposite the park. There is a library next to the school. There isn’t a pharmacy in my street. Are there any cafes near here? Yes — there are some cafes next to the cinema.

### Ejercicio 8 — Elige la opción correcta

1. There is \_\_\_\_ library in the centre. (a / an / the)  
2. I go to \_\_\_\_ cinema at the weekend. (a / the)  
3. There are \_\_\_\_ shops near the park. (some / any)  
4. There aren’t \_\_\_\_ pharmacies in this street. (some / any)  
5. Do you have \_\_\_\_ bread? (some / any)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a**  
2. **the**  
3. **some**  
4. **any**  
5. **any**
</details>

---

## 10. Plan de práctica (15 minutos)

1. **3 min** — 6 frases *There is a…* / *There is an…*.  
2. **3 min** — Cambia a *the*: *I go to the…*.  
3. **4 min** — *some* vs *any* (2 afirmativas, 2 negativas, 2 preguntas).  
4. **5 min** — Escribe y lee tu descripción de barrio.

### Checklist

- [ ] Sé elegir *a / an / the*  
- [ ] Uso *some* en afirmativa  
- [ ] Uso *any* en negativa y pregunta  
- [ ] Conozco park, supermarket, cinema, library, pharmacy  
- [ ] Combino con *There is/are* y preposiciones

---

## 11. Consejos para practicar

1. **Foto o mapa** de tu calle: escribe 10 frases con *a/the/some/any*.  
2. **Grabación** de 45 segundos: *My neighbourhood is…*.  
3. **Combina** U24: *There is a cafe next to the supermarket.*  
4. Prepárate para la [Unidad 26](/curso-a1/unit-26): *Giving Directions* (imperativos).  
5. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 25](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-25-barrio-the-a-an-some-any-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 25 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-25).

---

## Resumen rápido

| Tema | Lo esencial |
| :--- | :--- |
| **a / an** | Primera mención; *an* + sonido vocálico |
| **the** | Específico / conocido / “el de siempre” |
| **some** | Afirmativa |
| **any** | Negativa y pregunta |
| **Vocab** | park · supermarket · cinema · library · pharmacy |
| **Tip** | *There is a park* → *I go to the park* |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A1

En la **Unidad 26** aprenderás a **dar direcciones** con imperativos (*Turn left, Go straight…*).

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 25 A1 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-25-barrio-the-a-an-some-any-ejercicios-soluciones)
